notes: Item 7: "Social with virtually anything they cannot swallow" is rendered as "Bisa hidup bersama hampir semua ikan yang tidak muat ditelannya". This adds "ikan" and narrows the meaning. Use "hampir semua hewan/tankmate yang tidak bisa ditelannya", or similar wording that doesn't restrict it to fish.
Item 6: "crayfish" is translated as "udang air tawar (crayfish)". This is imprecise, because crayfish are lobster air tawar (udang karang). Use "lobster air tawar / crayfish".
Item 10: "Ameiurus means 'curtailed'" is translated as "terpotong". "Curtailed" is better rendered as "terpangkas" or "terpotong pendek". The "deep notch" explanation is fine.
Item 3: "lubuk sungai ... yang dasarnya" reads awkwardly. "pools" would be better as "kolam/lubuk dalam sungai". The sentence is also reordered, so check that "small to large rivers" is still clear.
Item 5: "kayu (log)" is a loose rendering of "larger logs". Use "kayu gelondongan besar" or "batang kayu besar". The English "log" is not needed in brackets.
Item 2: "Atlantic Piedmont" is left in English, and "dataran pantai (Coastal Plain)" is only half-translated. Use "Piedmont Atlantik dan dataran pesisir" consistently.
Item 8: "Females are much fuller bodied" is translated as "tubuh betina jauh lebih gemuk". This is acceptable but could say "lebih bongsor/penuh"; "awal musim semi" is fine.

amia-calva.name: Bowfin
notes: #12: "udang karang (crayfish)" is imprecise. In Indonesian "udang karang" usually means spiny lobster. Use "lobster air tawar (crayfish)" or "crayfish".
#15: "warnanya lebih menarik" for "more colourful" shifts the meaning. Use "warnanya lebih mencolok" or "lebih berwarna".
#8: "akar yang berliuk" is non-standard. Use "akar yang berliku" or "meliuk-liuk".
#18: "ikan lungfish" is left as English. Use "ikan paru-paru (lungfish)".
#1: "predator air beriklim sedang" adds "air". Better "predator dari wilayah beriklim sedang", or say it needs cool water.
#10: The quote marks around "paru-paru" are added and not in the source. Remove them.

ammocryptocharax-elegans.name: Green Darter Tetra
notes: "field studies have found" became "pengamatan di habitat aslinya"; "studi lapangan" is closer to the source and avoids implying that the observation was made by the author.
"tetra dasar" is a literal rendering of "ground tetra"; consider adding the English term in brackets, e.g. "tetra dasar (ground tetra)", or explaining it as a tetra that lives near the bottom.

"Only if they can sit on plants": "bertengger" is fine, but "baru bisa tetap hijau kalau" slightly weakens the "permanently" ("selamanya/permanen") of the original; consider "hanya jika ... warnanya akan tetap hijau permanen".
"Keep the animals" was rendered as "ikan ini"; this is fine, but "ditanami tanaman air" is repetitive and could be shortened to "akuarium yang ditanami".

ammoglanis-multidentatus.name: Ammoglanis multidentatus
notes: Item 2: "wilayah semi-kering Caatinga" is slightly awkward; better "kawasan semiarid Caatinga".
Item 2: "hulu Sungai Rio Paraguaçu" is redundant (Rio = Sungai); use "hulu Rio Paraguaçu".
Item 1: "bergigi banyak" is awkward; better "bergigi banyak" -> "memiliki banyak gigi".
Item 7: "kerabat segenusnya" is a bit non-standard; use "semua anggota genus lainnya (congener)".
Item 7: "supraorbital sesamoid" and "tonjolan ... yang menonjol" are repetitive; use "tonjolan dorsolateral yang jelas".

amphilius-atesuensis.name: Amphilius atesuensis
notes: Item 8: 'Côte d'Ivoire Tai National Park in the south west of Côte d'Ivoire' became 'Taman Nasional Tai, di barat daya Pantai Gading'. This is fine, but the first 'Côte d'Ivoire' was dropped. Consider 'Taman Nasional Taï'.
Item 2: 'thumbnail images' is rendered as 'Gambar-gambar kecil (thumbnail)'. 'Gambar mini' or 'gambar kecil' would be more natural.
Item 5: 'susunan batu dan gua' is slightly awkward. Use 'batu-batuan dan gua-gua persembunyian'.
Item 3: 'daerah hulu lembah Sungai Niger' is awkward. Use 'hulu daerah aliran Sungai Niger' or 'DAS Niger bagian hulu'.

amphilius-cryptobullatus.name: Amphilius cryptobullatus
notes: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)": the IUCN term in Indonesian is usually "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah"; fine, but "Kurang Perhatian" is not needed. Keep consistent.
"kutu air" for Daphnia: hobbyists commonly write "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)"; "cyclops" could be "Cyclops" capitalised as a genus name.
"Spesies Amphilius sebenarnya tidak menjadi sasaran penangkapan": "not really targeted" is better as "tidak terlalu menjadi sasaran penangkapan"; "sebenarnya" slightly shifts meaning.
"Lokasi tipe": more standard is "Lokalitas tipe".

amphilius-frieli.name: Amphilius frieli
notes: "Tubifex worms" -> "cacing sutra" is fine, but "Daphnia" -> "kutu air" is a loose common name; consider "Daphnia" (kutu air) for clarity.
"Susunan batu" for "rockwork" is slightly awkward; consider "tata batu" or "batu-batuan".

amphilius-kivuensis.name: Amphilius kivuensis
notes: Item 4: "well planted with a slight current to facilitate their natural habitat" is rendered fine, but "gua-gua persembunyian" adds "persembunyian" (hiding), which is not in the source. Use "gua" only. Minor.
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" - the bracketed English is acceptable but unnecessary for the IUCN status; optional.
Item 5: "pakan nabati" for "vegetable food" is fine, but "Cyclops" and "Tubifex" are left as-is; consider adding "kutu air" style local names, e.g. "cacing sutra" for Tubifex.

amphilius-longirostris.name: Amphilius longirostris
notes: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)": the official Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah", but "Least Concern" is left in English. Use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)".
"Sediakan susunan batu dan gua": "susunan batu" is awkward. Use "batu-batuan (rockwork) dan gua".
"Lokasi tipe": "Lokasi tipe (type locality)" or "Lokalitas tipe" is more standard.
"juga di anak-anak sungai Ngoko": "juga" is ambiguous. Use "juga di anak sungai Ngoko".

amphilophus-citrinellus.name: Midas Cichlid
notes: Item 10: "2-2.5\"" correctly ~5–6 cm; fine, but "6'" → "sekitar 180 cm" OK. No issue there.
Item 8: "harus tahu apa yang dilakukan" is awkward and changes the subject to "siapa pun"; rephrase e.g. "harus benar-benar paham apa yang dilakukan".
Item 8: "Loricariidae (pleco)" and "ikan lele/catfish" are fine, but "Sebagai salah satu cichlid paling galak" has a dangling subject; restructure.
Item 7: "dunia hobi ini" for "in the hobby" is OK; but "individu" for "specimens" is stiff; use "ikan" or "kebanyakan midas".

Item 5: "kadar oksigen terlarut dalam air harus tinggi" and "Ganti air dalam jumlah besar setiap minggu" fine; "sedang sangat bersemangat" for "excitable moments" is weak; use "saat sedang heboh/agresif".
Item 11: "menggemaskan" for "endearing" is slightly off for an aggressive fish; "menawan" or "disukai" is better.
Item 11: "Sementara populasi citrinellus ada di perairan lain" - italicise/write full Latin name A. citrinellus consistently; "sport" fish left untranslated without gloss.
Item 1/11: "louhan (flowerhorn)" is fine, but "jenong" in item 9 is a Louhan-hobby term; keep consistent with "nuchal hump" used in item 1.

amphilophus-labiatus.name: Red Devil
notes: Item 11: "belang" (barred) and "belang-belang tidak beraturan (piebald)" are too close to tell apart. Use "bergaris/berpita vertikal" for barred.
Item 5: "saat sedang heboh" is informal. Use something like "saat sedang sangat aktif/agresif".
Item 3: "limbah kotoran mentah" is awkward. Use "limbah tinja/kotoran mentah" or "limbah kotoran yang belum diolah".

anabas-testudineus.name: Ikan Betok
notes: Item 14: 'large barbs' rendered as 'barbir' — non-standard; use 'barb' or 'ikan tambra/wader'. Also 'a bit robust' → 'agak kasar' (rough) changes meaning; use 'agak bertubuh kekar/tangguh'.
Item 14: the 'Trichogaster' tankmate advice is fine, but 'small snakeheads' → 'ikan gabus kecil' is acceptable; no issue. Main issue is the 'kasar' mistranslation.
Item 16: 'ventral fins' as 'sirip perut' is fine, but 'Burayak' for fry is OK; however 'pengasuhan anak' should be 'pengasuhan induk/anakan' (parental care).

Item 4: 'Scientists also do not work on them' → 'jarang menelitinya' is softer than the source ('do not work on'); use 'tidak meneliti'. 'cukup belum jelas' is awkward; use 'masih cukup tidak jelas/kurang jelas'.
Item 4: 'Small size' (Despite their small size, max 20 cm) is fine, but 'Anabas adalah ikan konsumsi yang populer' loses nothing; no change.

Item 16: 'Sekitar 200 telur dilepaskan pada setiap lilitan' fine; however 'mastacembelid (ikan sili)' in item 13 is fine. Item 7: 'rawa berumput' for 'marshes' and 'lubang-lubang kecil' for 'small pits' are awkward; use 'paya' and 'cekungan/kolam kecil'.
Item 7: 'ephemeral flooded habitats' → 'habitat banjiran musiman' ok; but 'Pada musim hujan' fine. 'estivasi' could add '(dorman musim kering)' for readability.
Item 17: 'Lexicon' → 'Leksikon' is stiff; use 'Asal nama'. 'teleostei' should be 'teleost'; 'opercular/subopercular' left untranslated—use 'tulang tutup insang/sub-tutup insang'.
Item 9: 'Setelan' for set-ups is non-standard; use 'tata letak/aquascape'. Item 7: 'oxbow (danau tapal kuda)' should be 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' order.
Item 1/9/16: imperial figures omitted correctly; item 7 '5 feet' → 1,5 m is correct.

anableps-anableps.name: Ikan Mata Empat
notes: Item 3: 'pasang tinggi (spring tide)' is imprecise. Use the standard term 'pasang purnama' (spring tide), as opposed to 'pasang perbani' (neap tide) in item 7.
Item 2: 'melewati Guyana... lalu melewati delta Amazon' repeats 'melewati'. Vary the wording, e.g. 'hingga melewati delta Amazon'.
Item 6: 'Murni spesies tropis' is a stiff rendering of 'Strictly a tropical species'. Something like 'Spesies tropis sejati' or 'Khusus spesies tropis' reads more naturally.

anablepsoides-hartii.name: Rivulus hartii
notes: "Akuarium harus selalu ditutup benar-benar rapat": the English says the tank is "densely covered". Fine in meaning, but "ditutup rapat" is enough. "benar-benar" is slightly redundant.

"tergolong cukup besar": "comparatively large" is better rendered as "tergolong relatif besar" or "berukuran relatif besar". "cukup" weakens it a little and is repeated in the next sentence ("ikan yang cukup damai").
"rather peaceful" became "cukup damai", so "cukup" appears twice in close succession. Vary it, for example "ikan yang relatif damai".

anablepsoides-ornatus.name: Rivulus ornatus
notes: "berakhir di lantai": slightly ambiguous; "melompat keluar dan jatuh ke lantai" is clearer.
"ornatus ... berhias": "dihias" or "hias" is more natural, though meaning is intact.

anablepsoides-rubrolineatus.name: Rivulus rubrolineatus
notes: "sangat tidak rewel soal kimia air" is a bit colloquial; consider "sangat toleran terhadap kondisi kimia air" / "tidak menuntut parameter air tertentu"
"sangat tidak rewel soal pakan" is colloquial; consider "tidak pilih-pilih pakan"
"ikan catfish" is redundant; use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish"
"Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat tanpa celah" adds "tanpa celah"; "ditutup rapat" is enough
"baru diterima secara perlahan" is a little awkward for "adopted only hesitantly"; consider "baru diterima dengan ragu-ragu"
"Rivulus selalu tinggal di dekat permukaan" is fine, but "bagian atas akuarium" could be "lapisan atas akuarium"

anadoras-grypus.name: Dusky Doradid
notes: Item 3: "Small streams tributary to the Ambyiacu" - "bermuara ke Sungai Ambyiacu" is OK, but "in Eastern Ecuador" contradicts Peru in the source; faithful, though "yang mengalir ke Amazon" should be "bermuara di Sungai Amazon".
Item 4: "doradid (catfish duri)" ok; "berukuran sama atau mendekati" is incomplete/awkward - use "berukuran sama atau hampir sama".

Item 6: "melindungi diri secara pasif agar tidak dimakan dengan berbagai tonjolan kulit berduri" is awkward and ambiguous; rephrase: "melindungi diri secara pasif dari pemangsa dengan berbagai tonjolan kulit berduri". Also "thorny catfish" and "Spiny catfish" are rendered inconsistently/mixed with English "catfish"; consider "ikan lele duri" or consistent term.

Item 8: "A. nauticus memiliki jari-jari sirip punggung yang bergerigi" - the English says "this species" (Anadoras grypus) has serrated ray, whereas A. grypus is smooth; the source text is self-contradictory, and the translation silently swapped subject. Keep as source or flag; the translation changed the original statement.
Item 8: "berhidung bengkok seperti kait" adds "seperti"; use "melengkung atau berhidung kait".
Item 2: "melimpah di beberapa lokasi" - source "locally abundant" fine; "Least Concern" left in English with gloss is acceptable.
Item 5: "Juga mau memakan siput" is OK, but "Pakan tablet" might better be "pakan tablet" lowercase; minor.

anatolichthys-anatoliae.name: Anatolian toothcarp
notes: Item 1/6: Temperature '2–30°C (36–86°F)': the 36°F conversion is not the issue, but 'Max size 55 mm SL' etc. are fine; real issue: 'periode musim dingin yang dingin' is redundant/awkward, use 'periode musim dingin yang sejuk/dingin' or 'periode dingin (musim dingin)'.
Item 1/8: 'dipelihara tanpa ikan lain' is okay, but 'killifish' and 'toothcarp' left in English; use 'ikan killi' consistently.
Item 3: 'kondisi sedikit payau' fine, but 'ikan ini teramati' and 'Walaupun A. anatoliae memang masuk ke danaunya sendiri' is awkward; use 'memang masuk ke perairan danau itu sendiri'.
Item 8: 'Kebutuhan airnya yang khusus' ok; 'status konservasinya yang rawan' changes 'precarious' slightly, prefer 'genting/terancam'.

Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is common, but 'tanaman air' for 'aquatic vegetation' and 'kimia ... air' (item 10: 'air dengan kimia dan suhu yang sama') is unnatural; use 'parameter air (kimia air) dan suhu yang sama'.
Item 11: 'Hrnek et al., 2002' in the English is a source typo (Hrbek); the translation copied it, while the reference list says Hrbek; use 'Hrbek et al., 2002'.
Item 11: 'berevolusi secara mandiri' and 'danau pahit' are literal; use 'berevolusi secara terpisah' and 'danau bersalinitas/beralkali tinggi'.
Item 4: 'Volume: ~108 liter' is correct, US gallon figure omitted correctly; no change needed for volume.
Item 9: 'garis vertikal' for 'vertical bars' would be better 'pita/strip vertikal'; 'pangkal ekor' for caudal peduncle is acceptable but 'tangkai ekor' is the hobby term.
Item 10: 'Burayaknya sudah cukup besar' omits that the fry accept food 'immediately' linking to free-swimming only loosely; acceptable but 'burayak' vs 'benih/anakan' is a regional term choice.

anatolichthys-danfordii.name: Danford's Toothcarp
notes: Item 10: "air dengan kimia dan suhu yang sama" is awkward. Use "parameter kimia air dan suhu yang sama".
Item 11: "danau pahit" is a literal rendering of "bitter lake". Use a clearer wording, e.g. "danau dengan air sangat basa dan bermineral tinggi".
Item 5: "kalau suka" is too casual for a handbook. Use "jika diinginkan".
Item 2: "kemungkinan besar ciri-ciri pembeda tersebut kini akan hilang" is slightly off in tense. "kini kemungkinan besar akan hilang" reads more naturally.

anatolichthys-saldae.name: Salda Toothcarp
notes: Item 11: "This little-known fish" became "Ikan yang jarang dikenal ini"; use "kurang dikenal" ("jarang dikenal" is unnatural).
Item 11: "Aphaniid killifishes" became "Killifish Aphaniidae"; Aphaniidae is a family name not in the source. Use "killifish Aphanius" or "killifish aphaniid".
Item 7: "Daphnia" became "kutu air"; hobbyists use "Daphnia" or "kutu air" but "kutu air" is ambiguous. Keep "Daphnia" or add it in brackets.
Item 7: "mereka mau belajar menerima pakan kering" is stiff; write "umumnya mau menerima pakan kering".
Item 5: "idealnya alga berfilamen" is vague; the source says the space can be filled with filamentous algae. "warnanya dan kondisinya" is also clumsy; write "warna dan kondisinya".
Item 10: "Telur subspesies ini" is kept from the source, but the species is not a subspecies in context. Consider "spesies ini" (the source is inconsistent, so flag it).
Item 10: "diganti setiap dua hari sekali" is redundant; write "setiap dua hari". Also "kimia ... yang sama" is awkward; write "kimia air dan suhu yang sama".
Item 3: "sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "Introduksi ikan mas" is awkward; use "Introduksi ikan mas ... juga kemungkinan besar menekan" with a clearer "memberi tekanan pada".
Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 108 liter" is correct; no change. In item 3, "Anatolichthys biasanya memakan telur/burayaknya sendiri" adds "sendiri" that is not in the source.

anatolichthys-sureyanus.name: Burdur toothcarp
notes: Item 1: 'Daftar Merah IUCN' sentence says 'sehingga tercantum dua kali' right after name list; fine, but 'variable scalation' became 'sisiknya bervariasi' OK. Main issue is elsewhere.

Item 11: 'We've chosen to list them separately' became passive; fine. But 'ten endemic species' etc. fine. Issue: 'Hampir dalam semua kasus... Beberapa spesies, entah mengapa, masih dicantumkan' is OK; however 'Kecil kemungkinan' fine.
Item 10: 'Anatolichthys biasanya memakan telur/burayaknya sendiri' adds 'sendiri' (own), not in source; remove.
Item 10: 'seluruh media bisa diangkat dan diganti setiap dua hari sekali' – 'every couple of days' is approximate; ok, but 'air dengan kimia' is awkward: use 'kimia air yang sama'.

Item 3: 'Karena itu danau ini tidak pernah membeku, dan inilah sebabnya' is redundant; 'Beberapa spesies tanaman air' loses that Carex etc. are plants (ok). 'some discharges are saline' -> 'sebagian di antaranya keluar sebagai air asin' slightly changes meaning (some groundwater discharge points are saline).
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' (kutu air/daphnia) is the hobby term; 'artemia' fine.
Item 2: 'tempat musim dingin' is awkward; use 'tempat berlindung/menghabiskan musim dingin'. 'ever-decreasing' fine.
Item 5: 'Java moss' left in English without Indonesian term (e.g. 'lumut jawa'); 'setup' untranslated is acceptable.
Items 8/11: 'sangat disarankan untuk memeliharanya sendirian' fine; Item 11 'subspesies' vs species inconsistency copied from source; 'Meski Aphanius ... mereka' ok.
Item 11: 'Anatolichthys' genera described as 'sudah tidak dipakai' fine; 'Hrnek' typo in original retained in translation vs reference 'Hrbek' – should be 'Hrbek et al., 2002'.

anatolichthys-transgrediens.name: Acı toothcarp
notes: Item 12: the reference list drops the Zapater entry, but all other entries are kept. The Zapater (2005) item is missing, though the reference list should stay complete.

Item 6: the 'Temperature' line says 'Aktif pada rentang suhu yang lebar, 2–30 °C'. That is fine. But 'Pemanas tidak diperlukan kecuali di iklim yang paling dingin' is acceptable, so no fix is needed there. The real issue is in item 6: 'it should be provided with a winter period' is turned into 'perlu diberi periode musim dingin', which is correct.
Item 5: 'Begitu pula, substrat tidak wajib' links back poorly to the salt sentence. Reword it, e.g. 'Demikian pula, substrat tidak diperlukan'.

Item 3: 'taraf tertentu' and 'aliran genetik' are fine. But 'teluk-teluk kecil' for 'inlets' suggests bays, while the source means adjacent inlets or streams. Use 'aliran masuk / anak sungai di dekatnya'.

Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is common. 'Evolusi regresif' is fine. 'Pemisahan ... di bagian barat' is fine. 'species in statu nascendi' is fine. 'Klad' is unusual, so use 'klad (clade)' or 'garis keturunan'.

Item 11: 'baru pada 2003 sebuah komite ICZN memutuskan untuk menekan nama tersebut dan memakai Aphanius' loses 'as recently as'. Add 'baru'. It is there, so this is fine. The real fault is 'dulu pernah' (redundant). Use 'pernah'.

Item 1: 'Max size: 50 mm SL' keeps 'SL' without explanation. Use 'panjang standar (SL)'. Also 'kritis (critically endangered)' should read 'sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)', because 'kritis' alone is not the standard Indonesian term for the IUCN category. The same applies in item 2.

anatolichthys-villwocki.name: Sakarya Toothcarp
notes: Item 5: 'Female and subdominant male individuals must be offered...' fine, but 'Bahkan untuk pemeliharaan jangka panjang' is an awkward rendering of 'Even for long-term maintenance'; better 'Untuk pemeliharaan jangka panjang pun'.
Item 11: 'sebuah komite ICZN baru pada 2003 memutuskan untuk menekan nama tersebut' is ambiguous; say 'ICZN pada 2003 memutuskan menekan nama Lebias dan mengutamakan Aphanius'.
Item 11: 'Saat ini genus tersebut berisi 22 spesies' — the genus is never named in the preceding paragraph; write 'genus Aphanius'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is non-standard; use 'daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)'.
Item 3: 'Potamotegon' kept as in the source, but 'Typha sp. bullrushes' lost 'bullrush/ilalang air' meaning; add 'rumput kembang/Typha'.
Item 3: 'Gambusia ... deleterious effect' is fine, but 'Dataran Yigar' and 'sungai-sungai sementara' for 'temporary streams' — use 'aliran sementara' (streams, not rivers).
Item 5: 'jantan alfa' is a literal rendering; 'jantan dominan' is more natural.

Item 2: 'hilir pertemuan dengan Sungai Porsuk' — 'below the confluence' is downstream, but 'bagian hulu sistem' follows, so the logic is fine; however 'galur darah' for 'bloodlines' is awkward; use 'garis keturunan'.
Item 12: references left untranslated, which is correct.

ancharius-fuscus.name: Vaona
notes: "Data Deficient (kekurangan data)" / "Least Concern (risiko rendah)": use the standard Indonesian IUCN terms, e.g. "Kekurangan Data (Data Deficient)" and "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)"; the current order leaves the English as the main term.
"luas wilayah keberadaannya": awkward for "extent of occurrence"; use "luas daerah sebaran (extent of occurrence)".
"duri sirip dubur" for anal fin: "sirip anal" is the more common term among hobbyists; "duri sirip punggung" is fine.
"ruas tulang belakang" for vertebrae: "vertebra" or "ruas tulang belakang" are both okay, but "dari satu daerah aliran sungai saja" slightly shifts "single basin"; this is minor.
"kehitaman" for "dusky": "kelabu gelap/suram" is closer, but this is minor.

ancistrus-cirrhosus.name: Bristlenose Pleco
notes: Item 4: "20 gallons (about 75 litres)" and "40 gallons (about 150 litres)" are fine, but the ID drops "The page also lists" and says "Ada pula rujukan yang menyebut", which is acceptable. The sentence "akuarium 75 liter dapat menampung dua ekor" is correct. No fix needed here beyond keeping the wording consistent.

Item 5: The English gives "another figure given is 73-80 °F" (about 23-27 °C). The ID "angka lain yang disebutkan juga berada di kisaran yang sama" is vague and invents a claim. Give the converted figure (about 23-26,5 °C) or drop the sentence.

Item 6: "Never overfeed" is rendered "Jangan pernah memberi pakan berlebihan", which is OK. "blanched ... spinach" was translated as "direbus sebentar", but the English only says blanched for romaine and spinach. Say "diblansir/direbus sebentar" explicitly for both, as the English intends.
Item 7: "goldfish" is rendered "ikan mas koki". Use "ikan mas koki" or "goldfish" consistently. Also, "Some aquarists even pair them with known aggressors" is fine. "Guppys" is correct as "Guppy".

Item 8: "bristle (duri)" is inconsistent. Bristles are not spikes: use "bristle (tentakel/jumbai keras)" for the head and "duri" only for the fin spikes. In item 9, "duri/bristle" has the same problem.

Item 10: "underbite" is rendered "rahang bawah yang lebih maju", which is OK. "flat, fat body" is rendered "pipih dan gemuk". Bristlenose bodies are flattened from top to bottom, so use "pipih dorsoventral" or "melebar" to avoid implying a laterally flat body.

ancistrus-claro.name: Gold Marble Bristlenose
notes: Item 4: '60 × 30 cm ... about 54 litres' is kept, but the original likely gave a volume in the source; check that '54 liter' is correct, since 60×30 cm needs a stated height. Otherwise fine.
Item 8: 'tata letak akuarium cukup rumit dan penuh sekat' adds meaning not in 'well-structured'. Use 'tertata baik dengan banyak struktur/tempat berlindung'.
Item 2: the type locality quote is left in English and then translated in brackets. Keep the original quote and give the translation only once, or translate it consistently.

Item 1/3: 'sungai kecil berarus' translates 'flowing streams' acceptably, but 'bongkahan batu' for 'boulders' is fine. 'sapu-sapu' is the common name for Pterygoplichthys, not bristlenose. Use 'ikan lele pengisap (suckermouth catfish)' or 'ikan pleco'.
Item 5: 'batu yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn boulders'. Use 'bongkahan batu yang terkikis/licin oleh air'.
Item 7: 'Daphnia' is rendered as 'kutu air'. 'Prawn/shrimp' becomes only 'udang'. These are acceptable, but 'pakan kering yang tenggelam' should be 'pakan kering tenggelam (sinking)'.
Item 10: 'jantan yang bertugas menjaga telur dan anakan' is acceptable. 'Brood care' is broader, so 'menjaga telur dan anakan' is fine.

ancistrus-cryptophthalmus.name: Sapu-sapu Bushynose
notes: Item 2: 'upper Paraná River, Tocantins River drainage' rendered as 'hulu Sungai Paraná, daerah aliran Sungai Tocantins' is fine, but 'daerah aliran' reads awkwardly; 'DAS Tocantins' or 'sistem sungai' would be more natural.
Item 5: 'jauh lebih kecil dan jauh lebih sedikit' - the source says 'much smaller growths... to a much lesser extent'; consider 'jauh lebih kecil dan tidak serimbun jantan' to avoid ambiguity.

Item 3: 'diberi pakan yang sebagian besar nabati' is slightly off from 'mainly vegetarian'; 'terutama pakan nabati' is more natural. 'odd, small amount' is rendered as 'sesekali sedikit', which is fine.
Item 6: 'burayak' is a less common term among hobbyists; 'anakan' or 'larva/fry' is more usual.
Item 7: 'slight medium sized spotted pattern' is rendered slightly loosely; consider 'pola bintik halus berukuran sedang'.

ancistrus-dolichopterus.name: Starlight bristlenose
notes: Item 4: "Volume is approximately 243 litres (64 US gal)" is rendered as "Volumenya kira-kira 243 liter." This is fine on units. The sentence is accurate.
Item 11: "diberi nomor L L183" is a clumsy duplication. Write "diberi nomor L183" or "nomor-L L183".
Item 12: "hibrida berlapis" for "multiple hybrid" is unnatural and may mislead. Use "hibrida hasil persilangan berulang/berbagai spesies".
Item 12: "Common Bushmouth" and "White Seam Ancistrus" are left as English names in quotation marks. Add a local explanation or keep them consistent with "bristlenose biasa" used elsewhere.
Item 10: "Bertelur di dalam gua" is acceptable, but "anakan" for brood is slightly imprecise. "menjaga telur dan anakan" adds the idea of fry, which the English "brood care" only implies.

Item 12: "Hanya sesekali saja ada individu ... yang memiliki kurang dari 9 jari-jari lunak" is slightly clumsy. Reword it as "Hanya sesekali individu A. dolichopterus memiliki kurang dari 9 jari-jari lunak".
Item 7: "kutu air beku" for frozen Daphnia is non-standard. Use "Daphnia beku" or "kutu air (Daphnia) beku". "pakan kering yang tenggelam" should be "pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 1: "sungai kecil berair hitam" is fine. "lele bristlenose" is acceptable, but hobbyists usually say "pleco" or "ancistrus".

ancistrus-formoso.name: Blind Cave Bristlenose
notes: Item 1: "Ciri ini khas genus Ancistrus dan tidak dimiliki genus lain" adds a claim; also "lebat" for "bushy" is awkward.
Item 6: "bertelur di dalam gua atau celah" adds "celah" (crevice) not in the original; "cave-breeders" means they spawn in caves/cavities, so say "memijah di dalam gua".
Item 3: "sebagian besar nabati" is acceptable, but "pakan hewani" for "meaty foods" is OK; "timun (jenis timun Inggris)" is awkward, so use "timun Jepang/timun panjang" or keep "English cucumber".
Item 1: "Kotamadya Bonito" for "Município" should be "Munisipalitas/Kota Bonito"; "Blind Cave Bristlenose" has no local gloss.
Item 5: "tidak pernah selebat pada jantan" reuses "lebat" and slightly changes meaning, since the original says never to the same extent.

ancistrus-macrophthalmus.name: LDA 74
notes: Item 6: "pakan hewani" for "meaty foods" is slightly broader than the source. "pakan berdaging" or "pakan hewani (daging)" would be closer.
Item 12: "area di sekitarnya pada dada" reads a little awkwardly. "area di dada yang berdekatan dengannya" would be smoother.

ancistrus-pirareta.name: Bristlenose Pirareta
notes: Item 1: "Least Concern (risiko rendah; ...)" adds a gloss; "risiko rendah" is not an exact IUCN term. Use "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" or keep the English only.
Item 6: "bertelur di dalam gua" for "cave-breeders" is stiff. Use "memijah di dalam gua/celah" or "cave spawner". "gua" suggests a large cave, so "gua kecil/celah persembunyian" is better.
Item 5: "tentakel betina tidak pernah sebanyak milik jantan" is fine on meaning, but "hanya ada pada genus Ancistrus" drops the sense of "unique". Consider "khas/unik".
Item 3: "sebagian besar nabati" is slightly awkward. "Courgette/zucchini" is merged into "zukini", which is fine. "pakan hewani" for "meaty foods" is OK.

ancistrus-ranunculus.name: Medusa Pleco
notes: Item 11: "2 betina atau lebih" is fine, but "pH sebaiknya sekitar 6,0–6,5" is fine; the real issue: "ikan yang kurus kering pada ikan yang baru diimpor" (item 12) is redundant and awkward; rephrase to "tanda klasik kurus kering pada ikan impor baru".
Item 2: "paling 'emansipasi'" is awkward; use "paling 'emansipatif'" or explain: betina pun berjanggut besar. The original "most emancipated" joke is a bit lost.
Item 1/12: "medusa pleco" and "ikan sapu-sapu (suckermouth catfish)" are loose; Loricariidae are usually called 'sapu-sapu' only for common plecos, consider keeping 'pleco' as the hobby term.
Item 12: "bukan ikan yang paling mudah dipertahankan hidup" is stiff; use "tidak mudah dipelihara".
Item 11: "Akuarium berukuran sekitar 76 × 30 × 30 cm akan dibutuhkan" is stiff; use "dibutuhkan akuarium sekitar ...".
Item 11: "air yang sama persis" for "identical water" is slightly over-literal; use "dengan parameter air yang sama".
Item 11: "Jumlah burayak per pemijahan" adds "per pemijahan", which is not in the English "Brood size can vary".
Item 11: "mengalahkan yang lebih kecil dalam berebut pakan" is awkward; use "merebut pakan dari yang lebih kecil".
Item 6: "kurang tumbuh subur" is awkward; use "sulit tumbuh baik". "Setup" is acceptable but "penataan" is more natural.

ancistrus-triradiatus.name: Horned Bristlenose Pleco
notes: Item 10: "karena jika tidak bisa terjadi banyak perkelahian" is fine, but "sisakan hanya satu jantan bersama 2 betina atau lebih" is OK; the real issue is "lele sapu-sapu (suckermouth)" in item 1, which is misleading: sapu-sapu is the common name for Pterygoplichthys, not for a small Ancistrus. Use "lele penghisap" or just "pleco/bristlenose".
Item 1/7/10: "herbivora" for "Mainly vegetarian" is slightly stronger than the source, so "pemakan tumbuhan terutama" would be closer.
Item 10: "bayam yang sudah direbus sebentar" for "blanched" is fine, but "sayuran hijau" for "greenstuffs" is acceptable; "Substrat tidak diperlukan" is OK.
Item 11: "tanda klasik ikan kurus kekurangan gizi pada ikan yang baru diimpor" is redundant. Say "tanda klasik kondisi kurus kering pada ikan impor baru".
Item 3: "sungai kecil berarus" for "flowing streams" is OK, but "anak-anak sungainya" for "tributaries" is slightly off. Use "anak sungai".

andinoacara-latifrons.name: Blue Acara
notes: "sudah dipelihara di akuarium di berbagai belahan dunia" is acceptable, but "menggiring anakan" for "lead the brood" is slightly odd; use "membimbing/mengawal anakan".
"parent family" is rendered as "membentuk keluarga induk", which is awkward; use "keluarga induk (parental family)" or "pengasuhan oleh kedua induk".
"jarang mengorek substrat" for "little burrowing" is fine, but "Makin besar akuariumnya, makin damai cichlid ini" is slightly stiff; use "makin damai sifat cichlid ini".
"keturunan hasil penangkaran di Jerman" adds "hasil penangkaran", which the source doesn't state explicitly ("German offspring"); consider "keturunan (F-generasi) yang dibiakkan di Jerman".

andinoacara-pulcher.name: Andinoacara pulcher
notes: Item 1: "Max size: 150 mm SL (6 in)" became "150 mm SL" — fine, but consider converting to 15 cm for consistency with other metric values.
Item 8: "ikan catfish" is redundant; use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish".
Item 10: "Pengasuhan anak oleh induknya" is slightly awkward; use "Perawatan burayak oleh induk" for consistency with "burayak".
Item 10: "Kadang bisa terjadi pertukaran peran di sini" is awkward; use "Terkadang peran jantan dan betina bisa bertukar".
Item 5: "juga ide yang bagus" is slightly colloquial; use "juga pilihan yang baik".
Item 3: "sungai kecil dan sungai berarus" is a bit clumsy for "flowing clearwater streams and rivers"; use "anak sungai dan sungai berair jernih yang mengalir".

anematichthys-repasson.name: Anematichthys repasson
notes: Item 1: "Ukurannya bisa mencapai sekitar 280 mm SL" keeps mm. Prefer cm ("sekitar 28 cm SL"), consistent with the metric convention. Same for item 4 "280 mm SL". Minor.
Item 8: "Pada dasarnya ikan ini suka hidup berkelompok" is a loose rendering of "gregarious by nature"; "secara alami" is better. Minor.
Item 3: "Pada dasarnya ini ikan sungai" is awkward for "Primarily a riverine fish"; use "Terutama ikan sungai". Minor.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot" is fine, but "substrat pasir yang halus" drops "soft". Minor.
Item 11: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the more common hobby term. Minor.
Item 11: "bibir yang menyambung" for "continuous lips" is slightly unclear; use "bibir yang bersambungan". Minor.

Item 4: "Kalau data ukuran maksimumnya memang benar" is fine. Item 5: "Beberapa kelompok tanaman apung" is fine. Item 10: "diperkirakan belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan" slightly changes "Not thought to have been bred"; use "Tampaknya belum pernah dibiakkan".

anentome-helena.name: Keong Assassin
notes: #2: "keong bladder (siput kecil)" – the parenthetical "siput kecil" is an addition and doesn't identify the bladder snail (Physa); drop it or use the established name.
#2: "corak lebah bumble" – unnatural; use "corak lebah/tawon" or "lebah madu" instead.

annamia-normani.name: Vietnamese Giraffe Loach
notes: "cyanobacteria" is left in English in items 1, 5 and 9. Use the Indonesian "sianobakteri" (cyanobacteria in brackets if wanted).
"aufwuchs" is left in German in items 7, 9 and 10. Add a gloss such as "aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan jasad renik di permukaan)" on first use.
"riffles" is translated as "riam dangkal berbatu" in item 5 and as "riam" in items 1 and 7. Use one term consistently, because "riam" often means rapids.
"pertengkaran kecil" (squabbles) and "dimakan dengan lahap" (taken readily) are slightly free. "perselisihan kecil" and "mudah dimakan" would be closer.

annamia-thuathienensis.name: Annamia thuathienensis
notes: Item 2: "belum ada catatan lain" is a bit vague for "no additional records". Use "belum ada catatan temuan lain" or "belum ada laporan temuan lain".
Item 3: "sungai-sungai kecil yang tidak terlalu besar" is redundant and loses "streams" (anak sungai). Use "anak sungai dan sungai kecil".
Item 8: "lele" for catfishes of Glyptothorax, Akysis and Oreoglanis may mislead, since these are small hillstream catfishes. Consider "ikan berkumis (catfish)" or keep "catfish".

anomalochromis-thomasi.name: African Butterfly Cichlid
notes: Item 8: "sangat aktif dan agresif" adds "agresif", which the English doesn't say. "Vigorous" means boisterous or robust. Use "sangat aktif/lincah" without "agresif".
Item 10: the young are called "larva" in one place and "burayak" in another. Use one term, such as "burayak", for the wrigglers and the free-swimming fry.
Item 10: "dither fish" is left in English with no gloss. Add a short explanation, e.g. "ikan pengalih (dither fish)".

anostomus-anostomus.name: Anostomus
notes: Item 5: "Setup" is slightly informal; consider "penataan akuarium" or "aquascape".
Item 7: "yang sudah direbus sebentar (blanching)" attaches only to "zukini" in the sentence; place it so it covers all vegetables, e.g. "sayuran seperti bayam, ... yang telah diblansir".
Item 8: "cenderung sangat suka bertengkar" is awkward; use "cenderung sangat agresif terhadap sesamanya".
Item 1/8: "pengais" for "grazer" is acceptable but "pemakan alga yang merumput" is more natural.
Item 4: "~108 liter" is fine, but "Volume" could be "Volume sekitar 108 liter"; minor.
Item 11: "phylogentic" is a typo in the source and was silently corrected, which is fine. "garis keturunan polifiletik" is fine, but "kelompok polifiletik" is more natural.

anostomus-ternetzi.name: Golden Striped Headstander
notes: Item 1: 'Sungai Orinoco' fine, but 'Río Orinoco system and coastal Guyana' is OK; main problem is item 10, where the Vietnamese parentheticals were removed but 'karasin' is a non-standard term for characids. Use 'karasin (characid)' consistently, or the common 'tetra'.

Item 10: 'doradid (lele dari famili Doradidae)' is inaccurate/redundant; doradids are talking catfish, not true lele (Clariidae). Use 'doradid (patin berduri/ikan lele bicara)' or leave it as 'doradid (famili Doradidae)'.
Item 10: 'gerombolan besar' sounds negative (a gang); use 'kawanan besar'.
Item 10: 'cenderung sangat suka bertengkar' is awkward; use 'sangat agresif terhadap sesamanya'.

Item 6: the 'Standard length: 125 mm SL (5 in SL)' line dropped the imperial figure correctly, but 'Alas akuarium' and the translation of 'Aquarium base' are fine. The ~108 L volume is consistent with the original, so no change is needed here.
Item 7: 'Penutup akuarium yang rapat wajib ada' is stiff; use 'Tutup akuarium yang pas sangat penting'.
Item 9: 'bayam rebus sebentar (blansir)' is awkward; use 'bayam yang diblansir'. 'Omnivora ... herbivora' should be 'omnivora tetapi lebih condong herbivora'.
Item 16: 'Leksikon' is not natural in a hobby handbook; use 'Asal nama' or 'Etimologi'.
Item 1: 'merumput alga' is unnatural; use 'memakan alga' or 'menggerogoti alga'.

aphanius-apodus.name: Footless Killifish
notes: Item 11: the English says "from Somalia in the east to Pakistan in the west". The Indonesian swaps this to "Somalia di barat hingga Pakistan di timur". The swap is geographically sensible, but it silently changes the source. Keep it faithful or flag it for the editor.
Item 6: "kesuburannya menurun" is a loose rendering of "reduced fecundity". "Produksi telur/keturunannya menurun" or "daya biaknya menurun" would be clearer.
Item 5: "setup" and "boks plastik" are slightly informal. "Penataan akuarium" and "kotak/wadah plastik" are more standard.

aphanius-asquamatus.name: Scaleless killifish
notes: Item 10: the English says "this subspecies", but the translation says "Telur spesies ini". Keep "subspesies", or use a neutral wording.
Item 11: "sangat basa dan asin" adds "asin" (salty). The English "bitter" with alkaline carbonates and sulfates does not say salty. Use "pahit" or "sangat basa" with the mineral content.
Item 11: "Ketiga spesies dari kawasan Danau-Danau Turki tersebut" and "ketiganya" make the antecedent of "They" more specific than the English. Check that it refers to the right species.
Item 5: "Warnanya dan kondisinya secara keseluruhan" is clumsy. Use "Warna dan kondisinya secara keseluruhan".

aphanius-dispar.name: Arabian Toothcarp
notes: Item 1: 'tahan di kondisi apa pun' overstates the English 'anything from pure freshwater to hypersaline'; and it drops that the 4–30°C range is stated as is. Better: 'toleran terhadap kondisi dari air tawar murni hingga hipersalin'.
Item 3: 'Danau Afera' is inconsistent with 'Danau Afrera' in item 2; unify the spelling.

Item 3: the English says tolerance is shown in 'Lake Afera' as a contrast ('whereas'); 'Sementara itu, di Danau Afera salinitasnya pernah terukur' is fine, but 'tandon' for cisterns is regional (Java) and 'bulldozed ponds' as 'kolam galian buldoser' is OK; consider 'bak penampungan air'.

Item 11: 'sinonim Cyprinodon oleh sebagian besar otoritas' is correct, but 'menekan nama tersebut' (suppress the name) is a poor rendering of the ICZN term; use 'menetapkan nama tersebut ditiadakan/ditekan (suppressed)'. Also 'killifish Aphaniidae' is fine, but 'memutuskan ... mendahulukan Aphanius' is acceptable.
Item 5: 'betina serta jantan yang kalah dominan' is ambiguous (subdominant male); use 'jantan subdominan'. 'Java moss' and 'setup' are left in English; prefer 'lumut Jawa' and 'tata akuarium'.

Item 5: 'menyedot air dari bagian atas akuarium' adds 'menyedot' (siphoning); the English says only removing water from the top, which is not the same as siphoning the substrate. Use 'mengambil air hanya dari bagian atas'.
Item 5: 'Alternatifnya, gunakan kerikil berukuran besar' reads fine, but 'Usahakan cari tahu asal-usul ikan yang dimiliki' is slightly clumsy.
Item 9: 'sirip dubur' is a non-standard term; hobbyists use 'sirip anal'. 'garis vertikal tegas' for 'solid vertical bars' is acceptable. 'hyaline' as 'bening' is fine.
Item 10: 'burayak' is a good term, but 'kimia air' is awkward; use 'parameter air'. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable.

aphanius-farsicus.name: Farsi toothcarp
notes: "Killifish" is left in English at the start of a sentence; it is a common hobby term, but consider "ikan killi" or "Killifish (ikan killi)" for the first mention.

"terspesialisasi pada suhu air yang berbeda cukup jauh": the original says "differ clearly". "cukup jauh" weakens it, so use "berbeda jelas/mencolok". The phrasing is also stiff; consider "beradaptasi dengan suhu air yang berbeda jelas antara siang dan malam".

"sinar matahari langsung tanpa penghalang" is a reasonable rendering of "unfiltered sunlight", but it adds nuance ("tanpa penghalang"). Consider "sinar matahari tanpa tersaring kaca/plastik" to make clear the light is unfiltered.
"tepatnya hidup di sekitar Danau Shiraz": "tepatnya" is slightly added. Use "yang hidup di sekitar Danau Shiraz".
"Individu" for "Specimens" is fine, but "tidak sedang dalam kondisi siap memijah" is wordy for "not in breeding mood". Consider "belum berminat/tidak sedang musim berbiak".

aphanius-fasciatus.name: Mediterranean Killifish
notes: Item 4: "trio (satu jantan dua betina)" adds a detail the English doesn't give. Use just "trio", or note that it is the usual meaning.

Item 1: "tahan terhadap kondisi apa pun" is a bit too absolute for "tolerates anything from freshwater to hypersaline". Something like "tahan terhadap rentang kondisi yang sangat luas" would be closer.

aphanius-sirhani.name: Azraq Toothcarp
notes: Item 1: "Perilaku pemijahannya yang agresif" — source says "vigorous spawning behaviour" (not aggressive); use "aktif/bersemangat". Same in item 8 ("perilaku pemijahan yang agresif").
Item 8: the source's "Its particular water requirements" is rendered as "Kebutuhan air yang khusus", but the intro in item 1 omits it. Fine here, but check consistency.

Item 11: "memutuskan untuk menekan nama tersebut dan memakai Aphanius baru pada tahun 2003" — wrong meaning. The source says the ICZN voted to suppress the name Lebias in favour of Aphanius as recently as 2003; the "baru" is misplaced. Use "... menekan (menyatakan tidak berlaku) nama Lebias demi Aphanius pada 2003".
Item 11: "Aphanius" is used in the source text, while the species is now Aphaniops; keep as is, but "salah kelola" is stiff — use "pengelolaan yang buruk".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Hal ini sangat penting ... karena besarnya energi" slightly changes "high reproductive effort"; fine.

Item 3: "Throughour much of the 1990s ... ikan predator introduksi seperti Tilapia, Oreochromis, dan Clarias" — the source lists them as genera; "seperti" is acceptable but "Danau dangkal musiman" for "shallow, temporary lake" is OK.
Item 3: "jumlahnya hanya 1200 ekor" — use the Indonesian thousands separator "1.200" for consistency with "350.000".
Item 10: "air dengan kimia dan suhu yang sama" — awkward; use "komposisi kimia air dan suhu yang sama".

aphanius-vladykovi.name: Zagros pupfish
notes: "di kolam atau bak luar ruangan" / "wadah luar ruangan": the English says "outdoor tanks". Adding "kolam" is an addition, and the wording shifts between terms. Use "bak/akuarium luar ruangan" consistently.
"kurang berkembang baik" is awkward for "do not thrive well". Use "kurang dapat bertahan/tumbuh baik" or "tidak tumbuh optimal".
"atraksi pamer ikan jantan" is awkward for "displays of the males". Use "perilaku pamer/display ikan jantan".
"aquarist khusus" for "specialised aquarists" is slightly off. Use "aquarist spesialis" or "penghobi yang berspesialisasi".
"bisa mencapai panjang maksimal" repeats the idea ("bisa" plus "maksimal"). Use "mencapai panjang maksimal".
"Ikan yang dikembalikan ... paling sering menampilkan" is stiff for "most often show". Use "umumnya menampilkan".

aphanotorulus-unicolor.name: Unicolor Pleco
notes: Item 1: "torulus = otot, tali kecil" is fine, but "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is OK; no real issue here.
Item 12: "Uniknya" for "Astonishingly" is slightly weak; prefer "Mengherankan/Menariknya".
Item 2: "punya tonjolan-tonjolan" is colloquial; use "memiliki tonjolan".
Item 3: "Hidup di dasar berpasir" fine, but "Leopard Pleco" drops the plural/hyphen of "Leopard-Plecos"; minor.
Item 16: "cenderung membedakan spesies jauh lebih rinci" is awkward for "more splitting"; use "cenderung memecah menjadi lebih banyak spesies".
Item 7: "suhu yang lebih tinggi" is vague; clarify as "suhu air yang lebih hangat".

aphyocharax-anisitsi.name: Bloodfin tetra
notes: Item 3: "Ikan ini mungkin menggigiti sirip teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau gerakannya lambat" is ambiguous. Say "teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau berenang lambat".
Item 8: "paling tampak betah" is awkward. Use "paling cocok/tampak paling betah".
Items 3, 11, 14: "teman setangki" is slightly stiff. "Penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain" is more natural.
Item 14: "bertenaga aerator" for "air-powered" is imprecise. Use "digerakkan udara dari aerator".
Item 14: "burayak" is correct but "hasilnya sampai beberapa ratus ekor burayak" is wordy. Simplify to "beberapa ratus ekor burayak".
Item 13: "Para akuaris" and "kesempatan langka" for "unique opportunity" are acceptable. "Fungsi variasi warna" for "purpose" is fine. "Dikromatisme" could use a gloss.
Item 4: "si Bloodfin tetra" adds a colloquial tone not in the source. Use "yaitu Bloodfin tetra".
Item 12: "sirip anusnya" is stiff. "Sirip dubur" is the usual term.
Item 13: "sirip anus" has the same problem. Use "sirip dubur".

aphyocharax-nattereri.name: Dawn Tetra
notes: #11: "GH 2–5°" is ambiguous; use "2–5 dGH" to match the units used elsewhere.
#11: "filter spons kecil bertenaga aerator" is awkward; use "filter spons kecil yang digerakkan udara (aerator)".
#11: "mikroworm" is a non-standard rendering; use "cacing mikro (microworm)".
#11: "naupli artemia" is fine, but "Indukan sebaiknya dipindahkan" reads ambiguously. Say "Induk dewasa sebaiknya dipindahkan".
#9: "gerombolan campuran" sounds odd; use "kelompok campuran" or "shoal campuran".
#9: "karasin lain" and #2 "karasid" are inconsistent. Use one term, e.g. "karasin" for both.
#2/#6: "Tutupnya harus benar-benar rapat..." repeats the same point, as the English does. This is faithful but could be merged.
#6: "Beberapa tanaman apung juga bagus" is slightly terse; use "juga sebaiknya ada".

aphyocharax-rathbuni.name: Green Fire Tetra
notes: Item 5: 'Pencahayaan tidak terlalu penting' – English says lighting requirements are not critical; better 'Kebutuhan pencahayaan tidak khusus/tidak krusial'. Minor.
Item 10: 'Telur yang dihasilkan bisa mencapai 500 butir' fine, but 'sering kali pada pagi hari' omits 'first thing in the morning' (pagi-pagi sekali). Minor.
Item 10: 'Ikan ini memijah secara berkelompok dan menyebar telurnya' is okay but 'Group-spawning egg-scatterers' could be 'penyebar telur yang memijah berkelompok'. Minor.
Item 1/8: 'teman satu akuarium' is slightly awkward; 'ikan penghuni lain/tankmate' is more natural.
Item 8: 'Begitu pula, spesies bersirip panjang ... sebaiknya dihindari' – wording slightly stiff; 'robust, faster moving' translated as 'kuat dan gesit' is acceptable.
Item 5: 'kayu bogwood' and 'batu kerikil' – 'kayu bogwood' okay; 'pebbles' = 'kerikil/batu kali'. Minor.
Item 11: 'nama umum lain' for 'alternative vernacular name' fine; consider 'nama lokal'.

aphyolebias-schleseri.name: Killifish schleseri
notes: "ekor pedangnya yang unik": the English says only "unique sword" (the sword is on the tail in this species, but the source doesn't say so). "ekor" is an added detail; use "pedang yang unik" or check it against the source.
"menyelam masuk jauh ke dalam substrat": awkward. Use "menyelam jauh ke dalam substrat" or "membenamkan diri jauh ke dalam substrat".
"spesies annual": "annual" is left untranslated. Use "killifish annual" or "ikan semusim (annual)", which hobbyists understand. Also "annual yang khas" reads stiffly.
"Lokasi tipenya": use the standard term "lokasi tipe (type locality)" or "lokalitas tipe".
"bagian depan kata Aphyosemion": clumsy. Use "bagian awal kata".

aphyosemion-australe.name: Killifish Lyretail
notes: Item 9: "ikan yang lebih agresif saat makan" changes "more vigorous fish" and adds "saat makan". Use "ikan yang lebih aktif/tangkas" and drop the added feeding context.
Item 5: "(satu jantan dan dua betina)" is added detail that the English doesn't give. Remove it or keep it only as a neutral gloss.
Items 11 and 12: the text switches between "burayak" and "anakan" for fry. Use one consistent term, and note that "burayak" is less common among aquarium hobbyists.

aphyosemion-bitaeniatum.name: Aphyosemion bitaeniatum
notes: Item 1: "akuarium kecil sudah cukup" adds a claim; the English only says "small tank" (a requirement note). Use "akuarium kecil" or "cocok untuk akuarium kecil".
Item 2: "widely-distributed" is rendered "tersebar luas", which is fine, but "dianggap sebagai spesies lain" loses "represent". Consider "dianggap sebagai spesies yang berbeda".

aphyosemion-bivittatum.name: Killifish Bivittatum
notes: Item 1: "Two-banded lyretail" left in English as a common name; fine as trade name, but could add a local rendering or keep it consistently. Minor.
Item 3: "berpita" atau "bergaris" adds a slight alternative for 'banded'; keep one term (e.g. 'berpita') for fidelity. Minor.
Item 1: "SL" is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" for readability. Minor.

aphyosemion-bualanum.name: Bouala Lyretail
notes: Item 2: "Cameroon" inside the quoted original locality is left in English, which is fine as a quote; elsewhere "Kamerun" is used, so keep this consistent or add a note. Very minor.
Item 3: "kerabat satu genusnya" is slightly awkward; consider "spesies sekongenerik, A. elberti" or "satu genus".
Item 1: "Bouala lyretail" could be given as a common name in italics or quotes. Minor, optional.

aphyosemion-campomaanense.name: Aphyosemion campomaanense
notes: "hasil budidaya Jerman" is slightly ambiguous; "hasil penangkaran di Jerman" is more natural.
"dibingkai oleh dua garis kuning": "bars" would be more precisely "pita/strip", but the meaning is intact.
"Kerabat terdekat" is fine; "sempat bekerja" for "at times" is acceptable.

aphyosemion-celiae.name: Celia's Lyretail
notes: Item 4: "rumah keluarga Epie" adds "keluarga"; the English says only "Epie's home", so use "rumah Epie".
Item 4: "menerima Scheel sebagai tamu" is slightly stiff; "menjamu Scheel" or "menampung Scheel" would read more naturally.

aphyosemion-cognatum.name: Red-spotted Lyretail
notes: Item 1: "Specimen dari Lac Fwa ... juga diidentifikasi" – "juga" is not in the source; consider removing it.
Item 1: "Red-spotted lyretail" and "killifish" are left in English; consider adding a local name or italicising, e.g. "ikan killifish".

aphyosemion-congicum.name: Aphyosemion congicum
notes: Item 1: "habitat aslinya belum bisa dipastikan" changes "natural range" to habitat; use "wilayah sebaran aslinya", as in item 2.
Item 1: "Congo lyretail" is left in English with no gloss. Consider adding a local rendering or keeping it as an English trade name in quotes or brackets.

aphyosemion-decorsei.name: Aphyosemion decorsei
notes: Item 2: "kemungkinan sebarannya juga meluas" is slightly awkward; "sehingga sebarannya kemungkinan juga meluas" reads more naturally.
Item 1: "ikan killifish" is slightly redundant; "killifish" alone is fine.
Item 3: "Yun." for "Gr." is an unusual abbreviation; consider "Yun." spelled out as "Yunani".

aphyosemion-erythron.name: Aphyosemion erythron
notes: "Reddish lyretail" is left in English; consider adding a local rendering or keeping it as a trade name in quotes/italic, e.g. "lyretail merah".
"killifish" is left untranslated; this is acceptable as a hobby term, but could be marked once as "ikan killifish".

aphyosemion-gabunense.name: Killifish Gabon
notes: Item 8: 'Kesadahan: 5–15 °H' — the English '°H' is a German-hardness-style symbol; use 'dGH' consistently with the other hardness values.
Item 12: 'ikan yang tidak ikut memijah memakan sebagian telur' is fine, but 'Sebanyak 10–20 telur diletakkan setiap hari' lacks a subject. Say 'betina meletakkan 10–20 telur setiap hari'.
Item 12: 'ganti air sedikit' is awkward. Use 'ganti air sebagian kecil' or 'pergantian air dalam jumlah kecil'.
Item 10: 'Pilihan yang mungkin antara lain' is a stiff literal rendering. Use 'Pilihan yang cocok antara lain'.
Item 3 and item 7: 'lebih agresif' for 'more vigorous' shifts the meaning. 'Vigorous' means more energetic or boisterous, not aggressive. Use 'lebih lincah/gesit'.
Item 12: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is awkward in hobby usage. Use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi'.
Item 12: 'penyakit velvet' is acceptable, but add 'beludru' or the common local term for clarity.
Item 6: the volume '~28 liter' dropped the US gal figure (acceptable), but check that 28 L matches 45×25 cm at the original depth.

aphyosemion-hanneloreae.name: Hannelore's Lyretail
notes: Item 3: "second author Eduard Pürzl's wife" is rendered "istri penulis kedua deskripsi spesies ini"; "deskripsi spesies ini" is an added detail (the English only says second author), so state simply "istri penulis kedua, Eduard Pürzl".
Item 3: "berhias, sering berbentuk lira" is slightly stiff for "ornamented, often lyre-shaped"; "berhias" could be "berornamen" or "dihiasi", and "lira" is fine.
Item 1: "lyretail" and "killifish" are left in English without italics or a gloss. Both are accepted hobby terms, but you could write "ikan killifish" and keep "lyretail" as the trade name.
Item 2: "di tengah Pegunungan Du Chaillu" is OK, but "ada di seberang perbatasan" is a little colloquial; "ditemukan di seberang perbatasan" is more natural.

aphyosemion-herzogi.name: Herzog's Lyretail
notes: Item 1: "Herzog's lyretail" left in English; fine as trade name but could add Indonesian gloss. Minor.
Item 4: "sukses" in "hasil koleksi ikannya yang sukses" is slightly awkward; "berhasil" is more natural.
Item 4: "Asosiasi Killifish Jerman" is fine; "menyerahkan" is slightly stiff for "kindly provided" – "menyediakan" would be more natural.

aphyosemion-loennbergii.name: Killifish Aphyosemion loennbergii
notes: Item 1: "sebenarnya lebih luas" adds nuance ("actually") not in the English; use "Sebarannya di kawasan tersebut lebih luas".
Item 4: "sirip ekor ikan jantan anggota genus ini" is slightly awkward; better "sirip ekor jantan pada anggota genus ini".
Item 1: "killifish" is left in English without italics or a gloss; consider adding a local term or "(killifish)" formatting consistently.
Item 2: "yaitu juga di daerah aliran sungai" is clumsy; use "termasuk di daerah aliran sungai Lokundje dan Nyong".
Item 2: the English says the river is "now known as Kienké"; the Indonesian "Sungai 'Kribi'" adds "Sungai" before the name, which is acceptable but the sentence lacks a subject like the English.

aphyosemion-mimbon.name: Aphyosemion mimbon
notes: Item 1: "daerah aliran sungai di hulu" is slightly awkward; "drainage" could be rendered "daerah aliran sungai hulu". Meaning is intact.
Item 1/2: "anak sungai Mvé" and "Abanga, Mbei, Komo dan Nkam" drop "Sungai". Use "anak sungai dari Sungai Mvé" and "Sungai Abanga, Mbei, Komo, dan Nkam" for clarity.
Item 2: "anak sungai kecil Mvé" is awkward. Use "anak sungai kecil dari Sungai Mvé".
Item 4: "berhias, sering berbentuk seperti lira" is slightly stiff. "Berornamen, sering berbentuk lira" would read more naturally.
Item 4: "nama lokal untuk spesies Aphyosemion" is acceptable, but "nama daerah" is more natural for "vernacular name".
Item 1: "killifish" is left in English. This is an accepted hobby term, but you could add italics or an explanation on first use.

aphyosemion-ogoense.name: Killifish ogoense
notes: Item 11: 'Setiap hari diletakkan 10–20 telur' is passive and unclear about who lays them; better 'Betina meletakkan 10–20 telur per hari'.
Item 11: 'burayak' is used for fry, but 'anakan' is used earlier in the same text ('jumlah anakan'). Pick one term, e.g. 'burayak' or 'anakan ikan', for consistency.
Item 11: 'Dengan cara yang kedua' is vague. Say 'dengan metode gambut' so it is clear which method is meant.
Item 11: 'tidak sedang memijah memakan sebagian telur' is fine, but 'filter spons kecil bertenaga aerator' is awkward; use 'filter spons kecil berpenggerak udara (aerator)'.
Item 2/12: 'Broken-line lyretail' is left in English without a bracket or explanation. It is acceptable as a trade name, but it needs a consistent form.
Item 9: 'mengalahkan killi dalam berebut pakan' is a slight addition. The source only says 'outcompete', and 'terlalu agresif' also changes 'vigorous' (aktif/bertenaga).
Item 11: 'Telur yang terbasahi akan terangsang' is stiff; use 'terendam air akan merangsang penetasan'.
Item 8: 'Lebih menyukai pakan...' has a dropped subject; use 'Ikan ini lebih menyukai...'.

aphyosemion-rectogoense.name: Aphyosemion rectogoense
notes: Item 4: "julukan spesies ogoense" – 'specific epithet' is more standard as "epitet spesifik"; "julukan" is slightly informal.
Item 4: "berhias, sering kali berbentuk lira" is slightly awkward; consider "berhias, sering berbentuk seperti lira".

aphyosemion-splendopleure.name: Aphyosemion splendopleure
notes: Item 10: "Less eggs tend to fungus using the latter method" is rendered correctly, but "burayak" for fry is regional/less common. "Anakan" and "burayak" are mixed, so use one term consistently, e.g. "burayak" or "anakan ikan".
Item 10: "jumlah anakan cenderung lebih sedikit" translates "brood sizes". Say "jumlah burayak yang dihasilkan" or "jumlah telur per pemijahan" to be consistent.
Item 10: "peat" is used loosely in "filtrasi dengan peat". Use "filtrasi gambut (peat)" consistently, or keep "peat moss" only for the substrate.
Items 1, 5, 10: "Splendid lyretail" is left untranslated as a common name. Consider adding a local form such as "ekor lira", or keep the English trade name.
Item 10: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... bukan ide yang buruk" is a clumsy sentence. Add "tetapi" or restructure it: "menggunakan filter spons kecil ... tidaklah buruk".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is awkward in the aquarium hobby. Use "pembiak" or "penghobi/pembudidaya".
Item 10: "pakan yang lebih besar dan pakan beku" is correct, but "velvet" should be "penyakit beludru (velvet)".
Item 8: "saling teritorial" is awkward. Use "bersikap teritorial satu sama lain".

aphyosemion-striatum.name: Killifish Striatum
notes: Item 11: 'Burayaknya' / 'burayak' is the term for fry, which is fine, but 'peternak' for breeders is awkward; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi' instead.
Item 11: 'air yang diisi ... setinggi 2,5–5 cm' is fine, but 'dibibit' for 'seeded' is awkward; use 'diberi starter pakan' or 'diinokulasi'.
Item 11: 'air harus dibuat sangat dangkal' is fine, but 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' should read 'filter spons yang digerakkan udara (aerator)'.
Items 2/9: 'teman setanknya' is a bit informal; 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more natural.
Item 9: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'Loricariid kecil' are left as English terms; consider 'ikan sejenis Cyprinidae' or the local names.
Item 2/12: 'annual' is left untranslated; consider 'spesies annual (musiman)' for clarity.
Item 12: 'jari-jari ... sirip punggung' is acceptable, but 'garis vertikal' for 'vertical bars' is better as 'pita/garis tegak'.

apistogramma-agassizii.name: Apisto agassizii
notes: Item 3: 'sedikit di hulu kota Manaus' – 'just upstream from Manaus' is OK, but 'Lake Maximo' became 'Danau Maximo' fine; however 'munisipalitas' is non-standard, use 'kota/kotamadya' or 'kabupaten'.
Item 6: 'daun beech, ek' – 'ek' is rare; use 'daun oak' or 'ek (oak)'. 'Pot tanah liat' for 'ceramic flowerpots' should be 'pot keramik' (changed material).

Item 6: 'pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari; ganti air 10-15% per minggu' – okay, but 'lightly-stocked' → 'tidak padat penghuni' fine; 'Beberapa rumpun tanaman apung untuk lebih menyebarkan cahaya' is awkward; use 'agar cahaya lebih tersebar'.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but ambiguous; use 'daphnia (kutu air)'. 'invertebrata dasar perairan' fine.
Item 12: 'Para ahli' for 'authors' is a slight shift; and untranslated 'lineage' left in English, give Indonesian term (e.g. 'garis keturunan') or bracket it.
Item 4: 'waktu dalam setahun' – should be 'musim/waktu tertentu dalam setahun'; minor.
Item 14: references untranslated is fine; no issue.
Item 7: 'berkembang biak' for 'breed' fine; 'tangkapan alam' fine.
Item 1: 'kali' for creeks is colloquial/regional; consider 'anak sungai kecil' or 'sungai kecil'.

apistogramma-alacrina.name: Apisto alacrina
notes: Item 11: 'the putative subfamily Geophaginae' is rendered 'subfamili yang diduga, Geophaginae' – awkward and unclear; rephrase e.g. 'subfamili Geophaginae (yang diusulkan)'.

Item 11: 'Hobbyists ... in order to avoid mixing them and the potential of hybridisation' is OK, but 'Daftar semacam ini terus bertambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah' loses 'augmented by fish' nuance; say 'diperluas dengan ikan-ikan yang muncul di perdagangan'.

Item 11: 'sister to Crenicichla' translated 'kerabat terdekat (sister)' – fine, but 'lineage', 'sublineage', 'klad' left in English/loanwords; use 'garis keturunan/rumpun' and 'klad (clade)' consistently.

Item 3: 'parit/kali kecil' for 'creeks' – 'parit' means ditch/drain, which is wrong; use 'anak sungai kecil'. 'Kubangan' (wallow) for 'roadside pool' is also odd; use 'genangan/kolam kecil di tepi jalan'.
Item 8: ''dither' fishes ... 'ikan kecil sebagai dither fish'' – awkward; use 'ikan kecil penenang (dither fish)'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'chironomid larvae' left as 'larva chironomid'; more natural 'jentik/larva chironomid'. 'Kurang rewel' fine.

Item 1/2: 'Redspot dwarf cichlid' and 'Amazon' left untranslated; use 'Amazon' basin consistently, e.g. 'cichlid kerdil bintik merah'. Item 2: 'bertetangga' for 'neighbouring' is awkward; use 'yang berbatasan'; 'affluent' = 'anak sungai' ok.
Item 4: 'Base dimensions ... acceptable for a single pair' translated 'sudah cukup' ok; 'lembah Amazon' for 'Amazon basin' should be 'cekungan/DAS Amazon'.
Item 11: 'gurat sisi (linea lateralis) ... perkembangannya bervariasi dan sering kali tidak sempurna' word order muddles which is rudimentary; rephrase.

apistogramma-atahualpa.name: Apistogramma atahualpa
notes: "Sunset-Apistogramma" kept in quotes with hyphen; fine but could be written "Apistogramma Sunset" as hobbyists do.
"dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" is slightly awkward; "dideskripsikan secara resmi" or "sebelum dideskripsikan" is more natural.

apistogramma-baenschi.name: Apistogramma Inca
notes: Item 6: "Volumenya sekitar 72 liter" — the converted figure is not rounded sensibly; a tank of 72 L should be about 70 L (or give "sekitar 70 liter").
Item 13: "The A. nijsseni group..." fine, but "tribus" for 'tribes' is OK; however "hampir selalu berubah" is weak for "near-constant flux" — use "terus berubah hampir tanpa henti".

Item 13: "'klad Satanoperca' yang dukungannya kuat" — the English says "well-supported" and this is fine, but "Teleocichla sudah lama diakui" adds "sudah lama" (long) not in the source; use "sudah mapan diakui".
Item 13: "hubungan kelompok saudara ... antara Acarichthys dan Guianacara" — fine, but "Geophaginae yang masih bersifat dugaan" misplaces "putative"; say "subfamili Geophaginae (yang diduga)".
Item 7: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is an interpretation of "biologically-immature"; better "filter biologisnya belum matang".
Item 7: "Alder cone" left in English; use "buah/kerucut alder (alder cone)".
Item 10: "duel antarbetina terutama sangat sengit" — the English says "the latter particularly violent", OK, but "terutama sangat" is redundant; use "terutama sengit".
Item 5: "Dikoleksi" is awkward for "Collected"; use "Ditangkap/Diambil dari".
Item 1: "diternakkan secara komersial" for "produced on a commercial basis" is fine, but "Inca dwarf cichlid" left untranslated without local name; acceptable but could add "cichlid kerdil Inca".

apistogramma-barlowi.name: Apisto Barlowi
notes: Item 5: "Alder cone" left in English; use "kerucut alder" or add a description such as "(buah/kerucut pohon alder)".
Item 1/10: "larviphorous" left untranslated and unexplained; use an Indonesian description (induk membawa burayak di mulut) or put the English term in brackets.
Item 1: "Barlow's dwarf cichlid" left untranslated; add an Indonesian common-name form, e.g. "cichlid kerdil Barlow".
Item 3: "Spesies ikan yang hidup bersamanya" for "sympatric" is acceptable, but "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward; use "sesama anggota genus (A. agassizii)".
Item 2: the type locality quote is left in English; if it is a quote, add an Indonesian gloss.

Item 11: "lineage" and "grup spesies" are mixed; "tribus" is non-standard, use "tribe" or "suku". "Para penghobi ... untuk menghindari" is awkward. "Kesimpulan utama lain ... adalah konfirmasi bahwa" is awkward.
Item 11: "hampir selalu berubah-ubah" is a loose rendering of "near-constant flux"; use "terus berubah".
Item 4: the conversion is correct, but "cukup layak" is vague; "just about acceptable" is better rendered "baru cukup memadai".
Item 10: "Aquarist" is left in English; use "penghobi akuarium". "A. 'sp. Kelleri'" is inconsistent with the earlier A. sp. 'Kelleri' (copied from the source).

apistogramma-bitaeniata.name: Apisto bitaeniata
notes: Item 2: the Kullander type-locality quote is left in English, "Colombia (Amazonas), environments of Leticia". The translator then adds "(yaitu sekitar Leticia)", which is an added gloss. Translate the quote or keep it as a proper citation, but don't leave it half-done.

Item 11: "ada varian peralihan ... serta varian yang sangat gelap" is fine, but "sungai Tefé dan sungai Tapajós" is wrong. Tefé is a town and a lake, not a river, so the English "between the Tefé and Tapajós rivers" was adapted without checking. Check that this wording is accurate.
Item 11: "garis lateral bawahnya" is a vague translation of "lower lateral stripe". Use "garis/pita lateral bawah" so it isn't read as the lateral line ("gurat sisi").
Item 12: the reference list is left untranslated, which is allowed. No fix needed here.
Item 5: "Pot tanah liat (keramik)" for "ceramic flowerpots" is slightly imprecise. Use "pot bunga keramik".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is the common hobby term, but the English also lists "Artemia". Keep consistency, e.g. "Daphnia (kutu air)".
Item 1: "Two-striped dwarf cichlid" and the colour names are left in English without Indonesian context. This is acceptable, but add "ikan" or "cichlid kerdil" so the sentence reads naturally.
Item 3: "kali kecil" for "creeks" is a little unnatural. Use "anak sungai kecil" or "parit alami".

apistogramma-borellii.name: Apisto borelli
notes: Item 4: 'Volume approximately 41 litres' is kept as 41 liter, but the conversion should be rounded sensibly (about 40 liter)

Item 6: 'populasi liar dikumpulkan dari habitat' loses the English passive 'have been collected'; use 'populasi liar pernah dikumpulkan dari habitat...' or 'ditemukan di habitat...'. 'hasil budidaya komersial' for 'Commercially-produced' is acceptable but 'hasil penangkaran' would be more consistent with the rest of the text
Item 12: 'Para peneliti' for 'authors' is okay, but 'lineage, kompleks, dan grup' leaves 'lineage' and 'grup' untranslated; use 'garis keturunan/kelompok' or put the English term in brackets
Item 12: 'Grup A. borelli' should read 'A. borellii' (a spelling mismatch with the Latin name used elsewhere; keep it exactly as in the source)
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but it is better to write 'Daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)' because hobbyists use it as a name

Item 5: 'Selama tersedia cukup tempat bersembunyi dan struktur' – 'cover' is translated as 'tempat bersembunyi', and 'struktur' is vague; 'tempat berlindung dan struktur' reads more naturally. 'Pot keramik ... semuanya bisa dimanfaatkan' is acceptable

apistogramma-brevis.name: Apistogramma brevis
notes: Item 1: "sungai kecil blackwater" and item 3 "sungai kecil, kali, dan anak sungai ... juga di sungai-sungai yang lebih kecil": "streams, creeks, tributaries, smaller rivers" is rendered clumsily and redundantly ("sungai kecil" and "sungai yang lebih kecil"). Use "sungai kecil, anak sungai, dan sungai-sungai berukuran kecil".
Item 5: "gua kecil ini memberi betina tempat berlindung" is fine, but "ditanami dengan rimbun" is awkward. Use "ditanami rapat" or "banyak tanaman".
Item 8: "ikan catfish" is redundant. Use "catfish kecil" or "lele kecil".
Item 10: "burayak" is a fairly formal term. "Anakan" is more common among hobbyists. "Pakan ikan dewasa" is acceptable.

apistogramma-cacatuoides.name: Apisto Cacatuoides
notes: Item 3: "Almost exclusively bred specimens ... are traded" became "Hampir semua yang dijual adalah ikan hasil tangkaran"; "tangkaran" is fine, but "sports" rendered as "varian" loses the meaning of mutant colour forms. Also "tanpa ragu menjadi alasan mengapa varian ... sering kali bisa" is clumsy.

Item 3: "the most colourful males will always be the first victims" and "quickly forms very colourful sports" are acceptable, but "Fungsi biologis" for "biological sense" is a slight shift. Better: "makna biologis".

Item 8: "Ganti air 10–15% per minggu sudah cukup" is fine, but "very large water changes are best avoided" was translated as "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar", which is OK. The real problem is "Filter, atau setidaknya arus air", which should read "Filtrasi".
Item 9: "agar mau berkembang biak" is OK, but "Commercially-produced fish" as "hasil budidaya komersial" is acceptable. "lagi-lagi" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "juga" or "sekali lagi".
Item 14: "Spesies ini juga diberi nomor 'A' A200 dalam sistem DATZ" is acceptable. But "vernacular names" became "nama dagang", which shifts the meaning slightly. Better: "nama populer".

Item 14: "Daftar ini terus bertambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah" is a mistranslation of "in a state of near-constant flux". Fix the grammar so that the lists are augmented with fish from the trade and "nyaris terus berubah".

Item 1: "Cockatoo cichlid" is left untranslated and the term "line-bred" became "tangkaran selektif". Better: "hasil pembiakan selektif (line-bred)". "Tangkaran" can also confuse readers, since "tangkapan" means wild-caught.

apistogramma-cinilabra.name: Apistogramma cinilabra
notes: Item 3: "Laporan pengambilan sampel" for "Collection reports" is wrong; use "laporan penangkapan/koleksi di alam".

Item 3: temperature sentence "temperatures above 27 °C" is fine, but "Electrical conductivity ... and temperatures" structure is kept; no fix needed beyond checking. Real issue is item 7: "Moina" and "Daphnia" are rendered as "kutu air (daphnia, moina)", which adds a generic term and drops the separate genus names; list Daphnia and Moina as in the source.
Item 5: "Alder cone" left in English; use "kerucut alder (buah alder)".
Item 8: "bullyish" is rendered "suka menindas sesama jenisnya"; "conspecifics" is fine, but "karasin" should be "karakin" or "characin" as hobbyists write it.
Item 9: "more typically on the anterior edge" is awkward; rephrase as "terutama pada tepi depan sirip perut".
Item 11: "kerabat satu genusnya" for "congeners" is awkward; use "spesies Apistogramma lain".
Item 11: "Daftar semacam ini terus bertambah ... hampir selalu berubah" is loose for "augmented ... near-constant flux"; rephrase.
Item 4: "sepasang indukan" for "breeding pair" is fine, but "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is a bit stiff; use "Ukuran alas akuarium".
Item 10: "Pemijah substrat" is unclear; use "Ikan pemijah di substrat" or "substrate spawner" in brackets.
Item 10: "merayu betina lain" for "courting" is odd; use "mengawini/mendekati betina lain".

apistogramma-commbrae.name: Apisto commbrae
notes: "Masken-Apistogramma" is left in German in quotes; acceptable as a trade name, but consider adding a short gloss such as "(Apistogramma bertopeng)" for readers.
"hanya sesekali saja tersedia" is redundant ("hanya" and "saja"); use "hanya sesekali tersedia".

apistogramma-diplotaenia.name: Apisto diplotaenia
notes: Item 1: "Cichlid kerdil" is fine, but "Badannya sangat ramping" drops that the slim build refers to the animals in general; minor, acceptable.
Item 3: "hampir kehilangan dua garisnya" is a bit ambiguous; consider "hampir menghilangkan" or "garis gandanya nyaris hilang".

apistogramma-elizabethae.name: Apisto elizabethae
notes: Item 2: The type locality quote is left wholly in English ('affluent of Rio Uaupés at Trovao, about 20 kilometers from mouth of Uaupés ... Amazonas State, Brazil'). Translate the descriptive words, for example 'anak sungai rio Uaupés di Trovao, sekitar 20 kilometer dari muara Uaupés ... negara bagian Amazonas, Brasil'. Keep the place names and coordinates as they are.

apistogramma-eremnopyge.name: Apistogramma eremnopyge
notes: Item 11: "dukungannya kuat" is placed after "klade Satanoperca" in the list, but the English says "well-supported". Fine, but the first item should read "hubungan kelompok saudara yang dukungannya lemah". The real fault: "hampir selalu berubah-ubah" for "near-constant flux" is OK. The larger problem is that the reference list in item 12 is untranslated, which is allowed.

Item 11: "Apistogramma ... genus cichlid Amerika Selatan dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak" drops "among". Use "salah satu genus ... dengan spesies terbanyak", which is what it already says. No change needed.

Item 11: "Geophaginae yang masih bersifat dugaan" attaches 'putative' to the subfamily. Fine, but "tribe", "lineage" and "sublineage" are left in English. Use "tribus", "garis keturunan" or "galur" with the English term in brackets.
Item 5: "Alder cone" is left as English. Add a Indonesian explanation such as "kerucut alder (buah alder)".
Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically-immature aquaria" is acceptable, but "filter spons bertenaga aerator" would be more natural as "filter spons dengan aerator (udara)".

Item 7: "kutu air (daphnia, moina)" labels Artemia, Daphnia and Moina inconsistently. Artemia is not a water flea, and "kutu air" is not used for moina. Use "artemia, daphnia, moina" or "kutu air (daphnia dan moina)" with a clear separation.
Item 10: "sementara betina yang menjaga" is a clumsy rendering of "leaving the female to guard". Use "sementara betina menjaga dan merawat telur serta burayak".

apistogramma-eunotus.name: Apistogramma eunotus
notes: Item 11: "hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine, but "Kullander ... membagi ... menjadi enam subfamili. Salah satunya ... berisi 16 genus" is acceptable. Real issue: "garis keturunan (lineage)" is awkward. Use "linaje/garis keturunan" consistently or keep "lineage".
Item 11: "klad" is a non-standard term. Use "klade (clade)".
Item 11: "Para peneliti" for "authors" is acceptable, but "tribus" is better as "tribe (tribus)".
Item 5: "Kayu bogwood" is redundant. Use "kayu bogwood" or "kayu rawa/driftwood" with a short explanation.
Item 5: "pencahayaan sedang sampai redup" is fine, but "akuarium tidak padat" is ambiguous for "lightly-stocked". Use "jumlah ikannya sedikit".
Item 1/3: "sungai cabang" for "tributaries" is non-standard. Use "anak sungai" and distinguish "creeks" as "sungai kecil/parit".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "cacing darah" is fine. Consider using "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

apistogramma-gephyra.name: Apistogramma gephyra
notes: "hasil penangkaran Jerman" is slightly ambiguous; "hasil penangkaran di Jerman" would be clearer.
"ikan ini sungguh indah" is fine, but "ikan-ikan ini" would match the plural "fishes" more closely.
"dasar kerikil ... terdiri dari pasir halus" is slightly imprecise. "substrat kerikil yang setidaknya sebagian bercampur pasir halus" would be more natural.

apistogramma-gibbiceps.name: Apisto gibbiceps
notes: Item 1/11: "ikan yang sudah beradaptasi dan tenang di akuarium" adds "di akuarium"/"beradaptasi" beyond the English "settled fish"; consider "ikan yang sudah tenang".
Item 8: "membantunya merasa tenang" is fine, but "pencilfish" is left in English; consider "ikan pensil (pencilfish)".
Item 8: "satu jantan dan tiga betina atau lebih" is fine; "pemijah gua" in item 10 is better as "pemijah di gua" (minor).
Item 3: "blackwater" is left untranslated; consider "air hitam (blackwater)".
Item 1: "Blackline apisto" is left as the English trade name with no Indonesian gloss; acceptable but consider "apisto blackline".

apistogramma-hoignei.name: Apistogramma hoignei
notes: Item 9: "lebih berwarna" is slightly stiff; "warnanya lebih cerah" or "lebih berwarna cerah" reads more naturally.
Item 11: "Geophaginae (yang diduga)" is awkward; use "subfamili Geophaginae (putatif)" or "yang diduga" right after "subfamili".

apistogramma-hongsloi.name: Apistogramma hongsloi
notes: Item 4: "kira-kira 41 liter" is fine, but the base size was converted without issue; no change needed except consider keeping consistent. (minor)
Item 5: "Ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar" is slightly awkward; use "pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar".
Item 5: "daun beech, oak" left as English; use "daun beech/bük, oak (ek)" or add a short gloss such as "daun oak (ek)".
Item 5: "burayak" is acceptable, but "anakan" or "larva ikan" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is non-standard; use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)". "pakan serpihan" could be "flake".
Item 8: "'dither'" left untranslated; add a gloss such as "ikan penenang (dither)".
Item 11: "lineage, sublineage" left in English; use "garis keturunan, sub-garis keturunan" (or put the English term in brackets).

apistogramma-iniridae.name: Apistogramma iniridae
notes: "Ikannya sangat tangguh": EN "very stable" is better as "sangat stabil/mudah dipelihara"; "tangguh" slightly shifts meaning, but acceptable.
"Seperti kerabat dekatnya, A. uaupesi, para jantan memamerkan...": the subject mismatch from the source is kept. Better: "Seperti kerabat dekatnya A. uaupesi, jantan spesies ini memamerkan...".
"Leksikon" is a bit stiff; "Asal nama" or "Etimologi" is more natural in the hobby context.
"pertarungan hierarki" is a literal rendering; "pertarungan untuk menentukan dominasi/peringkat" reads more naturally.

"A. iniridae berbeda dari A. uaupesi terutama karena A. uaupesi memiliki...": "the latter" is rendered correctly, but "sirip ekor berbentuk lira" is fine; no change needed except to consider "bentuk lyre".

apistogramma-macmasteri.name: Apistogramma macmasteri
notes: Item 11: "Selain itu... Para penghobi cenderung memberi label data lokasi koleksi" is fine, but "Daftar semacam ini terus bertambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah" is a little awkward; better "terus ditambah ... dan hampir selalu berubah".
