Item 5: "Ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" is fine, but "daun beech, oak" could use the common names (mis. daun beech/oak) or a short gloss; minor.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but hobbyists often use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)"; consider adding the Latin name.
Item 11: "lineage" and "grup" are left in English; consider "garis keturunan" or "linies" with the English term in brackets.
Item 3: "kotamadya Tame" for municipality is questionable; in Colombia the standard Indonesian term is "munisipalitas/kota praja"; also "dikoleksi" is better as "ditangkap/dikumpulkan".

apistogramma-megaptera.name: Apistogramma megaptera
notes: In 2, "rios" translated as "sungai" is fine; no change needed except consider "Orinoco hulu" -> "hulu Sungai Orinoco" for naturalness.
In 6, "Lexicon" rendered as "Asal nama" is acceptable but "Etimologi" would be more standard.

apistogramma-mendezi.name: Apistogramma mendezi
notes: Item 7: 'around 41 litres (11 US gal)' converted to 'sekitar 41 liter'; per the rounding rule, 45×30 cm base ≈ 40 L. Better: 'sekitar 40 liter'.
Item 7: the English says 'Base dimensions ... acceptable for a single pair'. This is fine, but the sentence structure was split. No error here.
Item 8: 'biologically-immature aquaria' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis' is closer to the source.
Item 8: 'Tata kayunya sedemikian rupa' is a stiff phrase and sounds awkward. Use 'Susun kayu sedemikian rupa'.
Item 8: 'Buah alder (alder cone)' – 'alder cone' is a cone, not a fruit. Use 'kerucut alder' (strobilus).

Item 3: the type locality is left in English. This is acceptable, as it is a quoted citation. However, 'dekat kota Barcelos' for 'Barcelos municipality' loses the sense of 'municipality'. Use 'wilayah kota (munisipalitas) Barcelos'.
Item 12: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Artemia' is also fine.
Item 20: 'tempat A. mendezi bernaung' is an odd phrase. Use 'yang menjadi anggota A. mendezi'.
Item 20: 'Geophaginae yang masih bersifat dugaan' – the English 'putative' modifies 'subfamily', so this is acceptable.
Item 10: 'germ-poor' became 'minim kuman'. This is acceptable.

apistogramma-nijsseni.name: Apisto Panda
notes: Item 5: "Ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" reads as if "very large" water changes are avoided, which is acceptable. But "Beberapa kelompok tanaman apung untuk lebih meredam cahaya" is clumsy. Use "beberapa rumpun tanaman apung untuk meredam cahaya lebih jauh".

Item 5: "sebagian besar populasi akan senang dengan tanin" is a literal rendering of "most populations will appreciate". Rephrase it as "sebagian besar populasi menyukai tanin", or clarify that it means wild populations or strains.

Item 3: "sungai kecil, kali dan anak sungai" renders streams, creeks and tributaries. "kali" and "sungai kecil" overlap. Also, "juga di sungai-sungai yang lebih kecil" for "smaller rivers" is confusing next to "sungai kecil". Use "sungai yang lebih kecil" or "sungai berukuran kecil" and make the terms distinct.
Item 1: "Region Loreto" is non-standard. Use "Wilayah Loreto" or "Departemen Loreto". The same applies in items 2 and 4.
Item 4: "Volume: ±54 liter" keeps the approximate value. "±" is better written as "sekitar 54 liter" or "~54 liter".
Item 11: "lineage", "tribe" and "klad" are left in English or loan forms. Consider "garis keturunan" and "tribus" with the English term in brackets.
Item 11: "Teleocichla sudah lama dipastikan bersaudara" adds "lama" (long since). The English says only "well-established", so use "sudah mapan dipastikan" or "terbukti kuat".
Item 11: "Para peneliti juga telah mengelompokkan" for "authors" is acceptable. "hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is fine.

apistogramma-norberti.name: Apistogramma norberti
notes: Item 4: "Region Loreto" is awkward; use "Wilayah Loreto" or "Daerah Loreto".
Item 5: "very large water changes are best avoided" is rendered as "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar". This is fine, but "Selama tersedia" would read more naturally as "Asalkan tersedia".
Item 5: "sekaligus memicu tumbuhnya koloni mikroba" is slightly off. "Bring the growth" would be better as "mendorong pertumbuhan".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)" is clearer. "Artemia" is also fine.
Item 10: "Bertelur di substrat" is vague for "substrate spawner". Use "Pemijah substrat" or "Bertelur pada permukaan padat".
Item 11: "jumlah spesies terbanyak" is slightly stronger than "among the most speciose". Use "salah satu ... dengan jumlah spesies terbanyak".

apistogramma-panduro.name: Apistogramma panduro
notes: "Bintik di ekornya" / "bintik ekor": the hobby term is "bintik ekor" (tailspot); use it consistently instead of "Bintik di ekornya" (minor).
"grup ini": "kelompok ini" is more natural in Indonesian (minor).
"nama penghormatan" for "dedication name": a more natural phrasing is "nama untuk menghormati (seseorang)" (minor).

apistogramma-pantalone.name: Apistogramma pantalone
notes: Item 2: type locality quote left in English ("Departmento Loreto, Province Maynas, ..."); it is running text, so translate the descriptive parts or give an Indonesian rendering (original place names can stay).

Item 3: "Sungai Tigre" is fine, but "sungai kecil" for "stream" plus the missing "77 °F" is OK; the real issue is "lightly tanned" rendered as "sedikit kecokelatan karena tanin", which adds a cause the source does not state. Use "agak kecokelatan".

Item 1: "akuarium yang sudah benar-benar matang" is OK, but "tidak mau makan pakan kering" is stronger than the source "does not eat dried food" in the same way; and "hyper-acidic" is rendered "sangat asam", which weakens it. Use "sangat asam ekstrem" or "hiperasam".

Item 10: "Pemijah substrat" is awkward; use "Ikan penebar telur di substrat (substrate spawner)". "pendekatan kawin" for "courtship" is non-standard; use "pacaran" or "ritual pemijahan". "berbiak" for "breed" is acceptable but "memijah" is more common.

Item 5: "Alder cone (buah kerucut pohon alder)" is left half in English; use "kerucut alder" consistently. "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" changes "biologically-immature" slightly; say "belum matang secara biologis".

Item 9: "pendekatan kawin" for "courtship" is non-standard; use "pacaran" or "pemijahan". "bintik di pangkal ekor" should be "bintik di pangkal ekor (peduncle)" and it is OK, but "extensions" (fin extensions) is vague.

apistogramma-paulmuelleri.name: Apistogramma paulmuelleri
notes: Item 3: "up to 80 cm (31 in) deep" is fine, but "on August 2011" → "Pada Agustus 2011" is OK; no issue. Real issue is elsewhere (see below).
Item 5: "biologically-immature aquaria" rendered as "yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – acceptable, but "Alder cone" left in English; use "kerucut alder (alder cone)" or a local equivalent.
Item 11: "Geophaginae ... 16 genera" and "Hasil ini didukung" fine; but "klad", "lineage", "grup" are left as mixed jargon; use consistent terms (e.g., "garis keturunan", "kelompok").

Item 11: "a well-supported 'Satanoperca clade'" → translation puts "yang dukungannya kuat" after the name; fine, but "weakly-supported sister group relationship" reads awkwardly; rephrase for clarity.
Item 11: "tergantung suasana hatinya" for "depending on mood" – better "tergantung kondisi/suasana hati ikan" (minor).
Item 4: "Volume: ~41 litres" kept as 41 L though a conversion rule would round; minor, 45×30 base volume unspecified so leave as is.
Item 13: "Currently more than 80 species" vs item 11 "around 70 species" – faithful to source, no fix needed.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but "Daphnia" (kutu air/dapnia) is more precise; "artemia" should be "Artemia" per hobby usage.

apistogramma-rupununi.name: Apistogramma rupununi
notes: "Ekor lira" is a bit unnatural; better "sirip ekor berbentuk lira (lyretail)" so hobbyists recognise the term.
"cichlid kerdil" is acceptable, but "cichlid dwarf" or "cichlid kerdil (dwarf cichlid)" is more common in the hobby.
"beberapa jantan sudah sekitar 5 cm" omits "panjang"; use "sudah sepanjang sekitar 5 cm".

apistogramma-steindachneri.name: Apisto Steindachneri
notes: Item 11: 'Farias et al. (1999, 2000, 2001)' is fine, but 'the most detailed molecular analysis of the grouping to date' became 'hingga saat itu', which is acceptable. However, 'a well-supported "Satanoperca clade"' was moved so the 'weakly-supported' qualifier now reads 'hubungan ... dengan dukungan yang lemah'. This is OK, so there is no issue here.
Item 11: 'Teleocichla sudah lama dipastikan' adds 'sudah lama' (long). The English says only 'well-established'. Use 'sudah mapan/kuat dipastikan'.

Item 7: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' is wrong. Moina and Daphnia are both water fleas (kutu air), but this phrasing drops the original separate items, and 'artemia' is lowercase for a genus name. Write Artemia, Daphnia, Moina as in the source.
Item 5: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' reads fine. But 'Alder cone' is left in English without explanation. Add 'kerucut/buah alder' or a short gloss.
Item 5: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is slightly non-standard. 'filter spons bertenaga udara' or 'filter spons dengan aerator' is more natural.
Item 8: the term 'dither' stays in English in quotes without explanation. Add a gloss such as 'ikan pengalih/penenang'.
Item 10: 'merayu betina lain' is slightly odd. Use 'mengawini/memikat betina lain'.
Item 3: 'μS/cm-1' became 'μS/cm', which is fine. 'Daya hantar listrik' is acceptable.

apistogramma-trifasciata.name: Apisto Trifasciata
notes: Item 11: "garis lateral di tubuh" for "lateral body stripe" can be confused with the lateral line (gurat sisi). Use "garis memanjang di sisi tubuh" or similar.
Items 1 and 3: "creeks" and "tributaries" become "anak sungai" and "cabang sungai", which overlap. Use "sungai kecil/kali" for creeks to keep the two terms distinct.
Items 1, 2 and 11: "lembah" and "daerah aliran sungai" are used loosely for "basin". Use "DAS" or "cekungan" consistently.
Item 13: the common name "Three-Striped Dwarf Cichlid" is left in English. Add an Indonesian gloss such as "cichlid kerdil bergaris tiga", or keep it in brackets.

apistogramma-uaupesi.name: Apistogramma uaupesi
notes: "Jadi ini bukan soal varian lokasi": the source says 'locality forms'; "varian lokasi" is slightly vague. 'bentuk lokal/varian lokalitas' would be closer.
"yaitu keragaman warna di dalam satu spesies" is an added explanation not in the source. It is harmless but optional.

apistogramma-urteagai.name: Apistogramma urteagai
notes: "Spesies ini cukup mudah dipelihara" is fine, but "dijual" for "offered" is acceptable; consider "jarang tersedia di pasaran" for a more natural hobby phrasing.
"Asal nama:" for "Lexicon" is fine, but "pola tubuhnya" slightly narrows "pattern" (the pattern is probably the lateral line marking); consider "pola (corak)".

apistogramma-velifera.name: Apistogramma velifera
notes: Item 3: "manfish altum" – "Altum angels" is Pterophyllum altum; "manfish" is the common Indonesian name for Pterophyllum, so it's acceptable. Consider "angelfish altum" or "manfish altum (Altum angel)" for clarity.

Item 5: "berenang menyamping di dekat betina" – the English says "laterally to the female" (alongside/sideways facing her); "di dekat" is slightly loose. Prefer "berenang menyamping di hadapan betina".
Item 5: "comparably quarrelsome" rendered as "relatif suka bertengkar"; prefer "cukup agresif terhadap jantan lain" for natural hobby wording.
Item 4: "rewel" is colloquial for fish; "tidak terlalu menuntut" or "tidak terlalu pemilih" is more standard in a handbook.
Item 2: "tidak pernah diimpor secara rutin" is fine, but "saat ini sama sekali tidak ada impor" is a bit stiff; "saat ini tidak ada ikan yang diimpor sama sekali" reads more naturally.

apistogramma-viejita.name: Apisto viejita
notes: Item 5: "Despite being incredibly rare in captivity, imports are even less frequent" is rendered as "sangat langka di penangkaran" and then "sebagian besar ikan yang beredar kemungkinan hasil penangkaran". The English is illogical, but the translation drops "most captive specimens will be captive bred" as a certainty. Say "sebagian besar spesimen di penangkaran adalah hasil penangkaran"; "kemungkinan" is an added hedge.
Item 5: "biologically-immature aquaria" is translated as "siklus nitrogennya belum matang". Prefer "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum siklus)". This is minor.
Item 5: "Buah alder (Alnus)" should use the hobby term "kerucut alder" or "cone alder". "Buah" (fruit) is slightly inaccurate for cones.

Item 11: "Selain itu, banyak spesies memiliki ... bentuk warna geografis yang di masa depan mungkin ternyata merupakan spesies tersendiri, mungkin juga tidak" is awkward. Rephrase it as "yang kelak bisa jadi terbukti sebagai spesies tersendiri, bisa juga tidak".
Item 11: "hampir selalu berubah" for "near-constant flux" is acceptable. "penghobi yang mengkhususkan diri pada ikan ini" slightly changes "specialised hobbyist". Use "penghobi spesialis".
Item 7: "kutu air (daphnia, moina)" renders Daphnia/Moina as a generic "water flea" term, but "kutu air" is acceptable. Artemia is fine. "pakan dasar" is not an issue.
Item 1: "Red edge apisto" is left untranslated as a trade name, which is OK. "Apisto viejita jantan" is fine.

apistogrammoides-pucallpaensis.name: Apistogrammoides pucallpaensis
notes: "freckles (bintik-bintik di wajah)": use the Indonesian term "flek/bintik-bintik di kulit (freckles)" or just "bintik kulit"; the English word left in place is slightly awkward.
"cichlid kerdil": the common hobby term is "dwarf cichlid" or "cichlid kerdil". This is fine, but "inilah yang terkecil" is slightly stiff.
"serangan parasit (yang tidak berhasil)": the ambiguity is carried over. Make it clear that the parasite's attack was unsuccessful, e.g. "serangan parasit yang gagal".

aplocheilus-blockii.name: Green Panchax
notes: Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but no depth is given in the source; check that the sentence reads as describing the tank. Minor.
Item 6: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but ambiguous; "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)" is clearer for hobbyists.
Item 1: "killifish" is left in English; consider italics or "ikan killi".
Item 7: "burayak" is correct, but "moss" and "microworm" are left in English; consider "lumut" and "cacing mikro".
Item 6: "larva chironomid (cacing darah)" is fine, but "jentik/larva nyamuk merah" is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.

aplocheilus-lineatus.name: Striped panchax
notes: Item 11: "burayak" for fry is a regional/Javanese-leaning term; "anakan" or "larva/benih" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 4: "sumur di dataran rendah" is literal for "lowland wells"; fine, but "tumbuhan di permukaan" could be "tanaman permukaan".
Item 2/6: "jago melompat" is colloquial; "pelompat andal" or "suka melompat" is more fitting for a handbook.
Item 11: "kuning telurnya habis terserap" is slightly awkward; "kantung kuning telur" (yolk sac) is more precise.
Item 5: "Alas akuarium" is OK, but "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is more natural.

aplocheilus-panchax.name: Kepala timah
notes: "sirip anusnya" -> use "sirip dubur" (standard term for anal fin).
"Orang sudah punya pemanas listrik" -> the English says people now had them (new availability); better "Orang mulai memakai/beralih ke pemanas listrik" to convey the change.
"Ikan ini hidup di permukaan air" -> more natural "ikan permukaan" (surface-dwelling fish).

"Lain halnya di bawah lampu neon dari atas, panchax terlihat..." is a clumsy sentence; rephrase, e.g. "Lain halnya di bawah lampu neon dari atas, tempat panchax tampak cukup abu-abu"; "cukup abu-abu" is awkward ("agak keabu-abuan").
"tahan terhadap air asin di muara" -> "air payau" would be more apt for estuaries, though the source says salty.
"Suhu air ... sangat berubah-ubah" -> "sangat berfluktuasi" is more natural.
"Parameter air" for "water values" is fine, but "praktis tidak berpengaruh" could be "praktis tidak berperan".

aplocheilus-parvus.name: Dwarf Panchax
notes: Item 1: "artinya tahan pada rentang salinitas yang lebar" is an added explanation that isn't in the source. It is accurate, but you could drop it or put it in brackets.
Item 6: "kebanyakan ikan ini lama-lama mau menerima pakan kering" is a bit colloquial. "umumnya dapat dilatih menerima pakan kering" reads more naturally.

aposturisoma-myriodon.name: Farlowella myriodon
notes: Item 1: "baju zirah dada atau pelindung dada dari kulit" is a clumsy rendering of "cuirass or corslet of leather"; use something simpler like "baju zirah kulit (cuirass/corslet)".
Item 3: "ikan lele/catfish yang lebih besar" is awkward; use "ikan catfish yang lebih besar" or "lele-lelean".
Item 3: "Teman setangki" is an uncommon term; "tankmate" is usually "penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "teman satu akuarium".
Item 2: "Dept. Ucayali" is left abbreviated in English; write "Departemen Ucayali".
Item 5: "berbeda dari genus yang sirip punggungnya..." slightly expands the original "vs." clause; keep it closer to the source.

apricaphanius-baeticus.name: Baetican toothcarp
notes: Item 3: "spesies ini selalu ditemukan di saluran-saluran pesisir kecil yang hipersalin" – English says "in all other cases this species occurs"; "selalu" is an overstatement. Use "di semua kasus lainnya spesies ini ditemukan di...".
Item 2: "Sekitar separuhnya terancam musnah akibat Gambusia holbrooki atau Fundulus heteroclitus" is OK, but "5-7000 ha" is kept as in the source and is ambiguous. Write "5.000–7.000 ha".

Item 9: fin description reversed/ambiguous. English: dark distal band in dorsal, ventral, anal (the former three), and 4 rows of spots in the latter two (anal and caudal). The translation says "Tiga sirip pertama... dua sirip terakhir" with four fins listed, so the counts do not match (3+2=5 for 4 fins). Fix to dorsal, ventral, anal bands; anal and caudal spots.
Item 5: "sebagian populasi paling cocok di air tawar" and "Idealnya Anda mengetahui..." are fine, but "Warnanya dan kondisinya" is awkward; use "Warna dan kondisinya".
Item 4: Volume "108 liter" is correct, but check "Sepasang atau satu trio" - fine. Item 1: "Baetican toothcarp" left in English with no Indonesian gloss; add an explanation or accepted trade name.
Item 10: "Aphanius typically eat their eggs/fry" - genus name used where the text refers to the fish; "burayak" is fine, but "kimia air" is awkward; use "parameter air".
Item 1/6: temperature "2–30 °C" matches the source, but the source's "2–30°C" is likely a typo for 20-30; consider flagging it rather than copying.

apricaphanius-iberus.name: Spanish toothcarp
notes: Item 6: "kesuburannya menurun" for "reduced fecundity" is slightly off; "daya reproduksi" or "jumlah telur/keturunan" is more natural.
Item 4/10: "setup akuarium" and "microworm" are left in English. They are acceptable, but "penataan akuarium" would read better.

apricaphanius-saourensis.name: Sahara toothcarp
notes: Item 4: "Sepasang atau tiga ekor" loses the meaning of "trio" (one male with two females). Use "sepasang atau satu trio (1 jantan, 2 betina)".
Item 9: "pita vertikal kasar" adds "vertikal", which the English doesn't say. Use "pita-pita kasar".
Items 1 and 2: "sangat terancam punah / kritis (critically endangered)" is clumsy because of the slash. Use "kritis (critically endangered)" or "sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)".
Item 5: "kalau suka" is too casual for a handbook. Use "jika diinginkan".

apteronotus-albifrons.name: Black Ghost
notes: Item 14: "akhirnya kurus lalu mati" adds "lalu mati" (and dies). The English only says "wastes away", so use "menjadi kurus" or "semakin kurus".
Item 3: "bisa lecet karena bergesekan atau bertengkar" adds "bergesekan" (rubbing). The English "get into scrapes" only means getting into fights or trouble. Use "berkelahi" or "terluka".

Item 19: "pengalaman yang ada tidak menunjukkan hal itu" is vague and stilted. Use something like "hal itu tidak sesuai dengan pengalaman penulis/pemelihara", or the neutral "menurut pengalaman, hal itu tidak benar".
Item 2: "Dari pengalaman, ikan ini bisa tumbuh..." has no subject for the experience. Say "Menurut pengalaman pemelihara" so the sentence reads naturally.

apteronotus-leptorhynchus.name: Brown Ghost Knifefish
notes: "rutin diimpor" for "regularly stocked": slightly shifts meaning (stocked = available in shops). Consider "rutin tersedia" or "rutin dijual".
"Apteronotus leptorhynchus berwarna keemasan" with no article or noun: reads awkwardly. Consider "seekor Apteronotus leptorhynchus ..." or add "ikan".

apteronotus-macrostomus.name: Brown Ghost Knife
notes: "setiap ekor butuh tempat sembunyi": sebaiknya "setiap ikan" agar lebih natural.
"memanjakan mata pemiliknya": sedikit bebas untuk "delight the aquarist"; bisa "menyenangkan para penghobi".

"penangkap ikan hias": lebih lazim "penangkap ikan hias" atau "pengumpul ikan hias"; "tidak diimpor" sebaiknya "kemungkinan besar tidak diimpor" (sudah benar), pertimbangkan "daerah aliran Sungai Essequibo" tetap OK.
"polusi listrik" untuk "electrosmog": cukup dipahami, tetapi bisa ditambah penjelasan "gangguan sinyal listrik".

argonectes-longiceps.name: Argonectes longiceps
notes: "Ikan ini pertama kali diimpor dari Kolombia, dan saat itu hanya beberapa ekor" - the English says it was imported for the first time in a few specimens; this is acceptable, but the sentence order shifts the emphasis slightly. Consider "pertama kali diimpor dari Kolombia dalam jumlah sedikit".
"panjang standar" - consider adding the hobby term "(standard length)" or phrasing it as "panjang standar (SL), tanpa sirip ekor" for clarity.
"Ikan ini damai" - more natural as "Ikan ini berperangai damai" or "Ikan ini tidak agresif".
"partikel makanan dari dasar" - "dasar" is fine, but "dasar akuarium/substrat" would be clearer.

ariopsis-felis.name: Hardhead catfish
notes: Item 1: 'Commonly captured from catwalks, bridges and piers' was translated as 'sering tertangkap pancing dari ...'. 'pancing' (angling) is added and not in the source. Also 'passes' became 'selat-selat sempit', which is not accurate. Use 'alur/celah perairan' or similar.

Item 2: 'Massachusetts ... to southern Florida in USA and Mexico' is acceptable, but 'Teluk Meksiko bagian utara sampai Florida selatan' reads as if the range starts at Massachusetts and the Gulf. Make the geography clearer.

Item 4: 'continental waters' was translated as 'perairan paparan benua'. This changes the meaning, because the source says continental, not continental shelf. Use 'perairan benua' or 'perairan pesisir benua'.
Item 5: 'umumnya umum sampai melimpah' is clumsy. Use 'umumnya tergolong sering dijumpai hingga sangat melimpah'.

Item 6: 'when the fish is excited' became 'gelisah' (restless), which is not the same as excited or agitated. Use 'terangsang/terganggu'. The sentence about shoes is also missing the point that the spine can puncture them, so the meaning of 'offers little protection' is partly lost.

Item 8: 'manuscript name' became 'nama dari naskah', which is awkward. Use 'nama manuskrip'. 'catfish/ikan berkumis' is acceptable, but 'bycatch in trawl and saltwater angler catches' is rendered as 'pukat', which is not trawl. Use 'pukat tarik/trawl'. 'Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)' is acceptable, but 'Risiko Rendah' is not the standard Indonesian term. Use 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Kekhawatiran Rendah'.
Item 7: 'Belum dilaporkan' with 'pemijahan' is acceptable, but 'breeding' is more general than 'spawning'. Use 'pembiakan'.

ariopsis-seemanni.name: Colombian shark
notes: Item 1: "sebagian besar hidupnya di air payau" has no verb and reads clumsily; use "menghabiskan sebagian besar hidupnya di air payau".
Item 1: "padahal bisa tumbuh" adds a contrast the English doesn't have; use "tetapi" or "namun".
Item 5: "a few inches long" became "sekitar 10 cm", which is a little too large for "a few inches". Use "beberapa sentimeter" or about 7–8 cm.
Item 11: "segera minta bantuan medis" adds "segera" (immediately), which the English lacks. "Sebaiknya juga minta saran medis" is closer.

aristochromis-christyi.name: Aristochromis
notes: Item 1: the English says the fish hunts small fish in crevices and also ambushes prey, rolling onto its side as it approaches. The Indonesian says 'dengan memiringkan tubuhnya... saat mendekat', which is fine, but the sentence 'Selain itu, ikan ini juga menyergap mangsa' is slightly clumsy. Low priority.

Item 10: 'Jantan melepaskan spermanya' and 'mengeluarkan kelompok telur' are fine. But 'untuk menyebarkan agresi' is odd. Use 'mengurangi/menyebarkan agresi ke beberapa betina', and make clear the harem spreads the male's aggression.

Item 10: 'Sebagian peternak' for 'breeders' is acceptable, but 'burayak' for 'brood' in 'memuntahkan telur atau burayak' adds a stage. The English only says 'brood' spat out or eaten, and 'menghindari burayak dimangsa' is a stretch of 'fry predation'. Use 'induk memakan anaknya'.
Item 10: 'Burayak sudah cukup besar untuk menerima naupli artemia sejak awal' is fine. However, 'artemia' should keep the genus style 'Artemia' or 'naupli Artemia' because it is a Latin name.
Item 11: 'up to around 4" long' was converted to 'sekitar 10 cm', which is correct. 'efisien' for 'efficient ambush predator' is fine.

Item 7: 'kerang hijau' for 'mussel' and 'kerang darah' for 'cockle' are specific species choices that may not match. Prefer the generic 'kerang' and 'kerang kecil/remis'. 'lancefish' is left untranslated; add a gloss such as 'ikan lancefish (sand eel)' or use an Indonesian equivalent.
Item 8: 'teman satu akuarium yang muat masuk ke mulutnya' is awkward. Use 'ikan lain yang cukup kecil untuk masuk ke mulutnya'. Also 'harem... satu jantan' is fine.
Item 9: 'jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin' and 'siap memijah' are fine. 'Garis gelap di tubuh juga menghilang' is fine.

arnoldichthys-spilopterus.name: African Red Eye Tetra
notes: Item 1: 'Lokasi temuannya kurang dari 10, semuanya di kawasan...' is fine, but the English says 'an area' with 'extensive deforestation and pollution'. This is OK. The main issue is untranslated English in running text: 'African red-eyed tetra' is left as the name; use an Indonesian trade name or add 'tetra mata merah Afrika'.
Items 1 and 11: 'large-scaled African characin' and 'Niger tetra' are left in English quotes. Translate the first (e.g. 'karasin Afrika bersisik besar') and keep 'Niger tetra' as the trade name.
Item 2: 'penggundulan hutan serta pencemarannya tidak terkendali' is clumsy; also 'Endemik Nigeria. Di sana' is a bit choppy. Rephrase more naturally.
Item 3: 'Anak sungai dan sungai' - 'Streams' is better as 'Aliran sungai/sungai kecil dan sungai'.

Item 5: 'Cabang kayu apung' is misleading, since driftwood is 'kayu apung' only loosely; use 'kayu driftwood' or 'ranting dan cabang kayu'. Also 'Menyaring air lewat gambut' - say 'filtrasi dengan gambut'.

Item 8: 'Synodontis spp.' and 'cichlid kerdil' are fine; 'tetra Alestidae' ok. 'makin berkurang pada ikan yang sudah tua' - 'less-pronounced in older specimens' is ok but 'tua' could be 'dewasa/berumur'.
Item 10: 'burayak' is fine; 'dikondisikan' ok. 'driving' translated as 'mengejar betina dengan gencar' is fine.

asellus-aquaticus.name: Water louse
notes: Item 7: "tanaman yang memang sudah mati atau membusuk" — the English says plants that are "already dying"; "mati" overstates this. Use "sudah hampir mati/layu" or "yang sudah membusuk".
Item 2: "ikan dasar" for "bottom-feeding fish" is too vague. Use "ikan pemakan dasar" or "ikan yang mencari makan di dasar".
Item 6: "perubahan mendadak lebih dari 5 derajat" should specify the unit, "5 °C".
Item 8: "kru pembersih" is a literal calque of "clean-up crew". Use "tim pembersih" or "pembersih akuarium".
Item 1: "kutu kayu (woodlice)" is acceptable, but "Hewan ini masih berkerabat" adds "masih", which is not in the source. Drop "masih".
Item 3: "identik dengan iklim sedang" for "associated with a temperate climate" is slightly off. Use "berkaitan dengan" or "umum di wilayah beriklim sedang".
Item 4: "aliran yang berarus deras" is awkward. Use "sungai besar maupun kecil yang berarus deras".
Item 8: "penebar telur" is non-standard for "egg scatterers". Use "ikan penyebar telur".

aspidoras-fuscoguttatus.name: Aspidoras fuscoguttatus
notes: Item 3: "dH: 12" has no unit/context; fine as source, but consider "dGH: 12" for consistency with Indonesian hobby usage.
Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern...)" is acceptable, but the Indonesian IUCN term is usually "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah"; consider "Berisiko Rendah".
Item 4: "merasa tenang" for "settle" is slightly loose; consider "agar ikan ini betah".
Item 4: "kayu bogwood" mixes terms; use "kayu bogwood" or "akar kayu (bogwood)" consistently, and "driftwood" is rendered as "kayu apung", which also reads oddly; consider "kayu driftwood/akar kayu".
Item 1: "Nama spesiesnya" for "specific epithet" should be "epitet spesifiknya".

aspidoras-pauciradiatus.name: Sixray Corydoras
notes: Item 2: the English calls it an 'ideal tankmate for tetras, dwarf cichlids'. 'teman satu akuarium' is slightly stiff, so use 'cocok dipelihara bersama tetra...'. 'cichlid kerdil' is acceptable, but 'cichlid cebol' or 'dwarf cichlid' is more common among hobbyists.

Items 1 and 12: 'false corydoras' and 'sixray corydoras' are left in English with no Indonesian rendering. Put the English in quotes after a short Indonesian explanation such as 'corydoras palsu' and 'corydoras enam jari-jari'.
Item 6: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is a reasonable rendering of 'biologically immature set-up', but 'akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis' is closer to the source.
Item 1: 'lele berlapis baja' is an odd literal rendering of 'armoured catfish'. Hobbyists usually say 'lele lapis baja' or 'lele bersisik keras (armoured catfish)'.

Item 8: 'cacing sutra (Tubifex)' is fine, but 'pakan kering yang tenggelam' should be 'pakan kering tenggelam (sinking)'. 'Foraging omnivores' rendered as 'mencari makan di dasar' adds 'di dasar', which the source does not say.

aspidoras-raimundi.name: Aspidoras raimundi
notes: Item 1: 'lele berzirah' is awkward for armoured catfish; 'lele lapis baja' or 'lele berpelat' / 'ikan lele berlapis' is more natural.
Item 6: 'cacing sutra (Tubifex)' is fine, but 'larva chironomid (cacing darah)' could be 'larva Chironomus/jentik cacing darah' as used by hobbyists; 'sebagainya' fine. Minor only.
Item 8: 'saat sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' is slightly imprecise; 'saat penuh telur / sedang bunting telur' is closer.
Item 7: 'suka berkelompok' acceptable; 'hidup bergerombol' would be consistent with item 1.

aspidoras-taurus.name: Aspidoras taurus
notes: Item 6: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is acceptable but "biologically immature set-up" is more naturally "akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: volume "kira-kira 68 liter" is fine; no issue.
Item 4: the type locality quote is left in English; acceptable as a quotation, but consider translating the descriptive parts (e.g. "close to highway" -> "dekat jalan raya") for readability.

astacopsis-gouldi.name: Lobster air tawar raksasa Tasmania
notes: Item 6: "temperatures of up to 18°C" rendered as "suhu sampai 18 °C"; this is fine, but "Lobster raksasa ini menyukai ... suhu sampai 18 °C" is fine too, so no change needed here.

Item 5: "to avoid bouts with smaller inhabitants" became "agar tidak menyerang penghuni yang lebih kecil", which changes the meaning. Bouts means fights or conflicts, not only the crayfish attacking. Use something like "agar tidak terjadi perkelahian dengan penghuni yang lebih kecil".
Item 9: "Keep putting and replacing food" became "Terus masukkan dan ganti pakan". It is acceptable but unclear; add that uneaten food should be replaced.
Item 4: "snags" became "kayu/dahan tumbang terendam", which duplicates the earlier "kayu lapuk yang terendam". The slash wording is awkward; use "tunggul dan dahan tumbang".
Item 12: "raised ridge ... rostrum" became "rusuk/gerigi menonjol". The slash alternative "gerigi" (serration) is not in the source; use "rusuk/punggung menonjol" only.
Item 9: "Australian bass" and "platipus" are fine, but "Molting" would more commonly be written "Ganti kulit (molting)" in Indonesian hobby usage. Minor.
Item 2: "fishing" rendered as "penangkapan" is fine, but "seldom bred in home aquaria" should be checked for the logic link with the ban.

asterophysus-batrachus.name: Gulper Catfish
notes: Item 12: 'Feeder fishes are essential' → 'Ikan pakan mutlak diperlukan' is fine, but 'The fish feed readily on feeder fish' contradicts the next sentences in the source; the translation keeps it as is. 'susah disuruh makan' is awkward; use 'sulit mau makan'.
Item 12: 'manfish altum' is non-standard; use 'angelfish altum' or 'skalar altum' (Pterophyllum altum).
Item 11: 'ikan mas koki kecil' should be 'ikan mas kecil' or 'goldfish kecil'. The source says 'small goldfish', which is not specifically koki.
Item 9: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically immature set-ups' is acceptable, but 'setup' is left in English; use 'rangkaian akuarium' or 'sistem'.
Item 7: 'snorkeling' should be 'snorkeling/menyelam dengan snorkel'. 'ia melesat keluar' is fine. Note 'sulit ditangkap' is fine too.
Item 3: 'cuma mulut' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'hanya terdiri dari mulut'.

Item 17: 'Check list' is a reference list left untranslated, as allowed. Item 5: 'Check List...' is capitalised differently from the source; keep the title's original casing ('Check list of the freshwater fishes...').
Item 1/16: 'ogre catfish' is kept as an English trade name, which is fine, but 'Rio Negro' vs 'Sungai Orinoco' is inconsistent in naming; use 'Sungai Negro' or keep 'Rio' consistently.

astronotus-crassipinnis.name: Oscar crassipinnis
notes: "cf." is described as "singkatan" (abbreviation) of "conferre" — acceptable, but the original says "stands for"; fine. Optionally use "cichlid" -> "sikklid" is not needed.
"sebegitu kurang dipahami seperti oscar" is slightly awkward; consider "yang sekurang-kurangnya dipahami seperti oscar" or "sekurang dipahami" for more natural phrasing.

"Salah satunya, A. zebra, sudah berulang kali diimpor belakangan ini" is fine, but "ocellated spots" translated as "bintik mata (ocellus)" is OK; the "dorsal fin" region could be "sirip punggung" — fine.

astronotus-ocellatus.name: Oscar
notes: Item 22: the English has stray Vietnamese glosses; the translation correctly dropped them, so this is fine and needs no change.
Item 3: 'sepanjang bola football Amerika (bola rugbi)' is awkward and inaccurate, because an American football is not a rugby ball. Use 'sepanjang bola rugbi' or drop the comparison.
Item 3: 'hidup selama anjing peliharaan' is unnatural. Use 'bisa hidup selama umur anjing'.
Item 6: 'tempat ikan ini terlepas ke alam liar' loses the sense of being released. Use 'ikan ini dilepasliarkan'.
Item 6: 'spesies hama non-asli (invasif)' adds 'invasif' and is slightly awkward. Use 'spesies hama non-asli'.
Item 28: '1.000–2.000 butir' is fine. The '100 gallon' conversion to 'sekitar 380 liter' is right, but 'dengan volume sekitar 380 liter atau lebih' is acceptable.
Item 27: 'selama masa pendekatan' for 'courtship' is slightly off. Use 'selama masa pacaran/pemijahan'.
Item 27: 'Belum ditemukan data' drops the source's 'we' neutrally, which is acceptable. 'burayak, burayak' is repetitive, so rephrase the second one as 'dapat dipisahkan'.
Item 2: 'Tank level: Top, mid-dweller' became 'atas dan tengah'. This is OK, but 'Hardness: 5 dGH' is left as in the source.
Item 13: 'Oscar sangat menuntut kualitas kimia air' is a loose rendering of 'sticklers for good water chemistry'. Use 'sangat peka terhadap kualitas air'.

astyanax-bimaculatus.name: Two Spot Astyanax
notes: Item 4: 'Volume: ±432 liter' keeps the figure but the English also gives ~114 US gal, which is rightly dropped. This is fine. The real problem is in item 8: 'its adult size and vigorous' was rendered 'sangat aktif', which adds 'sangat' (very). The English says only 'vigorous'. Use 'cukup aktif' or 'aktif'.
Item 1 and 11: 'untuk sesuatu yang dianggap sebagai kompleks spesies' is clumsy. Use 'untuk apa yang dianggap sebagai kompleks spesies' or 'yang dianggap merupakan kompleks spesies'.
Item 1: 'Two spot astyanax' is left as an English name with no Indonesian gloss. Add a local name or italicize it, for example 'astyanax dua bintik (two spot astyanax)'.
Item 7: 'seharusnya cukup sebagai sebagian besar pakan utamanya' is awkward and repeats itself. Use 'sudah cukup sebagai pakan utama'.
Item 10: 'artemia' is lower-case, but 'Artemia' is a genus name and the English capitalises it. 'ganti air dilakukan secara rutin' is passive and stiff. Use 'penggantian air dilakukan rutin'.
Item 5: 'Tidak rewel' for 'Not critical' is fine, but 'output filter' is untranslated. Use 'pancuran/aliran keluar filter'.
Item 2: 'Guyana Prancis' is non-standard. Use 'Guyana Prancis' or 'Guyana Française'. Also 'ada di mana-mana' is too colloquial for 'ubiquitous'. Use 'tersebar luas'.
Item 9: 'Betina perutnya terlihat jelas membulat' is stiff. Use 'perut betina tampak jelas membulat'.

astyanax-jordani.name: Tetra Buta
notes: "Tetra buta" is acceptable, but consider "tetra gua buta" (or add "blind cave tetra" in brackets on first mention) to keep the cave meaning.
"perairan permukaan" is a bit awkward; "perairan permukaan (di luar gua)" or "perairan terbuka" reads more naturally.
"keluarga tetra" would more precisely be "famili tetra (Characidae)" in hobby/scientific usage; "keluarga" is acceptable but less precise.

astyanax-kennedyi.name: Kennedy's tetra
notes: Items 1 and 2: "hulu lembah Amazon" is slightly off for "upper Amazon basin". "Daerah aliran sungai Amazon bagian hulu" or "cekungan Amazon bagian hulu" is more standard.
Item 4: "Ikan ini tumbuh baik" is a literal rendering of "thrives". "Hidup baik" or "berkembang baik" reads more naturally.

astyanax-mexicanus.name: Blind Cave Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the source says only "in the evening" ("pada malam hari").
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka sudah memijah" adds "Biasanya" (usually), which softens the source's "They should have spawned". Use "Mereka seharusnya sudah memijah".
Items 5 and 10: "setup" is left as English. "Penataan akuarium" or "set-up" would be more natural.

ataeniobius-toweri.name: Striped goodeid
notes: Item 4: "sedikit lebih mudah dipelihara di dalam ruangan" is fine, but "Goodeinae tumbuh paling baik" is OK; no change needed. The only real issue is item 8's "ikan beranak bergigi": use "ikan beranak (Poeciliidae/cyprinodontiformes)" or "killifish beranak", since "ikan beranak bergigi" is a calque of "livebearing toothcarps" and is not a term hobbyists use.
Item 8: "tali nutrisi (trofotenia)" is an acceptable gloss, but "tali pemberi makan" is closer to "feeding cords"; minor.
Item 8: "burayak" for newborn live-bearer young is unusual. Hobbyists say "anakan" or "fry"; use "anakan ikan".

Item 8: "the eggs develop ... until spawning to the point where the young hatch at the moment of spawning" is rendered with "dilahirkan" and "telur dikeluarkan", which is slightly inconsistent; keep to "saat dikeluarkan/lahir".
Item 8 heading changed: "The live-bearing Goodeinae are 'true livebearers'" was translated "Goodeinae adalah...", dropping "live-bearing"; minor.
Item 3: "daerah aliran sungai Rio Verde" is fine, but "thermal streams" as "aliran sungai air panas" overstates it; use "aliran air termal/hangat".

atractosteus-spatula.name: Ikan aligator
notes: #2: "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" is redundant. Use "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" -> "hingga ke negara bagian Veracruz di selatan".

#8: "ikan yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa yang tidak muat di mulutnya" is ambiguous because of the stacked "yang". Rephrase, e.g. "ikan non-agresif berukuran serupa yang terlalu besar untuk muat di mulutnya".

atractosteus-tropicus.name: Tropical Gar
notes: "pada bulan-bulan musim semi": Indonesia has no spring. Use a neutral wording such as "pada musim pemijahan (musim semi di habitat aslinya)".
"perairan mati (backwater)": "perairan mati" is not a clear term for backwaters. Use "anak sungai yang tenang", "genangan tepi sungai" or "backwater" with a short explanation.
"ikan lance" for lance fish is unclear. Use "ikan lance (sand eel)" or the common local name, such as "ikan pasir".

atyoida-pilipes.name: Udang Kipas
notes: Item 1: "tidak jadi camilan di antara dua waktu makan" is slightly vague; the original says "too large to be eaten" by larger fish. Better: "cukup besar sehingga tidak dimakan ikan sebagai camilan di antara waktu makan".
Item 1: "alam telah menyediakan" is acceptable, but "Induk alam" (mother nature) is dropped; minor.
Item 2: "Semua A. pilipes ... akan cukup cepat berkumpul di situ" is a bit ambiguous. Consider "Semua A. pilipes di akuarium akan segera menemukan tablet itu".
Item 2: "capit berbentuk kipas" is fine, but "pakan tablet yang hancur perlahan" could be "tablet pakan yang perlahan terurai" (decay/disintegrate).
Item 3: "kelompok yang cukup besar" fits "larger aggregations" loosely; "kelompok besar" is closer. "tidak rewel" is fine.

atyopsis-moluccensis.name: Udang bambu
notes: Item 2: "finely grated dry food" translated as "pakan kering yang dihaluskan" - acceptable, but "cyclops beku" could be clarified as "cyclops beku" (fine); "partikel melayang" for "floating material" is fine.
Item 3: "kipas tangannya" ("hand fans") is awkward; use "kipas di capitnya" or "kipas capit". Also "capit" for "claws" and "kaki jalan" are okay, but "ujung ... kaki jalan" for "end limbs" is vague.
Item 3: "diam di tempat yang berarus" is slightly awkward; better "menempatkan diri di aliran arus".
Item 5: "cukup merepotkan" is weaker than "connected with some expenditure" (butuh biaya/upaya cukup besar); consider "memerlukan upaya dan biaya tertentu".
Item 1/3: "Moluccan mountain rock shrimp" and "Gabon giant fan shrimp" left in English; consider adding Indonesian names (e.g., "udang kipas raksasa Gabon") with English in brackets.

auchenipterichthys-coracoideus.name: Midnight catfish
notes: Item 8: "serta catfish lain berukuran serupa yang tidak agresif" repeats "berukuran serupa yang tidak agresif", so it reads clumsily. Shorten it, e.g. "characin, cichlid, dan catfish lain dari famili seperti ... yang berukuran serupa dan tidak agresif".
Item 1: "ikan catfish (kerabat ikan lele)" is redundant and a bit awkward. Use "ikan catfish" or "lele" on its own.
Item 5: "kayu apung/bogwood" is clumsy. Use "driftwood" or "kayu apung" only. "bogwood" is a different term from "driftwood" in the source.
Item 11: "jari-jari lunak sirip anal" adds "lunak" (soft), which the source does not say ("anal fin rays"). Use "jari-jari sirip anal".
Item 1: "jari-jari lunak sirip anal" has the same added "lunak". Use "jari-jari sirip anal".
Item 10: "pernah teramati menghasilkan telur fertil" is stiff. Say "bertelur dengan telur yang subur" or similar. "Tidak ada pengasuhan oleh induk yang teramati" could be smoother.

auchenipterus-nigripinnis.name: Paraguay shark-cat
notes: #10: "gerombolan" usually has a negative connotation (gangs). Use "kawanan" or "kelompok" for a group of fish.

auchenoglanis-occidentalis.name: Giraffe catfish
notes: #1, #3, #6, #10: "ikan lele" for catfish is acceptable, but Auchenoglanis is a bagrid-type (giraffe) catfish, not a true lele (Clarias). Consider "ikan catfish" or "patin/lele Afrika" for clarity.
#12: "sheatfish" left untranslated; add a local gloss such as "lele Eropa" or keep it in brackets after the Indonesian term.
#2: "Least Concern / Risiko Rendah" mixes English and Indonesian; use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" for consistency.
#7: "air yang lebih sadah" is ambiguous (sadah = hard); "air yang lebih keras/sadah (hard water)" would read more naturally.
#9: "raksasa yang kalem" is okay, but "raksasa yang lembut/jinak" is more natural for "gentle giant".

aulonocara-baenschi.name: Yellow Regal Peacock
notes: Item 1/4: 'Max size: ♂ 120 mm SL, ♀ 90 mm SL' – the imperial figures were rightly dropped, but for the tank volume the ~243 litres is kept and the US gal is dropped, which is fine. No fix is needed there.
Item 10: 'sejumlah butir' and 'peternak' are acceptable, but 'peternak' for breeders is better as 'pembiak' or 'breeder'.
Item 8: 'terlalu heboh dan aktif' – 'heboh' is colloquial and wrong in register for 'boisterous'. Use 'terlalu agresif/aktif' or 'terlalu galak'.
Item 7: 'chironomid larvae' became 'cacing darah' and 'Tubifex' became 'cacing sutra'. Both are accepted local terms, but 'Tubifex' is a genus name and could stay as 'Tubifex (cacing sutra)'.
Item 3: 'Perairannya biasanya relatif dangkal, sekitar 4–6 meter' – 'between 4-6 metres' should be 'antara 4–6 meter', and 'sekitar' adds an approximation that is not in the source.
Item 9: 'lebih berwarna' is a literal rendering of 'more colourful'. Prefer 'warnanya lebih cerah/menarik'.
Item 10: 'mulai menampilkan perilaku pamer' – 'courtship display' reads clumsily. Prefer 'menunjukkan tarian/tampilan pacaran'.
Item 10: 'cairan sperma (milt)' – 'milt' is the sperm-containing fluid. Use 'sperma (milt)' to avoid redundancy.

aulonocara-ethelwynnae.name: Chitande Aulonocara
notes: Item 1: "garis-garis cokelat cokelat-tua" is garbled and repeats the word. Use "garis-garis cokelat cokelat" only if it is deliberate; otherwise write "garis-garis cokelat tua (cokelat cokelat)" as "garis-garis cokelat tua" or "cokelat cokelat-kehitaman". The simplest fix is "garis-garis cokelat cokelat" → "garis-garis cokelat tua".

Item 11: "chocolate-brown striping" became just "cokelat tua". Use "cokelat cokelat" (chocolate) wording such as "cokelat kehitaman (warna cokelat)" to keep the colour nuance, or at least match item 1.
Item 7: "juga bisa cocok" is awkward. Use "juga bisa memberikan hasil yang baik".
Item 10: "peternak" for "breeders" is not the usual hobby term. Use "pembudidaya" or "breeder".

aulonocara-hansbaenschi.name: Red Shoulder Peacock
notes: Item 10: "burayak" is quite formal. Hobbyists more often write "anakan" or "benih", so consider one of those.

aulonocara-jacobfreibergi.name: Malawi Butterfly
notes: Item 10: "urutan hierarki" is redundant; use "hierarki kelompok" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 7: "juga bisa cocok" is slightly awkward; "juga bisa berhasil baik" would be more natural.

aulonocara-stuartgranti.name: Aulonocara stuartgranti
notes: #8: "terlalu ribut dan agresif" adds "agresif", which the English doesn't have ("excessively boisterous"). Use "terlalu aktif/ribut".
#7: "juga bisa cocok" is awkward for "can also work well". Use "juga bisa berhasil baik" or "juga sangat baik digunakan".

auriglobus-modestus.name: Buntal Emas
notes: "Pernah ada kiriman" / "Belakangan baru diketahui": fine in meaning, but "A shipment ... was received" implies the shop received it; consider "Kiriman ... diterima" for fidelity."
"ikan lele-lelean (catfish)": catfish is simply "lele" or "ikan lele/catfish"; "lele-lelean" is misleading since many catfish are not true lele."
"ikan sili (spiny eel)": "sili" is not a standard hobby term; use "spiny eel" or "tilan" (Mastacembelus)."
"ikan pisau (knifefish)": hobbyists usually say "knifefish" or "ikan pisau/belida"; acceptable but check consistency."
"Yang berlaku terhadap spesies ikan lain juga berlaku terhadap sesama jenisnya": awkward; better "Hal yang sama berlaku terhadap sesama buntal emas."
"kurang ajar" for "insolent" is too harsh/colloquial; use "lancang" or "agresif"."
"bukan pemilih pakan": "food specialists" means specialised feeders; better "bukan pemakan spesialis".

auriglobus-silus.name: Buntal Silus
notes: In item 3, "bisa cenderung berkelahi" is slightly redundant; use "cenderung berkelahi" or "bisa berkelahi".

In item 4, "ikan buntal yang lincah ini didatangkan" is fine, but "will be kept mainly by experts" is rendered as "kebanyakan akan dipelihara oleh ahli". "Umumnya dipelihara oleh ahli" would sound more natural.

austrofundulus-guajira.name: Austrofundulus guajira
notes: Omitted fact: "First time in limited quantities" is not translated; add something like "Pertama kalinya tersedia dalam jumlah terbatas".
Minor: "keluarga killifish" is fine, but "Dunia Baru" could be clarified as "Benua Amerika (Dunia Baru)".

austrolebias-nigripinnis.name: Black Fin Pearl Killifish
notes: Item 3: "Di air yang kotor, killifish pasti jatuh sakit" – "inevitably" is fine, but the EN "broth" (dirty brew) is dropped; acceptable. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 1: "Panjangnya paling banyak hanya 4,5 cm" is acceptable, but "bertengkar" is a bit weak; consider "berkelahi/bersaing dengan sesamanya".
Item 2: "hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "exclusively" is softened to "hanya"; consider "sepenuhnya/secara eksklusif hasil penangkaran".

Item 4: "pakan boleh diberikan sesering dan sebanyak yang diinginkan" is OK; "kita selalu diingatkan" adds "selalu" (always) not in the English ("Normally one cannot warn enough"). Use "Biasanya bahaya pemberian pakan berlebihan tidak bisa terlalu sering diingatkan".

Item 6: "jantan dan betina menyelam masuk jauh ke dalam dasar" – specify "ke dalam substrat/dasar gambut"; "dasar" alone is ambiguous. Also "Larva yang sudah berkembang sempurna" – the English refers to embryos in eggs; "larva" before hatching is misleading, use "embrio".
Item 6: "telur menetas dan siklusnya dimulai lagi" – "the game begins again" is rendered okay; "dibiakkan dengan berhasil" is awkward, use "berhasil dibiakkan".
Item 3: "Umur sampai satu tahun bisa terlihat di akuarium" is stiff; use "Di akuarium, ikan ini bisa hidup sampai satu tahun".

axelrodia-riesei.name: Ruby Tetra
notes: #19: "hancurkan pelet atau pakan serpihan" translates "pill" as pelet. "tablet" is closer to the source.
#22: "berisik (boisterous)" is a slightly off rendering of boisterous. "sangat lincah/ribut" or "kasar" would fit fish behaviour better, and the English in brackets is unnecessary.

#28: "mempelajari setiap spesies atau genus secara tuntas" is slightly looser than the English "exhaustive study of these on an individual basis". Consider "mengkaji masing-masing takson secara menyeluruh".

axelrodia-stigmatias.name: Pepper Tetra
notes: Item 11: 'hardly shy' means 'barely shy/not shy at all' but also 'prefer not to swim too much' — source is itself odd; 'tidak terlalu pemalu' is acceptable, but 'lebih suka tidak banyak berenang' fine. (minor)
Item 5: 'Volumenya disebutkan sekitar 54 liter' — 'disebutkan' (is stated) adds a claim of citation; EN says 'Volume is about 54 litres'. Use 'Volumenya sekitar 54 liter'.
Item 7: 'Cryptocoryne spp.' sentence: 'You can add... Microsorum, Taxiphyllum or Cryptocoryne spp.' is fine, but 'alder cone' left untranslated; use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)' for clarity.

Item 10: 'minimal 8–10 ekor, karena dengan jumlah itu ikan akan lebih berani' — fine; however 'sparring' translated as 'saling adu' is acceptable. Item 9: 'burayak artemia' is wrong for Artemia nauplii; burayak means fry. Use 'nauplius artemia'.
Item 9: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' — 'kutu air' is a common name for Daphnia only; keep as 'daphnia, moina' to avoid ambiguity.

Item 14: 'Faktor lain yang membatasi adalah bahwa...' is awkward; rephrase, e.g. 'Kendala lain adalah dalam banyak kasus masalah ini hanya bisa diselesaikan dengan meneliti tiap kelompok secara menyeluruh satu per satu.'
Item 15: reference list left untranslated — correct, no fix.

babylonia-spirata.name: Keong macan
notes: Item 1: 'Nama: keong macan (Babylonian snail)' adds a local name not in the source; 'Tiger snail' appears only in a reference title. Verify it is an established name for Babylonia spirata, or use 'keong babilonia'.
Item 9: 'frozen brine and mysis shrimp' is rendered 'artemia beku'. 'Brine shrimp' is Artemia, so this is acceptable, but 'udang mysis beku' reads as a separate item. Write 'artemia dan mysis beku'.
Item 9: 'freeze-dried larvae' is rendered 'larva kering beku (freeze-dried)'. This is awkward. Use 'larva serangga/jentik beku-kering (freeze-dried)', or say which larvae.
Item 9: 'Keong pemakan bangkai ... sangat peka' is fine, but 'Kalsium dibutuhkan untuk beberapa proses hidup yang vital' is stiff. Use 'sejumlah proses kehidupan penting'.

Item 10: 'Pada umumnya mereka adalah keong whelk predator yang memakan hewan yang berada di pasir' is clumsy and mixes 'mereka' with 'keong ini'. Use 'keong whelk pemangsa yang memakan hewan di dalam pasir'.
Item 10: 'cocok dengan sebagian besar penghuni lain' for 'compatible with most tankmates' is acceptable. 'Teman satu akuarium' is stiff, so consider 'penghuni lain' or 'tankmate'.
Item 12: 'Kawin' as a heading and 'Perkawinan tidak bergantung pada waktu' are fine. 'Setelah menetap di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (on the bottom), which is not in 'After settlement'. Remove it.
Item 12: 'Akuarium pembesaran harus memiliki parameter air yang sama' is ambiguous. Say 'sama dengan akuarium induk'.

Item 10: 'Pada umumnya mereka adalah keong whelk predator ... Namun, keong dewasa (fighting conch ...) seharusnya relatif aman': the sentence is unclear about who is safe. Specify that these adult snails are safe from predation.
Item 8: 'Substrate ... silt' is rendered 'lumpur halus' (fine mud) for a reef tank. It is understandable, but 'lumpur/silt' would be more precise.

badis-assamensis.name: Badis assamensis
notes: Item 4: the volume is stated as "sekitar 68 liter", but the source says about 68 litres. That matches, so no fix is needed here. The imperial figure was correctly dropped.
Item 11: "Pelukan memijah" for "spawning embrace" is acceptable but could be clearer. Consider "pelukan saat pemijahan".
Item 8: "Penempatan gua yang cerdik" is slightly awkward. Use "penempatan gua yang cermat".
Item 3: "Lokasi neotipe berupa sungai kecil" turns "stream" into "sungai kecil". That is fine, but "tergenang" for "stagnant" is a quote and is acceptable.
Item 10: "burayak" is correct for fry. Item 11: the line "ukuran dewasanya yang sedikit lebih besar" is fine.
Item 11: "beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang" is ambiguous. Use "beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada yang memanjang pada jantan".
Item 11: "Dalam makalah revisi 2002, semua spesies ... ternyata memiliki" changes "were found to" slightly. Use "ditemukan memiliki".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is fine. Leaving "glassworm" untranslated is acceptable, but "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine too.
Item 1: "dari sebuah sungai kecil berarus lambat di hutan" is fine.
Item 9: "Jantan juga mengembangkan sirip" is slightly unnatural. Use "sirip jantan menjadi sedikit lebih panjang saat dewasa".

badis-badis.name: Badis
notes: Item 7: "glassworm, larva Chaoborus" adds a Latin genus that the English doesn't give. Delete it, or keep only "cacing kaca (glassworm)".
Item 5: "peternak" for "breeders" sounds like livestock farming. "Penangkar", "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more natural for aquarium hobbyists.
Item 2: "anak-anak Sungai Gangga" is slightly awkward. "Anak sungai Gangga" (tributaries) would read more naturally.

badis-blosyrus.name: Badis blosyrus
notes: Item 11: "Badis species now number fifteen" is rendered correctly, but "B. badis, B. chittagongis, B. dibruensis, B. tuivaiei dan B. ferrarisi hanya berbeda dalam perbedaan hitungan morfologi" is redundant ("berbeda dalam perbedaan"). Use "hanya berbeda dalam beberapa hitungan morfologi (meristik)".

Item 11: the English ends with "the exact placement of these two", where "these two" are B. kyar and B. juergenschmidti. The translation names them explicitly, which is fine. But "B. kyar ternyata merupakan kelompok saudara" turns "was found to represent" into "ternyata" and drops the hedging. Use "ditemukan sebagai kelompok saudara".
Item 11: "Dario ... beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung dan sirip dada yang memanjang" is slightly ambiguous. The English says the first few dorsal rays and the pectoral fins are extended.
Item 7: "cacing sutra (Tubifex)" is acceptable. "glassworm" is left untranslated; use "cacing kaca" or "larva nyamuk kaca" with the English term in brackets.
Item 10: "cenderung diam di dasar" adds "di dasar" (on the bottom). The English only says "quite sedentary".
Item 8: "sifatnya pemalu" and "retiring nature" are fine. "heboh" for "boisterous" is colloquial; use "lebih aktif/agresif".
Item 1/3: "dikoleksi" is used for "collected", which is acceptable. "burayak" in item 10 is good.
Item 2: "sungai-sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine. "identifikasinya masih sementara" for "tentative identifications" could be "identifikasi belum pasti".

badis-corycaeus.name: Badis corycaeus
notes: #10: "jadi burayak sebaiknya dipindahkan ke akuarium terpisah" – the English "are best transferred to a separate tank" most plausibly refers to the adults (the parents that may eat the fry). The translation says the fry are moved, which changes the care advice. Make the subject clear, preferably "ikan dewasa sebaiknya dipindahkan".
#10: "burayak" is used for fry, but "anakan" is used in the last paragraph. Use one term throughout. "Anakan" or "benih" is more common among hobbyists than "burayak".
#11: "makalah revisi yang luas" is awkward for "extensive revision paper". Use "makalah revisi yang komprehensif" or "revisi menyeluruh".
#11: "dalam tingkat lebih rendah" should be "pada tingkat yang lebih rendah" or "sedikit".

badis-ferrarisi.name: Badis ferrarisi
notes: Item 11: "bintik cleithral" leaves the anatomical term in English. Consider "bintik kleitral" or add an explanation, e.g. "bintik di tulang bahu (cleithrum)".
Items 5 and 8: "peternak" for breeders sounds like livestock farming. Hobbyists would say "pembiak" or "penangkar".
Item 7: "predator kecil" for "micropredators" loses the nuance. "Pemangsa mikro" or "pemangsa hewan-hewan kecil" would be closer.
Item 8: "Penempatan gua yang cerdik" is a stiff literal rendering. "Penataan gua yang cermat" would be more natural.

badis-juergenschmidti.name: Badis juergenschmidti
notes: Item 7: "Di alam mereka memakan" adds "in the wild", which the English doesn't say. Use a neutral phrasing such as "Spesies Badis adalah mikropredator yang memakan ...".
Item 11: the semicolon-separated characters are split into <ul> bullet lists, which changes the source's paragraph structure. Content is intact, so this is only a formatting concern.

badis-khwae.name: Badis khwae
notes: Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' – fine, but the sentence says bloodworm should be omitted while the previous paragraph recommends 'cacing darah' as a regular food; this contradiction exists in the source, so keep it, though 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. No real fix needed here.

Item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins' became 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang'; the wording is ambiguous, so change it to 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada'.

Item 11: 'Prior to 2002 ... just five species' and 'erection of no less than ten new species' are fine, but 'less involved parental behaviour' became 'perilaku pengasuhan induk yang lebih sederhana'. Prefer 'kurang intensif'.

Item 11: 'B. dibruensis' vs the source 'B. dubruensis' – the spelling changes between mentions. This is in the source, but the translator should keep each spelling as the source has it. The translation did this, so no action is needed.
Item 8: 'Certainly do not combine' became 'Jelas jangan dicampur', which is stilted. Use 'Tentu jangan dicampur'.
Item 10: 'rival males will become increasingly combative' became 'makin sering berkelahi'. Use 'makin agresif'.
Item 1: 'a badid' became 'anggota famili Badidae', which is fine, but items 6 and 11 use 'badid' as a term. Keep the term the same throughout.
Item 4: the volume '54 litres' is correct, but 'sekitar 54 liter' is fine. No issue.

badis-kyar.name: Badis kyar
notes: #3: "dalam bentuk submersed" leaves English in place; use "terendam" or "tumbuh terendam (submers)".
#10: "microworm" stays in English; use "cacing mikro" or "microworm (cacing mikro)".
#8: "Cyprinid" and "cichlid kerdil" are fine as terms, but consider "ikan cyprinid (sekerabat ikan mas)" for readability.

badis-pyema.name: Badis pyema
notes: Item 11: "B. kyar memiliki garis-garis tegak gelap yang relatif tegas" is fine, but the closing sentence adds "B. kyar dan B. juergenschmidti" where the English says only "these two"; acceptable, yet "nenek moyang bersama semua famili tersebut" is okay. The real problem is below.
Item 11: English "B. dubruensis" was changed to "B. dibruensis" in the last group paragraph. Keep the Latin name exactly as in the source, since the author spelled it that way there.

Item 12: English "Badis dilbruensis" was changed to "Badis dilbruensis" in the reference, but the source spelling is kept in the text. Check consistency of this name across items 11 and 12 (dibruensis/dubruensis/dilbruensis).
Item 7: "larva nyamuk bening (glassworm)" is fine, but "chironomid (cacing darah)" is left in English. Use "larva Chironomus/cacing darah" in the usual hobby wording.
Item 5: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward. Use "batu sungai dan kerikil yang membulat".
Item 8: "penghalang visual" is a bit stiff for "broken lines of sight". Use "banyak pembatas pandangan".
Item 10: "pemijah gua" and "merayu" are okay, but "burayak" is used for both eggs and fry. In "mengipasi telur" this is fine. Keep "burayak" for fry only.

badis-ruber.name: Red Badis
notes: Item 6: English says 'Temperature: 15–25°C' but 'Set it to around 20–24°C'; fine. But 'Prefers neutral to slightly alkaline' ok. Real issue: 'Air di Myanmar utara umumnya lunak' fine. Main issue is item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins in males' became 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang' - ok; but 'Dario ... less involved parental behaviour' ok.
Item 11: 'Badis dilbruensis' vs 'B. dubruensis' fine as source. 'B. badis ... hanya pita vertikal yang samar' ok.
Item 7: 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' - acceptable; 'Tubifex' as 'cacing sutra' is fine. 'chironomid' left untranslated; use 'larva Chironomus/jentik' with cacing darah.
Item 8: 'Corydoras kerdil (pygmy)' and 'characin' 'cyprinid' left as English terms; prefer 'ikan karasin', 'kecil/kerdil'. 'Loricariidae kecil' fine.
Item 8: 'sifatnya penyendiri' for 'retiring nature' means loner; better 'pemalu/tidak menonjol'. Contradicts later 'agresif' sense slightly.

Item 8: 'Dalam kondisi seperti itu sebaiknya hanya beli sepasang' - 'in these cases' refers to smaller tanks; ok. 'Jelas jangan dicampur' is awkward for 'Certainly do not combine'; use 'Jangan sekali-kali dicampur'.
Item 3: 'danau tapal kuda (ox-bow lake)' fine. 'ikan penghuni dasar' fine.

Item 1: 'dari Sungai Ayeyarwady dan Sittaung hingga ke selatan sampai Tenasserim' redundant 'hingga ke selatan sampai'; also 'badid' / 'badis' wording inconsistent ('anggota famili Badidae' vs 'badid').

badis-siamensis.name: Badis Siam
notes: Item 8: 'suitable species found in the region include.' is truncated in the source; the translation silently turns it into a complete sentence ('ada spesies yang cocok dari wilayah tersebut'). The meaning is intact, but the gap should be handled.

Item 8: 'southwest Thailand' is translated as 'Thailand barat daya'. This is acceptable, but note that item 1 says 'pesisir barat' and the Peninsular region is better described as 'Thailand bagian barat daya'.

Item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins' is translated as 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang'. This is ambiguous. Use 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada yang memanjang'.

Item 11: 'B. badis can be told apart from B. kanabos ... only faint or indistinct vertical bars' is translated as 'hanya garis tegak yang samar'. Use 'pita/palang tegak' for 'bars' rather than 'garis' in order to keep the distinction from 'lines'.

Item 11: 'B. kyar was found to represent the sister group to either the B. ruber or B. badis/B. assamensis clades' is translated as 'kelompok saudara dari klad ... '. Keep the usage consistent: the translation mixes 'kelompok' and 'klad' for 'group' and 'clade'.
Item 11: 'B. dubruensis' and 'B. dibruensis' are spelled differently in the source. The translation keeps both. Check for consistency against the reference (dilbruensis).

Item 7: 'bloodworm' is translated as 'cacing darah' and then 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm) and/or Tubifex' as 'cacing sutra'. This is fine, but the earlier recommendation to feed bloodworm regularly contradicts the later advice to omit it. The contradiction is in the source; consider flagging it. Also 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Other species are best omitted' is translated as 'Sebaiknya tidak ada spesies lain'. This is acceptable, but 'burayak' for fry is less common among hobbyists than 'anakan'/'larva'.

badis-tuivaiei.name: Badis tuivaiei
notes: #4: the English gives '60 × 30 cm (24 × 12 in)'. Dropping the imperial figure is correct, so this is fine. Nothing to fix here.

#7: 'Tubifex' is rendered as 'cacing sutra', and 'glassworm' is left untranslated. 'cacing sutra' is acceptable, but 'glassworm' should be given as 'cacing kaca' or 'larva nyamuk kaca (glassworm)'. 'Daphnia' is translated as 'kutu air', which is Daphnia but is ambiguous with other animals. Write 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.
#8: 'Penempatan gua yang cerdik' is a stiff, literal rendering of 'clever placement'. Use 'penataan gua yang tepat'. 'Hara spp.' is left in English abbreviation form, so use 'spesies Hara'.

#5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn rocks and pebbles'. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat/halus'. 'Ranting kayu, cabang kayu' is also clumsy, so use 'kayu apung (ranting dan cabang)'. 'Driftwood' is mistranslated as plain wood, so use 'kayu apung/driftwood'.

#11: 'Dario currently contains only three members' is translated correctly. However, 'Badis species now number fifteen' follows the source and is fine. In the revision sentence, 'menghasilkan sepuluh spesies baru' drops 'erection of ... new species' nuance only slightly, so no fix is needed.

#11: 'sirip dada ... dan beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama ... yang memanjang' is slightly ambiguous. Clarify it as 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung dan sirip dada jantan yang memanjang'.

#10: 'burayak' is used for 'fry' and also for the eggs-to-fry stage, but in 'beberapa burayak mungkin bisa bertahan' it is fine. 'Spesies lain sebaiknya tidak disertakan' is fine. 'perilaku merayu' for 'courtship behaviour' is awkward. Use 'perilaku pacaran/memikat'. 'Saling mengunci mulut' is acceptable.
#9: 'mengembangkan sirip yang lebih panjang' reads as unnatural for 'develop extended finnage'. Use 'sirip jantan memanjang seiring dewasa'.

#12: The reference list is left untranslated, which is correct. However, 'dilbruensis' in the Latin title was changed from the English original 'dilbruensis' to 'dilbruensis'. No change is needed; the source spelling is kept.

bagarius-bagarius.name: Bagarius bagarius
notes: Item 6: "ikan mas koki kecil" for "small goldfish" is fine, but "feeder fish" rendered as "ikan umpan hidup" suggests bait; better "ikan pakan (feeder)".
Item 6: "predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is slightly loose; "predator obligat" or "pemangsa murni" is more precise.
Item 6: "Begitu juga, tidak ada manfaatnya" is stiff; "Demikian pula, tidak ada manfaatnya memberi..." is more natural.
Item 1: "lele sisorid" is acceptable, but "lele sisorid (famili Sisoridae)" would be clearer for readers.
Item 2: "India semenanjung" is awkward; use "India bagian semenanjung" or "Semenanjung India" (also in item 1).
Item 9: "gigi ... jelas heterodon (bentuknya tidak seragam)" is fine, but "markedly" is better rendered "sangat jelas heterodon".

bagarius-rutilus.name: Bagarius rutilus
notes: Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup (feeder)" is fine, but "ikan livebearer (vivipar)" is awkward; use "ikan livebearer (misalnya guppy atau molly)" or just "ikan vivipar".

Item 10: "Sisoridae ... subfamili" mirrors an English source error. Sisoridae is a family, so keep it as is but flag it. "heterodon" is a rare term; use "gigi yang sangat beragam bentuknya (heterodont)".
Item 5: "sebaiknya dianggap wajib" is slightly awkward; use "wajib disediakan".
Item 1: "catfish sisorid" is fine, but "ikan lele sisorid" or "catfish" with a gloss would be more natural for general readers.
Item 10: "jari-jari sirip dada" is fine, but "ruas tulang belakang praanal" is stiff; use "tulang belakang sebelum anus (praanal)".

bagarius-suchus.name: Crocodile Catfish
notes: Item 1/10: "punggung tulang yang tajam" / "punggung tulang tajam" mistranslates "ridges" (literally a back-bone); use "rusuk/lunas/gerigi tajam" or "tonjolan memanjang yang tajam".
Item 10: "punggung atau tonjolan besar" for "ridges or humps" is confusing (punggung = back); use "rusuk/lunas atau tonjolan besar".

Item 1/10: "Tengkorak yang terbuka dan kasar berkerut" and "permukaan atas tengkorak bertulang dan pelat predorsal yang kasar berkerut dan terbuka" garble the structure: rugose applies to the cranium dorsal surface; say "permukaan atas tengkorak yang kasar berkerut" and "pelat predorsal terbuka" separately.
Item 10: "pangkal awal sirip adiposa" is awkward for "adipose fin origin"; use "titik awal pangkal sirip adiposa".
Item 1: "lele sisorid" - Bagarius is not a true lele (Clariidae); better "ikan keli/patin-patinan sisorid" or "catfish sisorid" with a note.

Item 10: "subfamili Sisoridae" - Sisoridae is a family (English says 'putative subfamily', but the term is odd); keep as source but ensure the 'diduga' placement reads correctly: "subfamili Sisorinae yang diduga" is not needed, just reorder.
Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'goldfish' is "ikan mas koki" fine, but "cacing darah" for chironomid larvae and "udang sungai" ok; "heterodon" should be "heterodonta" (markedly heterodont).

bagarius-vegrandis.name: Goonch Catfish
notes: Item 1: "lele sisorid" is acceptable, but the sentence "jauh lebih kecil daripada Bagarius lainnya" would read more naturally as "dibandingkan Bagarius lain"; minor.
Item 1/6: "catatan B. bagarius ... merujuk pada spesies ini" is a bit literal; "catatan" could be "laporan temuan" for natural hobby/scientific reading.
Item 2: Type locality in quotes is left in English; acceptable, but consider translating "province" or keeping as is consistently; minor.
Item 4: "remis" for mussels and "kerang" for cockles are fine, but "mau makan" is slightly informal; consider "memakan".
Item 6: "heterodon" is a rare term; consider "heterodont (gigi bervariasi bentuk)" for readability.
Item 6: "dapat menyebabkan sakit" is awkward; use "dapat menyebabkan keracunan/gangguan kesehatan".

bagarius-yarrelli.name: Goonch
notes: Item 1: "lele sisorid" is awkward. Sisorid catfish are not lele (Clarias), so use "ikan lele sisorid" or just "ikan sisorid (catfish)".
Item 3: "arus putih (jeram)" is a literal rendering of "white water". Use "arus deras berbusa" or "jeram berbuih".
Item 8: "heterodon" is a non-standard term. Use "heterodont" or explain it as "bentuk gigi yang berbeda-beda".
Item 5: "harus dianggap wajib" is redundant. Use "wajib dipenuhi" or "mutlak diperlukan".
Item 2: "Semenanjung Malaysia" is acceptable, but "Lokasi tipenya" is better as "Lokalitas tipe", the usual term.
Item 6: "mau menerima" is stiff. Use "mau memakan".

bagre-marinus.name: Gafftopsail Catfish
notes: Item 7: "hingga dua bulan sampai menetas" is slightly awkward; use "hingga dua bulan sampai telur menetas".

bagrichthys-hypselopterus.name: Black Lancer
notes: Item 9: 'Although they possess a small mouth it is wide' is translated 'Mulutnya memang kecil tetapi lebar' - fine, but 'Meski begitu... tetapi kalau' is clumsy; the source says the fish is not a threat because of the mouth, so the logic is blurred. Rephrase more clearly.
Item 1: 'Least Concern' translated as 'Risiko Rendah' - the standard Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'; use consistently (also item 12).
Item 1: '400 mm or 15.7" SL' - the SL (standard length) is not explained; consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.

Item 12: 'hypselopterus berarti bersirip tinggi atau panjang' - source says 'deep or long finned'; acceptable but 'nama genus ini hanya dipakai' wrongly repeats 'genus' where source speaks of the name 'bagre' being used - clarify that 'bagre' is the word used for African and Asian species.
Item 12: '247000 km2' should be written '247.000 km²' in Indonesian number format.
Item 7: 'memakan detritus' is OK but 'detritivorous' implies a detritivore; use 'pemakan detritus (detritivor)'.
Item 1 vs 2: Common name 'Black Lancer Catfish' left in English while item 9 uses 'Black lancer' - keep consistent.
Item 3/4: 'in fluviis' left untranslated Latin phrase; fine, but add '(di sungai-sungai)' for readers.

bagrichthys-macracanthus.name: Bagrichthys macracanthus
notes: Item 9: "Komposisi kimia air tidak berpengaruh" is an overly absolute rendering of "meaningless" and contradicts the pH/dGH ranges given elsewhere; soften it, e.g. "tidak terlalu penting".

Item 3: the EN says "Lamatang" and "Palambang". The ID silently changes them to "Lematang" and "Palembang". The corrected names are fine, but keep the Latin species spelling consistent: the EN "majusuculus" was changed to "majusculus".
Item 1: "Lele" for a bagrid is acceptable, but "Ukuran maksimalnya sekitar 20 cm" should say panjang maksimal (maximum length).
Item 12: "3 betina atau lebih" is correct, but "Khususnya sesama jantan jarang bisa saling menerima" is awkward. Rephrase as "terutama jantan, jarang saling menoleransi".

Item 6: the volume "243 liter" is fine, but the source's 48 × 18 in and 64 US gal were dropped, as instructed. No fix needed except to check the 243 L figure. 120×45 cm with a height of about 45 cm gives about 243 L, so it is OK.
Item 13: "Saat waktu makan" is redundant. Use "Saat waktu makan" → "Pada waktu makan".

bagrichthys-majusculus.name: Black Lancer Catfish
notes: Item 1 and 8: "barbir" for 'barbs' is unusual among hobbyists; use "barb" (italic or plain) instead.

bagrichthys-obscurus.name: Black Lancer obscurus
notes: Item 15: "Keep a single male alongside 3 or more females" is rendered "3 betina atau lebih" - fine, but "seharusnya membantu ... terus-menerus menjadi sasaran" adds "terus-menerus" (continuously), which is not in the source; remove it.

Item 7: "Volume: sekitar 243 liter" - 120×45 cm base with no height given; the figure is carried over from the source. The imperial "48 × 18 in" was correctly dropped, so no change is needed there. Check that the volume is plausible.

Item 1/20: "serrae" translated as "gerigi" and "crenulated" as "bergerigi halus" - the same word is used for two different structures. Use "gerigi/serrasi" for serrae and "berkerut/bergelombang" for crenulated.

Item 20: "genital papilla in males touching the first anal-fin ray" is rendered "menyentuh jari-jari pertama sirip anal" - should be the singular "jari-jari pertama" (the first ray), not plural "jari-jari".
Item 13: "Tubifex" rendered as "cacing sutra" - fine, but "Artemia" is left lowercase; minor.

Item 18: "Not reported in aquaria; there is no breeding report" is rendered as "Belum pernah dilaporkan berkembang biak di akuarium" - slightly changes meaning, since the source says the species is not reported in aquaria at all.
Item 8: "Heater" is left in English; "pemanas" is the more common Indonesian term.
Item 14/15: "Conspecifics may be aggressively territorial" and "sesama jenis" are fine, but "teritorial yang agresif" is awkward.

bagrus-filamentosus.name: Bagrus Catfish
notes: "lele-lele besar": Bagrus is a bagrid, not a true lele (Clariidae); better use "ikan lele bagrid" or "catfish Bagrus" to avoid implying Clarias-type catfish.
"pengecualian yang menarik dari hal ini": more natural as "pengecualian yang menarik dari aturan ini" (English says 'this rule').
"identifikasi spesiesnya cukup sulit": fine, but "sesama jenis" for 'conspecifics' could be clearer as "sesama spesiesnya".

balitoropsis-zollingeri.name: Balitoropsis zollingeri
notes: Item 5: "Volume: ~54 litres" is kept as ~54 liter. 60×30 cm base with ~54 L is the source's own figure, so leave the number as is, but check that it matches the tank depth.
Item 6: "filter yang kapasitasnya lebih besar dari ukuran akuarium" is a loose rendering of "over-sized filter". Use "filter berkapasitas besar (di atas ukuran standar)".
Item 6: "Anubias sangat berguna" replaces "The latter", which in the English refers to the plants. This is fine, but "Anubias spp." before it is a bit repetitive.

Item 6: "aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)" leaves a German term in place. Use the common hobby term "lumut/alga dan biofilm", or explain it consistently. In item 8, "aufwuchs lainnya" is left unexplained.
Item 9: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp." mixes "genus" with "spp.". Use "lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis".
Item 9: "teman setangki" is slightly informal. Use "ikan penghuni bersama (tankmate)".
Item 12: "loach 'lizard' (kadal)" and "'black gecko'" are mixed in how they are quoted. Make the trade names consistent, for example 'lizard loach' and 'black gecko loach'.

Item 2: "Tutup yang rapat juga wajib" moves the lid sentence around and duplicates it, which is faithful to the source. "mutlak hidup" for "obligate dweller" is awkward. Use "hanya hidup di" or "penghuni khas".

bangana-ariza.name: Reba carp
notes: Item 1: "300 mm SL" kept in mm; a hobbyist handbook would use cm ("sekitar 30 cm SL"). Minor, but the unit is not in the metric form used elsewhere.
Item 5: "8-9 branched dorsal-fin rays 8-9" was rendered as "8-9 jari-jari bercabang pada sirip punggung", which drops the duplicated number. This is faithful to the sense, so it is fine.
Item 5: "putative cyprinid subfamily" became "yang masih diperdebatkan" (still debated). "Putative" is closer to "yang diduga" or "yang diusulkan", so the nuance shifts slightly.

Item 2: "Kaveri" is the Indonesian spelling for the Cauvery river, which is fine. The type locality quote stays in English, which is acceptable for a quoted Latin-script locality, though you could add a short Indonesian gloss.
Item 4: "induced breeding" is rendered as "pemijahan buatan" with the English term in brackets. This is fine, but "pemijahan induksi" is the more common aquaculture term.

bangana-behri.name: Incisilabeo
notes: #2 'Ukurannya bisa mencapai 450 hingga 550 mm': keep as is or convert to cm (45–55 cm); mixing mm with cm elsewhere is inconsistent.
#2/#5 'bermigrasi ke hulu Sungai Sekong': 'up the ... rivers' is fine, but 'siprinid' is non-standard; use 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' or 'ikan karper'.
#14 'nama persembahan untuk Otto Behr': awkward; use 'nama untuk menghormati Otto Behr'.
#14 'Bersama Bangana behri, didatangkan juga Labeo pierrei': 'came along with' is vague; the added 'didatangkan' is acceptable but could be clearer as 'ikut masuk dalam kiriman yang sama'.
#1 'Nama umum: Two-headed carp': add an Indonesian gloss or keep as the trade name; the 'tonjolan seperti tanduk' for 'horn' weakens the source.
#15 'Tubuh dan kepalanya juga tampak sangat tinggi': 'deep' means body depth; use 'tubuh dan kepalanya sangat tinggi (pipih tegak)', and the phrase 'tampak' is added.
#15 'mengesahkan kembali Incisilabeo': use 'menghidupkan kembali/memvalidasi kembali' for taxonomic revalidation.

bangana-devdevi.name: Bangana devdevi
notes: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable, but "lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.
