"SL" is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" on first use.

barbodes-aurotaeniatus.name: Barbodes aurotaeniatus
notes: Item 10: "dengan enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin" – English says "half a dozen specimens of each sex being a good number"; fine, but "betina tampak bertelur (perutnya gendut)" adds a gloss; use "tampak penuh telur (gravid)" without the colloquial addition.
Item 10: "air matang" for "mature water" is misleading in Indonesian (means boiled water); use "air yang sudah matang/berumur (siklus nitrogen sudah berjalan)" or "air akuarium matang".
Item 10: "Taxiphyllum spp." is left unitalicized as in the source; should be italicized as a Latin genus name.

Item 8: "Banyak loach ... Botiidae yang berukuran kecil" – the English says "many cobitid, nemacheilid, and smaller botiid loaches"; "smaller" applies only to botiids, but the translation makes it ambiguous. Rephrase as "loach Cobitidae, Nemacheilidae, dan Botiidae yang lebih kecil" carefully.

Item 8: "minimal 6–10 ekor" – "at least 6-10" is contradictory; "minimal 6 ekor, idealnya hingga 10" is clearer. "hasilnya akan tampak lebih alami" loses "rewarded with a more natural-looking spectacle" (pemandangan lebih alami).
Item 4: Dimension in inches was dropped (acceptable), but volume "72 liter" matches; no issue. Item 5: "Setup" is left as an English term; prefer "tata letak/aquascape".

Item 11: "gurat sisi lengkap atau tidak" and "Sungut rostral ada" are stiff; use "ada sungut rostral". "Aspek ontogeni" is fine, but "Kemungkinan belum pernah tercatat" (item 10) should be "Mungkin belum pernah tercatat (pemijahan)".

barbodes-banksi.name: Barbodes banksi
notes: Item 11: 'broad bar' rendered as 'garis lebar' is ambiguous with 'stripe/garis'. Use 'balok/pita tegak lebar' or 'garis tegak lebar'.
Item 5: 'Tetap saja' for 'though' is slightly off in tone. 'Meski demikian' or 'namun' is more natural.

barbodes-binotatus.name: Wader cakul
notes: Item 1: 'Wader cakul (spotted barb)' – 'wader cakul' is a name for Barbodes binotatus in Indonesia, fine; but the 'ikan cyprinid' phrasing is acceptable. No fix needed here.
Item 4: Volume 'sekitar 243 liter' – 120×45×45 cm is not stated in the source; it is the source's figure and was kept, so OK. However 'minimal 120 × 45 cm' should keep wording 'ukuran alas'; fine.
Item 5: 'sangat disarankan' overstates 'is recommended' – change to 'disarankan'.
Item 5: 'Arus sederas air bah' – 'torrent-like' means a fast mountain stream; use 'arus deras seperti torrent/sungai pegunungan', not 'air bah' (flood).
Item 3: 'kolam-kolam di dasar air terjun' – should be 'kolam di dasar air terjun' (plunge pools); 'dasar' ok. 'AMSL' rendered fine.

Item 10: 'diisi air matang' – 'mature water' means water from a mature aquarium (air dari akuarium matang), not 'air matang' which means boiled water in Indonesian; fix to 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang'.
Item 10: 'dua pasang... dimasukkan' ok; 'microworm' and 'spawning mop' left in English – add italics or local term 'cacing mikro'.
Item 11: 'pangkal awal sirip punggung' for 'base of the dorsal-fin origin' is clumsy; 'di awal pangkal sirip punggung' would be simpler.
Item 11: 'bintik di tengah sisi tubuh... garis lateral' – 'lateral stripe' rendered 'garis lateral' conflicts with the term 'gurat sisi' used later; use 'garis sisi tubuh'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok; 'pelet butiran kering' is redundant with 'granules'.

barbodes-dunckeri.name: Barbodes dunckeri
notes: Item 4: 120 × 45 cm base 'about 243 litres' is kept unchanged. This is fine, but the source gives no height, so check that the translation adds none.
Item 10: 'tidak menjaga anaknya' is acceptable, but 'burayak' is a less common term than 'anakan' or 'larva' among Indonesian hobbyists. Consider 'anakan ikan (fry)'.
Item 10: 'Telur akan menetas dalam 24–48 jam' is fine. 'ber-pH sedikit asam hingga netral' is slightly awkward. Consider 'pH sedikit asam hingga netral'.
Item 10: 'air matang' for 'mature water' is misleading. In Indonesian, 'air matang' means boiled water. Use 'air akuarium yang sudah matang (mature)' or 'air dari akuarium yang sudah berjalan'.
Item 10: 'Beri pakan seukuran infusoria' is understandable but terse. 'Pakan sekecil infusoria' reads more naturally.
Item 5: 'Arus deras seperti air bah' translates 'torrent-like' too dramatically. 'Air bah' means flood. Use 'arus deras seperti aliran torrent/jeram'.
Item 5: 'aquascape dibuat menyerupai' is awkward. Use 'akuarium ditata (aquascape) menyerupai sungai berarus'.

Item 1: 'sehingga ... tercatat dengan nama tersebut' is understandable. The ichthyological 'extirpated' is rendered 'punah', which wrongly implies global extinction. Use 'punah secara lokal / tidak lagi ditemukan di sana' (also items 1 and 2).

barbodes-everetti.name: Clown Barb
notes: Item 2: 'di Kalimantan bagian Indonesia (Borneo Indonesia)' is clumsy and redundant for 'Kalimantan Barat province, Indonesian Borneo'. Suggest 'Provinsi Kalimantan Barat, wilayah Borneo Indonesia'.
Item 2: 'belum ada catatan pasti yang bisa diperoleh' drops the sense of 'we've been unable to obtain'. Rephrase neutrally: 'tidak diperoleh catatan pasti'.
Item 5: 'sungai atau aliran berarus' is awkward and redundant. Use 'sungai berarus'.
Item 5: 'Arus deras seperti torrent' leaves English 'torrent' in place. Use 'arus sangat deras seperti air terjun/jeram'.
Item 5: 'air yang nyaris bersih sempurna' is a bit stiff. Use 'air yang nyaris tanpa polutan'.
Item 10: 'Dalam kedua cara tersebut, indukan kemungkinan akan memakan telur' softens 'will probably eat ... given the chance'. Tighten to 'kemungkinan besar akan memakan telur bila ada kesempatan'.
Item 10: 'satu atau dua pasang kemudian dimasukkan' loses the sense of instruction ('should be introduced'). Use 'sebaiknya dimasukkan'.
Item 11: 'pangkal depan sirip punggung' for 'dorsal-fin origin' is fine, but 'garis tengah perut' is imprecise. Use 'garis tengah ventral'.
Item 8: 'balitorid yang kuat (hillstream loach)' is inconsistent. 'Famili Balitoridae' would be more consistent with the other families.
Item 1: 'jarang ada di hobi akuarium' is awkward. Use 'jarang ditemui dalam hobi akuarium'.

barbodes-kuchingensis.name: False Spanner Barb
notes: Item 4: '120 × 45 cm ... (sekitar 243 liter)' is an unconverted/unchecked figure; the volume is kept from source and is not a sensible rounded value. Verify the number, or round as 'sekitar 240 liter'.
Item 11: 'pangkal depan sirip punggung' for 'dorsal-fin origin' is OK, but 'pita tegak' for 'broad bar' is awkward; use 'pita vertikal/balok lebar'.
Item 11: 'tinjauan parsial' / 'keranjang sampah' in quotes adds a metaphor not in the source ('catch-all'); use 'kelompok serba-ada' or 'kelompok tampung-semua'.
Item 2: 'sistem danau Danau Sentarum' is redundant; use 'sistem danau di Danau Sentarum'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'mencari makan dengan memakan' is wordy; use 'pemakan'.
Item 3: 'batu dan bongkahan batu halus' reads awkwardly; 'smooth' may be misread as modifying only boulders. Rephrase to 'batu dan bongkahan batu yang halus terkikis air'.
Item 1: 'plus garis pendek' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'serta'.

Item 5: 'Ganti air mingguan ... juga sebaiknya dijadikan rutinitas' loosens the source structure ('plus ... should be considered routine'); fine, but 'tata letak' for 'aquascaping' shifts meaning slightly.

barbodes-lateristriga.name: Spanner barb
notes: Item 3: "Ikan muda dan remaja" for juveniles and subadults is fine, but "sungai-sungai kecil" for "forest streams" is acceptable. The real issue is "batu dan bongkahan batu halus", which reads as if only the boulders are smooth. Rephrase it.
Item 8: "Danio, Devario, dan Barilius yang berukuran lebih besar" is ambiguous. "larger" should apply only to Danio (larger Danio). Fix it so the meaning is clear.
Item 8: "cukup agresif" for "quite boisterous" shifts the meaning toward aggression. Use "cukup heboh/aktif". The same applies in item 1: "Ikan ini cukup agresif dan lincah".
Item 11: "Tweedei (1961)" repeats the English typo. The reference list has "Tweedie", so correct it to "Tweedie".
Item 11: "titik di pangkal depan sirip punggung" for "dorsal-fin origin" is fine. However, "pita tegak yang lebar" for "broad bar" is awkward. Use "balok/pita vertikal".
Item 5: "Ganti air mingguan ... juga sebaiknya dianggap sebagai rutinitas" is acceptable. "sungai berarus" drops the "or river" part of "stream or river". Add "atau sungai besar".

Item 10: "pemijah bebas yang menyebar telur" is okay. "Sebaiknya ... indukan ... dimasukkan" changes "should then be introduced" slightly, but it is acceptable. "burayak" is a non-standard term for fry here; "benih" or "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.

barbodes-semifasciolatus.name: Chinese barb
notes: #12: "Indukan akan dengan mudah memakan telurnya" is stiff. Use "Indukan cenderung memakan telurnya" or "akan langsung memakan telurnya".
#24: "pemijah bebas penyebar telur yang tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk" is clumsy. Use "pemijah penyebar telur yang tidak menjaga telur maupun anaknya".
#24: "mikroworm" is half-translated. Use "cacing mikro (microworm)" or "microworm" in italics.
#4: "punggung yang melengkung curam" is a loose rendering of "steeply-sloped back". Use "punggung yang menanjak curam" or "bagian punggung yang miring tajam".

barboides-gracilis.name: Dwarf Ember Barb
notes: Item 10: "kayu beech (Fagus)" adds a Latin genus name that the English doesn't have. Remove "(Fagus)" or keep it consistent with the other items.

barbonymus-altus.name: Red Tail Tinfoil Barb
notes: Item 4: '(8 in)' and '(60 × 24 in)' and '(~143 US gal)' dropped. Metric conversion is fine, but 'Standard length: 210 mm SL (8 in)' is already metric, so this is acceptable; no real issue except 'SL' left without explanation.

Item 5: 'koloni bakteri yang diinginkan' misattaches 'desired' (levels of oxygen, flow and surface area are what is desired); rephrase to 'tingkat oksigen, arus, dan luas permukaan yang diinginkan untuk koloni bakteri'.
Item 5: 'mudah kaget' for 'skittish' is fine, but 'kadang cukup' is vague; minor.
Item 7: 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar' fine; 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term, so keep Daphnia/kutu air.
Item 8: 'Hasilnya, tampilan akuarium akan jauh lebih alami, plus perilaku ...' is awkward; 'plus' is colloquial. Rephrase to 'serta perilaku ikan yang menarik'.
Item 8: 'mudah kaget atau bahkan agresif' for 'skittish' acceptable; 'cara makannya yang cukup beringas' is a bit strong for 'rather vigorous feeding behaviour'; use 'cukup agresif/bersemangat'.
Item 10: 'menghasilkan anakan dalam jumlah besar' – 'broods' fine; 'penyebar telur' acceptable but 'egg-scatterer' is usually 'penyebar telur (egg scatterer)'.
Item 11: 'Banyak pemilik toko akan bilang' is colloquial; use 'akan mengatakan'.
Item 11: 'sirip perut' for pelvic fins is fine; no change.
Item 2/3: 'Pada bulan-bulan yang lebih basah ini' is slightly awkward; use 'pada bulan-bulan basah tersebut'.

barbonymus-gonionotus.name: Ikan tawes
notes: #10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" means laying eggs. Use "saat penuh telur" or "sedang membawa telur".
#3: The type locality "Indonesia: Java: Kalimas River [Brantas] in Surabaya" is left wholly in English. Write "Indonesia: Jawa: Sungai Kalimas [Brantas] di Surabaya".
#9: "ikan lele/catfish" is inaccurate, because lele is only one catfish group. Use "ikan catfish" or "lele dan catfish lain".
#9: "cara makannya yang cukup rakus" slightly overstates "rather vigorous feeding behaviour". "cukup agresif/bersemangat" is closer.

barbonymus-schwanefeldii.name: Tinfoil barb
notes: "mudah panik" for "skittish" is slightly off; "mudah kaget" or "mudah gugup" is more natural (items 2, 6, 9).
"cara makannya yang cukup rakus" adds a negative nuance to "rather vigorous feeding behaviour"; "cukup agresif/lincah saat makan" is closer.
"saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; use "saat sedang membawa telur / penuh telur".
"affluent river channels" (probably meant as tributaries) is dropped; "sungai berukuran sedang" loses the idea of tributary channels, though this is minor.

barbronia-weberi.name: Lintah Asia
notes: "Alat isap" for suckers: the standard zoological term is "batil isap" (anterior/posterior).
"udang hias kerdil" for dwarf shrimp is stilted. Use "dwarf shrimp" or "udang hias"/"udang kerdil".

barbucca-diabolica.name: Fire Eye Loach
notes: Item 8: 'A group of six or eight specimens should be the smallest considered' is rendered as 'Kelompok berisi enam atau delapan ekor sebaiknya menjadi jumlah paling sedikit' – acceptable, but 'if geography isn't an issue' became 'asal-usul geografis tidak dipermasalahkan', which is vague. Use 'jika perbedaan wilayah asal tidak jadi masalah'.
Item 8: 'Not especially robust' became 'tidak terlalu kuat', which is ambiguous. Use 'kurang tangguh' or 'tidak terlalu tahan banting'.
Item 2: 'bisa ternyata merupakan spesies tersendiri' is awkward word order. Use 'suatu saat ternyata bisa terbukti merupakan spesies tersendiri'.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is translated as 'biofilm/perifiton'. Perifiton alone is better, and 'tampil sebaik-baiknya' is stiff. Use 'tampil paling indah'.
Item 5: 'water worn rocks' became 'batu sungai yang membulat'. Use 'batu yang terkikis air' or 'batu kali'.
Item 11: 'sirip ekor berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)' is fine, but 'terekspos' for 'exposed' is awkward. Use 'terbuka' or 'tidak tertutup'.
Item 11: 'mengarah ke atas-samping' is clumsy for 'dorso-laterally orientated'. Use 'menghadap ke atas dan ke samping'.

Item 3: 'Kemungkinan besar ia hanya hidup' ('probably restricted to') is fine, but 'Kawasan ini berupa daerah pegunungan' reads slightly stiff. Use 'Kawasan pegunungan berhutan ini seluas hampir 800 km²'.

barilius-ardens.name: Barilius ardens
notes: Item 11: "baru dipakai secara lebih luas setelah Kottelat (2013)" slightly shifts the meaning of "until Kottelat (2013)", which says it was widely adopted with Kottelat. Use "baru digunakan secara lebih luas oleh Kottelat (2013)".
Item 3: "batu bulat" for "cobbles" is not a common term. "batu kali berukuran sedang" or "kerakal" would read more naturally.

barilius-bakeri.name: Royal Danio
notes: Item 7: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine in meaning, but "sudah matang secara biologis" or "belum cycling" is more common among hobbyists.
Item 12: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise. Use "saat penuh telur" or "saat bertelur/matang gonad".
Item 14: "Penempatan genus spesies Barilius" is slightly awkward. Use "Penempatan genus spesies-spesies Barilius".
Item 10: "sangat suka bertengkar" is a bit clumsy. Use "sangat agresif/suka berkelahi".
Item 11: "berenang serempak (schooling)" is a bit awkward. Use "berkelompok rapat" for schooling.
Item 14: "tuberkel" for "tubercules" in item 12 is acceptable, but "bintil kawin" is more common in Indonesian.

barilius-bendelisis.name: Indian Hill Trout
notes: Item 5: "biologically-immature aquaria" rendered as "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – adds a specific claim; better "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 9: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" – gravid means full of eggs, not laying; use "saat penuh telur / bunting telur".
Item 7: "gut-loaded" translated as "sudah diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" – unclear; say the insects were fed nutritious food beforehand ("diberi pakan bergizi sebelum diberikan ke ikan").
Item 4: "luas permukaan minimal 180 × 60 cm" fine, but "~648 liter" unchanged OK; no issue. Item 5: "batu ... yang halus terkikis air" for "water-worn" – better "batu bulat yang terkikis arus".
Item 1: "Sesekali dijual" fine; "makannya rakus" ok. Item 3: "batu bulat" for "cobbles" – better "batu kali/kerakal".
Item 8: "Ikan yang jauh lebih kecil juga sebaiknya tidak dicampur" ok; "lele loricariid" – loricariids are not lele; use "ikan loricariid (sapu-sapu)" instead of "lele".
Item 8: "sedangkan ikan yang dipelihara sendirian bisa menjadi agresif" ok; but "spesies shoaling ... bukan schooling" explanations fine.
Item 11: "Penempatan genus spesies Barilius" – awkward; "penempatan genus spesies-spesies Barilius".

barilius-canarensis.name: Jerdon's Baril
notes: Item 4: 'luas permukaan minimal 150 × 60 cm' is fine, but the volume '540 litres' is kept; OK. No issue.
Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature aquaria' is okay, but 'Butuh... akuarium yang sudah matang' in item 1 is fine; no change.
Item 5: 'pelompat yang hebat' is weak for 'prodigious jumpers'; use 'pelompat ulung' or 'sangat suka melompat'.
Item 5: 'sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' is misleading, since gravid means full of eggs and not yet laying; use 'saat sedang penuh telur/bunting telur'.
Item 8: 'rakus saat makan' for 'vigorous feeder' adds a negative nuance; use 'makan dengan agresif/lahap'.
Item 9: 'Jantan yang siap kawin ... tuberkel' is acceptable, but 'sedang bertelur' above should be fixed.
Item 11: 'Howe's group ii' is rendered 'versi Howes', which is fine; 'gain wider usage' is OK. 'sebagai subdivisi ... di dalam Barilius' is fine.
Item 8: 'Ikan yang jauh lebih kecil juga sebaiknya tidak dicampur' is fine; but 'shoaling rather than schooling' glosses are okay.
Item 10: 'ganti air ... memakai air yang lebih dingin' fine; 'burayak' is rare for hobbyists, so prefer 'anakan' or 'benih'.

barilius-caudiocellatus.name: Opsarius caudiocellatus
notes: Item 4: "pers. comm." left in English; use "komunikasi pribadi" (or "kom. pribadi").
Item 12: "not gain wider usage until Kottelat (2013)" is rendered "baru dipakai lebih luas sejak", which is fine, but "Howe's" is rendered "dari Howes". Keep this consistent.
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is a bit indirect for "biologically-immature aquaria". Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 9: "Teman setangki" is odd; use "penghuni lain/tankmate yang cocok". "Rakus saat makan" slightly overstates "vigorous feeder"; use "agresif/lincah saat makan".
Item 8: "diberi pakan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague; say "diberi makanan bergizi tinggi terlebih dahulu".

barilius-dogarsinghi.name: Manipur Baril
notes: Item 1: "8–9 garis vertikal biru gelap" — "bars" are bands/stripes; "pita/lajur vertikal" is more natural than "garis" (minor).

Item 2: "daerah aliran anak sungai Manipur dan Yu" — "Manipur and Yu affluent drainages" means the Manipur and Yu river drainages (tributaries of the Chindwin). Rephrase as "daerah aliran Sungai Manipur dan Yu".
Item 3: "batu bulat" for "cobbles" is non-standard; use "batu kali berukuran sedang" or "batu bulat sedang" (minor).
Item 5: "sedang bertelur" for "gravid" — better "sedang bunting telur" or "penuh telur" (minor); the same applies in item 9.
Item 5: "Meskipun sebagian besar tanaman air tidak akan tumbuh baik... genus yang tangguh" — the comma before "genus" is missing, which hurts readability (minor).
Item 7: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" — gut-loading means feeding the insects nutritious food beforehand; say "sudah diberi pakan bergizi terlebih dahulu (gut-loading)" (minor).
Item 8: "pelompat ulung" and "Teman setangki" — acceptable, but "penghuni dasar" and "cyprinid perenang tengah" could be clearer (minor).

barilius-gatensis.name: Malabar Baril
notes: Item 1: "dipelihara berkelompok, dan akuarium yang sudah matang" – the parallel list is awkward; better "butuh akuarium yang sangat besar dan sudah matang, serta harus dipelihara berkelompok".
Item 6: "sungai atau aliran air" is vague for "flowing stream or river"; use "sungai kecil (anak sungai) atau sungai berarus".
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – use the common hobby term "akuarium baru yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 6: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders"; use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus".
Item 3: "diduga endemik dan tersebar" – clearer as "diduga endemik dan ditemukan di seluruh ..."; "Catatannya berasal dari" is stiff.
Item 9: "mengalahkan" for "outcompete" is imprecise; use "menyaingi" or "kalah bersaing mendapat makanan".
Item 9: "hidup bergerombol longgar (shoaling)... berenang serempak (schooling)" is wordy; the explanation was added in the translation.
Item 2/4: "Ghats Barat" – the usual form is "Ghat Barat" (Western Ghats).
Item 8: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" – "gut-loading" is better explained as "diberi pakan bergizi lebih dahulu".

barilius-infrafasciatus.name: Opsarius infrafasciatus
notes: Item 7: "sudah diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading) sebelum diberikan" is redundant ("sebelumnya... sebelum"). Use "sudah diberi pakan bergizi (gut-loading) terlebih dahulu".

barilius-malabaricus.name: Barilius malabaricus
notes: Item 2: 'Vallapattanam' vs 'Valapattanam' in item 1 — spelling follows source, but is inconsistent; harmonise if desired.
Item 8: 'sapu-sapu/pleco (lele famili Loricariidae)' — loricariids are not lele (catfish of Clariidae); use 'ikan lele loricariid' or 'sapu-sapu (Loricariidae)' more cleanly.
Item 7: 'di-gut-load' is awkward untranslated English; use 'diberi pakan bergizi terlebih dahulu (gut-loading)'.
Item 8: 'Untuk penghuni dasar, misalnya Garra...' is a sentence fragment; rephrase as 'sedangkan penghuni dasar dapat berupa ...'.
Item 8: 'mengungguli ... atau membuat mereka takut' — 'outcompete' is better as 'mengalahkan dalam berebut pakan'.

barilius-ornatus.name: Barilius ornatus
notes: Item 1: "Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat" – the source says "needs a tight-fitting lid". Better: "Perlu tutup yang pas/rapat". The meaning is intact.
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – "biologically-immature" is more natural as "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: "Tutup yang rapat juga mutlak perlu" is clumsy. Use "juga sangat penting".
Item 5: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders". Use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus".
Item 8: "mengalahkan" for "outcompete" is weak. Use "menyingkirkan dalam perebutan pakan".
Item 8: "makannya rakus" and "teman setangki" are slightly informal. "Penghuni akuarium lain" is more standard.
Item 9: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise. Use "saat membawa telur / bunting telur".
Item 7: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague. Say "diberi pakan bergizi tinggi sebelum dijadikan pakan".
Item 2: "kalau memang begitu" is colloquial in a handbook. Use "jika demikian".

barilius-shacra.name: Barilius shacra
notes: Item 5: 'Volume: ~540 litres' kept as is; fine, but 'luas permukaan' fine. No issue.
Item 6: 'tidak boleh dimasukkan ke akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is OK, but 'tumbuh baik' for fish 'thrive' should be 'berkembang/tetap sehat' (minor).
Item 12: 'mengalahkan' for 'outcompete' (item 9) is weak; use 'kalah bersaing/menyingkirkan' (minor).
Item 12: 'pangkal sirip punggung terletak di depan pangkal sirip anal' is fine, but 'sungut maksila dan sungut rostral' acceptable; 'tuberkel' should be 'tuberkel/bintil' (minor).
Item 8: 'diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)' is inexact; gut-loading means feeding the insects nutritious food before they are fed to fish: use 'diberi pakan bergizi terlebih dulu'.
Item 9: 'bergerombol longgar (shoaling), bukan berenang serempak (schooling)' is slightly interpretive but ok; 'Kalau hanya dua atau tiga ekor' fine.
Item 12: 'tetapi baru dipakai lebih luas sejak Kottelat (2013)' matches; 'Howe's' is left as 'Howes' - fine.
Item 3: Wording 'Padma' fine.

barilius-signicaudus.name: Opsarius signicaudus
notes: Item 9: "gravid" is rendered as "saat sedang bertelur", which means laying eggs. Use "saat penuh telur" or "sedang membawa telur".
Item 3: "zona asuhan" is a stiff calque of "nursery zones". Use something like "area pembesaran anakan".
Item 7: "diberi makan bergizi (gut-loading)" is vague. Say the live feed was fed nutritious food beforehand, e.g. "sudah diberi pakan bergizi sebelumnya (gut-loading)".

barilius-vagra.name: Vagra Baril
notes: Item 1: "Akuarium wajib memakai tutup" adds "Akuarium" and is slightly stronger than the source; "Needs a tight-fitting lid" is fine as plain "Perlu tutup yang rapat".
Item 5: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is wordy; use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: "batu ... yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders"; use "bongkahan batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" or "batu sungai yang membulat".
Item 7: "di-gut-load (diberi makan bergizi)" leaves English in place and the gloss is imprecise; use "diberi pakan bergizi terlebih dahulu (gut-loading)".
Item 8: "berenang serempak (schooling)" is slightly off; use "berenang rapat dan serempak".
Item 8: "lele loricariid" is not accurate, because loricariids are not true lele; use "ikan lele loricariid (sapu-sapu)" or just "loricariid".
Item 11: "memasukkan anggota 'group ii' ... ke dalam nama genus Opsarius yang divalidasi ulang" is awkward; use "menempatkan ... ke dalam genus Opsarius yang divalidasi kembali".

baryancistrus-beggini.name: Pleco L239
notes: Item 1: "Sungai Orinoco dan hilir río Guaviare" adds "Sungai" to Orinoco, while Guaviare keeps the "río" form. Make this consistent, e.g. "Sungai Orinoco dan hilir Sungai Guaviare".
Item 1 and item 8: "agak rentan" for "somewhat delicate" can be misread as susceptible to disease. Use "agak sensitif" or "agak sulit dipelihara" for the intended sense.
Item 5: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn boulders". Use "bongkahan batu besar yang terkikis/halus oleh aliran air".
Item 5: "aufwuchs (lapisan biofilm dan alga)" is an added gloss. It is acceptable, but use one consistent term for aufwuchs across the text.
Item 7: "kerang-kerangan/udang" for "shellfish" mixes terms. Use "hasil laut bercangkang (udang, kerang)".
Item 7: "pakan ikan" for "puréed fish food" is ambiguous. "Daging ikan" or "pakan ikan yang dihaluskan" is clearer.
Item 7: "mampu menghirup udara atmosfer" is slightly stiff. "Mampu bernapas dengan udara bebas" would be more natural.
Item 3: "dasar batuan granit" for "granite bedrock" is awkward. Use "batuan dasar granit".
Item 11: "Cakram pengisap yang dibentuk oleh bagian mulut dimiliki oleh semua anggotanya" is clumsy. Rephrase it more naturally.

baryancistrus-chrysolomus.name: Mango Pleco
notes: Item 5: "digerogoti ikan" for "graze" sounds like gnawing or eating away. Use "dirumput" or "dimakan dengan cara merumput".
Item 11: "nama dagang alternatif" for "alternative vernacular name" is slightly off. "Nama umum alternatif" is closer.
Item 5: "bongkahan batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is a little awkward. "Batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" reads more naturally.

baryancistrus-demantoides.name: Green Phantom Pleco
notes: Item 6: 'Panjang standar: 151 mm SL' — the English also gives '6 in SL'. Converting inches to cm is fine, but 151 mm is already metric. Keep it as is; the real problem is the volume, so check that '~243 liter' matches the source (it does) and say 'SL' once as 'panjang standar (SL)'.
Item 12: 'cukup tidak pemalu' is awkward and unnatural. Use 'tidak terlalu pemalu' or 'cukup berani'.

Item 10: 'mixed brown orgamic' in the source is a typo for 'organic'. The translation 'campuran bahan organik dan mineral berwarna cokelat' moves 'cokelat' onto the materials and drops the 'matrix' (matriks) sense. Use 'matriks organik dan mineral campuran berwarna cokelat'.
Item 11: 'sangat cocok' is stronger than the English 'particularly suitable' and is acceptable, but 'ruang teritori' is awkward. Use 'ruang wilayah' or 'wilayah teritorial yang cukup'.

Item 3: the type locality quote is left in English. This is acceptable as a quotation, but 'muara anak sungai río Guapuchi' adds 'anak sungai' (tributary) and 'muara' (mouth). The English only says 'the inflowing río Guapuchi'. Use 'sampai río Guapuchi yang bermuara di sana'.
Item 8: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated, with no gloss. Add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan jasad renik)'. 'Halus terkikis air' is also clumsy; use 'batu bulat yang terkikis arus'.
Item 1: 'sejauh ini hanya diketahui dari' wrongly adds 'sejauh ini' (so far), which the source doesn't say. Use 'hanya diketahui dari'.

baryancistrus-longipinnis.name: Pleco Longipinnis
notes: "Nama spesiesnya berarti": better "Nama epitet spesiesnya" / "Epitet spesifiknya berarti" (specific epithet is not the species name).
"Lokasi tipe": more standard is "Lokalitas tipe".

baryancistrus-xanthellus.name: Golden Nugget Pleco
notes: Item 8: "aufwuchs yang akan dirumput oleh ikan" is awkward; better "yang menjadi tempat ikan merumput" or "yang dimakan ikan dengan cara merumput".
Item 8: "bongkahan batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is slightly clumsy; "bongkahan batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" reads more naturally.

batasio-fasciolatus.name: Batasio fasciolatus
notes: Item 10: "social animals" rendered as "ikan yang suka berkelompok" – better "hidup berkelompok/bersifat sosial"; minor nuance.
Item 10: "bukan penghuni dasar murni" is slightly stiff; use "bukan ikan dasar sejati".
Item 12: "berpita kecil-kecil" for "banded, i.e. with small bands" is awkward; use "bergaris/berpita" and "berpita kecil".
Item 12: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" – the Indonesian gloss is fine, but keep the usual term "Berisiko Rendah" consistently.
Item 1: "dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" is acceptable, but "dideskripsikan secara ilmiah" could be simplified to "diperikan secara ilmiah"; minor.
Item 6: "setup" is left as English; "penataan/set-up akuarium" would be more natural.

batasio-fluviatilis.name: Batasio fluviatilis
notes: #10: "Success has been achieved with at least two other members of the genus, of which this is one" is ambiguous in the English; the Indonesian "setidaknya dua anggota genus ini, termasuk spesies ini" is acceptable but slightly changes the count. Say "setidaknya dua anggota lain dari genus ini" to match 'other'.

#1/#5: "lele bagrid" and "ikan beranak (livebearer)" are fine, but "sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk akuarium komunitas 'umum'" reads awkwardly. Use "umumnya kurang cocok untuk akuarium komunitas biasa".
#3: "air terjun kecil" for 'cascades' is slightly off. "jeram" would be more natural.
#8: "untuk mengisi bagian bawah akuarium" is fine, but "Lele akysid atau sisorid ... direkomendasikan" would read better as "disarankan sebagai penghuni dasar".

batasio-tigrinus.name: Batasio tigrinus
notes: Item 1: "hanya hidup di anak sungai hulu" – "obligate inhabitant" is rendered acceptably, but "anak sungai hulu" is a slightly awkward term for "headwater streams"; "sungai hulu" or "aliran hulu" is more natural.
Item 1: "sehingga sebagian besar tidak cocok" – "largely unsuitable" reads awkwardly; "pada umumnya kurang cocok" is better.
Item 3: "air terjun kecil" for "cascades" is fine, but "Batasio spp. hanya hidup" and "bagian atas sungai-sungai kecil" are a bit stiff; consider "hulu sungai-sungai kecil".
Item 5: "batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus" or "batu kali besar yang membulat".

Item 5: "tumbuh baik" for "thrive" is fine, but "Bukan ikan yang pandai berebut makanan" in item 8 adds the idea of food; the English "not especially competitive" does not mention food. Use "Tidak terlalu kompetitif".
Item 8: "area bawah" for "lower levels" – use "lapisan bawah akuarium".
Item 7: "cukup berhasil diberikan" is awkward; use "Pakan buatan tenggelam juga dilaporkan cukup berhasil".

batasio-travancoria.name: Malabar Batasio
notes: Item 1/11: "satu-satunya anggota genus ini lain" is awkward word order; use "satu-satunya anggota lain dari genus ini".
Item 1: "hanya bisa hidup di" for "obligate inhabitant" is slightly strong. "Penghuni khas/mutlak sungai hulu" would be closer.
Item 5: "setup" is used untranslated. "Aquascape" or "penataan akuarium" would read more naturally.
Item 5: "agar bisa tumbuh baik" is acceptable, but "berkembang dengan baik" or "tetap sehat" is better for "thrive".
Item 8: "saat berebut makan" is added to "not especially competitive". Remove it, or use "tidak terlalu kompetitif" alone.
Item 11: "sepasang tonjolan posterior yang menonjol" repeats the same word. Use "sepasang tonjolan posterior yang jelas".

bathyclarias-nyasensis.name: Sapuwa
notes: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable, but "lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.
"Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is fine, but "Berisiko Rendah" is the more current Indonesian IUCN wording.

batrochoglanis-raninus.name: Bumblebee Catfish
notes: Item 7: "Di akuarium, ikan ini memangsa ikan yang lebih kecil" is fine, but "Sediakan banyak tempat persembunyian untuk bersembunyi" is redundant. Rephrase it as "Sediakan banyak tempat persembunyian untuk siang hari".
Item 6: "sangat damai" is slightly stiff. "Sangat tidak agresif" or "sangat tenang" is more natural.
Item 2: "Least Concern/Risiko Rendah" mixes English and Indonesian. The usual Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)".

batrochoglanis-villosus.name: Batrochoglanis villosus
notes: #4: "menerima semua jenis pakan" is fine, but "pakan serpihan, pakan tablet" adds "pakan" repeatedly; use "serpihan (flake), tablet, pelet" for natural hobby wording.
#8: "terutama sangat banyak di atas sirip dada" is awkward; use "terutama melimpah di atas sirip dada".
#1: "Difoto" is informal for a handbook; use "Difoto/Dipotret" or "Foto diambil di Rio Nanay".
#3: "tempat persembunyian untuk bersembunyi" is redundant, which mirrors the source; say "banyak tempat bersembunyi" for smoother wording.
#2: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable, but "lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.

beaufortia-cyclica.name: Beaufortia cyclica
notes: Item 1: the English says 'Needs a tight-fitting lid'. 'Akuarium perlu tutup yang rapat' is acceptable, but the passage repeats the lid and immature-tank advice. Check that nothing in it was added.
Item 8: 'ikan lele kecil' for Glyptothorax, Akysis and Oreoglanis adds 'kecil' (small), which the English does not say. Use 'ikan lele' or 'catfish'.

Item 8: 'meskipun biasanya dijual sebagai teman ikan mas koki' is ambiguous. Say 'meskipun biasanya dijual sebagai teman ikan mas koki' with clear wording that the genus is a poor companion for goldfish.
Item 5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn rocks and pebbles'. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air'.
Item 5: 'dikerok ikan ini' (grazed) is fine but 'Exposed filter sponges' is unclear. Say 'spons filter yang terbuka'.
Item 3: 'penghuni wajib' for 'obligate dwellers' is literal. Use 'penghuni khas' or 'hanya hidup di'.
Item 3: 'jeram dangkal dan alur berarus' for 'riffles and runs' is acceptable but loose. Check that it matches the habitat meaning.
Item 3: 'Saat musim hujan lebat' changes 'During periods of high rainfall'. Say 'saat curah hujan tinggi'.
Item 7: 'gangguan pencernaan' for 'internal problems' narrows the meaning. Use 'gangguan kesehatan internal'.
Item 11: 'Kemampuannya berenang di air terbuka sangat berkurang' is fine. 'Kerabat segenus' is fine. No fix needed.

beaufortia-leveretti.name: Hillstream Loach
notes: Item 1: "hillstream loach" left in English; consider adding a local term in brackets, e.g. "ikan loach arus deras (hillstream loach)".
Item 1: "habitus" is rendered as "Bentuk tubuhnya", which is fine; no change is needed beyond optional wording.

beaufortia-szechuanensis.name: Szechuan Hillstream Loach
notes: Item 8: "gangguan pencernaan" narrows "internal problems"; use "gangguan internal/kesehatan organ dalam" or keep it general.

Item 4: "(kadang sangat deras)" is placed after "kedalaman air", so "sometimes torrential" now seems to describe depth or discharge. Attach it to the flow: "aliran yang lebih deras (kadang sangat deras)".
Item 6: "Kayu apung yang sudah lama terendam" for "aged driftwood" shifts the meaning. Better "kayu apung yang sudah tua/matang (sudah dikeringkan dan lama direndam)".

bedotia-madagascariensis.name: Rainbow Madagaskar
notes: #9: "pigmentasi hiasan" is awkward for "ornate pigmentation". Use something like "pigmentasi yang lebih rumit/indah" or "corak warna yang lebih mencolok".
#4: "mandatory" is translated only as "diperlukan", which is weaker. Use "wajib" or "mutlak diperlukan".
#2: "region Atsinanana" leaves "region" in English. Use "wilayah/regio Atsinanana".
#2: "Sungai Kecil Manambalo" is stiff for "Manambalo Creek". Consider "Anak Sungai Manambalo" or "Manambalo Creek".

belodontichthys-dinema.name: Belodontichthys dinema
notes: Item 7: "Pemakan ikan obligat (piscivora)" is awkward; "ikan karnivora pemakan ikan (piscivora)" is more natural.
Item 11: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is dated; the current Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Resiko Rendah". Use "Least Concern" with the standard Indonesian term.
Item 11: "menamainya ulang menjadi" is fine, but "sinonim objektif" is stiff; "sinonim objektif (objective synonym)" would be clearer.
Item 1/4/5: "Butuh" is colloquial for a handbook; use "Memerlukan" or "Membutuhkan".

Item 1: "ikan lele" is acceptable, but this is a Siluriformes catfish, not a true Clarias lele; "lele" alone, or "ikan patin/lais", is closer to what local hobbyists use (lais is the local name for this group).

belontia-hasselti.name: Selincah
notes: Item 10: "sangat subur" for "very fecund" is imprecise. Use something like "menghasilkan banyak telur".
Item 10: "dengan jantan yang menjaga telur" narrows "paternal" to egg guarding. Use "jantan yang mengasuh telur dan anakan" or "pengasuhan oleh jantan".
Item 3: "kerabat murad" for Melaleuca (myrtle) is vague. Consider "Melaleuca (famili Myrtaceae/gelam)".
Item 5: "Buah alder (alder cone)" is awkward. Consider "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder".

belontia-signata.name: Combtail
notes: Item 10: "Pembuat sarang busa yang induk jantan dan betinanya sama-sama mengasuh" is clumsy. Suggest "Pembuat sarang busa dengan pengasuhan oleh kedua induk (biparental)".
Item 9: "Anakan hidup tidak bisa dibedakan jenis kelaminnya" is awkward for "Live juveniles". Suggest "Anakan yang masih hidup/masih kecil tidak dapat dibedakan jenis kelaminnya dengan pasti".
Item 8: "betina yang sedang tidak siap kawin" is awkward for "non-nuptial females". Suggest "betina yang tidak sedang berpijah".

benitochromis-finleyi.name: Benitochromis finleyi
notes: "pengeram mulut ovofil (telur dierami di dalam mulut)": "ovofil" is obscure jargon, and the gloss explains mouthbrooding rather than oviphilic (egg-loving: eggs taken into the mouth first). Prefer "mouthbrooder ovofil" or "pengeram telur di mulut", keeping it simple."

"Soal kimia air": informal register for a handbook; prefer "Terkait kimia air/parameter air". "ternyata" (turns out) adds a nuance of surprise not in "astonishingly"; use "sangat mudah beradaptasi" or "mengejutkan".
"bersikap cukup kasar": "gruff" is more like aggressive/surly; "cukup agresif" is more natural for fish behaviour in aquarium Indonesian.

benitochromis-riomuniensis.name: Benitochromis riomuniensis
notes: "pemijah gua" is acceptable, but "pengeram mulut ovofil" could add the term "(mouthbrooder)" for clarity; optional.
"hasil tangkapan alam" could be phrased more naturally as "tangkapan alam" or "koleksi dari alam liar"; minor.

benthochromis-tricoti.name: Benthochromis tricoti
notes: #1/#5: "bisa melompat saat bersemangat" is fine, but "Pastikan akuarium tertutup rapat" repeats the lid advice in #1 almost word for word; the repetition is in the source, so only consider tightening it.
#8: "heboh dan lincah" adds "lincah" (agile), which the English "boisterous" does not say. Use "heboh/agresif" only.
#10: "Pengeram mulut maternal (induk betina mengerami telur)" is clumsy. Use "Pengeram mulut oleh induk betina (maternal mouthbrooder)".
#10: "dilepaskan dalam keadaan lemah" is a bit unnatural for fry released from the mouth. "Burayak hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "keluar dari mulut induk dalam keadaan lemah" would be more natural.
#7: "artemia" is lowercase while "Mysis" and "Cyclops" are capitalised, so the style is inconsistent. Use "Artemia" or "artemia" throughout, as in "naupli artemia" in #10.
#12: The reference list is left untranslated, which is allowed.

betadevario-ramachandrani.name: Betadevario
notes: Item 8: "lele/catfish" is wrong for catfishes in general. Lele is one specific catfish group (Clarias). Use "ikan lele (catfish)" or just "catfish".
Item 1: "jago melompat" is colloquial for a handbook. Use something like "pelompat yang handal/ulung".
Item 1/5/8: "teman setangki" is non-standard. "Tank mate" is usually "penghuni lain/ikan lain dalam akuarium".
Item 3: "jeram kecil" for cascades and "pengambilan sampel" for collection are slightly off. "Pengumpulan/penangkapan" would be more natural.
Item 11: "Garis P: atau 'pigment stripe'" has awkward punctuation. Drop the colon after "P" or restructure the phrase.
Item 5: "batu-batu bulat bekas tergerus air" is clumsy. Use "batu kali yang terkikis air" or "batu sungai".

betta-akarensis.name: Betta akarensis
notes: Item 10: "Hal ini perlu dilakukan sehati-hati mungkin" is fine, but "banyak yang memindahkan betina" after "namun" reads awkwardly; rephrase, e.g. "namun banyak breeder memilih memindahkan betina".
Item 10: "Burayak sudah cukup besar untuk langsung menerima pakan hidup yang bergerak" – "motile foods" is better as "pakan bergerak"; microworm is also not necessarily live-only. Minor.
Item 10: "anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia" drops the hedge "reports of young Betta developing"; use "dapat mengalami".
Item 5: "ikan ini juga pelompat yang sangat andal" is awkward for "excellent jumper"; use "pelompat ulung" or "sangat suka melompat".
Item 5: "sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara lembap" is stiff; use "sesekali perlu naik menghirup udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 5: "burayak" is used for fry; "anakan" is also used in the same text, so keep the term consistent.
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left in English-like forms; use "suprabrankial" and "epibrankial".
Item 8: "garis pandang yang terputus-putus" is awkward; use "penghalang pandang" or "garis pandang yang terhalang".
Item 7: "memastikan warna dan kondisi terbaiknya berkembang" is stiff; use "menunjang warna dan kondisi terbaik".

betta-albimarginata.name: Betta albimarginata
notes: "Jantan yang sedang menampilkan warna berwarna merah bata": repetitive "menampilkan warna berwarna"; use "Jantan yang sedang memamerkan warna berwarna merah bata" or "Jantan yang sedang menampilkan warna merah bata".
"Channoides" in the English is rendered as "B. channoides", which is fine; but "membentang di sepanjang tinggi sirip" is awkward; use "membentang di seluruh tinggi sirip".

betta-anabatoides.name: Betta anabatoides
notes: Item 6: "bisa mencapai panjang sekitar 12,5 cm" turns "up to 5 inches" into an approximation; "hingga 12,5 cm" or "mencapai 12,5 cm" is closer.
Item 2: "cukup toleran" softens "more tolerant"; "lebih toleran" would be more literal.

betta-antoni.name: Betta antoni
notes: Item 16: 'Meskipun sebagian penangkar tidak pernah mengalami masalah ... penangkar lain pernah kehilangan ..., tetapi banyak yang memindahkan betina' – contrast is garbled; should say many breeders remove the female as a precaution regardless.
Item 16: 'penutup yang serapat mungkin' is fine, but 'dipungut dengan mulut oleh betina' is awkward; use 'diambil dengan mulut betina'.
Item 16: 'pakan hidup yang bergerak seperti microworm dan naupli artemia' – 'motile foods' is better as 'pakan hidup yang aktif bergerak'; minor.
Item 18: 'ada garis dagu' and 'sirip ekor biasanya dengan garis-garis melintang' are stilted; use 'terdapat garis dagu' and 'biasanya bergaris melintang'.
Item 18: 'suprabranchial'/'epibranchial' left in English; give Indonesian forms (suprabrankial, epibrankial).
Item 7: 'pelompat yang sangat andal' – 'andal' is odd for jumping; use 'pelompat ulung'.
Item 13: 'ikan yang ... lebih aktif dan lincah' for 'vigorous' – acceptable but 'intimidate' rendered as 'tertekan' (stressed); use 'mengintimidasi/membuatnya takut'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable; 'cacing sutra' for blackworms in item 10 is a different worm (Tubifex); use 'cacing hitam (blackworm)'.
Item 1: 'Pemijahan: pengeram mulut' – 'Breeding' type; fine, but 'Tangkapan alam' should be 'Tangkapan liar'.

betta-apollon.name: Betta apollon
notes: "masih berkerabat dekat dengan Betta pugnax": "masih" is added and not in the source; use "berkerabat dekat dengan Betta pugnax" (or "termasuk kelompok yang sangat dekat dengan").
"dideterminasi secara ilmiah": awkward; use "belum diidentifikasi/dideskripsikan secara ilmiah".
"hobiis": non-standard; use "penghobi" or "penggemar ikan hias".
"cupang pengeram mulut": fine, but "dapat" is better than "bisa dibilang" in a handbook register; "dikenal bisa dibilang meledak" is slightly colloquial. Consider "jumlahnya melonjak pesat".

betta-bellica.name: Betta bellica
notes: Item 4: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" – English says permanent water is not always available; "sepanjang tahun" is an added meaning. Use "karena genangan air permanen tidak selalu ada".

Item 6: "filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar sirkulasinya pelan" – fine, but "unit reverse osmosis" is OK. The main issue is "Akuarium harus ditutup rapat"; "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff. Use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".

Item 3: Place-name text left in English (neotype and type locality quotes). Because this is a quoted locality citation it is acceptable, but "provinsi Utara" should be "Sumatra Utara" for Indonesian readers.
Item 3: "43 kilometers" is left as in the original quote; fine, but the quote is an untranslated English sentence that could be given a short Indonesian gloss.
Item 8: "cacing darah beku" is fine, but "blackworm hidup" could be "cacing hitam (blackworm)".

Item 10 and 16: "Betta unimaculata" vs "kompleks Unimaculata" – keep species names consistent. In item 16, "Sirip ... dan ekor jantan lebih runcing" repeats the caudal fin and tail as separate items, which is as in the source.
Item 12: "Jantan berwarna lebih bagus" is informal; "warna jantan lebih menarik/cerah" is more natural.
Item 15: "Proses ini diulang sampai telur betina habis" – the source says the female is spent ("lelah/habis tenaga"). It is not that her eggs run out. Rephrase as "sampai betina kehabisan tenaga".

Item 15: "Betina yang siap kawin warnanya menjadi lebih pucat" is fine. "sperma" for milt should be "air mani/sperma" – OK. "sekadar seleksi alam" is a slight reinterpretation of "survival of the fittest"; keep it close to the source.

betta-breviobesus.name: Betta breviobesus
notes: Item 4: "per 19 liter air" – 5 gallons ≈ 19 L is fine, but "air" was added; use "per 19 liter" (minor).
Item 7: "saling flaring" leaves English; use "saling mengembangkan sirip/insang (flaring)" or "saling menggembungkan insang".
Item 3: "Genangan air tenang" suggests puddles; better "kolam/perairan tenang dan sungai kecil".
Item 1: "Tercatat di IBC" – IBC is not expanded; consider spelling it out (International Betta Congress). "punya" is informal; use "memiliki".

betta-brownorum.name: Betta brownorum
notes: Item 4: 'Many habitats around the former' (= Sibu) is rendered 'di sekitar lokasi yang disebut pertama', which is ambiguous. Name Sibu explicitly: 'di sekitar Sibu'.
Item 8: 'excellent jumper' became 'pelompat yang sangat andal'. This is awkward, since 'andal' means reliable. Use 'pelompat ulung' or 'pandai melompat'.

Item 18: 'Burayak sudah cukup besar untuk langsung menerima pakan hidup... naupli artemia' is faithful. But the final clause 'anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia' states a fact; the English says 'reports of'. Add 'dilaporkan' / 'bisa mengalami'.

Item 18: 'the eggs hatch... remaining in the nest for a further 3–4 days... male continues to collect and return any that fall'. The translation changes 'telur' to 'burayak yang jatuh'. Keep 'telur/burayak' consistent with the source (any that fall = larvae/eggs).
Item 18: 'sperma' for milt is acceptable, but 'sel sperma/cairan sperma' is more natural. 'Plastik wrap' for clingfilm is a loanword. Use 'plastik pembungkus makanan'.
Item 19: 'sisik subdorsal', 'lateral' and 'predorsal' follow the source. 'ruas tulang belakang abdominal' is fine. 'tutup insang' for opercle is acceptable. 'sirip perut... falcate' is fine.
Item 1: 'Pemijahan: pembuat sarang busa' is not a natural label. Use 'Tipe pemijahan' or 'Pembuat sarang busa'.

Item 14: 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan' for 'outcompete' is OK. 'Beberapa ikan cyprinid kecil dan loach... cocok dijadikan teman' adds 'teman' (tankmates), which is acceptable. 'Penghuni stenotipik' is jargon but kept from the source.

betta-burdigala.name: Betta burdigala
notes: Item 4: IUCN status 'Vulnerable' ('Rentan') since 1996 conflicts with item 1 'Critically Endangered' ('Kritis'). This is a source inconsistency, so keep each as written, but check the source.
Item 1: 'tangkapan alam' is fine, but 'Betta uberis tetapi tanpa bintik di bagian tengah tubuh' is an acceptable rendering. Not a problem.

Item 6: the original gives '1.2 - 1.5 inches (about 3-3.8 cm)'. Using 'sekitar' is fine. However, '1 pasang per 5 gallons' is rendered as 'per sekitar 19 liter'; 5 US gallons is about 19 L, so this is correct. No change needed.

Item 17: 'Floating plants may be incorporated into the nest' is rendered 'tanaman apung... mungkin dimasukkan ke dalam sarang'. This wrongly suggests the keeper adds them. Say instead that the male may incorporate floating plants into the nest, e.g. 'dapat disertakan jantan dalam sarang'.

Item 17: 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable, but 'mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia berlebihan' drops 'young Betta... reports exist' nuance. Reword to 'ada laporan bahwa Betta muda mengalami masalah kesehatan bila diberi naupli artemia berlebihan'.
Item 7: the SL conversion '1.4 in' was dropped, which is fine. No issue.

Item 5: 'sepanjang tahun' in the last sentence is slightly added ('karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun'). The original says 'permanent water is not always available', so use 'air permanen tidak selalu tersedia'.
Item 17: 'induk biasanya bisa dibiarkan tetap di akuarium' is OK. 'Dasar perairan' is fine.
Item 18: 'sisik postdorsal', 'predorsal' and 'subdorsal' are left as English terms; use Indonesian-style 'sisik di depan/belakang sirip punggung' if possible.

betta-channoides.name: Betta channoides
notes: Item 1: "Genting" is the usual Indonesian rendering of Endangered; fine, but the Latin name "Betta albimarginata" should be italic, which the HTML does not show (minor).
Item 4: "snakehead betta" left in English within quotes; consider adding the local name, e.g. "cupang kepala ular" (minor).

betta-chloropharynx.name: Betta chloropharynx
notes: Item 4: "sekitar 72 liter" is wrong for 80 × 30 cm base; the English figure is taken as given, but check it (depth unspecified, so the volume can't be verified). Keep consistent with the source.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is misleading, because driftwood in the hobby is kayu akar/bogwood and does not float. Use "kayu rendam" or "kayu driftwood" instead.
Item 5: "pelompat yang handal" should be "andal" (standard spelling).
Item 8: "Beberapa ikan kecil dari famili Cyprinidae" adds "famili" and drops "cyprinids". Use "sebangsa cyprinid" or "ikan cyprinid kecil".
Item 8: "loach" is left in English. Use "ikan lohok/botia" or "ikan loach" with a gloss.
Item 10: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan" is acceptable but "cacing mikro" for microworm is ok. "pelukan 'latihan'" for 'dummy' embraces is odd. Use "pelukan semu/palsu".
Item 10: "Termasuk mouthbrooder ... oleh pejantan" is awkward. Use "Mouthbrooder paternal (jantan mengerami telur di mulut)".
Item 1: "Satu populasi ... dulu dianggap satu spesies dengannya" is awkward. Item 10: "dipungut ke mulut betina" is slightly off. Use "diambil dengan mulut betina".
Item 3: "Kandungan mineral terlarutnya umumnya nyaris nol" turns "negligible" into "nearly zero". This is acceptable but a bit stronger than the source. Use "sangat rendah/dapat diabaikan".

betta-coccina.name: Cupang Coccina
notes: Item 3: "Kanopi ranting yang rapat" – canopy of branches; ok, but "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" changes "permanent water is not always available" (air permanen) – should be "air yang menetap/permanen tidak selalu tersedia".
Item 10: "Jika ada tanaman apung, tanaman itu mungkin ikut dijadikan bagian sarang" is okay, but "mengembalikan larva yang jatuh" – English says eggs ("any that fall"); use "telur" not "larva".
Item 10: "kuning telurnya terserap habis" – yolk sac should be "kantung kuning telur".
Item 10: "sperma" for milt – better "cairan sperma (milt)"; "sampai telur betina habis" fine.
Item 10: "pakan hidup yang bergerak" for motile foods fine; "Wadah film kamera bekas" okay but add 'rol film'.
Item 5: "Tanaman apung juga disukai" fine; "filter spons bertenaga aerator ... diatur agar sirkulasinya lembut" ok; "jago melompat" is colloquial – use "pelompat yang handal".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but "Daphnia" is commonly used; "chironomid" okay.
Item 1: the lead sentence "Nama spesies ini dipakai untuk kelompok" ok; "pembuat sarang busa" fine.
Item 4: the volume ~41 L is fine; no issue.
Item 8: "riset yang matang" – better "pencarian informasi yang cermat".

betta-cracens.name: Betta cracens
notes: Item 5: "kayu beech atau oak" is left in English. Use "kayu beech/oak (ek)" or briefly explain the wood types, since Indonesian hobbyists may not know them.
Item 5: "ikan ini juga jago melompat" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "pelompat yang handal" or "sangat mudah melompat".
Item 5: "peternak" is used for breeders throughout. "Penangkar" or "pembiak" is more usual in the hobby.
Item 8: "cyprinid kecil dan loach" are left as English terms. Use "ikan sekerabat cyprinid kecil dan ikan loach (botia)", or explain them.
Item 10: "Pengeram mulut oleh induk jantan" is awkward. "Pengeram mulut paternal (dierami oleh jantan)" would be clearer.
Item 10: "pelukan kosong" for 'dummy' embraces is a slightly loose rendering. "Pelukan semu" or "pelukan tanpa pelepasan telur" is better.
Item 10: "burayak sudah cukup besar untuk langsung menerima pakan hidup". "Burayak" is a regional term for fry, and "anakan" is used for the same fish elsewhere in the text. Keep the term consistent.
Item 11: "sepasang organ suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left as English anatomical terms. Use Indonesian forms (suprabrankial/epibrankial) or add an explanation.

betta-dennisyongi.name: Betta dennisyongi
notes: Item 4: "Kota Singkil" renders "town" as a city; "Kota Meulaboh" and "Kota Singkil" could be written as "kota kecil Singkil" or just "Singkil" (minor).

betta-dimidiata.name: Betta dimidiata
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but item 20: "jantan mengerami... sebelum disemburkan ke air untuk ditangkap jantan" is OK; real issue below.

Item 20: "burayak Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika terlalu banyak diberi artemia" turns "reports of" into a flat statement; keep it hedged, e.g. "ada laporan bahwa burayak Betta bisa mengalami masalah kesehatan bila terlalu banyak diberi artemia".
Item 20: "kecuali ikan sudah dipelihara tanpa ikan lain" is awkward and unclear; use "kecuali ikan memang sudah dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)".

Item 20: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina" is correct, but "Setelah semua telur berada di mulut jantan... sampai telur betina habis" is fine; "burayak... sudah terbentuk sempurna" is OK. Item 9: "mengakses lapisan udara" reads stiffly; use "sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 7: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" adds "sepanjang tahun"; the English says permanent water is not always available ("air permanen tidak selalu tersedia").
Item 2/22: the claim "mudah dibedakan" is fine, but item 2 "sirip ekornya bisa membedakan keduanya" is awkward; use "sirip ekornya yang membedakan keduanya".
Item 5: "danau-danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant; use "kawasan Danau Sentarum".
Item 12: "Aliran air yang lembut atau nyaris tanpa arus lebih disukai" is clumsy; use "Lebih disukai aliran air yang pelan atau nyaris tanpa arus".
Item 19: "Burayak yang baru dilepaskan bisa langsung makan" is fine, but "pelukan percumbuan" is unnatural; use "pelukan saat berpacaran".
Item 10: "Air blackwater yang lunak dan asam adalah yang ideal" is stiff; use "Idealnya air blackwater yang lunak dan asam".

betta-edithae.name: Betta edithae
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: sekitar 5,8 cm' is fine, but the 'much better coloration ... above 78°F (about 26°C)' line is rendered 'di atas sekitar 26 °C'. This is acceptable, so no change is needed here. The real problem is item 2/19: the sentence 'membran branchiostegal dan bagian belakang operkulum ... yang buram atau tembus cahaya' is fine.

Item 5: 'sekitar Palembang di Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Sumatra' changes the source's 'near Palembang'. It also reads as if the province is 'Sumatra'. Rephrase to: 'di dekat Palembang (Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Pulau Sumatra)'.

Item 7: the '60 mm SL (2.4 in SL)' conversion was dropped, which is fine. However '80 × 30 cm ... sekitar 72 liter' keeps the source's volume without the tank height, so it is not verifiable. Check it against the source.

Item 8: 'Buah alder (Alnus)' should be 'kerucut/buah alder (Alnus)'. 'Alder cones' are strobili, not fruit. Also 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang ulung' is slightly awkward. Better: 'dan pandai melompat'.
Item 8: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'Mikroba ini bisa menjadi sumber pakan' changes the referent: the source says 'These' (the microbe colonies), which is acceptable.
Item 12: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Isi perut serangga tersebut dulu' is ambiguous. Rephrase to 'beri makan serangga itu dulu dengan serpihan ikan atau sayuran sebelum diberikan ke ikan'.
Item 13: 'sangat damai' is ok, but the duplicated sentence mirrors the source. No change is needed.

Item 18: 'Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditangkap di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina' is faithful. 'Burayak ... microworm dan naupli artemia' is also fine. But 'anakan Betta ... jika diberi naupli artemia' reads as if the problem was with artemia only, which is correct. Also 'peternak' for 'breeders' is fine. 'plastik wrap' is acceptable.
Item 4: 'kompleks Betta edithae' is acceptable, but the source's 'group' is used inconsistently. Use 'kelompok Betta edithae' to match items 2 and 19.
Item 20: the references are untranslated, as instructed.

betta-enisae.name: Betta enisae
notes: Item 1: 'mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh pejantan' is awkward. Better 'Betta enisae adalah ikan labirin mouthbrooder yang pengeraman telurnya dilakukan oleh pejantan'.
Item 1: 'Ciri khasnya adalah garis-garis melintang' implies this is the species' only distinguishing feature, which overstates the source. It is a distinguishing character in the complex.
Item 1: 'Indonesian Borneo' became only 'Indonesia', so 'Borneo' is dropped in the summary.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipenya' is a calque. Use 'Lokalitas tipe' or 'Lokasi penemuan spesimen tipe'.
Item 2: 'terlihat memiliki perbedaan' for 'have been observed to exhibit' is fine. 'ukuran serta proporsi tubuh' for 'morphometrics' is acceptable but loose.
Item 5: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is acceptable, but hobbyists usually say 'breeder' or 'penangkar'.
Item 5: 'Kalau tidak menemukan driftwood' is too casual for a handbook.
Item 5: 'jago melompat' is too colloquial. Use 'pelompat yang andal'.
Item 5: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'Betta spp.' and 'Cryptocoryne spp.' are left in Latin, which is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Pejantan mengerami telur di mulut.' is fine. 'masa pendekatan' for 'courtship' is vague. Use 'masa pacaran' or 'penjajakan'.

betta-falx.name: Betta falx
notes: Item 7: The English gives '24 × 12 in' as well as '60 × 30 cm', and the translation correctly drops the inches. 'kira-kira 54 liter' is fine, but the translator was told to round 5 L or more to the nearest 5 L, so 55 liter is expected. This is minor.
Item 3: 'wilayah Utara yang letaknya lebih ke utara' is awkward and unclear. It should say 'Sumatra Utara' (North Sumatra), which is the region the next paragraph names.
Item 9: 'sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara lembap' is stiff. Prefer 'sesekali perlu mengambil napas dari lapisan udara lembap'. 'jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook.
Item 8: 'Ukuran spesies ini bisa mencapai sekitar 6 cm' is slightly off. It would be more natural as 'panjangnya bisa mencapai sekitar 6 cm'.
Item 2: 'lingkar kerabat' is an odd rendering of 'form circle'. Use 'kelompok Betta picta' or 'kompleks'.
Item 13: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but the English 'Betta spp.' is left untranslated in places. This is minor.
Item 15: 'jadi teman yang cocok' is a loose paraphrase of 'compatible'. 'dapat dipelihara bersama' is closer.

betta-ferox.name: Betta ferox
notes: "sungai-sungai kecil" for "brooks": acceptable, but "anak sungai" is the more natural hobby term.

"Pernah masuk ... diterima": the English "were received" (shop talk) is rendered as "Pernah masuk", which is fine. "spesimen ... hasil penangkaran Jerman" could read more smoothly as "hasil budidaya di Jerman".

betta-gladiator.name: Betta gladiator
notes: Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is not quite right, because driftwood used in aquaria does not float. Use "kayu driftwood" or "akar/kayu rendaman" instead.
Item 1: "ikan labirin berukuran besar yang mengerami telur di mulut oleh si jantan" is clumsy. Something like "ikan labirin besar yang jantannya mengerami telur di mulut" reads better.

betta-hendra.name: Betta hendra
notes: #9: "menghuni perairan yang lambat" is awkward for "sluggish waters"; use "perairan berarus tenang/lambat".
#19: "mungkin akan dimasukkan ke dalam sarang" is a little stiff; "dapat disertakan" or "sering dijadikan bagian sarang" would read better.

betta-hipposideros.name: Betta hipposideros
notes: Item 11: "kalah bersaing berebut makanan" adds "berebut makanan". The English only says "outcompete". Use "kalah bersaing".
Item 14: "Pengeram mulut oleh jantan" is a bit stiff. "Jantan mengeram telur di mulut" would read more naturally.

betta-ibanorum.name: Betta ibanorum
notes: Item 1: "Pulau Borneo (Kalimantan)" adds something the source doesn't say and is misleading. Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo, not Kalimantan. Use "Pulau Borneo" only.
Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" narrows "outcompete" to food. Use a general phrase such as "bersaing dengannya" or "mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 10: "mengerami" (to incubate or brood) is used for mouthbrooding. "mengeram di dalam mulut" is more precise and consistent with the term used earlier.

betta-ideii.name: Betta ideii
notes: Item 2: "memicu munculnya warna dan perilaku memijah" is slightly awkward; consider "memicu warna yang lebih cerah dan perilaku berbiak".

betta-imbellis.name: Cupang Imbellis
notes: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)": the IUCN term is usually "Risiko Rendah/Berisiko Rendah"; keep one form for consistency, e.g. "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)".
"saat pamer": "display" is better rendered "saat memamerkan diri/menggertak" (display behaviour) so it is not read as showing off to people.
"dua garis vertikal": the English says "bars"; "garis/pita vertikal" is acceptable, but "di atas tubuhnya yang gelap" would be more natural as "pada latar tubuhnya yang gelap".
"tipe aduan": "fighter types" is better as "cupang aduan (fighter)" to make clear they are fighting bettas.
"line-breeding": consider "pembiakan galur murni (line-breeding)" for readability.

betta-krataios.name: Betta krataios
notes: Item 10: "ada laporan bahwa anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan" loses 'young Betta developing health issues'; fine, but 'Pejantan ... sirip anal' ok. Real issue: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal pejantan" is fine.

Item 5: "Penambahan daun kering ... selain memberi tempat berlindung tambahan bagi ikan, juga mendorong" – sentence is clumsy; restructure ("selain menyediakan tempat berlindung tambahan, daun juga mendorong...").
Item 5: "filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar sirkulasinya pelan" okay, but 'air-powered' better as "filter spons berpenggerak udara".
Item 5: "sangat pandai melompat" is slightly odd; use "pelompat yang andal/sering melompat".
Item 5: "akses lapisan udara lembap" – 'mengakses' is stiff; use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" left in English/Latin form; use "suprabrankial"/"epibrankial" or Indonesian anatomical terms.
Item 11: "organ suprabranchial ... lipatan kulit" – 'paired' → 'sepasang' is fine, but 'menghirup udara bebas' should be "udara atmosfer/udara langsung dari permukaan".
Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds 'for food' not in the source (outcompete); use "kalah bersaing".
Item 8: "cocok dijadikan teman" is awkward; use "cocok sebagai teman sekolam".
Item 8: "dalam kelompok akan menunjukkan" – 'cyprinid dan loach' left in English; use "ikan cyprinid (sejenis ikan mas) dan ikan loach/pasir" or add local terms.

betta-kuehnei.name: Betta kuehnei
notes: "Kelantan, negara bagian paling utara di Malaysia": the English says "northernmost province" and Kelantan is not the northernmost state of Malaysia. The source wording is kept, so this is only a minor point. Consider "negara bagian" or "provinsi" for consistency.
"akuaris" is not the usual hobby term. Use "akuaris" only if it is common locally, or use "penghobi akuarium".
"Males and females can be distinguished best by..." is translated as "paling mudah dibedakan". This is acceptable, but "paling baik" would be closer to the source.

betta-lehi.name: Betta lehi
notes: Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds "makanan" (food). The English only says "outcompete". Use "mengungguli/mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left as English/Latin anatomical terms. Optionally use Indonesian forms such as "suprabrankial" and "epibrankial".

betta-livida.name: Betta livida
notes: Item 1: 'Ikan ini anggota berwarna merah dari kelompok B. coccina' is missing the verb 'adalah' and reads awkwardly. Also 'status terancam punah (endangered)' is fine, but 'sarang busa' for a labyrinth fish is OK.
Item 8: 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang sangat andal' – 'andal' (reliable) is the wrong nuance for 'excellent jumper'. Use 'pelompat ulung' or 'sangat pandai melompat'.

Item 8: 'Tanaman air ... bisa ditambahkan' drops the 'You could add' framing, which is minor. 'filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar airnya berputar pelan' is clumsy; use 'filter spons dengan aerator yang diatur pelan'.

Item 16: 'Jika ada tanaman apung, tanaman itu mungkin ikut dijadikan bagian dari sarang' is OK, but 'Gunakan tutup akuarium yang serapat mungkin' is fine. 'larva tetap berada di sarang' adds the word 'larva' where the English says 'eggs remaining in the nest' (the eggs hatch, so the meaning is not clearly the same). Say 'telur/larva'.
Item 16: 'sperma dan beberapa butir telur dikeluarkan' – 'milt' is better as 'cairan sperma/air mani jantan'. Also 'ikan dewasa ... tidak memakan anaknya' is fine.

Item 18: 'jari-jari sirip anal', 'sisik subdorsal' are fine, but 'hanya hidup di rawa gambut hutan' for 'stenotypic' loses the meaning that it is restricted to this habitat. 'Sirip perut' for pelvic fin is fine.
Item 2: 'Betta' is rendered 'cupang' here but kept as 'Betta' elsewhere. Keep the term consistent across entries.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'kutu air' may be confused with other things. Consider 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.

betta-macrostoma.name: Betta macrostoma
notes: #12: "mengunggulinya" for "outcompete" is unnatural; use "mengalahkannya dalam persaingan (pakan/ruang)".
#15: "Ritual pemijahan" for "Courtship" is slightly off; "Pacaran" or "Perilaku pendekatan/pacaran" is more precise.
#6/#15: "peternak" for "breeders" is acceptable but "pembiak/breeder" is more usual in the hobby.

betta-mahachaiensis.name: Cupang Mahachai
notes: Item 1: "Betta" capitalized in "satu-satunya Betta" – use lowercase "betta" (common name), as in the source.
Item 1: the "two bars on its cheek plates" is rendered as "dua garis di tutup insangnya"; "garis vertikal"/"balok" would be more precise, minor.
Item 4: "Ikan ini dipelihara... tetapi tahan pada rentang yang lebih lebar" is slightly awkward; "toleran terhadap rentang yang lebih luas" is more natural.
Item 4: "dalam pemeliharaan ini tidak dipelihara di air payau" is repetitive; use "tidak dipelihara di air payau di sini" or "tidak dipelihara dalam kondisi payau".
Item 5: "teman akuarium" is awkward for tankmates; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan penghuni lain yang bukan betta jantan".
Item 6: "burayak" is fine, but "Awali dengan infusoria" is a bit stilted; "Beri makan awal berupa infusoria" is more natural.

betta-mandor.name: Betta mandor
notes: Item 11: 'carbonate hardness ... negligible' translated as 'kesadahan karbonat yang nyaris nol' - slightly stronger than 'negligible'; use 'sangat rendah/dapat diabaikan'.
Item 19: 'Fry ... can take ... immediately' fine, but 'Betta mandor adalah pengeram mulut, dan yang mengerami adalah jantan' is clumsy; use 'pengeram mulut paternal (jantan yang mengerami)'.
Item 9: 'Cryptocoryne spp.' and 'Betta spp.' left as 'spp.' fine, but 'Kerucut alder (alder cone)' is unclear; use 'buah alder/kerucut pohon alder' and explain.
Item 9: 'biologically-immature aquaria' rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' - adds a specific concept; better 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 20: 'bubble-nesters' rendered 'Betta pembuat sarang busa' - ok, but 'Jantan yang ... stres atau belum berpengalaman' and 'burayak' used for fry at release; fine. 'Cacing mikro' fine.
Item 2/22: 'twin red bars on the opercle' rendered 'dua garis merah di tutup insang' - 'bars' better as 'pita/garis vertikal'.
Item 6: 'kolam-kolam' for 'pools' suggests ponds; use 'genangan'.
Item 22: 'interradial membranes' as 'selaput antarjari' - use 'selaput antar jari-jari sirip'; 'zat humat' vs 'asam humat' inconsistent across items.
Item 16: 'more vigorous' as 'lebih aktif dan lincah' adds nuance; use 'lebih tangkas/agresif'.
Item 13: 'daphnia' as 'kutu air' is ok but 'Daphnia' elsewhere; keep consistent.

betta-midas.name: Betta midas
notes: Item 10: 'ikan betok (climbing perch)' is wrong. Anabas spp. is usually 'betok' or 'ikan betok', but the 'climbing perch' gloss is fine. Check that 'betok' is the common name for Anabas testudineus and not a different fish.

Item 10: 'transverse bars in caudal-fin present or absent' became 'garis melintang di sirip ekor ada atau tidak ada'. Use 'pita/garis lintang' consistently. The same applies to 'dark transverse bars'.

Item 8: 'cocok dijadikan teman' is ambiguous. Say 'dapat dipelihara bersama (kompatibel)'. 'mengintimidasinya dan kalah bersaing dengannya' reads awkwardly. Use 'mengintimidasi dan mengalahkannya dalam persaingan pakan'.
Item 7: the first sentence has no subject ('Di alam kemungkinan besar sebagian besar memakan...'). Add 'ikan ini'. 'cacing darah' is fine.
Item 5: 'Betta spp. ... ikan ini sesekali perlu mengakses' is stiff. Use 'sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap'.
Item 5: 'filter spons dengan aerator' should be 'filter spons bertenaga udara (air-powered sponge filter)'. 'turn over gently' is better rendered as 'aliran pelan'.
Item 3: 'sisa-sisa hutan rawa gambut dan hutan rawa gambut yang masih utuh' is clumsy. Use 'hutan rawa gambut yang tersisa maupun yang masih utuh'.
Item 2: 'anak-anak sungai hutan kerangas' loses the singular source ('streams' is fine). 'Sungau Sepatah' is kept from the source, which is acceptable.

betta-miniopinna.name: Betta miniopinna
notes: Item 3: "lokasi spesifiknya belum diketahui" slightly changes "no specific location at this time" (not given/recorded). Use "belum ada keterangan lokasi spesifik".
Item 5: type locality is left in English inside the quote. Consider giving the Indonesian place names, e.g. "Kepulauan Riau, Bintan utara".

betta-ocellata.name: Betta ocellata
notes: Item 1: "Ukuran maksimum: 7,6 cm lebih" is wrong. English says "3+ inches (about 7.6 cm)" but item 2 says 90 mm SL. Use "lebih dari 7,6 cm" or "7,6 cm+".
Item 5: "sekitar 72 liter" is the converted volume, and the 31 × 12 in bracket was dropped. The conversion is fine, so no change is needed unless precision is wanted.
Item 7: "22–28 °C" is a rounded conversion of 72–82°F (22.2–27.8 °C), which is acceptable. "memunculkan warna" is awkward; use "memperkuat warna" or "memunculkan warna cerah".

Item 12: "kalah bersaing dengannya" and "mengintimidasinya" are ambiguous and stiff. Rephrase, e.g. "ikan ini akan terintimidasi dan kalah bersaing". "lebih agresif" for "more vigorous" changes the meaning slightly; use "lebih lincah/aktif".
Item 11: the sentence "yang berisi betta-betta terbesar" is awkward. Say clearly that the complex contains the largest bettas.
Item 16: "Akuarium harus memakai tutup serapat mungkin" is acceptable. "burayak" for fry is correct, but "Proses pendekatan (courtship)" is vague; "pacaran/penjajakan" is more usual.
Item 6: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is fine. "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff; use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 18: the reference list is left untranslated, as instructed, so there is no issue.

betta-pallida.name: Betta pallida
notes: Item 10: 'Akuarium harus memakai penutup serapat mungkin' is fine, but 'Burayak ... langsung menerima pakan hidup' omits nothing; however 'Betta muda mengalami masalah kesehatan' drops the hedge 'there exist reports ... developing' so it reads as established fact. Write 'ada laporan bahwa Betta muda dapat mengalami masalah kesehatan'.
Item 10: 'Setelah masa pendekatan yang panjang' for 'protracted courtship' is acceptable, but 'pelukan kosong' for 'dummy embraces' is unclear. Use 'pelukan semu/tanpa telur'.
Item 5: 'kayu apung (driftwood)' is a mistranslation. Driftwood is 'kayu driftwood' or 'kayu rambat/akar kayu'. 'Kayu apung' means floating wood. Use 'kayu driftwood' or 'kayu apung/akar kayu'.
Item 5: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is better as 'pembudidaya' or 'breeder'.
Item 5: 'Betta spp.' and 'Cryptocoryne spp.' leave the English abbreviation as is. Use 'Betta' and 'Cryptocoryne'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Pakan serpihan' should be 'pakan flake/serpih'.
Item 8: 'cocok dijadikan teman' is awkward. Use 'cocok dijadikan tank mate/penghuni bersama'.
Item 2: the English is garbled, but 'Sejauh ini belum pernah tercatat di tempat lain' is fine.
Item 11: the terms 'caudal peduncle', 'opercle', 'suprabranchial' and 'epibranchial' are left as English or Latin. 'Garis dagu' for 'chin bar' is unclear. Use 'balok dagu' or 'bar dagu'.

betta-pallifina.name: Betta pallifina
notes: Item 15: 'Idealnya siapkan akuarium terpisah ... dan tata seperti yang dijelaskan di atas' changes the meaning. The English says to set up the tank as suggested above only when the fish are not already kept alone. Reword it to match.

Item 15: 'Feed them small amounts of different foods' became 'Beri sedikit pakan yang bervariasi'. This is acceptable, but 'sangat hati-hati' reads awkwardly. 'Pakan hidup yang bergerak' also adds 'hidup'. The English says 'motile foods', so use 'pakan yang bergerak'.
Item 15: 'mouth gaping' became 'mulut terbuka'. 'Burayak' is used for the free-swimming fry, which is fine. 'The fry need access to warm humid air' is correct.
Item 12: 'outcompete it' became 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan'. 'Over food' is added and is not in the source. Use 'menyisihkannya' or 'mengalahkannya dalam persaingan'.
Item 6: '90 mm SL' is kept but 'SL' is not explained. The inch figure was dropped, which is fine. Consider writing 'panjang standar (SL)'.

Item 10: 'Daphnia' became 'kutu air'. This is acceptable, but 'Daphnia' is the more precise term. 'Zooplankton lainnya' is attached to the wrong noun. The English says 'insects and other small invertebrates/zooplankton'.
Item 7: 'Ketapang almond leaves' became 'daun ... ketapang'. This is fine. 'Jago melompat' is colloquial, so use 'pelompat yang handal' or 'sering melompat'.

Item 9: 'higher temperatures bring out colouration and breeding behaviour' became 'memunculkan warna dan perilaku kawin'. Use the more natural 'memicu pemijahan' or 'memunculkan warna dan perilaku berbiak'.

betta-pardalotos.name: Betta pardalotos
notes: Item 8: "mengintimidasinya dan mengalahkannya saat berebut makanan" adds a detail (competition for food) not in the source; "outcompete" is general. Use "menyingkirkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 10: "Setelah masa pendekatan yang cukup lama" and "pelukan percobaan" are slightly awkward. Prefer "masa pacaran yang panjang" and "pelukan palsu".
Item 10: "Idealnya siapkan akuarium terpisah ... dengan penataan seperti yang dijelaskan di atas" is ambiguous about what is set up as described above.
Item 5: "kayu beech atau oak" with the "kayu apung" label is confusing, because driftwood is not the same as beech or oak wood. Use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu bakar/kayu keras".
Item 5: "mengakses lapisan udara" is stilted. Use "mengambil napas dari lapisan udara".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "pakan serpihan" is awkward. "Ikan di akuarium" also works, but "supaya perutnya terisi" is unclear (gut-loading).
Item 1: "seri tipenya diambil dari" is awkward. Use "spesimen tipe".
Item 3: "khas estuari" shifts the meaning slightly. The source says only that some estuarine species were recorded.

betta-patoti.name: Betta patoti
notes: Item 1: 'Genting (Endangered)' is a Malaysian-style term. Indonesian IUCN usage is 'Terancam Punah (Endangered)'.
Item 9: 'blackworms' as 'cacing sutra' is imprecise. Cacing sutra is tubifex, and blackworm (Lumbriculus) is a different worm. Use 'cacing hitam (blackworm)'.
Item 16: 'plastik wrap' for clingfilm is slightly awkward. 'Plastik pembungkus makanan' or 'plastic wrap' would read better.

betta-picta.name: Cupang picta
notes: Item 10: 'clingfilm/plastic wrap' became just 'plastik wrap' – fine, but 'fry need access to a layer of warm, humid air' is okay; however 'motile foods such as microworm' was rendered 'pakan hidup yang bergerak' – acceptable. Main issue: 'Several dummy embraces' ok.
Item 11: 'I–III, 18–24 anal-fin rays' became 'sirip anal dengan I–III, 18–24 jari-jari' – ambiguous phrasing; write 'jari-jari sirip anal I–III, 18–24'.
Item 4: 'Volume: ±54 liter' – the original ~54 litres is fine, but 'dalam kondisi' OK; check that 60×30 cm base volume implies a 30 cm height (not stated) – no change needed.
Item 11: 'Anggotanya ... ciri' fine; 'garis pra- dan pasca-orbital' and 'garis di dagu' ('chin bar') okay; 'kompleks Betta picta' fine.
Item 1: 'Cupang picta' is a coined common name for 'spotted betta'; the original 'spotted betta' was dropped – use 'Cupang bertotol (Betta picta)' or similar.
Item 5: 'Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, atau Cryptocoryne spp.' – 'lembut' water okay; 'unit reverse osmosis' fine. 'turn over gently adequate' fine.
Item 8: 'Not among the more aggressive' fine; 'cyprinid' and 'loach' left in English – use 'ikan sapu-sapu/ikan kecil famili Cyprinidae' and 'ikan loach (botia)' for local readability.
Item 10: 'free-swimming fry' translated 'burayak' used for both fry and young; 'anakan Betta' inconsistent – keep 'burayak'.

betta-pinguis.name: Betta pinguis
