notes: Item 4: the volume '(about 72 litres)' is kept, but 80×30 cm needs a stated height. This is OK, so no change is needed there. The real problem is item 1's 'tutup insang di bawah garis postorbital', which is fine, so ignore it.
Item 2: the type locality quote is left in English ('Sungai Letang near Kampung Kandung Suli ... Kapuas basin'). Translate the connecting words or leave it as a clearly marked original citation.
Item 8: 'riset yang matang wajib dilakukan' is stronger than the English 'proper research is essential' and sounds stiff. Use 'perlu riset yang cermat dulu'.
Item 8: 'menang dalam berebut pakan' for 'outcompete it' is awkward. Use 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan'.
Item 10: 'plastik wrap' is clumsy. Use 'plastik pembungkus makanan (cling wrap)'.
Item 10: 'Pengeram mulut jantan' as a standalone sentence is fine, but 'telur betina habis' is unclear. Use 'sampai betina tidak punya telur lagi'.

Item 10: 'banyak yang memindahkan betina' changes the logic. The English 'but many remove the female' means many breeders remove her as a precaution. Make this explicit: 'banyak peternak memindahkan betina'.
Item 11: 'pangkal sirip punggung berada di atas sisik lateral ke-18-19' makes the range read awkwardly. Use 'sisik lateral ke-18 sampai 19'.
Item 5: 'jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook. Use 'pelompat yang andal'.
Item 5: 'fully-decorated aquarium' becomes 'didekorasi lengkap', which is acceptable. The sentence 'paling cocok dengan pencahayaan' should be 'paling baik di bawah pencahayaan'.

betta-prima.name: Betta prima
notes: Item 6: "brooks" is translated as "parit" (ditch/drain), which changes the habitat. Use "anak sungai" or "sungai kecil" instead.

betta-pugnax.name: Betta pugnax
notes: Item 1/10: "Betta pugnax adalah ikan labirin pengeram mulut, dengan jantan yang mengerami telur" is clumsy; "pengeram mulut" plus "mengerami" is redundant. Use "ikan labirin pengeram mulut paternal (yang mengeram adalah jantan)" or similar.
Item 1/3: "dideskripsikan dari Penang" and "dikoleksi" are stiff. Use "pertama kali dideskripsikan berdasarkan spesimen dari Penang" and "ditangkap/dikumpulkan".
Item 5: "pelompat yang sangat andal" is unnatural for "excellent jumper". Use "pelompat ulung" or "sangat pandai melompat".
Item 5: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" and "mengakses lapisan udara" are awkward. Use "filter spons dengan aerator" and "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 10: "plastik pembungkus makanan (cling wrap)" has nested brackets. Simplify to "plastik wrap".
Item 10: "pakan hidup yang bergerak" for "motile foods" is slightly redundant, and microworm and Artemia nauplii are not all strictly live. Use "pakan hidup berukuran kecil yang aktif bergerak".
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left as English/Latin terms. Use Indonesian forms ("suprabrankial", "epibrankial") or explain them.
Item 3: "kesadahan yang nyaris nol" is fine, but "zat kimia lain yang dilepaskan bahan organik" is ungrammatical. Use "dilepaskan oleh bahan organik".

betta-pulchra.name: Betta pulchra
notes: Item 4: the English gives '31 × 12 in' and '~72 litres'. Fine, but the volume is not checked; 80×30 cm with unstated height is an assumption. Keep as is.

Item 5: 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang andal' is fine, but 'sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap' is OK. Main issue: 'Akar dan cabang driftwood' mixes English and local terms. Use 'kayu apung/bogwood' consistently.
Item 5: 'Filter spons bertenaga aerator' is stiff. Use 'filter spons dengan aerator (air-powered sponge filter)'.
Item 10: 'Telur ... ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke dalam mulut betina' is OK, but 'ganti air banyak tapi jarang' is colloquial. Use 'sesekali dalam jumlah besar'.
Item 10: 'Pengeram mulut oleh jantan' is fine, but 'plastik wrap' is non-standard. Use 'plastik pembungkus makanan (cling wrap)'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is fine, but 'cacing darah' should be 'cacing sutra' or 'jentik merah' only if the source means that. Bloodworm = 'cacing darah' is correct. No change.

Item 11: 'sepasang organ suprabrankial' is acceptable, but 'caudal peduncle' and 'predorsal' are left partly untranslated or in English. Use 'pangkal batang ekor' and 'sisik predorsal (di depan sirip punggung)'.
Item 12: References left untranslated. This is allowed, so no change.

betta-raja.name: Betta raja
notes: #20: "stagnant ditches" is rendered "parit berair tenang"; "parit berair menggenang/tergenang" is closer to the meaning.
#9 and #4: "peternak" for breeders sounds like livestock farmers. "Penangkar" or "breeder" is the term hobbyists use.

betta-renata.name: Betta renata
notes: Item 4: the volume '81 litres' is unchanged, which is fine, but the '36 × 12 in' figure was dropped as intended. No fix needed here.

Item 10: 'Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut dengan mulut oleh betina' is fine. However 'Gunakan tutup yang serapat mungkin' loses 'tightest-fitting you can find'. Consider 'tutup yang paling rapat yang bisa didapat'.
Item 10: 'Pengeram mulut oleh jantan' is acceptable. 'pura-pura' for 'dummy' embraces is fine, but 'masa pendekatan' for 'courtship' is better as 'masa pacaran/penjajakan'.
Item 5: 'Filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine, but 'jago melompat' is too colloquial for a handbook. Use 'pelompat yang andal' or 'mudah melompat keluar'.
Item 5: 'ikan ini sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara' is stiff. Use 'perlu sesekali naik ke lapisan udara lembap'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but add the term 'Daphnia' in brackets, e.g. 'kutu air (Daphnia)', as hobbyists often use 'daphnia'. 'Cacing darah' is fine.
Item 8: 'cyprinid' and 'loach' are left in English. Use 'ikan cyprinid kecil dan ikan loach (botia/sepat)' or give a local gloss.

Item 10: 'Jantan yang sedang mengerami' is fine. In 'dalam kondisi kedua sebagian mungkin akan dimangsa', 'kondisi kedua' is ambiguous for 'the latter circumstances'. Use 'jika dibiarkan bersama induk'.

betta-rubra.name: Betta rubra
notes: Item 18: "(sirip punggung, anal, dan ekor)" is added; the English says only "unpaired fins". Remove the bracket or say "sirip tunggal" only.
Item 7: "genangan air hitam yang tergenang" is redundant. Use "kolam air hitam yang tergenang".
Item 21: "bar-like marking" is translated "tanda berbentuk balok". "Balok" suggests a block, so use "tanda menyerupai pita/palang".
Item 21: "putative groups" is translated "kelompok sementara". "Kelompok dugaan" or "kelompok yang diusulkan" is closer.

betta-rutilans.name: Betta rutilans
notes: Item 12: "dalam berebut makanan" adds a detail (food) not in the English "outcompete it"; use a neutral "mengungguli/menyaingi".
Item 12: "Sebagian hobiis mengamati" adds "hobiis"; the English only says "Some observe".

Item 15: "jantan terus memungut dan mengembalikan burayak yang jatuh" is a bit ambiguous, because the English "any that fall" refers to eggs/hatchlings in the nest; use "telur atau burayak yang jatuh".

betta-siamorientalis.name: Betta siamorientalis
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 2.3 inches (about 5.8 cm)' is translated as 'sekitar 5,8 cm', which is fine. But the 'Suhu' line drops 'much better coloration at warmer temperatures above 78°F' only partly: it should say 'suhu lebih hangat'. Minor.

Item 22: 'the eggs hatch in 24-48 hours, remaining in the nest ... until the yolk sac is fully-absorbed ... collect and return any that fall' – the ID changes 'any that fall' to 'burayak yang jatuh'. Use 'telur/burayak yang jatuh' faithfully (the eggs hatch, so the fry fall afterwards). Minor.

Item 22: 'young Betta developing health issues if fed excessive amounts of the latter' is rendered 'burayak Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia'. 'Excessive' is kept, but 'reports of' is slightly muddled. Rephrase.

Item 22: 'tata akuarium tersebut seperti yang disarankan di atas' is fine, but 'burayak' is used for the 'eggs' stage in the sentence 'mengumpulkan dan mengembalikan burayak yang jatuh'; the English says 'any' (eggs/fry). Change to 'telur atau burayak'.

Item 4: 'Pragmatically, ... two species are distinguished' – 'B. splendens males develop two bright red stripes' is rendered 'memiliki dua garis merah terang'. OK. But 'akuaris' (aquarists) should be 'aquascaper/penghobi akuarium' to avoid confusion with 'akuaris'. Use 'penghobi'.
Item 3: the English says the species was described in 2013, while items 2 and 24 say 2012. The ID follows the source, but flag the inconsistency; do not change the facts without checking.
Item 24: 'iris of the eye with iridescent green or blue patches' is fine, but 'unpaired fins without an iridescent margin' → 'sirip tunggal' is non-standard. Use 'sirip tak berpasangan'.
Item 17: 'mengintimidasinya dan mengalahkannya dalam berebut pakan' is awkward. Use 'mengintimidasi dan kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan' (the English says 'outcompete it').

betta-simorum.name: Betta simorum
notes: Item 3: 'Dasar perairannya ... karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun' — source says 'permanent water is not always available'; 'sepanjang tahun' is OK but 'nyaris nol' for 'negligible' is fine. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 11: 'sirip punggung, sirip ekor, dan ekor jantan lebih runcing' — 'caudal and tail fin' is redundant in source, so the Indonesian repeats the error; merge as 'sirip ekor'. Minor.

Item 14: 'larva tetap berada di sarang' — the source says 'eggs ... remaining in the nest' until yolk sac absorbed; fine, but 'Jantan mungkin membangun sarang di dalam tabung atau selongsong' translates 'canister' poorly (use 'tabung film').
Item 14: 'sperma' for 'milt' should be 'cairan sperma/mani' (minor).

Item 14: 'cacing darah beku' vs 'burayak' used for fry; 'larva' for 'eggs' is inconsistent and misleading — should be 'telur' or 'larva yang baru menetas'. Source says 'eggs hatch ... remaining in the nest' meaning the hatchlings.
Item 14: 'Pasangan tidak perlu dipisah' fine; but 'sperma ... dilepaskan' ok.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term; 'kutu air' is common in Indonesia, minor.
Item 7: 'blackworm' translated as 'cacing sutra' is incorrect: cacing sutra is Tubifex; blackworm is Lumbriculus, so the food type is changed. Use 'blackworm (Lumbriculus)' or 'cacing hitam'.
Item 4: 80 × 30 cm base, 72 L: volume depends on height; source given, fine.
Item 1: 'sarang busa' fine; 'Perkembangbiakan' OK.

betta-simplex.name: Betta simplex
notes: Item 10: "peternak" for breeders is misleading; use "penghobi/pembiak" (peternak implies livestock farmers).

Item 10: "Akuarium harus memakai tutup serapat mungkin ... plastik wrap" fine, but "pelukan 'kosong'" for 'dummy' embraces is okay; "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina" is fine. However "pakan hidup yang bergerak" for 'motile foods' ok.
Item 8: "Beberapa ikan cyprinid kecil dan loach ... cocok dijadikan teman" - "teman" is slightly odd; use "tankmate/penghuni bersama".
Item 3: "Danio sp." rendered "satu jenis Danio sp." is redundant; use "satu spesies Danio".
Item 5: "Menambahkan daun kering" loses 'leaf litter' sense; use "serasah daun kering".
Item 5: "ikan ini sesekali perlu mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff; use "naik menghirup udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 11: "suborder Anabantoidei" fine; "garis di depan dan di belakang mata" okay. "jari-jari sirip anal I-III" ok.
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is ambiguous; use "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

betta-spilotogena.name: Betta spilotogena
notes: Item 1: "sungai kecil" for streams is fine, but "kedalaman kurang dari satu meter" is attached to the water description ("air jernih ... dan kedalaman"), so the sentence is slightly awkward; separate the depth clause.
Item 5: "ia juga pelompat yang sangat andal" reads oddly; use "dan ikan ini pelompat ulung" (or "jago melompat").
Item 5: "cukup redup" for "fairly dim" is OK, but "paling cocok" slightly overstates "seems to do best"; consider "tampaknya tumbuh baik".
Item 8: "cyprinid dan loach kecil" leaves English terms; prefer "ikan cyprinid (sebangsa ikan mas/wader) dan ikan loach (sebangsa ikan pengisap/berot) kecil", or give local names.
Item 10: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke dalam mulut betina" is a bit unclear; consider "ditangkap" and "diambil betina dengan mulutnya".
Item 10: "ikan lain dibiarkan tetap di tempatnya" is fine, but "pelukan 'kosong'" for 'dummy' embraces would be better as "pelukan 'palsu'".

betta-splendens.name: Ikan cupang
notes: Item 18: "Tubifex" translated as "Cacing sutra" is acceptable, but "Brine shrimp" -> "Artemia" fine; real issue: "Glassworms" rendered "jentik Chaoborus" adds a fact/specific genus not in source; keep just "glassworm" or "jentik kaca".

Item 22: "Species with body shapes or trailing finnage" -> "Spesies dengan bentuk tubuh serupa" adds "serupa" and drops the sense that similar body shapes/long fins should be avoided; clarify as "bentuk tubuh serupa atau sirip panjang menjuntai".

Item 21: "tiger barbs" -> "ikan sumatra (tiger barb)" is OK, but the sentence "Betta fish recognize their owners" is fine; no change. Real issue: item 11 "low-maintenance" -> "tidak merepotkan perawatannya" is awkward; use "mudah dirawat".

Item 27: "Artemia nauplii... excessive amounts of the latter" ok, but "the adults do not usually eat their offspring" while item 26 says male may eat young; source conflict, fine. Item 27: "Proses ini diulang sampai telur betina habis" is fine.
Item 26: "A hiding place... " fine; "36 jam berikutnya" ok. Item 5: "should be discouraged" -> "sebaiknya tidak didukung" weakens meaning; use "sebaiknya tidak dilestarikan/dicegah".
Item 14: "power filters ... not suitable" -> "filter bertenaga pompa yang kuat" adds "yang kuat" and odd wording; use "filter eksternal/power filter".
Item 15: "tidak rewel dengan kisaran 6,0–8,0 yang masih bisa diterima" is awkward; rephrase "tidak rewel, kisaran pH 6,0–8,0 masih dapat diterima".

Item 4: "we pick" rendered as "dipilihkan oleh penjual", and the original shop talk adapted; the sentence "Semua jantan berasal dari garis keturunan yang sama" fine. Item 29: "two to three inches (5–7 cm)" ok.
Item 12: "Keep the aquarium well-covered ... an excellent jumper" -> "pelompat yang sangat andal" is unnatural; use "pelompat ulung".

betta-stigmosa.name: Betta stigmosa
notes: Item 6: "values over this range" means higher values, but "nilai di luar rentang ini" also covers lower values. Use "nilai di atas rentang ini".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengannya dalam berebut pakan" adds "pakan", which the English doesn't say. Use a general phrase such as "mengintimidasi dan mengungguli/mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 8: "cyprinid" and "loach" are left in English. Use "ikan cyprinid kecil (famili Cyprinidae)" and "ikan loach/botia", or the usual local terms.

betta-stiktos.name: Betta stiktos
notes: Item 1: "pembuat sarang busa" is awkward; use "penyarang busa" or "bubble nester (pembuat sarang gelembung)". Busa (foam) is not the same as gelembung (bubble).
Item 2: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off; use "penangkar" or "pembiak" for hobby breeders.
Item 3: "Tumbuh baik di air" is odd for a fish; use "Hidup baik di air" or "Cocok di air".
Item 3: "mengambil udara" is unnatural; use "bernapas di udara" or "mengambil oksigen dari udara permukaan".
Item 8: "kepala yang kokoh" for "stout head" is fine, but "roundtail" is left untranslated; consider "roundtail (ekor bulat)".

betta-strohi.name: Betta strohi
notes: Item 1: "Genting/Endangered" — "Genting" is the Malaysian term. Indonesian IUCN usage is "Terancam Punah (Endangered)".

betta-taeniata.name: Betta taeniata
notes: Item 8: "ikan loach (botia/hillstream loach)" adds "botia", which is a different fish group. Use "loach" or "ikan loach sungai berarus" instead.
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengannya dalam hal makanan dan tempat" adds "makanan dan tempat", which the English doesn't say. Use "kalah bersaing" alone.
Item 5: "pelompat yang handal" should be "andal" in standard spelling.
Item 5/10: "peternak" for breeders is a bit off. "Pembiak" or "penangkar" is more usual in the hobby.

betta-tussyae.name: Betta tussyae
notes: #8: "kalah bersaing berebut pakan" adds "pakan", which the English ("outcompete it") doesn't say. Use "kalah bersaing" alone.
#5: "jago melompat" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "pelompat yang handal" or "sangat pandai melompat".
#5: "mengakses lapisan udara lembap" is stiff. "menghirup udara dari lapisan udara lembap" reads more naturally.
#3: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" drops the "permanent" nuance. Use "air permanen tidak selalu tersedia".

betta-uberis.name: Betta uberis
notes: Item 13: "blackworms" is rendered "cacing sutra" (tubifex); blackworm (Lumbriculus) is a different worm. Consider "cacing hitam (blackworm)"; this is minor.
Item 5: "sepanjang tahun" is added to "karena air tidak selalu tersedia". The English only says permanent water is not always available. Use "karena air permanen tidak selalu tersedia".

betta-unimaculata.name: Betta unimaculata
notes: #14: "Seperti banyak spesies dalam kompleks ini yang berisi betta-betta terbesar" is slightly awkward. Rephrase to something like "Seperti banyak spesies dalam kompleks ini, yang mencakup betta-betta terbesar, ikan ini bisa agresif".
#15: "lebih aktif" for "more vigorous" is a bit weak. "Lebih agresif/gesit" would be closer.

bhavania-australis.name: Bhavania australis
notes: Item 5: "over-sized filter" was rendered as "filter dengan kapasitas lebih besar dari ukuran akuarium". That is fine, but "Yang paling penting, air harus bersih dan kaya oksigen" drops "well-oxygenated" nuance only slightly. The real problem is the turnover rate. Item 1 says 8–12 times an hour, while item 5 says 10–15. Both match their sources, so keep them, but check the source for the inconsistency.
Item 5: "biologically immature set-up" became "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang". This adds a specific claim. Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 5: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air" is clumsy for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air".

Item 5: "Anubias spp." is followed by "Anubias sangat berguna", which loses the "latter" reference. This is acceptable but slightly changes the meaning, because "the latter" may refer to all three genera or only to Anubias.
Item 2: the type locality is left in English inside quotes: 'Mountain stream in the Walliar jungle, Nilgiris, India'. Translate it, for example "Sungai pegunungan di hutan Walliar, Nilgiris, India".
Item 4: "Ukuran dasar akuarium" and "Panjang standar: 100 mm SL" leave the SL abbreviation unexplained and the unit as mm. Convert to "10 cm" and write "panjang standar (SL)" for hobbyist readers.
Item 3: "riam dangkal" for "riffles" and "berarus lancar" for "runs" are acceptable. However, "kolam atau air terjun kecil" for "pools or cascades" is loose. Use "kolam atau jeram".
Item 8: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax, Akysis dan Oreoglanis spp." is fine. "teman setangki" is non-standard, so use "penghuni lain" or "tank mate".

biotodoma-cupido.name: Cupid Cichlid
notes: Item 7: '150 × 45 cm ... about 304 litres (80 US gal)' translated as 'sekitar 300 liter'; per the table 80 US gal is not listed, so it should be converted and rounded to whole litres: 304 liter, not 300.

Item 11: 'tidak akan memangsa ikan yang panjangnya lebih dari beberapa mm' reverses the meaning. English says it won't predate on fishes larger than a few mm, which is nearly the same, but the Indonesian reads fine; however 'belilah minimal 5-8 ekor' changes 'a group of 5-8 should be the minimum' into a range minimum; use 'kelompok 5-8 ekor sebagai pembelian minimum'.
Item 8: 'biologically immature aquarium' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'; fine, but 'batu sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu sungai yang halus'.
Item 15: 'Masa inkubasi 3-4 hari' fine, but 'This process took a couple of hours' was translated 'beberapa jam'; use 'sekitar dua jam'.
Item 15: 'diambil kembali' for 'removed' is fine, but 'sperma jantan' for 'milt' should be 'mani/cairan sperma jantan'.
Item 1: 'damai secara mengejutkan' is stiff; use 'ternyata cukup damai'.
Item 6: 'Selain itu' for 'Otherwise' is slightly off; use 'Di luar itu'.
Item 3: Latin type-locality quote left in English is acceptable, but 'di samping Amazon di deltanya' is awkward; use 'berdampingan dengan Amazon di deltanya'.
Item 15: 'dasar yang padat' for 'solid base' should be 'landasan yang kokoh'.

biotodoma-wavrini.name: Orinoco Eartheater
notes: Item 6: '~304 liter' is wrong against the ~80 US gal source. 80 gal is about 300 L, so use ~300 liter.
Item 10: 'belilah minimal 5–8 ekor' turns 'a group of 5-8 should be the minimum purchase' into an ambiguous minimum range. Rephrase it as 'kelompok 5–8 ekor sebaiknya jadi jumlah pembelian minimum'.

Item 10: 'tidak akan memangsa ikan yang panjangnya lebih dari beberapa mm' reverses the meaning. The English means it will not prey on fishes larger than a few mm. This is fine, but 'Di luar masa kawin' now repeats the sentence structure from item 1 and should read naturally.

Item 13: 'ethodocumentarist' was rendered as 'pembuat film dokumenter etnografi', which is acceptable. 'hubungan kelompok saudara ... yang dukungannya lemah' is awkward; use 'hubungan kelompok saudara yang didukung lemah'.
Item 3: the type locality quote 'upper Río Orinoco in Venezuela between...' is left in English. Consider translating it or marking it clearly as a quoted original.
Item 7: 'batu yang licin terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn rocks'. Use 'batu yang halus terkikis arus'. 'setup' could be 'tata letak/aquascape'.
Item 7: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is OK, but 'minimum weekly water changes of 50-70%' is fine.
Item 9: 'kepingan seukuran sekali makan' is awkward; use 'potongan seukuran mulut ikan'. 'ujung pipet yang tajam' is also unclear.

biotoecus-dicentrarchus.name: Biotoecus dicentrarchus
notes: "Ikan ini hidup di dasar berpasir": "sandbottom dwellers" means fish living near/on the sandy bottom; consider "penghuni dasar berpasir" for closer wording (minor).
"Saat berkembang biak": "berkembang biak" is a bit generic; "Saat pemijahan/untuk berbiak" is more typical for the hobby (minor).

biotoecus-opercularis.name: Biotoecus opercularis
notes: Item 4: 'Sungai Madeira, Tapajós, dan Trombetas bagian hilir' changes the meaning. The English says 'lower rios Madeira, Tapajós, Trombetas', but this reads as if only the Trombetas is lower, or is ambiguous. Rephrase so it is clear which rivers are lower.

Item 6: '(sekitar 81 liter)' is correct for 90×30 cm only if the height is assumed. The translation keeps the figure, which is fine, but 'peternak yang berhasil memelihara kelompok' is clumsy. Use 'pembiak yang berhasil' and 'memelihara kelompok ... dalam akuarium'.
Item 7: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is fine, but 'ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari' is awkward. Suggest 'hindari penggantian air dalam volume sangat besar'.

Item 12: 'induk di teritori yang berdekatan ... menjaga burayak pasangan lain bila anakan mereka bercampur' is clumsy. Also 'pemijah substrat yang kedua induknya ikut menjaga' is awkward; use 'pemijah substrat dengan pengasuhan biparental'.
Item 14: 'B. dicentrarchus saat ini satu-satunya anggota genus lain' needs 'adalah'. 'jumlah modal jari-jari' is unnatural; use 'jumlah jari-jari sirip punggung yang paling umum'.
Item 14: 'tribus', 'klad' and 'jumlah modal' are stiff, non-standard terms. Consider 'tribe (tribus)' and 'klad (clade)'.
Item 13: 'sekali seumur hidup menyaksikan' is stiff. Better: 'sebaiknya sekali seumur hidup menyaksikan jantan Biotoecus membangun gundukan'.

boleophthalmus-boddarti.name: Ikan glodok
notes: "Pasang surut tidak perlu ditiru": fine, but "pantai pasir yang dangkal" for "shallow sand strand" would read more naturally as "hamparan pasir dangkal".
"dipertahankan mati-matian" is a bit colloquial for "heavily defended"; consider "dipertahankan dengan gigih" or "dijaga ketat".
"dasar" for "holes in the ground" is okay, but "lubang di tanah/lumpur dasar" would be clearer.
"Memang ikan ini sepenuhnya euryhaline": consider "eurihalin" (Indonesian spelling) and "Memang" for "Of course" is slightly off; "Meskipun ikan ini sepenuhnya eurihalin, ..." reads better.
"pakan ... cukup mirip dengan makanan alaminya": "quite equal" means very similar; consider "hampir sama dengan".

boraras-brigittae.name: Chili Rasbora
notes: Item 28: "no more than a couple of days" is rendered "tidak lebih dari beberapa hari". "Beberapa" is looser than "a couple" (about two days). Use "tidak lebih dari dua hari", because the first eggs hatch by day two.
Item 3: "a couple of weeks of adjustment" is rendered "beberapa minggu". Use "sekitar dua minggu" to keep the precision.
Item 29: "for a couple of days" is rendered "selama beberapa hari". Use "selama sekitar dua hari".
Item 1: "baru terlihat kalau" ("only appear when") adds a restrictive nuance. A plain "terlihat saat dipelihara" is closer to the English.

boraras-maculatus.name: Dwarf Rasbora
notes: Item 10: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is a slight interpretive rendering of "biologically-immature"; "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" would be closer.
Item 20: "jaring dengan lubang yang cukup besar" is fine, but "segerombol Java moss" is a little awkward; "seikat/gumpalan Java moss" is more natural.

boraras-merah.name: Boraras merah
notes: Item 9: "kayu beech biasa atau kayu ek aman digunakan" — 'common beech' is mistranslated as an adjective; use "kayu beech (Fagus) atau ek" and keep the oak/beech wording clear.
Item 16: "pygmy Corydoras" left in English; use "Corydoras kerdil/pigmi".

Item 18: "lebih gemuk" and "warna yang lebih pudar" are acceptable, but "intense fiery red to orange" is rendered as "oranye yang pekat", which shifts the meaning slightly. Rephrase as "merah menyala pekat hingga oranye".

Item 21: "tidak menjaga anaknya" is fine, but "zero parental care" plus "Setelah pemijahan dimulai, pemijahan akan berlanjut setiap hari" is awkward. Rephrase as "pemijahan akan terus berlanjut setiap hari".
Item 22: the whole sentence is omitted. It is shop talk and a byline, so this is acceptable only if it was meant to be dropped; check it.
Item 14: "Daphnia" is rendered "kutu air (Daphnia)" in 14 but "kutu air (daphnia)" in 13; make the term consistent. "Kutu air" is a loose term.
Item 23: "kelompok danionin" for 'the other sub-group contains the danionins' is unclear; say "subkelompok lainnya berisi danionin".

boraras-micros.name: Boraras micros
notes: Item 3: the Latin names were silently corrected ('Cerotophyllum dermersum' became 'Ceratophyllum demersum'). Latin names should stay as in the source, even if you flag the misspelling separately.

Item 11: 'Of these it was found to form a monophyletic group' became 'B. brigittae ternyata membentuk...'. This replaces the source's 'it' with a specific species. Keep 'ikan ini/Boraras' unless the source names the species.
Item 2: the gloss for the type locality is clumsy ('di titik jalan no. 2 memotong rel kereta api'). Rephrase, e.g. 'tempat jalan no. 2 melintasi rel kereta api'.
Items 10 and 11: 'burayak' is a regional or archaic term. 'Benih' or 'anakan' is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.
Item 11: 'kerabat satu genus' and 'ikan bertulang sejati' are slightly unnatural. 'Spesies sekerabat (congener)' and 'ikan bertulang' read more naturally.

boraras-naevus.name: Strawberry Rasbora
notes: Item 1: "yaitu perbedaan warna antara jantan dan betina" is an added explanation not in the English; remove it or keep it only in brackets.
Item 3: "ternyata berumur sangat panjang" mistranslates "astonishingly long-living"; use "berumur panjang secara mengejutkan" or similar. "ternyata" changes the nuance.

Item 10: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" for "biologically immature tank" is acceptable, but "perubahan kimia air" for "swings in water chemistry" loses the sense of fluctuation; use "fluktuasi parameter air".
Item 15: "tidak lebih dari beberapa hari" for "no more than a couple of days" changes the care advice; it should be "sekitar dua hari". Eggs hatch by day two, so "beberapa" is misleading.
Item 15: "Meskipun spesies ini jelas akan memakan telurnya" is fine, but "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is vague. Use "matras plastik tipe 'rumput'".
Item 16: "pemotongan perkembangan" for "developmental truncation" is inconsistent with the earlier untranslated 'developmentally truncated'. Use one consistent term.
Item 16: "Semuanya menunjukkan kesukaan pada perairan tenang" is unnatural; use "umumnya menyukai".
Item 16: "karya ekstensif" is an awkward calque of "extensive work"; use "karya yang komprehensif".

Item 16: "Di antara semuanya, ikan ini ditemukan membentuk kelompok monofiletik" wrongly makes "ikan ini" refer to B. naevus. The English refers to Boraras the genus, so write "Boraras ditemukan membentuk...".

botia-almorhae.name: Botia Yoyo
notes: Item 12: 'Hobiis di Inggris cenderung memakai Levamisole' leaves out 'the antibiotic' (antibiotik) from the source. Add it, or note the class of drug.
Item 12: 'mental lobe berkembang menjadi sungut' leaves an English anatomical term. Use 'cuping mental' or add the English in brackets.
Item 12: 'skinny disease', 'greying out', 'Shadowing' and 'loachy dance' are mixed in without consistent glosses. Give an Indonesian gloss for 'skinny disease' and 'Shadowing'.

botia-dario.name: Botia Dario
notes: Item 12: "Tarian ini bisa berlangsung" – 'Tarian ini' is added wording but harmless; however the 'Botia appears to be the basal... lineage' paragraph drops "rather then being grouped" nuance okay. Main issue: "Pertunjukan seperti ini" for "Such displays" is awkward; use "Perilaku menunjukkan diri seperti ini".
Item 12: "Ikan alfa biasanya adalah yang terbesar" fine, but "membayangi" for 'shadow' is ambiguous (reads as 'overshadow'); use "mengikuti/menempel" and keep 'shadowing' explained.
Item 5: "Volume: ~243 liter" is kept without issue, but "Alas akuarium" is fine; no change. Item 8: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is acceptable but "Artemia" ok; "zukini" for courgette ok.
Item 9: "ikan lele/catfish" – many catfishes are not lele; use "ikan catfish" or "berbagai jenis catfish".

Item 9: "mereka bisa hidup baik bersama" ok; but "That said they seemingly require regular contact" rendered "Meski begitu" fine. Item 6: "pot tanah liat" for 'flower pots' is acceptable; "Kalau tidak memakai tanaman" slightly shifts 'Otherwise' (meaning: in any case/regardless) – use "Selain itu/Pada dasarnya".
Item 6: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" adds a specific concept; original says 'biologically immature'; consider "yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 12: "Hill Tracts"/"Tribus" fine; 'tribus' could be 'suku' but acceptable. Item 6: "Taxiphyllum barbieri (java moss)" dropped quote marks around 'Java' – trivial.

botia-histrionica.name: Burmese Loach
notes: Item 3: 'Collected in the Salween Basin of India, China and Myanmar' translated as 'Dikoleksi dari Lembah Salween'; 'Lembah' (valley) is wrong for a river basin. Use 'daerah aliran Sungai Salween' or 'DAS Salween'.
Item 6: 'Standard length: 130 mm SL' is left in mm. It is a measurement, so this is acceptable, but 'Panjang standar' and 'SL' are redundant. Keep it consistent with 13 cm if the style converts.
Item 7: 'biologically immature set-ups' is rendered as 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This adds a specific claim, and 'belum matang secara biologis' is closer to the source.
Item 7: 'smooth, water-worn rocks and pebbles' is rendered as 'batu dan kerikil halus yang licin tergerus air'. This is awkward; 'batu dan kerikil bulat yang halus terkikis air' reads better.

Item 11: 'Slow-moving, long-finned species' mentions 'banyak jenis cichlid'. The source says 'many cichlids', so this is fine, but 'teman setangki' is non-standard; use 'penghuni akuarium lain' or 'tank mate'.
Item 11: 'That said they seemingly require regular contact' is rendered as 'Bagaimanapun, ikan ini tampaknya memang membutuhkan'. The connective is slightly off but the meaning is intact.
Item 10: 'Pertunjukan seperti ini' (item 15) for 'Such displays' is slightly odd. Use 'Perilaku semacam ini'.
Item 14: 'Pada tahap ini ikan ini mudah dikenali' repeats 'ikan ini'. Change to 'Pada tahap ini ikan mudah dikenali'.
Item 10 'suka berkelompok' for 'social' is fine. Item 2 'botia (loach famili Botiidae)' is acceptable.
Item 1: 'memudar ke arah bagian bawah tubuh' is fine, but 'Golden (Gold) Zebra Loach' is left in English as a trade name, which is acceptable.

botia-kubotai.name: Botia kubotai
notes: Item 11: 'seorang anggota komunitas' drops the named member 'SF member Mark Duffill'. That's acceptable as neutral wording, but it is slightly vague.
Item 12: 'Hobiis' is non-standard. Use 'penghobi' or 'hobiis akuarium'.
Item 9: 'butuh kontak rutin dengan sesama jenisnya' is fine, but 'penyendiri' for 'withdrawn' is a bit awkward. Use 'menarik diri' or 'pemalu'.
Item 6: 'botia punya rasa ingin tahu tinggi' switches between 'botiid' and 'botia' for the same group. Use one term.
Item 6: 'paling mudah beradaptasi di akuarium yang stabil' is clumsy. Say 'paling mudah beradaptasi di akuarium yang stabil dan matang'.
Item 2: 'Anakannya' for juveniles is slightly off. 'Ikan muda' or 'juvenil' is more usual.
Item 8: 'zukini' for courgette is acceptable, but 'labu siam' or 'zucchini' is more common.
Item 3: 'anak sungai Megathat' for 'Megathat stream' is slightly inaccurate, because 'anak sungai' means tributary. Use 'sungai kecil Megathat' or 'aliran Megathat'.

botia-lohachata.name: Botia lohachata
notes: Item 1: "yang pertama di depan sirip punggung, yang kedua di bawahnya, dan yang ketiga di belakangnya" – the English says the second band is below the dorsal fin and the third behind it; this is fine, but "bertubuh tinggi" for "deep bodied" is acceptable. No change needed here; main issue is below.

Item 2: "setidaknya jika dipelihara..." – the parenthetical merges the list so "relatif damai, setidaknya jika..." is ambiguous; use a clearer structure (e.g. 'relatif damai, setidaknya bila dipelihara dalam kelompok besar mulai 10 ekor').

Item 2: "biasanya tetap berukuran kecil yang praktis, sekitar 8–10 cm" is awkward for "remains with usually 8-10 cm length ... handily small"; rephrase as 'biasanya hanya mencapai 8–10 cm sehingga ukurannya praktis'.
Item 2: "Entah karena apa" is colloquial for "For unknown reasons"; use 'Tidak diketahui alasannya'.

Item 3: "Seiring bertambahnya umur, polanya juga banyak berubah" – the English says 'strongly changes' and 'And in the age' (in older fish); 'juga' is an added nuance, and 'pola jaring' could be 'pola jala/jaring-jaring'. Prefer 'Pada ikan yang tua, polanya berubah drastis menjadi pola jaring'.
Item 3: "spesies yang valid" for "a good species" is fine; but "botia India yang tampak mirip" for 'Indian loaches' is acceptable. 'Ichthyofile Number 2' is fine.

botia-rostrata.name: Botia Rostrata
notes: Item 12: 'Ambastaia nigrolineata dan A. sidthimunki ternyata lebih dekat ... daripada dengan Yasuhikotakia' is fine, but 'studi yang kedua ... mendapati genus ini lebih dekat kekerabatannya dengan tribus Botiini' is okay; the real issue: 'Penyatuan (anastomosis)' and 'beranastomosis' are unnatural; use 'menyatu/bersambungan' consistently.
Item 12: 'Di dalamnya, Botia tampaknya merupakan garis keturunan basal' – 'Within these' means within these subfamilies; clarify as 'Di dalam kelompok-kelompok ini'.

Item 12: 'Sistem yang lebih baru dan lebih sederhana inilah yang saat ini diikuti.' drops 'here on SF' (acceptable), but 'Pertunjukan seperti ini' for 'Such displays' is awkward; use 'Perilaku unjuk diri seperti ini'.

Item 12: 'Ikan muda ... 3 belang gelap di kepala' – in B. rostrata paragraph 'satu di tutup insang' is OK; but 'ruang depan gelembung renang' for 'anterior chamber of gas bladder' should be 'ruang anterior gelembung renang'.
Item 12: 'membayangi' for 'shadowing' is ambiguous; keep 'shadowing' in brackets with a clearer verb such as 'mengikuti dari sisi'.

Item 12: 'Kottelat (2004) ... menegaskan' and the 'Perubahan pertama/kedua' are OK, but 'Hymenophysa ... sinonim junior dari Botia' fine; 'loachy dance' left untranslated without gloss – add a short explanation (tarian loach).

Item 3: 'lokasi tipe' is acceptable; 'alias Someshwari' fine. Item 6: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' adds a specific concept not in source ('biologically immature'); use 'belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 6: 'ingin tahu' stated of 'inquisitive' reads awkward; use 'berjiwa penasaran/suka menyelidiki'. 'Ganti air mingguan ... dijadikan rutinitas' fine.

botia-striata.name: Botia zebra
notes: Item 12: "Levamisole yang tergolong antibiotik" repeats the source's error, but Levamisole is an anthelmintic, not an antibiotic. Fenbendazole is also an anthelmintic. Fix the wording or add a neutral note. Check this against the source before finalising.

Item 6: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" adds "nitrogen cycle", which the English doesn't say ("biologically immature set-ups"). Use "filter biologisnya belum matang" or "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil halus yang tumpul terkikis air" is awkward, and "kerikil halus" is repeated after "kerikil halus" for the substrate. Use "batu dan kerikil bulat yang halus terkikis air".
Item 4: "Dasarnya" for substrate is vague. Use "Substratnya". "anak Sungai" is fine, but "hardness ~2.5°" should say the unit (dGH) if the source specifies it.

Item 9: "jangan dicampur dengan ikan yang jauh lebih kecil karena ikan-ikan itu bisa merasa terintimidasi" is acceptable. "cupang hias" and "lele" for catfishes in general are imprecise. Use "ikan kucing/catfish" instead of "lele".
Item 2/12: "Botia zebra" as the common name is not established in Indonesia. Keep "zebra loach" in brackets.

Item 8: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "Artemia" before "dalam bentuk hidup atau beku" is ambiguous. The English says bloodworm, Tubifex and Artemia, live or frozen, so the phrasing is acceptable.

botia-udomritthiruji.name: Botia emperor
notes: Item 5: "Volume: ~243 liter" – the English also gives ~64 US gal; litres is fine, but a 120×45 cm base giving 243 L is kept unchanged, so no issue; however item 5's "Panjang standar: 150 mm SL" is OK. Real problem is in item 12 below.

Item 12: "Shadowing" ('Shadowing' adalah perilaku...) then uses "membayangi" – inconsistent but fine; however "Perilaku unjuk diri seperti ini" for "Such displays" adds a nuance (showing off) not in source; use "Tampilan seperti ini" / "Perubahan warna seperti ini".

Item 12: "Ikan alfa" / "alfa" is okay, but "Kemudian Kottelat (2004) ... mendirikan genus Chromobotia" – English says 'raising Chromobotia', acceptable; "dua spesies yang dulu pernah menjadi anggota Botia maupun Yasuhikotakia" okay.
Item 12: "Hobbyists in the UK tend to use ... Levamisole" – translation "antibiotik Levamisole" repeats source's error; fine. "Obat" fine.
Item 2/9: "Akuarium wajib diberi tutup yang rapat" slightly stronger than "Needs" but acceptable; "cupang hias" fine.
Item 8: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine; "bayam yang sudah direbus sebentar" fine; "zukini" for courgette fine.
Item 12: "Dari segi" etc. fine; "loach botiid" mixes terms mildly; "Teman setangki" non-standard for tankmates — prefer "teman sekandang akuarium" / "ikan penghuni bersama".

boulengerella-cuvieri.name: Boulengerella cuvieri
notes: Item 6: "menyukai adanya peneduh... " is acceptable, but "mudah kaget" for skittish is fine; however "Tutup yang rapat" vs "tightly-fitting cover" is okay. Main minor issue: "Hepsetidae dan Alestidae berkerabat lebih jauh" fine.
Item 3: "Sungai Tocantins dan Juruena" renders "rios" loosely; and "Oyapock" should be "Sungai Oyapock" for clarity.
Item 8: "ikan pakan (feeder)" for 'feeder' fish is slightly awkward; use "ikan umpan/ikan pakan hidup (feeder)". "ikan mas koki" should be "ikan koki" (goldfish).
Item 11: "ctenoluciid"/"ctenolucids" and "klad" are left as technical jargon; consider "famili Ctenoluciidae" and "klad (clade)" for readability.
Item 5: "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is awkward for 'Aquarium base'; use "Ukuran alas akuarium minimal".

boulengerella-lateristriga.name: Striped Pike Characin
notes: Item 8: 'Insects such as crickets or are also suitable' is garbled in the source, but the translation silently drops it. This is minor.
Item 8: 'feeder fish' is translated as 'umpan hidup', which means live bait. Use 'ikan pakan' or 'feeder fish' instead.
Item 6: 'Tutup yang rapat juga wajib' drops the 'essential' nuance slightly. 'skittish' is rendered 'mudah kaget', which is fine.
Item 6: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable but narrower than the source, so consider 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 9: 'Peaceful with anything too large to swallow' is rendered 'ikan apa pun'. Fine, but 'agresif teritorial' reads awkwardly; use 'yang sangat teritorial dan agresif'.
Item 11: 'sedikit kemajuan' for 'some headway' is a little weak, and 'garis tengah perut' for 'ventral midline' is acceptable. 'Dubur' for the anal fin is fine.
Item 2: the quoted common name 'Striped pike characin' is left in English with no Indonesian gloss. Consider adding one, or keep it as a trade name.
Items 1 and 5: the 258 mm SL figure is kept in mm. This is fine, but consider giving it in cm (25,8 cm) for consistency with the other sizes.

boulengerella-lucius.name: Boulengerella lucius
notes: Item 11: "garis samping gelap yang agak samar" mistranslates "dusky, somewhat diffuse lateral stripe" as lateral line; use "garis/strip lateral yang suram dan agak kabur" (gurat sisi is the lateral line, a different structure).
Item 11: "pangkal sirip anal" for "anal-fin origin" is acceptable, but "Ctenolucidae" vs "Ctenoluciidae" is inconsistent; the source has the same inconsistency, so use one spelling.
Item 11: "garis miring di bagian posteroventral tulang infraorbital ketiga" – "oblique stripe" should be "strip/garis serong"; minor.
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "ikan menabrak kaca" for "swimming into the glass" plus "mudah kaget" is OK; no change needed.
Item 8: "Insects such as crickets or are also suitable" is truncated in the source; the translation silently completed it. Fine.
Item 8: "'feeder' fish" translated as "pakan hidup" (live food) – this broadens the meaning; use "ikan umpan/feeder" for fish given as food.
Item 2: first bullet "Tutup yang benar-benar rapat juga wajib untuk Boulengerella spp." is an incomplete sentence carried over from the source; consider completing it ("karena suka melompat").

boulengerella-maculata.name: Spotted Pike Characin
notes: Item 12: 'feeds exclusively on live fish' translated as 'terutama memakan ikan hidup' (mainly); 'exclusively' is weakened, which changes the fact. Use 'hanya/secara eksklusif memakan ikan hidup'.
Item 2: 'Spotted Pike Characin' rendered as 'ikan pike characin bertotol'; 'bertotol' is non-standard (use 'berbintik'), and the common name is awkward.
Item 2: 'is very peaceful' is rendered flatly, but the next sentence is fine. Minor: 'teman setangki' is acceptable, though 'penghuni akuarium lain' is more natural.
Item 9: 'biologically-immature aquaria' translated as 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'; this is acceptable, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis/belum cycling' is closer to hobby usage.
Item 9: 'tidak rewel' for 'unfussy' is OK, but 'it is appreciated' became 'menyukai', a slight shift.

Item 14: 'wonderful to look at' becomes 'sangat indah'; fine. Item 16: 'incertae sedis' left in Latin, which is fine, but 'gurat sisi berpori' and 'klad' are very technical; consider adding 'cabang/klade'.
Item 13: 'conspecifics' as 'sesamanya' is fine; 'soliter' is OK.

boulengerochromis-microlepis.name: Emperor Cichlid
notes: In #10, "Pendekatan kawin" for "courtship" is awkward; use "percumbuan" or "ritual pemijahan".

brachirus-panoides.name: Ikan Lidah
notes: "Small Indian Tongue" is left in English in both items; add an Indonesian form such as "ikan sebelah/lidah India kecil", with the English name in brackets if needed.
"flounder Eropa" is fine, but "ikan sebelah" for flatfish is less common among hobbyists than "ikan sebelah/ikan lidah". Consider clarifying it as "ikan pipih (flatfish)".
"hidup berpindah-pindah di antara dua dunia" is a bit literal. "penjelajah dua dunia" or "berpindah antara air tawar dan air laut" would be more natural.

brachychalcinus-orbicularis.name: Discus Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'Volume: ~108 liter' is fine, but the sentence structure aside, no real issue; however in item 8 'perilakunya yang cukup lincah' mistranslates 'somewhat vigorous behaviour' (lincah = agile; use 'cukup aktif/bersemangat'), which changes why it intimidates smaller fish.

Item 8: 'lele callichthyid dan loricariid' - 'callichthyid, and loricariid catfishes' is better rendered as 'lele callichthyid dan loricariid' only if 'lele' is accepted; loricariids/callichthyids are not 'lele' in Indonesian hobby usage - use 'catfish callichthyid dan loricariid'.

Item 10: 'Akuarium tersebut' - the English 'This' refers to the spawning aquarium, but the previous sentence does not mention one; add 'akuarium pemijahan' to be clear. 'dipindahkan' lacks 'dari akuarium'.
Item 3: 'kali' for creeks is colloquial/Jakarta-specific; use 'sungai kecil/anak sungai'. 'waduk' (reservoir) is narrower than 'impoundments'; consider 'genangan/bendungan'.
Item 5: 'menata aquascape' is awkward; use 'menata akuarium'. 'bongkahan batu kecil' for 'small boulders' is okay. 'driftwood' bracket is fine.

Item 11: 'dari panjang kepala bagian dorsal' is unclear for 'of the dorsal length of the head'; use 'panjang kepala di sisi dorsal/ panjang dorsal kepala'. 'Stethaprioninae yang masih bersifat dugaan' is OK.
Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal ... 90 mm SL' – 'SL' left unexplained; consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.

brachygobius-aggregatus.name: Brachygobius aggregatus
notes: Item 5: "sekitar 41 liter" is over-precise; round to about 40 liter.
Item 12: "Mekong dwarf bumblebee goby" is left in English; consider adding a local rendering such as "goby lebah Mekong" in brackets.

brachygobius-doriae.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: Item 6: 'Volume: ±41 liter' — 41 L is a converted figure from ~11 US gal; fine, but 'Panjang standar: 35 mm SL' is okay. No major issue here.
Item 10: 'sangat disukai' for 'much appreciated' is literal and odd for fish; better 'sangat bermanfaat/disukai ikan, tetapi tidak wajib'.

Item 16: 'ikan penjaga/perawat telur dan anakan' adds 'anakan' (fry) and uses slash; better 'ikan yang merawat telurnya (broodcare)'. The English says care ends when fry swim free, so 'dan anakan' slightly contradicts.
Item 15: 'wadah film mungkin perlu diberi pemberat agar tenggelam' adds 'agar tenggelam' — minor; also 'menunjukkan diri' for 'display' is awkward; use 'memamerkan diri/berahi di hadapan betina'.
Item 2: 'terlepas dari warnanya' fine, but 'by far' translated OK; 'mengembangkan warna' is literal—use 'menampilkan warna'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but ambiguous; use 'daphnia'/'kutu air (Daphnia)'.
Item 17: 'Spesies ini ... kemungkinan endemik di Jawa' — ok; 'saat ini tidak diperdagangkan untuk akuarium' ok. 'pita hitam kedua mencapai garis tengah bagian perut' fine.
Item 17: 'keduanya mungkin paling baik dianggap takson nominal' — 'they' in the English refers to the species; ok but 'takson nominal' could be 'spesies nominal'.
Item 12: 'agresi tersebar ke beberapa individu' — better 'agresi terbagi di antara banyak individu'; 'sebaiknya beli minimal 6 ekor atau lebih' redundant.

brachygobius-kabiliensis.name: Kabili bumblebee goby
notes: Item 1/2/4: 'Kalimantan bagian timur laut' for 'northeastern Borneo' - Sabah is in northern Borneo (Malaysia), not Kalimantan (Indonesian part); use 'Borneo bagian timur laut' or 'Pulau Kalimantan' carefully, as it changes geography.

Item 9: 'Both are best considered as nominal taxa' - 'Keduanya' fine, but 'Therefore' sentence says photos 'dipilih' vs 'assigned images to profiles'; the 'profil ini' wording is fine. However 'bisa dibedakan dari pita hitam tubuh di atas sirip anal' is awkward; rephrase to 'berdasarkan pita hitam...'.

Item 9: 'two black body bands reaching ventral midline posterior to anal-fin' translated as 'dua pita hitam ... di belakang sirip anal' - ambiguous; clarify that the bands reaching the midline are posterior to the anal fin.
Item 9: 'Genus ini dianggap paling dekat kekerabatannya dengan genus Pandaka' - subject should be 'Brachygobius'; acceptable but 'Kelompok ini' was used before, inconsistent.
Item 1: 'Kabili bumblebee goby' left untranslated as a trade name; acceptable, but 'lebih sadah' is stilted; consider 'lebih menyukai air yang lebih sadah' -> 'air dengan kesadahan lebih tinggi'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok but ambiguous; use 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.
Item 5: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' fine; 'buffer' could be 'penyangga pH (buffer)'.

brachygobius-mekongensis.name: Mekong Bumblebee Goby
notes: Item 2: 'between bridge at between bridge at Muang Kengkok' duplication in source was silently fixed; fine, but 'Provinsi Nongkhai ... Thailand timur laut' ok. No issue.
Item 5: 'jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium baru yang belum matang (belum siklus nitrogen)' adds explanatory content; 'belum siklus nitrogen' is awkward, use 'belum tersiklus'.
Item 10: 'meskipun gambar ditetapkan pada profil' is awkward/unclear for 'we've assigned images to profiles'; rephrase e.g. 'foto dicocokkan dengan profil'.
Item 10: 'spesies lain pernah dijumpai dijual dengan label nama ini' is slightly awkward; the neutral phrasing should be 'spesies lain pernah ditemukan dijual dengan label nama ini'.
Item 3: 'temporal swamps' rendered as 'rawa musiman' is fine, but 'lahan basah yang masih alami' for 'undisturbed marshland' loses 'marsh'; use 'rawa yang belum terganggu'.
Item 10: 'tidak bersisik' for 'naked' opercle/nape fine, but 'kadang tanpa sisik' for opercle in B. nunus is fine; 'gurat sisi di kepala' should be 'sistem garis rusuk (gurat sisi) kepala' - minor.
Item 9: 'betina yang sedang mengandung telur' acceptable; 'burayak' OK. No issue.
Item 8: 'agresi tersebar ke beberapa individu' is stiff; use 'agresi terbagi ke banyak ikan'.

brachygobius-nunus.name: Brachygobius nunus
notes: Item 9: "saat sedang bertelur" means laying eggs; "gravid" means carrying eggs, so use "saat penuh telur" or "saat membawa telur".
Item 2: "sungai di hilir Calcutta" is slightly off for 'river below Calcutta'. "sungai di bawah Calcutta" or "di sebelah selatan" is more literal.

brachygobius-sabanus.name: Bumblebee Goby
notes: "Kalimantan bagian timur laut" (items 1 and 2) for Sabah is geographically wrong. Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part of Borneo, and Sabah is in Malaysia. Use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo) bagian timur laut" or "Borneo bagian timur laut".
Item 10: "supaya tidak mengapung" adds a reason that the source doesn't give ("weighed down somehow"). Say only "perlu diberi pemberat".

brachygobius-xanthomelas.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "Dengan jumlah segitu" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu".
"foto online" could be the more standard "foto di internet" or "foto daring".

brachygobius-xanthozonus.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "selalu ternyata B. doriae atau B. sabanus" (items 1 and 4) is awkward word order. Use "ternyata selalu B. doriae atau B. sabanus" or "selalu berupa B. doriae atau B. sabanus".
"bumblebee goby" is left in English in items 1 and 4. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add an Indonesian gloss such as "ikan gobi lebah" on first mention.
"Max size ... (1.5 in SL)" was dropped in item 1. This is fine, since 38 mm is the metric value.

brachyplatystoma-capapretum.name: Brachyplatystoma capapretum
notes: Item 1: 'lele pimelodid' is acceptable, but 'Difficulty: 5 of 8' and the rest are fine; consider 'penghobi swasta' instead of 'penghobi pribadi' for 'private aquarists'.
Item 7: 'ikan teri (whitebait)' is inexact. Whitebait is juvenile herring/sprat, not teri; use 'ikan whitebait' or 'ikan kecil seperti whitebait'.
Item 7: 'kerang' for mussel and 'ikan loricariid' are fine, but 'pemakan ikan; di alam memangsa...' reads slightly choppy; smooth the sentence.
Item 2: the duplicated 'Purus' in the river list is copied from the source; consider removing the repeat.
Item 11: 'anakan' for juveniles is slightly off; 'ikan juvenil' is the usual hobby term. 'Suspensorium mandibula' and 'parasphenoid' are mixed in style; use Indonesian or Latin terms consistently.
Item 8: 'Hanya pelihara bersama...' is awkward; use 'Hanya boleh dipelihara bersama spesies yang cukup besar sehingga tidak dimangsa.'

brachyplatystoma-filamentosum.name: Piraiba
notes: "kawasan Guyana" for "the Guianas": this could be read as the country Guyana only. Consider "kawasan Guiana (Guyana, Suriname, Guyana Prancis)" or "Dataran Guiana".
"sexually-immature adults" became "ikan yang hampir dewasa". This is slightly loose. "ikan dewasa muda yang belum matang kelamin" is closer.
"diameter mata sekitar 1/5–1/7 panjang moncong" is a little awkward for "fits approximately 5-7 times in length of snout". Consider "panjang moncong sekitar 5–7 kali diameter mata".

brachyplatystoma-juruense.name: Gold Zebra Catfish
notes: Item 11: "the head turned upside, against the current" is translated as "kepala menghadap ke atas, melawan arus". The original says the fish swims head-down (or upside-down), so check the source. As written, the posture is probably wrong. Also, "looking against the water surface" is rendered as "menghadap ke arah permukaan air", which is acceptable.

Item 4: The original says "Peru. The Rio Jurua is the type locality." This contradicts item 3, which places the river in Brazil. The translation copies the contradiction. Keep it faithful, but "Rio Jurua" and "rio Juruá" are spelled inconsistently across items. Standardise them.
Item 1: "lele pimelodid" and "Gold zebra catfish" are fine, but "600 mm" was left as is. Convert it to "60 cm" so it matches item 2.

Item 14: "it's" and "its unclear" in the source are typos, and the translation is fine on them. However, "filamen tetap ada pada ikan dewasa" is joined to the previous clause by a comma. Use a semicolon or "dan" to make the list clearer.
Item 9: "ikan teri kecil (whitebait)" is a questionable equivalent. Whitebait is not teri in the strict sense. Consider "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)".
Item 7: "akuarium yang benar-benar kosong" for "completely bare arrangement" is acceptable. "Populer" for "most-favoured" is fine too.
Item 10: "Hanya pelihara bersama..." is an unnatural imperative. Use "Hanya boleh dipelihara bersama spesies yang cukup besar sehingga tidak dimangsa."

brachyplatystoma-platynemum.name: Slobbering Catfish
notes: Item 1: "lele pimelodid" and "ngiler" are colloquial; use "ikan lele pimelodid" and "mengeluarkan air liur" for a handbook register.

Item 3: "Individu yang sudah matang kelamin biasanya tidak tercatat dalam migrasi ini" is fine, but "white water"/"black water" would read better with Indonesian glosses (air putih/air hitam) in brackets.
Item 4: "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is an odd rendering of "Aquarium base"; use "Ukuran alas akuarium" or "Luas dasar akuarium".
Item 11: "countershading" is left untranslated; use "pewarnaan countershading (punggung lebih gelap, perut lebih terang)" or an Indonesian gloss.
Item 11: "sirip ekor ... bercabang dalam" is vague for "deeply forked"; use "bercagak dalam".
Item 11: "ikan muda dan remaja" for juveniles and subadults is fine, but the mix with "ikan muda" for juveniles elsewhere is inconsistent; keep the terms consistent.

brachyplatystoma-rousseauxii.name: Dourada catfish
notes: Item 3: "Tempat makan yang kaya ini" is a bit stiff for "rich feeding ground"; "area mencari makan yang kaya" is more natural.
Item 7: "ikan teri" for whitebait is only approximate. "ikan kecil (whitebait)" would be closer.

brachyplatystoma-tigrinum.name: Tigrinus
notes: Item 14: "jeram yang sulit untuk menangkap ikan" is ungrammatical. Use "jeram, tempat ikan ini sulit ditangkap".
Items 1 and 3: "air terjun" for "cataracts" is imprecise. Item 2 uses "riam" for the same word. Use "riam/jeram" consistently.
Items 1 and 3: "hanya bisa hidup di alur utama sungai" is stronger than "appear to be obligate inhabitants". Use something like "tampaknya bergantung sepenuhnya pada alur utama sungai".

brachyplatystoma-vaillantii.name: Piramutaba
notes: Item 1: "Size: 1500 mm (59.1 in) SL" was kept as "1500 mm SL". Converting to metric is allowed, but 1500 mm conflicts with 105 cm SL in the description. This is a source inconsistency, so check it. Also consider "150 cm".
Item 4: "Brasil timur laut" is awkward. Use "timur laut Brasil" or "Brasil bagian timur laut".
Item 9: "burayaknya" is a rare word. Use "larvanya" or "anak ikannya" (fry).
Item 9: "pimelodid" and "ikan loricariid" are left as raw taxonomic terms. Consider "lele pimelodid" and "ikan famili Loricariidae" for clarity.
Item 8: "tidak pernah di zona yang rawan banjir" is elliptical. Use "tetapi tidak pernah ditemukan di zona yang rawan banjir".
Item 8: "Di Amazon" ("In the Amazon") is fine, but "Kadang ikan ini bisa tertangkap di bagian hulu" loses "upper part" context. Clarify as "bagian hulu Amazon".
Item 14: "Hanya campur dengan" is ungrammatical. Use "Hanya boleh dipelihara bersama spesies yang cukup besar agar tidak dimangsa".
Item 7: "sampai ke hilir hingga habitat muara" is redundant ("sampai" plus "hingga"). Use "sampai ke hilir di habitat muara air tawar".

brachyrhamdia-heteropleura.name: Brachyrhamdia heteropleura
notes: Item 6: "Pelihara di akuarium khusus spesies ini, atau bersama ... yang menempati separuh bagian atas akuarium" is ambiguous. The English says only the top half applies to the tankmates, and the Indonesian can be read as describing this catfish. Make it clear that the tankmates occupy the upper half.
Item 6: "karena ikan ini bisa memangsa" is vague about the subject. Say "karena lele ini bisa memangsa" or "ikan ini dapat bersifat predator" so it clearly refers to Brachyrhamdia.
Item 6: "substrat pasir dan kerikil yang diselang-seling" is awkward for "alternate sand and gravel substrate". Use "substrat berupa pasir atau kerikil" or "campuran pasir dan kerikil".
Item 2: "meniru (mimikri) spesies Pimelodella spp." is redundant. Use "meniru Pimelodella spp." or "meniru spesies Pimelodella".

Item 5: "Kerabat satu genus spesies ini" is stiff. Use "Spesies sekerabat (satu genus)". "lingkungan dasar perairan berpasir" is unclear for "benthic environments with sandy bottoms". Use "lingkungan bentik berdasar pasir".

Item 8: "merujuk pada sisi tubuh yang 'berbintik'" is fine. The quoted description "kromatofor... berkumpul di sepanjang septa" is acceptable, but "Jarang terlihat dalam impor" is awkward. Use "Jarang ditemukan di antara ikan impor".
Item 3: "lembah Amazon" is a poor rendering of "Amazon basin". Use "DAS Amazon" or "cekungan Amazon". The same applies to "lembah Sungai" in item 4. "Negro Hilir" is acceptable.
Item 4: "Coratijn" copies a misspelling from the English. Item 3 spells it "Corantijn", so make the two consistent (Corantijn).

brachyrhamdia-imitator.name: False Cory
notes: "pola mimikri Bates" for "Batesian form of shoaling": the Batesian mimicry concept is wrong here. The fish takes food and eggs, so this is closer to aggressive mimicry. Rephrase it as a Batesian-type shoaling behaviour, e.g. "bentuk bergerombol ala Bates", or keep the sense that it joins the shoal to exploit the Corydoras.
"Lele tak bersisik" is fine, but "Corydoras yang berlapis pelindung" is awkward. Use "Corydoras yang berlapis lempeng tulang (berperisai)".
"substrat pasir dan kerikil yang diselang-seling" is unnatural for "alternating sand and gravel substrate". Use "substrat berselang-seling pasir dan kerikil" or "campuran pasir dan kerikil".
"Pelihara di akuarium" for "House in aquaria" is acceptable, but "Julukan spesies" for "specific epithet" is non-standard. Use "epitet spesifik" or "nama spesies".
"Ikan ini tidak rewel soal makanan" is a bit colloquial. Use "tidak pemilih makanan".
"dari bahasa Yunani brachys, -eia" is fine. "Kesadahan" is fine.
Item 12, the journal reference, is left untranslated, which is acceptable. The citation "pp 123" is unchanged.
"Lokasi tipe" is non-standard. Use "Lokalitas tipe".

brachyrhamdia-meesi.name: Brachyrhamdia meesi
notes: Item 1: the English says 'Rare in the hobby'; 'jarang ada di hobi' is awkward. Use 'jarang ditemukan dalam hobi akuarium'.
Item 1: 'ikan ikutan' is not a standard hobby term. Use 'tangkapan sampingan (bycatch)'.
Item 1: 'Ikan muda bisa meniru' loses the hedge 'may mimic', and 'Corydoras yang berukuran lebih kecil' is slightly ambiguous. Say 'Corydoras yang lebih kecil' instead.
Item 3: 'Alas akuarium' for 'Aquarium base' is unnatural. Use 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' or 'Alas akuarium minimal'.
Item 3: '±72 liter' for '~72 litres' should be '~72 liter' or 'sekitar 72 liter'.
Item 4: 'tidak tahan terhadap penumpukan' is stiff. Use 'tidak toleran terhadap penumpukan' or 'peka terhadap'.
Item 4: 'requires spotless water' should be 'air yang sangat bersih'. 'tumbuh baik' for 'thrive' is acceptable.
Item 7: 'Spesies ini tidak perlu dipelihara bersama sekelompok Corydoras' is fine. 'gregarious' is rendered 'suka bergerombol', which is acceptable.
Item 8: 'seharusnya terlihat jelas lebih berisi tubuhnya' is awkward. Use 'tubuh betina dewasa tampak jelas lebih gemuk daripada jantan'.

Item 10: 'syntopically-occurring' became 'hidup di tempat yang sama', which is acceptable. 'berkerabat dekat dengan ... Pimelodella' is okay, but 'fontanel kranial posterior' is awkward and 'monofilinya' should be 'monofiletiknya'.

brachyrhamdia-rambarrani.name: False Adolfoi
notes: #11: "sampai perutnya seperti mau meledak" is a bit colloquial; "sampai perutnya sangat penuh/menggembung" is more natural for a handbook.
#19: "monofilinya" is awkward; "bersifat monofiletik" is more standard.

brachyrhaphis-roseni.name: Brachyrhaphis roseni
notes: Segment 4: the English says "gravity spot" (a typo for "gravid spot"). The translation silently corrects it to "Gravid spot" and adds "(bercak kehamilan)". That is arguably fine, but check that the term is consistent with the source.
Segment 3: "ikan lele/catfish" is a questionable rendering of "catfish". Lele is a specific food fish (Clarias). Use "ikan catfish" or "ikan dasar sejenis corydoras" instead.
Segment 5: "terlalu gampang stres" is colloquial. Use "terlalu mudah gelisah" or "mudah stres" to match the register of a handbook.
Segment 4: "hampir mirip jantan" is redundant. Use "hampir menyerupai jantan" or "mirip jantan".
Segment 3: "Teman satu akuariumnya" is slightly awkward. "Ikan penghuni bersama" or "tank mate" would be more natural.
Segment 5: "Memijahkan" suits "breeding" in context, but "sangat kanibal terhadap burayaknya" should be "memangsa burayak" for naturalness.

breitensteinia-cessator.name: Breitensteinia cessator
notes: "punggung adiposa yang rendah dan panjang" for "long low adipose ridge": "punggung" reads as the back, not a ridge. Use "lunas/rigi adiposa" or "lipatan lemak yang rendah dan panjang".
"Belum ada laporan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan." is repetitive. It is faithful to the source, but could be smoothed to "Belum ada laporan pemijahan."

breitensteinia-insignis.name: Breitensteinia insignis
notes: Item 3: "jari-jari keras sirip dubur: 0" is fine, but "Dibedakan dari spesies lain dalam genusnya" is slightly wordy; "kongenerik" could be used. Minor only.
Item 3: "kurang lebih berbercak ungu tua" is slightly awkward; consider "agak berbintik-bintik ungu tua".

brevibora-cheeya.name: Brevibora cheeya
notes: Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the English gives the volume as only a rough figure alongside the dimensions. 80 × 30 cm with no height stated cannot give 72 L. This is a source issue, so mention it only if the translator was meant to flag it.

Item 8: "does not compete well with much larger or more boisterous species" is translated as "lebih agresif" (more aggressive). "Boisterous" means rowdy or lively, not aggressive, so use "lebih lincah/heboh".
Item 11: "Several years prior to its description" is rendered as if the species were the one described. Fine. But "lokasi yang samar" for "vague locality" is awkward; use "lokasi yang tidak jelas".
Item 5: "common beech or oak" is left as "beech atau oak" with no explanation. Add the local context, e.g. "kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak (ek)", or advise on locally available hardwoods.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan" has a broken sentence structure. Change it to "tanaman seperti Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, dan Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan".
Item 11: "larger head and prepectoral length" is rendered "kepala dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar". Use "kepala lebih panjang dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan spesies" is fine. However, "temannya setangki lainnya dibiarkan" is awkward; use "tidak mengganggu penghuni lain".

brevibora-dorsiocellata.name: Rasbora Eyespot
notes: Item 10: the English gives 72–78°F (about 22–26°C). The conversion is fine, but 'Suhu: sekitar 22–26 °C' is OK. No fix is needed here.
Item 16: 'ikan jantan akan menampilkan warna terbaiknya karena saling bersaing' is fine. 'kurang gugup' is awkward, so use 'kurang mudah stres/takut'.
Item 9: 'kayu beech atau oak' leaves the English names. Use 'kayu bukit/beech (Fagus) atau ek'. 'setup' could be 'penataan'.
Item 18: 'Pakan awal sebaiknya Paramecium' is OK. 'menyebar telur, bertelur secara terus-menerus' is clumsy, so use 'penyebar telur yang memijah berkelanjutan'.
Item 4: the translation is omitted. The stocklist code 451802 and the wholesale-only note are shop talk and may be dropped, so this is acceptable.
Item 15: 'Teman satu akuarium' is fine, but 'rakus saat makan' for 'aggressive eaters' could be 'agresif saat makan'.
Item 7: 'rawa gambut hutan purba' is acceptable. 'khasnya memiliki' is awkward, so use 'umumnya/biasanya memiliki'.
Item 5: 'akuarium habitatnya' is awkward. Use 'habitat (akuarium) sudah siap'.
Item 3: 'ikan siprinid' is a little stiff, but it is understandable. 'ikan hasil tangkapan alam' is fine.

brevimyrus-niger.name: Black Elephant Nose
notes: Item 3: "must be spacyious" became "harus luas dan sebaiknya punya banyak tempat sembunyi". The English says the tank should have many hiding places and must be spacious. The Indonesian is close but shifts the emphasis. Consider "Akuarium harus berisi banyak tempat sembunyi dan harus luas".

Item 3: "polusi listrik" for "electro-smog" is acceptable but a bit loose. Consider "elektrosmog" or "gangguan medan listrik". "dari akuarium tetangga" is also an interpretation of "from the neighbour". Use "dari ikan/akuarium di sebelah".
Item 1: "di hobi akuarium" is awkward. Use "dalam hobi akuarium" or "di dunia akuarium hias".
Item 1: "ikan gajah/elephantfish" is fine. "mormyrid" is left untranslated and not explained as a group, but this is minor.
Item 2: "organ pernapasan tambahan" is fine. "eg" was rendered as "jadi", which is acceptable. "Tidak rewel" is slightly colloquial, so consider "tidak menuntut".
Item 5: "cukup suka berkelahi" is OK. "Cukup agresif" is more common among hobbyists.

brochis-multiradiatus.name: Corydoras Hognose
notes: #19: "peternak" for "breeder" is slightly off. "penangkar" or "pembudidaya" is more natural for fish hobbyists.

#2 and #6: "ceruk sungai yang airnya hampir tidak mengalir" and "danau tapal kuda" are long, unfamiliar renderings of "backwaters" and "oxbows". Consider "perairan genangan/rawa tepi sungai" and "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)", with the English term in brackets.
#1: "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is not the usual Indonesian category name. "Risiko Rendah" or "Kurang Perhatian" is more standard.
#22: "Lineage 8 (sub-klad 1)" mixes English and Indonesian. Use one style, for example "Garis Keturunan 8" or "Lineage 8 (subklad 1)".
#4: the added "(aslinya: ...)" repeats the Spanish type-locality text, which is not in the English. Drop it, or keep only the original locality name.

brotia-pagodula.name: Keong Pagoda
notes: Item 16: "umurnya hampir tidak bisa mencapai 1–2 tahun paling lama" is garbled and changes meaning. Rewrite as "umurnya paling lama hanya sekitar 1–2 tahun".
Item 16: "Tentakel kepala" and "antena keong" are inconsistent. Use "tentakel" for the snail.
Item 16: "Marisa cornuarietis akan memakan semua tanaman" is fine, but "Keong assassin bisa mengganggu mereka" is vague. Make it clear that assassin snails prey on or harass Brotia.

Item 14: "Betina menyimpan anakan ... di bagian punggung area leher, yang mengisi hampir seluruh rongga viseral" is ambiguous. It is unclear whether "yang" refers to the pouch. Rephrase so it is clear the pouch fills the cavity.

Item 14: "4–5 ekor" and "Pembiakannya sangat lambat" are fine. However, "cangkang embrionya berkerut secara tidak simetris" is awkward. Use "cangkang embrio berkerut tidak simetris dan tak beraturan".
Item 10: "pakannya mungkin perlu ditambah" is slightly ambiguous. Say "perlu diberi pakan tambahan".
Item 10: "Tambahkan sayuran hijau seperti wortel" is ok. But "pupuk dan pakan tidak mengandung tembaga" is fine.
Item 8: "agar pH di bawah 7 tidak dibiarkan" shifts the meaning from "not tolerated by the animals". Use "pH di bawah 7 tidak dapat ditoleransi keong dalam jangka panjang".
Item 11: "menyiramnya dengan air mendidih" is ok. But "tanaman herba seperti dandelion" is fine.

Item 7 vs Item 8: the sources conflict on pH, hardness and temperature (7.0–7.5 vs 7.5–8.5; 22–28 vs 18–26). The translation is faithful and the conflict is in the source, so no fix is needed on the translation side.

brycinus-longipinnis.name: Long-finned Tetra
notes: Item 3: "satu-satunya anggota genus ini yang bermigrasi" is accurate, but item 1 says "tidak seperti kerabatnya yang lain dalam genus ini" (unusually for the genus) – fine; however item 5: "tidak gampang panik atau kaget" is OK. Main issue is item 4: the source says ~137 litres, which is rounded oddly. Use "sekitar 135 liter" (nearest 5 L).
Item 5: "Cahaya yang lebih redup dari tanaman apung ini" is awkward; use "Cahaya yang lebih redup akibat tanaman apung ini".
Item 10: "2–5 °H" should be "2–5 dGH" for consistency with the other hardness values.
Item 10: "filter spons kecil bertenaga aerator" is awkward; "filter spons kecil bertenaga udara (air-driven)" is clearer.
Item 8: "lele Synodontis" is wrong; Synodontis is a squeaker catfish, not a lele. Use "ikan hiu-hiuan/catfish Synodontis" or just "catfish Synodontis".
Item 7: "cacing tanah atau udang yang dipotong-potong" is fine, but "Bisa rewel soal makan" adds "soal makan" which is minor.

brycon-cephalus.name: Red Tail Brycon
notes: Item 3: "várzeas" (plural in the source) was changed to "várzea"; keep the original form or add a plural cue.
Item 7: "Di akuarium pun ikan ini sama tidak rewelnya" is awkward; "Di akuarium pun ikan ini tidak pilih-pilih makanan" reads more naturally.
Item 11: "Di Brasil umumnya dikenal sebagai matrinxã, ikan ini memiliki..." is a dangling clause with no subject; add "Ikan ini" at the start or split the sentence.
Item 11: "ikan pancingan olahraga" is non-standard; "ikan buruan pancing (sport fish)" or "ikan pancing olahraga" is more usual.

bryconaethiops-boulengeri.name: Boulenger's Featherfin Tetra
notes: Item 1: "karasin" is a rare term; "characin" or "ikan karasin (characin)" would be more recognisable to hobbyists. This is minor.

Item 10: "Belum ada catatan pemijahan" adds "pemijahan", which the English doesn't say. It is probably the breeding section, so it is acceptable. "Belum tercatat di kalangan penghobi" would be closer to the source.

buccochromis-lepturus.name: Green Lepturus
notes: Item 10: the bracketed gloss "(induk betina mengerami telur di mulut)" is not in the source. It is accurate but unnecessary, so it could be dropped or shortened to "pengeram mulut oleh induk betina".
Item 8: "cukup bisa ditoleransi" is slightly stiff. "cukup ditoleransi" or "umumnya bisa hidup rukun" would read more naturally.

buccochromis-nototaenia.name: Stripeback Hap
notes: Item 8: "cukup bisa saling menerima" is a little stiff; "cukup ditoleransi" or "umumnya bisa hidup rukun" would be more natural.
Item 5: "perenang pelagis yang suka menjelajah" is acceptable, but "roamer" could be phrased more simply, e.g. "perenang pelagis yang aktif berkeliaran".

bunocephalus-colombianus.name: Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 1: "Lokasi tipe" is slightly literal; "Lokalitas tipe" is the more common term in ichthyology, but meaning is intact.
Item 4: "yang sangat menonjol pada beberapa spesies" is slightly ambiguous; it could be clearer that the bumps (not the fish) are more marked in some species.

bunocephalus-coracoideus.name: Bunocephalus coracoideus
notes: Item 4: 'approximately 68 litres' is kept, which is fine, but the 'kira-kira 68 liter' figure is not rounded to the nearest 5 L (about 70 L). Minor.
Item 5: 'a couple of inches of sand' became 'setebal sekitar 5 cm'. This is acceptable, but 'kayu bogwood' could use the local term 'kayu akar/driftwood'.
Item 8: 'cichlid kerdil' is fine, but 'Loricariidae' for 'smaller Loricariids' could be 'lele Loricariidae kecil' for naturalness. Minor.
Item 11: 'cuma hanyut' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'hanya hanyut'.
Item 11: 'Nama lokalnya di daerah asal' is slightly redundant; 'Nama lokalnya' is enough.
Item 1: 'dibandingkan anggota genusnya yang lain' is a bit awkward. Use 'paling umum dijumpai di antara anggota genusnya di toko ikan hias'.
Item 10: 'half a dozen' became 'minimal enam ekor'. This is OK. 'mereka mau menerima' is stiff; use 'burayak dapat diberi'.

butis-amboinensis.name: Olive flathead gudgeon
notes: Item 5: "pot tanah liat" adds "clay", which the English ("plant pots") does not say. Use "pot tanaman" or "pot".
Item 7: "larva Chironomus (cacing darah)" narrows "chironomid larvae" to one genus. Use "larva chironomid/Chironomidae (cacing darah)".
Item 1: "menempelkan posisi tubuhnya sejajar dengan permukaan padat" is awkward. Use "sering menempelkan tubuhnya pada permukaan padat" or "menyejajarkan tubuhnya dengan permukaan padat".
Items 1 and 8: "kemungkinan sebaiknya dipelihara" is clumsy for "should probably be kept". Use "sebaiknya dipelihara sendirian" or "mungkin lebih baik dipelihara sendirian".

butis-butis.name: Crazy Fish
notes: Item 5: 'It can apparently adapt to both full marine and freshwater' – 'we suspect' became passive 'diduga'; fine, but 'Usahakan mencari tahu salinitas... samakan kira-kira dengan itu' is awkward; rephrase as 'sesuaikan salinitas awal dengan air di toko'.

Item 7: 'live or frozen chironomid larvae' translated as 'cacing darah' – chironomid larvae are bloodworm, OK, but 'Spesies ini ... pakan pengganti' for 'prepared alternatives' is slightly off; use 'pakan olahan/pengganti pakan alami'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' – fine; 'feeder' fish advice OK.

Item 10: 'Not thought to have occurred in aquaria' (breeding context) rendered 'belum pernah terjadi di akuarium' loses the subject; specify 'Diperkirakan belum pernah berhasil dibiakkan di akuarium' (or keep neutral), as 'terjadi' is vague.
Item 11: 'jari-jari keras' / 'jari-jari lunak' for spinous/rayed dorsal fin is awkward; use 'jari-jari sirip keras (duri)' and 'jari-jari lunak', and 'sirip dada' vs 'sirip pectoral' consistent.
Item 11: 'ciri terakhir ini juga dimiliki' and 'berbagi leluhur bersama terdekat' awkward; use 'tidak memiliki nenek moyang bersama terdekat'.

Item 11: 'siklus hidup laut hingga muara (estuari)' – 'marine to estuarine life history' ok but 'ctenoid' and 'branchiostegal' left untranslated; consider 'bergerigi (ctenoid)' and 'jari-jari membran insang (branchiostegal)'.
Item 1: 'ikan gudgeon (sleeper) berkepala pipih' – 'flathead gudgeon' is split awkwardly; acceptable but consider 'gudgeon kepala pipih'.

butis-koilomatodon.name: Mud Sleeper
notes: "Sebagian ahli juga memasukkan": the English says "authors"; "para penulis/beberapa peneliti" is closer, but this is minor.
"Ikan yang masuk ke pasaran": "The animals received" is more literally "ikan yang diterima/didatangkan"; the added "pasaran" is a small liberty.
"Goby dewasa bisa menerima air tawar murni sama mudahnya dengan air laut murni": a bit stiff. Try "dapat hidup di air tawar murni maupun air laut murni dengan sama baiknya".
"Terhadap sesama jenisnya, spesies ini suka bertengkar": "conspecifics" is better as "sesama spesiesnya", and "agresif" is the more common hobby term than "suka bertengkar".
"Sebaran seluas ini jelas menunjukkan": fine, but "Pasifik timur" should be capitalised as "Pasifik Timur" for consistency with "Indo-Pasifik Barat". This is minor.

caelatoglanis-zonatus.name: Caelatoglanis zonatus
notes: Item 1: "lele" for erethistid catfish is loose; erethistid are not true lele (Clariidae). Consider "ikan lele erethistid" or "ikan keras/catfish dari famili Erethistidae".
Item 2: "membentang melewati perbatasan" is slightly awkward; "Sungai Ataran merupakan hulu dari sebagian" is a bit unclear. Consider "membentuk hulu sebagian DAS Salween".
Item 2: type locality quote left in English; acceptable as a quote but could add an Indonesian gloss (e.g., "sekitar 20 km").
Item 3: "tampaknya kaya oksigen" is slightly awkward; "berarus dan teduh di bawah naungan hutan" is redundant. Consider "teduh oleh naungan hutan".

callichthys-serralabium.name: Sawlipped Catfish
notes: Item 3: "adipose-fat body" rendered as "bantalan lemak" (fat pad); acceptable but "jaringan lemak" / "badan lemak" would be closer to the source.
Item 4: "Bubble nest breeder" translated as "Berkembang biak dengan membuat sarang busa"; "Penghasil sarang busa" or "pembuat sarang busa" is more natural. "pemijahannya" is fine.
Item 1: "Least Concern (Risiko Rendah)" is okay, but the standard Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah"; "Risiko Rendah" is slightly non-standard.

callochromis-macrops.name: Callochromis macrops
notes: Item 10: "shelldweller" is left in English; use a local term such as "cichlid penghuni cangkang" (shell dweller) in brackets.
Item 13: "eartheater" is left as English; add a gloss such as "(pemakan tanah)" or "cichlid eartheater".
Item 1: "Big-eyed mouthbrooder" is left untranslated; consider "cichlid pengeram mulut bermata besar" with the English in brackets.
Item 12: "untuk menyebarkan agresi" is slightly off. "Mengalihkan/meredam agresi" is closer to "dissipate".

cambarellus-diminutus.name: Least crayfish
notes: Section 3: "sampai-sampai spesies ini dinilai perlu mendapat perhatian konservasi untuk dimasukkan dalam daftar Endangered Species Act" is awkward; "Endangered Species Act" should be given as the US law, e.g. "Undang-Undang Spesies Terancam Punah AS (Endangered Species Act)".
Section 3: "genus Cambarellinae" is kept as in the source; this is a wrong rank name, since the genus is Cambarellus. It can be left as is or flagged.
Section 7: "dalam hal itu" is stiff; use "dalam kasus itu" or "jika begitu".

Section 8: "Akuarium harus sudah melewati siklus nitrogen" is fine, but "ia membutuhkan perawatan yang tepat" and "tidak merepotkan" for "not high-maintenance" are loose. Also, "nitrat" high as harmful: the source says ammonia and nitrate, which is kept.
Section 11: "bisa memakan hampir apa saja yang bisa dimakan yang ditemuinya" is clumsy; use "hampir semua makanan yang ditemuinya".
