Section 11: "sore menjelang malam" and "Pakan granul udang" are fine, but "pakan hidup penghuni dasar" is awkward; use "pakan hidup yang hidup di dasar".
Section 12: "mencabik sirip" is acceptable, but "mengorek substrat" for "dig" and "mendapat manfaat ... dengan memungut bakteri" are clumsy; use "menggali" and "mengambil".
Section 14: "menelentangkannya" is non-standard; use "membaringkannya telentang".
Section 2: "karapas" is correct, but "di antara semuanya" is vague; use "di antara semua spesies Cambarellus".

cambarellus-patzcuarensis.name: Lobster Mini Meksiko
notes: "Lobster ini" in sentence 2 adds a noun not in the English ("them"); acceptable but could be "Hewan ini" or "Udang karang kerdil ini" for consistency. Minor.
"dwarf orange crayfish" and "orange Mexican dwarf crayfish" are left in English; consider adding a local name such as "lobster air tawar kerdil oranye" (English in brackets is fine).

cambarellus-puer.name: Swamp Dwarf Crayfish
notes: Item 2: "cukup mungkin merupakan hibrida" is awkward; use "kemungkinan besar hibrida".
Item 4: "vegetasi emersed maupun submersed" leaves English terms; use "tanaman yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air maupun terendam".
Item 6: "soil" left untranslated; use "tanah" or "soil substrat" (e.g. soil akuascape).
Item 6: "kaki atau capit yang hilang tumbuh kembali" changes "lost appendages replaced" slightly; acceptable but "anggota tubuh" is closer.
Item 10: "udang bisa tertangkap" is ambiguous; use "udang bisa ditangkap dan dimakan lobster".
Item 5: "sangat pandai kabur" is a bit literal; use "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 9: "bisa-bisa mereka saling memangsa" is slightly colloquial; "mereka bahkan bisa saling memangsa" is better.
Item 12: "daya tarik feromon itu makin lama makin berkurang" is a bit loose; "efek penarik" would be closer.

cambarellus-shufeldtii.name: Cajun Dwarf Crayfish
notes: Item 9: "Tubifex worms" rendered as "cacing sutra" in both mentions. That is acceptable for tubifex, but "Blackworms" is left as "Blackworm" (untranslated). Use "cacing hitam (blackworm)" for consistency.

Item 9: "Brine shrimp" is translated as "Artemia". This is fine, so no change is needed. In the same list, "Detritus worms" becomes "Cacing detritus", which is a literal rendering. Consider "cacing tanah kecil/cacing detritus (detritus worms)".

Item 6: "cycle the tank" is translated as "jalankan siklus nitrogen". This is acceptable, but "cycling akuarium" is the term hobbyists use. "Safe with any live plants" is translated as "aman untuk semua tanaman air", which loses "live". Use "tanaman hidup".

Item 6: "Keep putting in and replacing food" is translated as "Tetap berikan pakan dan ganti pakan yang tersisa". This adds "yang tersisa" (leftover), which shifts the meaning. Use "ganti pakan" without the addition, or "Tetap berikan dan ganti pakan secara rutin".

Item 10: "Endler's livebearers" is translated as "endler", which is vague. Use "guppy endler". "Dwarf swordtails" is translated as "platy pedang kerdil", which is incorrect, because dwarf swordtail is not a platy. Use "swordtail kerdil".
Item 10: "they mostly occupy existing burrows and hollow them out" is translated as "memperdalamnya" (deepen them). This is a small shift in meaning. "Mencapit udang" for "snap at" is acceptable.
Item 5: "everything can go wrong very fast" is translated as "segala sesuatu bisa memburuk". This is a slightly awkward rendering. Use "banyak hal bisa salah dengan cepat".
Item 1: "Optimal tank size: ~40 litres" is translated as "±40 liter". "Sekitar 40 liter" would be more natural.
Item 12: "2 broods" is translated as "2 kali anakan". This is awkward. Use "2 kali bertelur/melahirkan anakan (brood)". "Obligate burrowers" is translated as "penggali sejati". This is acceptable.

cambarus-bartonii.name: Appalachian Brook Crayfish
notes: Section 9: "Signal crayfish are territorial" was rendered as "Lobster air tawar ini bersifat teritorial", which drops the source's mention of signal crayfish. That is an English source error, but the translation should still be checked. Cambarus bartonii is not a signal crayfish.

Section 9: "Cambarus bartonii ... lose ground when encountering crayfish of different species" is fine, but "hostile" became "bersikap agresif". That is acceptable. "burrows ... 1–3 ft (0.3–1 m)" is correct.

Section 12: "ranging from weak beiges to deep chestnuts to tan" became "dari krem pucat, cokelat kastanye tua, hingga cokelat muda". The order and the colour sense are a little off. Use "dari krem pucat hingga cokelat kastanye tua dan cokelat muda (tan)".

Section 12: "Kingdom ... Subphylum: Crustacea" is fine. "Interesting fact: ... 30–40% of crayfish brain volume" is fine. "Tubuhnya bisa berpigmen" is a literal rendering of "The body can be pigmented"; it is vague but acceptable.
Section 7: "Cambarus bartonii sangat tidak menuntut" is awkward. Use "sangat tidak rewel" or "tidak menuntut perawatan khusus".
Section 6: "suhu letal atas awal (ultimate upper incipient lethal temperature)" is a clumsy rendering of the technical term. Check it against the standard term "suhu letal atas awal ultimat".
Section 6: "dapat bertahan (LC50) pada pH 2,43" is imprecise. Say that LC50 (50% mortality) was reached at pH 2,43 over 96 jam.
Section 4: "agar kimia air lebih stabil" is unnatural. Use "agar kualitas/parameter air lebih stabil".

camposcia-retusa.name: Kepiting Dekorator
notes: Item 2: the English says the crabs "may simply miss the food you give them". The Indonesian "pakan yang Anda berikan terlewat oleh mereka" is acceptable, but "Karena mereka tidak banyak bergerak" for "not very mobile" is fine too. The wording "kurang cocok" is okay.

Item 12: "larvae normally hatch overnight, occasionally in the early morning" became "menjelang pagi", which is acceptable. However, "Waktu mencapai dewasa" for "Maturity" is fine. "Uneaten food was removed" is fine.
Item 13: the English "Superfamily: Majidae" is given as "Superfamili: Majidae". Majidae is a family, but this mirrors the source, so keep it. "Subfilum: Crustacea" mirrors the source too.
Item 13: "Rostrum: the head is broad, slightly deflexed anteriorly, with an emarginated anterior edge". "bertakik" for "emarginated" is loose but acceptable.
Item 8: "seagrass leaves" became "helaian daun lamun", which is fine. "Decor should replicate" is fine.
Item 10: "Social: no" became "Hidup berkelompok: tidak". This is acceptable.
Item 12: the Indonesian keeps the awkward "Kelangsungan hidup zoea ... pada salinitas 35 dan 38" (as in the source). It also keeps "NH4+/NH3 dan NO2", which is fine.
Item 3: "Cape Grenville dan Port Denison" are left untranslated. Consider "Tanjung Grenville", but this is a minor point.

campylomormyrus-compressirostris.name: Ikan Gajah
notes: "Cacing darah beku": "bloodworm" is fine, but "pakan utama" for "basic food" is acceptable; no real issue beyond this, consider "pakan dasar".
"situasi penerbangan yang kurang memadai": "unsatisfying flight situation" is closer to "kurang memuaskan"; minor nuance.
"RD Kongo": more common form is "Republik Demokratik Kongo" or "DR Kongo"; spell out for readability.

campylomormyrus-tamandua.name: Worm-jawed Mormyrid
notes: Item 5: "menyebarkan (meredam) cahaya lebih jauh" is awkward; use "menyebarkan/melembutkan cahaya" (diffuse).

Item 11: "memiliki ukuran otak relatif yang setara dengan manusia" is clumsy and redundant after "memiliki otak yang relatif besar, yaitu"; rephrase, e.g. "dengan ukuran otak relatif setara otak manusia".
Item 1: "Worm-jawed mormyrid" left in English as the lead of the sentence; give a local gloss such as "mormyrid berahang cacing", or keep it in brackets after the Indonesian term.
Item 1/11: "ikan gajah (elephant fish)" is fine, but "Chad" in item 2 should be "Cad" in standard Indonesian.
Item 5: "Substrat pasir sangat penting" is acceptable, but "mengorek substrat" repeats the word; use "mengorek dasar".

canthophrys-gongota.name: Moose-faced loach
notes: Item 7: "mengambil segenggam substrat" renders "mouthfuls" as a handful; use "sesuap/segigit substrat" or "mengambil substrat dengan mulutnya".

carassius-auratus.name: Ikan mas koki
notes: Item 1: "Varian ikan mas koki" drops "We received ... from China" nuance; also "koki" and "mas koki" are used inconsistently for goldfish. Minor.
Item 4: translation is left out entirely (the stocklist code 808202 and the wholesale-only note). This is shop talk, so dropping it is allowed.
Item 7: "koki komet asli berasal dari ikan Crucian carp" – the Crucian carp should have an Indonesian name or at least be explained (ikan mas karper/Crucian carp). "tidak ada di alam" is acceptable.
Item 11: "Salinitas: tetap tumbuh baik hingga 6‰" – "good growth up to 6‰" is rendered loosely. "Tahan suhu tinggi" is fine.
Item 14: "pemakan dasar" is fine, but "kutu air (moina)" is acceptable. "Feeding every day should be roughly 2%" is ok. No serious errors.

Item 17: "Zebrafish" is rendered "Ikan zebra", yet the text says "zebra danio"; use "zebra danio" consistently. "Mas koki bertubuh panjang ... mereka bisa lebih cepat" is slightly vague (outpace in swimming).
Item 20: "Betina sebagian besar matang kelamin pada tahun ke-2" is awkward; use "umumnya matang pada tahun kedua".
Item 3: "Bertelur" for "Egg layer" is fine; "Top and mid-dweller" is OK.

Item 13: "Gunakan kerikil halus dan membulat" – English says "smooth, rounded", but "halus" may be read as fine-grained, which conflicts with "large enough not to be swallowed". Use "licin" or "mulus".
Item 15: "gigi geraham" for goldfish pharyngeal molars is imprecise; "gigi faring" is more accurate. Also "mas koki" and "koki" used inconsistently.

caridina-dennerli.name: Udang Cardinal Sulawesi
notes: "stres sementara" is slightly literal; "stres sesaat" or "stres jangka pendek" would read more naturally.
"spesimen hasil penangkaran di Jerman" is fine, but "German-bred" could be "hasil penangkaran Jerman" (minor). "pemelihara yang sudah ahli" could be "penghobi tingkat lanjut/ahli" (minor).

caridina-logemanni.name: Bee Shrimp
notes: "punya warna merah yang luar biasa banyak" is awkward; better: "menampilkan warna merah yang sangat pekat/intens" ("degree of red coloration").
"penangkaran ikan hias" for "breeding sports" is imprecise; "sports" means mutations/varian hasil mutasi, so use e.g. "munculnya varian mutasi (sport) pada ikan hias".
"udang kerdil" is not the usual hobby term; "dwarf shrimp" is commonly "udang hias/udang kerdil (dwarf shrimp)". Consider adding the English term in brackets.
Caridina logemanni should be italic as a Latin name if the format allows; the content is unchanged.

caridina-mariae.name: Udang Tiger
notes: "pemakan lapisan biofilm dan alga (grazer)": the English says "growth eaters" (Aufwuchs). "biofilm dan alga" is a reasonable interpretation, but it narrows the meaning a little; consider "pemakan aufwuchs/lapisan organisme yang menempel (grazer)".
"Tiger shrimps ... mau saja makan": "mau saja" is a bit casual. Use "dengan senang hati makan" or "mau makan".

"Sekali bertelur, 20–40 butir itu normal": "per litter" is better as "sekali menetas/per induk 20–40 telur"; the sentence is awkward. Also "induk jantan dan betinanya" for "mom and dad" is stiff; use "induknya" or "induk betina dan jantan".
"garis-garis hitam khas ala harimau": "khas" and "ala" are redundant. Use "garis hitam khas seperti harimau".
"Udang tiger": the commonly used term is "udang tiger" or "Tiger shrimp". Keep it consistent, and italics are not needed.
"beech, oak": untranslated English leaf names are left in place. Add the Indonesian equivalents (daun beech/"bangkuang"? no) or "daun beech, ek/oak" so that readers can understand them.
"hobi akuarium": "hobi" alone with "di hobi ini" is awkward. Use "dunia akuarium hobi" or "dalam hobi ini" and "di kalangan penghobi".

caridina-multidentata.name: Udang Amano
notes: Item 11: "solid white or lighter color line" translated as "garis putih pekat" – 'pekat' is odd for white; use "garis putih solid/tegas".

Item 10: "Para pemakan sisa" for scavengers is fine, but "Udang ini lebih memilih tidak makan alga" is okay; "kulit kosong" for exoskeleton should be "kulit/eksoskeleton bekas molting"; "bukan berwarna pekat" for solid-colored is awkward – use "bukan yang berwarna solid".
Item 12: "Endler" alone drops "livebearers" and "ikan mas koki" for goldfish is wrong (goldfish = ikan mas/maskoki); "corydoras catfish" ok.
Item 12: "bisa kalah bersaing dengan mereka" reverses meaning: English says Amano may outcompete cherry shrimp; should be "bisa mengalahkan mereka dalam berebut makanan".
Item 1: Hardness unit "dKH" retained fine, but "Sifat: Damai" ok; item 2: "semburat cokelat muda" for tan fine. Item 5: "selang aerator" fine.
Item 3: "merumput alga dan detritus sisa hewan air lainnya" ok; item 14: "deretan garis putus-putus" ok; item 16: "air payau berkadar garam tinggi atau air laut" ok.
Item 11: "komunitas" 'community player' fine; "hanya memanjang sebagian dari panjang tubuh udang" slightly clumsy.

caridina-pareparensis-parvidentata.name: Udang Pareparensis
notes: "berkembang biaknya sangat produktif" is slightly awkward; better "berkembang biak dengan sangat produktif" or "sangat mudah berkembang biak".
"Dalam semua kondisi ini udang ini tetap hidup" repeats "udang ini"; use "Pada semua kondisi tersebut, udang ini tetap hidup...".

"terkenal karena warnanya yang cerah, tapi juga terkenal susah dirawat" is a bit colloquial and drops the sense of "notorious" and "high demands on care"; consider "dikenal berwarna-warni namun terkenal menuntut perawatan tinggi".
"hobiis" is non-standard; use "penghobi" or "hobiis akuarium" in a more natural form.
"Pembiakannya sangat produktif" is stiff; use "Udang ini berkembang biak dengan sangat produktif".

caridina-rubropunctata.name: Leopard shrimp
notes: Item 12: "Seimbangkan pemberian pakan dengan pakan bubuk" is awkward; better "Lengkapi pemberian pakan dengan pakan bubuk".
Item 12: "berenang berputar-putar dengan heboh" is slightly colloquial; use "dengan liar/bersemangat".
Item 12: "Anakan udang tidak banyak berpindah tempat seperti udang dewasa" is ambiguous; use "tidak seaktif udang dewasa dalam berpindah tempat".
Item 2: "peternaknya" is odd for shrimp; use "penangkarnya" or "pembiaknya".
Item 6: "tidak tahan banting" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "tidak tangguh" or "kurang tahan".

Item 9: "Pakan" for the diet line is fine, but "siput yang dihancurkan" is better as "siput yang dihaluskan/dipecah"; "Lebih baik pakan kurang daripada berlebihan" is awkward, use "Lebih baik memberi pakan sedikit kurang daripada berlebihan".

carinotetraodon-borneensis.name: Buntal Borneo
notes: Item 13: 'Tetraodontidae umumnya disebut 'buntal'' — the English says 'Tetraodontids' (family members); fine, but 'Ikan buntal adalah ikan air tawar sekunder, dan sebagian besar anggotanya hidup khusus di lingkungan laut' is OK. The real issue: 'sirip dada ... diodontiform' fine.
Item 6: '54 liter' — the original says 'about 54 litres' and it is kept; no change needed except to make sure the rounding follows the 5-litre rule (use about 55 litres).
Item 3: 'Negara Bagian Sarawak' — use 'negeri Sarawak' or just 'Sarawak'; 'Negara Bagian' is awkward for Malaysia.
Item 10: 'hanya agak suka berkelompok' is awkward; use 'kecenderungan berkelompoknya lemah'. Also 'cyprinid' could be given as 'ikan cyprinid (famili Cyprinidae)'.
Item 9: 'aufwuchs' left untranslated; use 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan organisme renik pada permukaan)' or 'perifiton'.
Item 13: 'kejinggaan' is non-standard; use 'berwarna oranye kekuningan' or 'agak oranye'.
Item 13: 'tenggorokan tanpa tanda' is awkward; use 'tenggorokan tanpa corak'.
Item 13: 'dependant on species' was translated as 'bergantung pada spesies' which is fine; 'waktu dalam setahun' should be 'musim'.
Item 9: 'kerang-kerangan yang dicacah' for 'chopped shellfish' is acceptable, but 'cockles' as 'kerang' is too generic; use 'kerang darah' or 'kerang kecil'.
Item 2: 'hidup hanya di air tawar murni' is awkward; use 'hanya hidup di air tawar murni'.

carinotetraodon-irrubesco.name: Red Tail Red Eye Puffer
notes: Item 7: 'aufwuchs' is left as German jargon; add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan organisme renik pada permukaan)'.
Item 7: 'chopped shellfish' is rendered 'kerang yang dicincang', which duplicates 'cockles' (kerang). Use 'kerang/moluska cincang' or 'hasil laut bercangkang yang dicincang'.
Item 5: 'ditambahkan ke dasar akuarium' adds 'to the bottom of the aquarium', which the English does not say. Use 'Penambahan daun kering'.
Item 1: 'Red-tailed redeye puffer' stays in English with no gloss. Add a local name or gloss, for example 'buntal mata merah ekor merah'.

carinotetraodon-lorteti.name: Red Eye Puffer
notes: Item 11: 'Puffers are secondary freshwater fishes, with the majority of members exclusively inhabiting marine environments' is translated 'sebagian besar anggotanya hidup khusus di lingkungan laut' - fine, but 'Tetraodontidae... mostly inhabit coastal waters' fine; however 'Greater Sunda Islands' rendered 'Kepulauan Sunda Besar' OK. Real issue: 'tenggorokan tanpa tanda' / 'bagian perut tanpa tanda' is awkward for 'unmarked'; use 'tanpa corak/bercak'.
Item 10: 'fully absorbed within a couple of days' becomes 'habis terserap dalam beberapa hari'; 'couple' means about two days, so use 'dua hari'.
Item 10: 'perayuan' and 'jambul' (crests) are awkward; use 'proses pacaran' and 'lunas/jengger'. Item 9 'merayu betina' and 'pamer ancaman' are also stiff; use 'pamer gertakan' and 'saat pacaran'.
Item 11: 'Ikan famili Tetraodontidae umumnya disebut buntal' is mistranslated; 'Tetraodontids' should be tetraodontid, and 'sambungan di tengah' for 'median suture' should be 'sutura median'.
Item 7: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated; use 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)'. 'chironomid' is OK, but 'Pakan kering' should be clearer, e.g. 'pakan kering/buatan'.
Item 11: 'Ini satu-satunya famili tetraodontiform' is slightly unnatural; use 'Famili ini satu-satunya dalam ordo Tetraodontiformes'.

carinotetraodon-salivator.name: Striped Red Eye Puffer
notes: Item 2: type locality left in English: 'kilometer 10 on road to Simunjan ... Sarawak state, Borneo, East Malaysia'. Translate the descriptive parts (e.g. 'kilometer 10 di jalan menuju Simunjan', 'negara bagian Sarawak, Kalimantan, Malaysia Timur'); keep the place names and coordinates.

Item 4: '54 litres' for 60×30×30 cm. The source's own figure is kept, but check it. The volume is 54 L, so this is fine; only the wording 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran paling kecil' is awkward. Suggest 'sebaiknya merupakan ukuran minimum'.
Item 5: 'Ikan ini mungkin juga menyukai adanya sedikit arus air' is too tentative. 'may also be appreciated' is better as 'arus air yang sedikit juga akan disukai'.
Item 9: 'saat pacaran/pemijahan' adds 'pemijahan' (spawning), which is not in the source. Use 'saat pacaran' or 'saat penjajakan pasangan'.
Item 1/3: 'sungai kecil' for 'stream ~15 m wide' and 'berarus deras' for 'riffle' are slight shifts. 'Fast-flowing' is rendered as 'deras'; 'riffle' is better as 'riam dangkal'.
Item 11: 'Spesies ini termasuk dalam kelompok ... ' is fine, but 'MA' is used for 'million years ago'. Indonesian usually writes 'jtl' (juta tahun lalu), so 'MA' may confuse readers.
Item 11: 'dependant on species' is translated as 'bergantung pada spesies'. The sentence is correct, but 'waktu dalam setahun' is stiff; use 'musim'.

carinotetraodon-travancoricus.name: Pea puffer
notes: #24: both daphnia and moina are rendered "kutu air", so the two cannot be told apart. Use "kutu air (daphnia)" and "moina", or "kutu air" and "kutu air moina".
#32: "yang membatasi bintik-bintik kuning keemasan" is imprecise for "which mark the shining golden yellow spots". Better: "yang menandai" or "di sekitar bintik...".
#29: "Pea puffer bisa cukup jorok" is colloquial for "messy". "banyak menghasilkan kotoran" is more natural.

carnegiella-marthae.name: Black Wing Hatchetfish
notes: Item 1: 'stenotipik' is awkward, non-standard jargon; use e.g. 'penghuni khas/spesialis perairan air hitam'.
Item 11: 'tulang frontal bergelombang' and 'klad' are stiff; 'kelompok saudara' is acceptable but 'sister group' could be clarified.
Item 11: 'bukti anekdot dari para penangkap ikan' - 'collectors' is better as 'pengumpul/penangkap ikan hias'; 'tergeletak di lantai' is fine.
Item 3: 'berkembang biak' fine; 'menyebar ke samping' for 'laterally' is a bit loose; use 'bergerak ke samping'.
Item 7: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' - Daphnia/Moina are commonly called 'kutu air' but 'burayak artemia' is better as 'nauplii artemia' (burayak means fry).
Item 2: 'dengan sesekali spesimen juga tercatat' is awkward; rephrase as 'dan sesekali spesimen tercatat'.

carnegiella-myersi.name: Pygmy Hatchetfish
notes: #1/#11: "hatchetfish yang sudah diakui (bernama)" for "nominal hatchetfishes" is awkward; use e.g. "hatchetfish yang valid/dideskripsikan".
#4: "alas (dimensi permukaan)" is awkward for "surface area measuring"; simplify to "luas permukaan akuarium minimal 50 × 30 cm".
#5: "mudah sekali melompat, entah karena bermain..." is long and a little clumsy; consider splitting the sentence.

#11: "tergeletak di lantai (di luar akuarium)" adds a parenthetical not in the source; "Jadi, sudah jelas ikan ini memang suka melompat" is slightly adjusted wording. Use "di lantai" and "jelas bahwa ikan ini memang melompat".
#5: "Ranting kayu apung (driftwood)" is a bit off for "Driftwood branches"; use "ranting kayu" or "kayu apung/driftwood".

carnegiella-strigata.name: Marbled Hatchetfish
notes: Item 12: 'Characiformes' is left in the translation as an untranslated Latin name; this is fine, but 'klad' and 'jari-jari sirip' are somewhat technical. Consider 'gurat sisi' consistency; this is minor.

Item 9: 'lele callichthyid atau loricariid' is awkward. Consider 'lele callichthyid atau loricariid' → 'ikan lele callichthyid atau loricariid', or use the local names 'corydoras' and 'sapu-sapu' (for loricariids).

Item 12: 'dengan corak berbentuk Y ... Ia juga mencatat' is fine. But 'sama sekali terhambat' for 'completely restricted' is slightly awkward; 'sama sekali terbatas/tidak terjadi' reads more naturally.
Item 2: 'Butuh tutup akuarium yang rapat' repeats the sentence in the second part, as in the English source. This is acceptable.

catlocarpio-siamensis.name: Siamese Giant Carp
notes: Item 1: "Giant Carp" and "karper terbesar" are acceptable, but "ikan karper" could be "ikan mas/karper"; this is a minor point.
Item 2: "strange fish" is translated as "ikan unik". "Aneh" would be closer to the original, since "unik" changes the tone slightly.
Item 4: "ikan migrasi besar" is awkward. Use "ikan besar yang bermigrasi".
Item 4: "hampir tidak pernah sempat hidup cukup lama" is wordy. Use "hampir tidak pernah mencapai usia cukup dewasa untuk berkembang biak secara alami".
Item 4: "biotop dan habitat" is slightly redundant, but it mirrors the source.

catoprion-mento.name: Wimple Piranha
notes: Item 4: "137 liter" is a wrong conversion/rounding. The English gives about 137 litres, but the translator should round sensibly (e.g. "sekitar 135 liter"). Keeping the source figure unrounded is an inconsistency.

Item 8: "Terutama betina, ikan ini menjadi sangat agresif" changes the meaning. The English says females in particular become belligerent. Rephrase as "Terutama ikan betina menjadi sangat agresif saat dewasa dan akan terus-menerus menyerang jantan."
Item 8: "bisa habis sirip dan sisiknya" is awkward. Use "sirip dan sisiknya bisa terkelupas/habis dimakan dengan cukup cepat".
Item 11: "Secara iktiologi, spesies ini sebenarnya bukan piranha. Ia monotipik, sehingga unik." is stiff. "Monotipik" needs a clearer explanation, e.g. "satu-satunya anggota genusnya".
Item 11: "jenis ikan seperti ini" and "pemula di jenis ikan seperti ini" are awkward. Use "bagi pemula yang baru memelihara piranha".
Item 11: "perubahan kimia air yang tidak stabil" is a loose rendering of "uneven swings in chemistry". Use "fluktuasi parameter air".
Item 7: "lancefish" is left in English. Give an Indonesian equivalent (e.g. "ikan lancefish/ikan pedang kecil") or a brief gloss.
Item 3: "aliran-aliran cabangnya" is awkward. Simplify to "anak sungai dan cabang-cabangnya".

centrochir-crocodili.name: Centrochir crocodili
notes: #7: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is the old IUCN category name. Use "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Minimal", whichever the IUCN Indonesian usage prefers.
#7: "tidak berjari-jari" for "unrayed pectoral spines" is awkward. Use "duri sirip dada yang tidak bersegmen" or similar.
#7: "milik buaya" for "of a crocodile" is a bit unnatural. "Berkaitan dengan buaya" or "si buaya" is better.
#7: "sirip dadanya yang tajam dan dikenal bisa membunuh kaiman" is vague. Make it clear that the spines are known to kill caiman that try to eat the fish.
#4: "Nouvelle-Grenade" is left in French inside the type locality. This is acceptable as a quoted historical name, but consider adding "(Granada Baru)".
#4: "Lower and Middle Magdalena basin" is rendered "bagian hilir dan tengah". This is fine, but "diketahui berasal dari" is clumsy. Use "diketahui dari" or "tercatat di".
#1: "Ukuran: 210 mm SL" omits the (8.3") conversion. This is fine, but "SL" is not explained. Add "panjang standar (SL)".
#8: The citation is entirely untranslated, which is acceptable as a reference. "Title page" and "pp181" in it are left as they are.
#3: "Colombia Caribbean Rivers, Magdalena" is translated clumsily as "Sungai-sungai Karibia Kolombia, Magdalena". Use "sungai-sungai di wilayah Karibia Kolombia".
#2: "Doradidae" is described as "famili lele". Consider "lele berduri (thorny catfish)", because Doradidae are thorny catfishes and not true lele.

centromochlus-heckelii.name: Heckel's Driftwood Catfish
notes: Item 6: "shrimp" and "prawns" are rendered as "udang, dan udang kecil"; the distinction is blurred. Use e.g. "udang" and "udang kecil (shrimp)" or "udang besar"/"udang kecil" consistently.
Item 11: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah"; the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah"/"Resiko Rendah"; ok but check. Also "can be stung" lost the "nastily" nuance (minor).
Item 1/7: "lele driftwood" is a non-standard hobby term; consider "lele kayu apung" or keep "driftwood catfish" in brackets.
Item 7: "Ikan ini tidak pernah bersembunyi" is fine, but "dasar" for "ground" is okay; "dinding akuarium" fine. Minor: "boleh dibilang 99% waktunya dipakai untuk berenang" is slightly stiff.
Item 2: "seorang ahli lele kelompok ini" is awkward; use "ahli lele jenis ini".

centromochlus-macracanthus.name: Centromochlus macracanthus
notes: Item 9: 'It's sometimes included in the putative subfamily Centromochlinae' refers to the genus Centromochlus, but the translation 'Genus ini kadang dimasukkan ke dalam subfamili yang diusulkan, Centromochlinae' is acceptable. The next sentence 'Kelompok ini' is fine. No major issue here.
Item 9: 'jaringan lemak' for 'adipose tissue' is fine, but 'sirip lemak (adiposa)' is okay. No change needed.
Item 7: 'mau menerima' is awkward; use 'menerima' or 'mau memakan'.
Item 7: 'ikan lele' for catfishes in general is misleading, since these are not true lele (Clarias). Use 'ikan berkumis (catfish)' or keep 'catfish'.
Item 9: 'ikan lele lain' has the same problem as above. Use 'catfish lain'.
Item 5: 'bongkahan batu yang halus terkikis air' is awkward. Use 'bongkahan batu bulat yang terkikis arus'.
Item 8: 'jangka waktu yang belum diketahui' is fine. 'tidak ada pengasuhan dari induk' should read 'induk tidak merawat telur atau anakan'.

centromochlus-perugiae.name: Oil catfish
notes: Item 9: "Saat sedang mengandung telur, betina jauh lebih gemuk" – 'gravid' is fine, but 'mengandung' suggests pregnancy/live birth; better 'saat bertelur/penuh telur' (the species fertilises internally, so wording matters).

Item 10: "Betina menjaga telur sampai menetas, dan pada saat itu sebaiknya induk atau burayak dipindahkan ... agar burayak tidak dimangsa" – 'predation' is added as 'burayak'; the English says to avoid predation (eggs/fry), mild shift; also 'burayak' for fry is a regional/less common term, 'benih' or 'anakan' is more usual.
Item 8: 'burayak' is used for fry; Indonesian hobbyists typically say 'burayak' or 'anakan', acceptable but consider 'anakan ikan'.
Item 5: 'tumpukan kayu (bogwood)' – 'tangles of bogwood' is better 'jalinan akar/kayu bogwood'; 'tumpukan' loses the tangled sense.
Item 11: "berenang heboh melawan arus" is colloquial; 'frantically' better as 'berenang lincah/cepat'.
Item 1/10: 'lele' for auchenipterid is fine, but 'Oil catfish' left untranslated without local name; acceptable.
Item 4: Volume ~41 litres for 45×30×30 cm: 40.5 L, fine; however as a converted aquarium size the original figure is kept so no issue.

centromochlus-reticulatus.name: Purple Oil Catfish
notes: Item 4: "about 54 litres" was converted to "sekitar 54 liter", but the source figure is metric already (60×30 cm base), so it is fine. No fix needed for the number itself.
Item 7: "mau menerima sebagian besar pakan kering" is awkward. Use "mau memakan sebagian besar pakan kering yang tenggelam" or "menerima pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 11: "jaringan lemak" for "adipose tissue" is acceptable, but "mengesahkan kembali" (revalidated) is stiff. Use "mengaktifkan kembali / memvalidasi ulang".
Item 3: "dijuluki lele 'kayu' atau 'driftwood' (wood catfish atau driftwood catfish)" is redundant. Simplify it to "wood catfish" or "driftwood catfish".
Item 1: "Reticulated driftwood catfish" is left as the English common name with no local gloss. Consider adding something like "lele kayu apung" or "lele kayu".

centromochlus-romani.name: Roman's Woodcat
notes: Item 1: "Least Concern/Risiko Rendah" is slightly awkward; the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" – use the bracket format.
Item 2: "Daerah aliran Sungai San Juan" is acceptable but "Daerah Aliran Sungai (DAS) San Juan" is more natural; "anak Sungai San Juan" is fine.

cephalocassis-melanochir.name: Ikan duri
notes: Item 1: "Famili" is acceptable, though "Famili" vs "Suku" is a minor choice; consider "Suku (Family)".
Item 4: "Pemijahan" is fine; "Breeding: Unreported" could also be "Belum dilaporkan" (minor).

cephalosilurus-apurensis.name: Cephalosilurus apurensis
notes: Item 1: "lele predator" is acceptable, but "para penggemar ikan jenis ini" is slightly repetitive; could be "penggemar ikan lele jenis ini".

cephalosilurus-fowleri.name: Rusty Jelly Catfish
notes: Item 6: "paling tangguh dan agresif" adds "agresif"; the English "most bullish" means the most robust/pushy. Also "yang jauh lebih besar dan paling tangguh" is a clumsy rendering of "considerably larger company". Suggest "bersama ikan yang jauh lebih besar dan bertemperamen paling kuat".
Item 1: "Pocoma (Brasil)" is fine, but "ikan lele" for Greek silouros/"cat fish" and "lele berjambul" is acceptable; consider "patin/lele" only if a local trade name exists. Minor.
Item 7: "area kelamin (venting)" is slightly awkward; "sangat mudah dikenali" is OK, but "dimorfisme seksual" could be kept for fidelity.

ceratoglanis-scleronema.name: Ceratoglanis scleronema
notes: Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" – the IUCN Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah"/"Risiko Rendah"; acceptable but check consistency. Leave as is if the glossary uses it.
Item 1: "sungut maksila yang kaku dan bengkok seperti kait" – "hooked" is rendered with redundant phrasing; simplify to "kaku dan membengkok/berkait".
Item 2: "rentan terhadap syok" is slightly awkward; "sangat sensitif terhadap guncangan/stres (syok)" would read more naturally.
Item 7: "kerabat segenusnya" is awkward; use "satu-satunya spesies lain dalam genus yang sama".

cetopsis-coecutiens.name: Blue Whale Catfish
notes: Item 8: "Dalam kondisi seperti ini ikan ini jauh lebih aktif" repeats "ini". Use "Dalam kondisi seperti itu, ikan ini jauh lebih aktif".

chaca-chaca.name: Frogmouth catfish
notes: Item 14: "begitu mendekat terlalu dekat" is redundant and awkward. Use "begitu terlalu dekat" or "saat mendekat terlalu jauh/dekat".
Item 7: "daun oak/ek" is an unnatural slash alternative. Use just "daun oak".
Item 14: "di bawah naungan gelap" is awkward for "under cover of darkness". Use "dalam kegelapan" or "saat gelap".

chaetobranchopsis-orbicularis.name: Orbicularis cichlid
notes: Item 2: "sekhusus ini" is non-standard and awkward. Use "sekhusus itu" or rephrase, e.g. "ikan dengan kebutuhan pakan yang sangat khusus".
Item 4: "kutu air" for daphnia is acceptable. Consider "daphnia (kutu air)" to avoid confusion with other small crustaceans.

chaetostoma-fischeri.name: Bulldog Pleco
notes: Item 1: 'chaite = rambut' – source says 'chaite = hair'; fine, but 'Bedanya dengan Ancistrus: tidak ada tentakel...' is awkward; better 'Berbeda dari Ancistrus karena tidak memiliki tentakel berdaging di moncong'.

Item 5: 'Habitatnya berdasar campuran' is awkward; use 'Menghuni dasar perairan yang beragam (pasir, kerikil, batu, lumpur)'. 'tumbuhan tepi sungai' for 'riverine vegetation' is acceptable but redundant with riparian.
Item 8: 'Pemakan alga yang hebat' is slightly informal; 'subsidise this food' is rendered OK. 'pakan tablet tenggelam' better 'tablet tenggelam (sinking tablet)'.
Item 9: 'menelungkupkan sirip ini' for 'inverting' is questionable; 'membalikkan/melipat' may be more accurate. 'jantan mencegah' adds explicit subject but is fine.
Item 12: Attribution is ambiguous in English; 'sahabat terkasih Steindachner, W. Fischer' ordering is acceptable. 'bulu kaku' for bristles is OK; 'odontoda' fine.
Item 3: 'Colombia Caribbean Rivers' rendered as 'sungai-sungai Karibia Kolombia' – acceptable.
Item 6: 'untuk mendapatkan air yang kaya oksigen' is a slightly awkward rendering; use 'agar air tetap kaya oksigen'.
Item 4: 'ke selatan sampai Kolombia bagian barat laut' is fine; 'belum dihitung' for 'not quantified' ok.

chaetostoma-formosae.name: Chaetostoma formosae
notes: Item 9: 'sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' suggests actively laying; 'sedang membawa telur / bunting telur' is more accurate.
Item 5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is slightly awkward for 'water-worn'; 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus teraus' or 'bulat terkikis arus' reads better.

chaetostoma-leucomelas.name: Magdalena Tiger Chaetostoma
notes: Item 1: 'Magdalena Tiger Chaetostoma' kept fine, but the 'Etimologi' dropped 'Greek' for the second term: 'chaite = rambut + stoma = mulut' is OK; no issue. Main issue is item 1 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)': IUCN category should be 'Berisiko Rendah' / 'Kekhawatiran Rendah' (standard Indonesian: 'Risiko Rendah' is acceptable but check consistency).

Item 2: 'sungai-sungai Kolombia yang bermuara ke Pasifik/Karibia' adds 'bermuara' interpretation; original is 'Colombian Pacific rivers' (drainage), acceptable but wordy; consider 'sungai-sungai di lereng Pasifik/Karibia Kolombia'.
Item 6: 'Pemakan alga yang hebat' is slightly informal; use 'Pemakan alga yang sangat baik'. 'algae wafer' should be given as 'wafer alga'.
Item 7: 'Sirip perut yang sangat besar ini ... menelungkupkannya' - 'inverting' is better rendered 'membalikkannya'; 'pelvic' fins as 'sirip perut' fine.
Item 8: 'sirip perut (ventral)' fine; 'warnanya lebih bagus' is informal, use 'warna lebih cerah/menarik'.
Item 3: 'dideskripsikan' acceptable; 'di sepanjang pesisir' is fine.
Item 10: 'tutup insang (odontoda interoperkular)' fine; 'duri' for odontodes is ambiguous but acceptable.

chaetostoma-marginatum.name: Chaetostoma marginatum
notes: Item 5: "Sudah pernah dipijahkan di akuarium. Belum ada laporan pemijahannya." mirrors a contradictory source, but verify; translation is faithful, so no change needed unless source intended "Has not been bred". Consider flagging to editor.

Item 4: "Mungkin sirip perut yang sangat besar ini berperan penting" and "ikan jantan mencegah" – source says 'they prevent' (the fins); better "sirip tersebut mencegah sel sperma terbawa" to avoid adding the male as subject.
Item 4: "menelungkupkan" for 'inverting' is awkward; use "membalikkan/melipat sirip di atas telur".
Item 1: "Pelafalan: KATE oh STOW mah" fine; but "Risiko Rendah" is the official IUCN term "Berisiko Rendah"/"Risiko Rendah" – acceptable; "Lokasi tipe" better "Lokasi tipe (type locality)".

Item 6: "the species has spines" -> "spesies-spesiesnya memiliki duri" is fine, but "duri di belakang tutup insang" for interopercular odontodes is imprecise; use "odontoda interoperkular (duri kecil seperti gigi)".

chagunius-chagunio.name: Chagunio Barb
notes: Item 5: "setup" is left in English; use "tata aquascape/penataan akuarium" or "set-up" in brackets.

Item 5: "luas permukaan untuk koloni bakteri yang diinginkan" is ambiguous, because "yang diinginkan" seems to modify the bacteria. Rephrase it as "kadar oksigen, arus, dan luas permukaan koloni bakteri yang diinginkan/memadai".

chalceus-erythrurus.name: Tucan Fish
notes: "lembah Amazon" for "Amazon basin": "cekungan/DAS Amazon" is more accurate than "lembah"
"paling pas dibandingkan dengan spesies ikan trout asli": awkward; use "paling tepat dibandingkan dengan ikan trout asli (setempat)"
"cabang pohon beech": use "ranting kayu beech" (aquascaping term)
"bisa suka bertengkar": redundant; use "bisa agresif/suka berkelahi terhadap sesamanya"

chalceus-macrolepidotus.name: Pinktail Chalceus
notes: Item 10: "Burayaknya" is a typo/non-standard; use "Anakan ikannya" or "Burayak".
Item 10: "setelah kuning telurnya habis terserap" is awkward; use "setelah kantung kuning telur terserap habis".
Item 1/5: "jago melompat" is colloquial; prefer "pelompat ulung" or "suka melompat".
Item 8: "cocok untuk banyak akuarium komunitas berukuran besar" is slightly awkward; use "cocok ditambahkan ke banyak akuarium komunitas yang lebih besar".
Item 7: "menunya" is informal; use "porsi pakannya".
Item 1: "Pinktail chalceus" left in English; add the local name or "chalceus ekor merah muda" if one exists.

chalinochromis-brichardi.name: Chalinochromis brichardi
notes: Item 2: "bisa disamakan dengan" is a bit literal for "can be compared with"; more natural: "mirip dengan / dapat dibandingkan dengan genus Julidochromis"; minor.
Item 1: "Cichlid" left in English; the local hobby term "siklid" is also common, though "cichlid" is widely used, so this is only minor.

champsochromis-caeruleus.name: Malawi Trout
notes: Item 10: "to dissipate this aggression" is rendered "untuk menyebarkan agresi". Better: "meredam/mengalihkan agresi" (spread across several females). The phrase is acceptable but vague.

Item 10: "Some breeders artificially strip the fry" is rendered "mengeluarkan burayak secara manual". At the 2-week stage these are eggs/embryos, so say "telur/larva". "Peternak" is better as "pembudidaya". "burayak" is also used for the free-swimming fry, which is OK.
Item 7: "kerang hijau, kerang dara" for "mussel, cockle" is a plausible match. "lancefish" is left in English; add a gloss such as "ikan lance (sand lance)" or a local equivalent.

Item 8: "Frontosa" and "Mbuna" are fine. "yawn of an adult specimen" is translated as "lebar bukaan mulut" (gape width). This drifts from the original meaning "menguap/bukaan mulut"; the nuance is minor.
Item 8: "A male can be kept along with several females, but are territorial" is OK. "Hap" in item 10 is unexplained; consider "Haplochromis (Hap)".
Item 4: "bare minimum" is rendered "batas paling minimal". Use "minimum mutlak".
Item 1: "Bedanya dengan C. spilorhynchus ada pada..." is fine. "menjelajah" is acceptable. Consider "berkeliaran" or "mengembara" for "roams".

champsochromis-spilorhynchus.name: Champsochromis spilorhynchus
notes: Item 8: 'Frontosa' is fine, but 'The best tankmates are those inhabiting the bottom part' is OK; however 'ikan apa pun yang terlalu besar untuk masuk ke mulutnya' reverses the logic: should be 'ikan yang terlalu besar untuk masuk ke mulutnya' (not 'apa pun'), otherwise reads as aggression toward anything.
Item 10: 'kerang hijau, kerang dara' for mussel and cockle is acceptable, but 'lancefish' left untranslated; use 'ikan lancefish (sand lance)' or 'ikan lance/teri' explanation.
Item 10: 'untuk menyebarkan agresi' is imprecise; should be 'untuk mengurangi/membagi agresi jantan' (dissipate).

Item 10: 'Sebagian peternak mengeluarkan burayak secara manual' - 'strip' is stripping the brood from mouth; better 'mengambil telur/burayak dari mulut induk secara manual'. At 2 weeks they are eggs/embryos, not fry.
Item 10: 'Tampaknya tidak ada tempat pemijahan yang dibuat' is okay, but 'Hap fashion' translated as 'cara khas Hap' leaves 'Hap' unexplained; use 'haplochromine'.
Item 8: 'Frontosa' and 'Mbuna' may be fine, but 'jantan bisa dipelihara... tetapi jantan bersifat teritorial' loses subject clarity; ok.
Item 4: 'ukuran minimum mutlak' is acceptable for 'bare minimum' but 'minimal' sounds more natural; also 'liter' is fine.
Item 7: 'Ikan ini adalah predator pengejar' is awkward; use 'predator pemburu yang mengejar mangsanya'.

channa-andrao.name: Channa Andrao
notes: Item 2: "Salah satu spesies channa terkecil dan paling berwarna ini baru dideskripsikan belum lama" is awkward, with a stray "ini" and a redundant "baru ... belum lama". Suggest "Salah satu spesies channa terkecil dan paling berwarna baru saja dideskripsikan."
Item 6: "Ikan hanya keluar" is minor and fine, but "Liang-liang ini berisi air permanen" could read more naturally as "Liang ini selalu berair".

channa-argus.name: Gabus Argus
notes: Item 7: 'Suhu: 0–30 °C' is kept from the source, which is fine, but check the range. Not a translation error.
Item 2: 'minimal 2 m' is fine, but 'Butuh' is informal for a handbook. Use 'Memerlukan' or 'Membutuhkan'.
Item 8: 'ikan umpan/pakan' is awkward for 'feeder fish'. Use 'ikan pakan (feeder fish)'.
Item 8: 'ikan mas koki' is redundant. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish'; 'koki' alone is fine.
Item 6: 'pandai kabur' is slightly informal. Use 'terkenal sering meloloskan diri'.
Item 1: 'Ukurannya bisa mencapai 85 cm' is correct. 'channa berukuran besar' for 'large snakehead' is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Spesies ini ... terkadang tertukar' is fine. 'sirip dubur' is correct. 'sisik di bagian atas dan samping kepala' is OK.
Item 11: The references are left untranslated, as allowed.
Item 10: 'dorsal and lateral scales on head small' is rendered as 'sisik di bagian atas dan samping kepala'. This is acceptable.

Item 9: 'Belum tercatat berhasil dipijahkan di akuarium' adds 'berhasil'. 'Unrecorded in aquaria' means not recorded as bred in aquaria. The meaning is intact, but 'dibudidayakan' for 'bred' is acceptable.

channa-asiatica.name: Channa asiatica
notes: Item 8: "Atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, merupakan kompleks spesies..." is a sentence fragment. Join it to the previous sentence, e.g. "...banyak varian, atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, kompleks spesies...".
Item 8: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for fish. "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 4: "Parameter air tidak berpengaruh" is a bit loose for "irrelevant". "tidak penting" or "tidak menjadi masalah" would be more natural.

channa-aurantimaculata.name: Channa Auranti
notes: Item 4: "tidak segeneralis banyak spesies Channa lain secara ekologis" is stiff. Something like "kurang bersifat generalis secara ekologis dibanding banyak spesies Channa lain" would read more naturally.
Item 8: "Predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is understandable but not the usual term. "Karnivora obligat" or "pemangsa murni" would be clearer.

channa-bankanensis.name: Channa bankanensis
notes: "jenis channa" for "snakehead species" is fine, but consider "ikan channa (snakehead)" for consistency; minor.
"Pada tahap ini kamuflase dibutuhkan" is slightly stiff; consider "Pada tahap ini kamuflase menjadi penting".
"Anakan Channa" mixes capitalised genus with a lowercase "channa" elsewhere; use consistent casing ("anakan channa").

channa-baramensis.name: Channa baramensis
notes: Item 3: "sekitar 243 liter" – the volume should be rounded sensibly (e.g. "sekitar 240 liter"), but this is minor. The more serious problem is in item 7.
Item 7: "ruang ini bukan labirin" – the English says the chambers are not labyrinthic (not a labyrinth organ); better "bukan organ labirin", otherwise unclear.
Item 1: "divalidasi ulang" – "revalidation" is better as "dinyatakan valid kembali"; "Wajib memakai tutup" is stronger than the English "Needs".
Item 4: "pandai kabur" – "notorious for their ability to escape" is better as "terkenal sering meloloskan diri".

Item 6: "ikan mas koki kecil" – the English says "small goldfish", so "ikan mas koki" is acceptable, but "cacing darah" for chironomid larvae is fine. "livebearer" is left untranslated; use "ikan vivipar (livebearer)".
Item 6: "jantung sapi atau ayam" is ambiguous, because it can read as "cow heart or chicken". Rephrase as "jantung sapi atau daging ayam".
Item 7: "Ng. et al." – keep the citation form consistent with item 1, "Ng et al.".
Item 8: the references are left untranslated, which is correct.

channa-bleheri.name: Channa Bleheri
notes: Item 8: "jantung sapi atau ayam" could be read as chicken heart; say "daging ayam" or "daging sapi (jantung) atau daging ayam".
Item 10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; "saat sedang bunting telur" or "saat membawa telur" is better.

Item 12: Several terms are left in English, such as "isthmus", "hypurapophysis", "urostyle", "epibranchial" and "branchial". Add Indonesian forms (e.g. "tulang epibrankial", "pelat gigi brankial") or put them in italics.

channa-burmanica.name: Channa Burmanica
notes: Item 4: '(sekitar 243 liter)' – the English volume was kept as a precise figure; the volume is a calculated approximation, but the unit conversion rule says round sensibly; at least round to '(sekitar 245 L)' or '(sekitar 240 liter)'. Minor.

Item 8: 'dengan dugaan kelompok spesies C. gachua menurut Britz (2008) yang mencakup...' is awkward and distorts 'putative ... assemblage'; rephrase, e.g. 'kelompok spesies C. gachua (diduga) menurut Britz (2008), yang terdiri atas...'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'memberi ikan pakan hidup seperti ikan livebearer' loses the 'feeder fish' meaning; use 'ikan umpan (feeder)' instead of 'ikan pakan hidup'.

Item 7: 'pakan mati' for 'dead alternatives' is ok, but 'ikan dewasa mau makan ... udang sungai hidup' is fine; 'Predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' should be 'predator obligat/karnivora murni'. Minor.
Item 5: 'terkenal pandai kabur' is a little colloquial; use 'terkenal sering melarikan diri/melompat keluar'.
Item 2: 'Kecamatan Putao' – 'township' in Myanmar is usually 'distrik/kota praja'; 'Kecamatan' is an Indonesian administrative term. Minor.
Item 8: 'sirip dubur' for anal fin is okay but hobbyists typically say 'sirip anal'; 'predorsal' left untranslated ('sisik predorsal' -> 'sisik di depan sirip punggung'). Minor.
Item 1/8: 'Channa burmanica adalah channa (snakehead)' - 'ikan gabus/channa' commonly; fine, but 'tampaknya endemik' is OK.

channa-diplogramma.name: Channa Diplogramma
notes: "jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "terkenal sering meloloskan diri".
"Ikan juvenil dan remaja" for subadults: "remaja" is OK but "subadult" might be clearer; consider "ikan juvenil dan subdewasa".
"hitam muda" for "light black" is awkward; use "abu-abu" or "hitam pucat".
"ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder' fish: use "ikan pakan (feeder)"; "umpan" suggests fishing bait.
"divalidasi ulang" is a bit stiff; consider "dinyatakan sah kembali sebagai spesies tersendiri".
"tinggi badan lebih kecil" for "lesser body depth": "tinggi badan lebih rendah" is better; also "jarak pra-anal" for "pre-anal length" should be "panjang pra-anal".
"sirip ekor, punggung dan kepala" - "dorsal surface" is the back, not the dorsal fin; use "bagian punggung".

channa-gachua.name: Channa gachua
notes: Item 12: 'northeastern India' was translated as 'India timur laut', which is acceptable. The real problem is 'Greater Sunda Islands' → 'Kepulauan Sunda Besar', which is fine, so it is not listed.

Item 12: 'sides of body without numerous black spots' → 'sisi tubuh tanpa banyak bintik hitam' is acceptable. But 'The second-last point' → 'Poin kedua dari terakhir' refers to the wrong item because the list was reordered. Check that it still points to 'no bars on upper portion of body'.

Item 12: 'Ruang inilah yang memungkinkan ikan menghirup udara... di air miskin oksigen' is fine. However, 'pelat kepala' for 'cephalic plates' and 'sisik epidermis' are unclear. Use 'sisik kulit (pelat kepala)'.

Item 8: 'Predator sejati (obligat)' is awkward. Use 'predator obligat'. 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'cepat beradaptasi' adds 'cepat' (quickly), which is not in the source ('adapting well'). Use 'dapat beradaptasi dengan baik'.
Item 8: 'ikan umpan hidup (feeder)' is slightly off for 'feeder fish'. Use 'ikan pakan (feeder)'.
Item 5: '243 litres (64 US gal)' → the translation dropped the gallon figure, which is allowed. However, 'Volume yang disebutkan' is vague. Use 'Volume yang dianjurkan'.
Item 2: 'pandai kabur dari akuarium' is a bit colloquial for 'notorious for their ability to escape'. Use 'terkenal sering lolos'.
Item 9: 'galak terhadap sesama spesies lainnya' is awkward. Use 'agresif terhadap ikan sejenis lainnya'.
Item 10: 'sirip dubur' is non-standard. Hobbyists use 'sirip anal'. 'sedang mengandung telur' is acceptable, but 'bunting' is not used for fish.

channa-harcourtbutleri.name: Channa harcourtbutleri
notes: "sangat tidak rewel" kurang natural; lebih baik "sangat mudah beradaptasi / tidak menuntut".
"Channa yang sangat jarang ditawarkan" menghilangkan "snakehead"; pertimbangkan "ikan channa (snakehead)" agar sesuai istilah hobi.
"tergantung suasana hati" terlalu harfiah; "tergantung kondisi/mood ikan" lebih alami.
"spesies yang sah" kurang tepat; gunakan "spesies valid".

channa-lucius.name: Channa lucius
notes: Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but "Pemijah bebas yang kedua induknya ikut menjaga" in item 9 is awkward; rephrase as "Pemijah bebas biparental (kedua induk ikut menjaga)".
Item 2/6: "pandai kabur" is colloquial for 'notorious for their ability to escape'; use "dikenal sangat mahir meloloskan diri".
Item 4/10: "miskin oksigen" for 'hypoxic' is OK, but "hipoksia/kadar oksigen rendah" is more standard in the hobby.
Item 10: "spesies yang sah" for 'valid species' is a literal rendering; use "spesies valid".
Item 6: "Tanaman permukaan" should be "tanaman terapung" for Ceratopteris, the hobby term.
Item 2: "channa predator" is inconsistent with the English 'snakehead'; keep consistent as "snakehead predator".

channa-maculata.name: Channa Maculata
notes: "Sebagai teman satu akuarium, hanya ikan yang lebih besar daripada channa yang dipelihara yang cocok" is clumsy; use "hanya ikan yang lebih besar daripada channa yang dipelihara yang cocok sebagai teman satu akuarium" or simplify.
"tidak akur" for "incompatible" is fine, but "cukup tidak akur" is awkward; use "bisa cukup agresif satu sama lain" or "sering berkelahi".
"mencegah kematian ikan" for "avoid losses" is OK; "a detailed daily check" is rendered as "dengan teliti", so consider "pemeriksaan harian yang cermat".
"dipotong memanjang" for "cut into strips": better "dipotong menjadi potongan memanjang (strip)"; the current wording is slightly ambiguous.
"spesies yang masih bisa dipelihara": "masih" is added and slightly shifts the nuance of "can be maintained"; consider "yang cocok dipelihara".

channa-marulioides.name: Channa Marulioides
notes: Item 11: 'feeder fish ... livebearers or small goldfish' translated as 'ikan umpan hidup'; 'ikan mas koki kecil' is redundant/wrong (goldfish = 'ikan mas koki' or 'koki'); also 'tend not have high nutritional value' is OK, but fix the goldfish term.
Item 11: 'dried foods ... should never form the staple diet' rendered 'jangan sampai dijadikan pakan utama' loses 'never' strength; use 'tidak boleh sama sekali dijadikan pakan utama'.
Item 14: 'chevron' described as 'huruf V' then kept as 'chevron'; fine, but 'gurat sisi ke-17-20' ambiguous; use 'sisik gurat sisi ke-17 sampai 20'.
Item 14: 'DAS Mekong' for 'Mekong basin' OK; but 'danau-sungai' for 'riverine lake system' is awkward; use 'sistem danau paparan banjir/sungai'.
Item 6/14: 'Danau Sentarum ... in Kalimantan, Borneo' drops 'Borneo' - minor omission.
Item 14: 'Kalimantan' for 'Indonesian Borneo' drops 'Indonesian' nuance; use 'Kalimantan, Indonesia'.
Item 7: 'tenggelam' in quotes for 'lost' is a bit odd; use 'terlihat hilang/kecil sekali' ('mudah stres karena kurang terlindungi' not stated; avoid adding).
Item 1: 'Kemungkinan besar ikan ini bisa tumbuh sebesar C. marulius' changes 'likely to have the potential' slightly; and 'relationship of' = 'kelompok' rather than 'kerabat'.
Item 2: 'hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)' is an interpretive expansion; just 'pelagis'.

channa-melasoma.name: Channa melasoma
notes: Item 8: 'ikan umpan hidup (feeder)' is OK, but 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' is fine; however 'Predator obligat' is non-standard — use 'predator sejati/karnivora murni'.
Item 8: 'tend not have a high nutritional value unless properly conditioned' is rendered ok, but 'Begitu juga' is slightly stiff; prefer 'Demikian pula'.

Item 5: 'Volume: ~243 liter' is retained from the source's unit; verify it matches 120×45×45 cm (≈243 L) — it's a derived figure, fine, but 'Kedalaman air tidak terlalu penting' loses nuance of 'less important' (than base area); say 'kurang penting dibanding luas alas'.
Item 9: 'sisik gular' and 'jari-jari sirip anal' mix terms; use 'sirip dubur' for anal fin, the standard Indonesian term.
Item 9: 'sisik gurat sisi 50-54' should be 'jumlah sisik gurat sisi' (lateral line scales count); 'pangkal sirip punggung' fine.
Item 2/6: 'terkenal pandai kabur' is colloquial; prefer 'terkenal suka meloloskan diri'.
Item 1: 'teman satu akuarium' acceptable but 'penghuni akuarium lain (tankmate)' is more common.
Item 9: 'kerabat segenusnya' awkward; use 'spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama'.

channa-orientalis.name: Channa Orientalis
notes: Item 4: "Volume: about 81 litres" is kept as "sekitar 81 liter"; this is the given figure, so leave it as is unless the source needs rounding. Check it against the 90 × 30 cm base and the 30 cm depth.
Item 7: "feeder fish" is translated as "ikan pakan hidup", which adds "hidup" (live). Use "ikan umpan/ikan pakan" and keep the meaning of feeder fish.
Item 5: "Channa spp. terkenal pintar kabur" is too colloquial. Use "terkenal sering meloloskan diri" or "pandai melompat keluar".
Item 8: "teman tangkinya" is wrong for aquarium tankmates. Use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain" instead of "tangki".
Item 1: "channa" is used to translate "snakehead" without the common term. Add "ikan bogo/gabus (snakehead)" or keep "snakehead" consistently.
Item 10: "burayak" and "anakannya" are mixed for fry. Use one consistent term, and "Pengasuhan anak" should be "perawatan anakan".
Item 10: "saling melilit" for the anabantoid embrace is acceptable. "ikan labirin" is fine, but "Setelah dilepas" lacks the subject of the fry being released from the mouth; clarify.
Item 3: "Mystus vittatus" and the other Latin names are fine. "Hutan tua" for "old forest" is slightly awkward. Use "hutan primer/hutan asli".
Item 11: "Telah diusulkan adanya kelompok-kelompok filogenetik yang berbeda. Kelompok spesies C. gachua menurut Britz (2008)" drops the word "putative" (diduga). Add it.

channa-ornatipinnis.name: Channa Ornatipinnis
notes: "Burma" is acceptable, but "Myanmar" is the more common Indonesian usage; consider "Myanmar (Burma)".

"Para pengepul" for "collectors" is fine, but "kolektor" or "penangkap" might fit the hobby context better; "tidak mau membuka lokasi persis" could be more natural as "tidak mengungkapkan lokasi pastinya".

channa-panaw.name: Channa panaw
notes: Item 3: "Warnanya memang tidak terlalu mencolok, walaupun ..." followed by "Meski begitu" is slightly redundant in concessive structure; could be smoothed.
Item 1: "Snakehead (channa) yang tergolong kecil" is fine, but "comparatively small species" could be "relatif kecil"; minor wording only.

channa-pleurophthalma.name: Channa Pleuro
notes: Item 6: "sehingga tidak perlu ganti air secara rutin" adds a causal link and narrows "regular maintenance" to water changes only. Use "dan tidak memerlukan perawatan rutin" to match the source more closely.
Item 3: "Kalimantan, Indonesia" drops "Indonesian Borneo". Consider "Kalimantan, Borneo Indonesia".
Item 8: "ikan mas koki kecil" for "small goldfish" is too specific, since the English means ordinary feeder goldfish. Use "ikan mas kecil" or "goldfish kecil".
Item 6: "jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "terkenal pandai melompat keluar/meloloskan diri".

channa-stewartii.name: Channa Stewartii
notes: "Selain ikan hidup maupun ikan mati": awkward; better "Selain ikan hidup maupun mati" or "ikan hidup dan ikan mati".", ""mau makan pelet stik": source says "sticks" (food sticks); "pelet stik" is fine but "pelet" is an added specificity, consider "stik pakan".", ""Channa ini" in sentence 1: "This snakehead" is better rendered as "Ikan bandotan/gabus" or "Snakehead ini"; "Channa ini" is slightly vague but acceptable.", ""Karena habitat aslinya tidak berada di wilayah tropis": fine meaning, but "tidak berada di wilayah tropis" could be more natural as "bukan di daerah tropis".", ""pengeram mulut": common hobby term is "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram telur di mulut"; consider "ikan pengerami mulut".

characidium-fasciatum.name: Characidium fasciatum
notes: Item 1: "Warna ikan muda berbeda dari ikan dewasa" — the English only says juveniles have divergent coloration; "dari ikan dewasa" is an added comparison. Use "Warna ikan muda berbeda (menyimpang)" or similar.

Item 4: "These tetras are among the few fish that can move their heads" is rendered literally, but "Tetra ini termasuk segelintir ikan..." is fine. The real problem is "duduk bertumpu pada sirip dadanya ... di suatu tempat yang tinggi", which is stiff. Use "bertengger" and "titik pengamatan".
Item 4: "punya banyak struktur" is vague for "well structured". Use "ditata dengan banyak dekorasi/tempat berlindung".
Item 2: "Untuk sementara waktu" suggests a temporary stay. The English means a temporary cool period each year. Use "Selama periode tertentu (beberapa minggu setahun)".
Item 3: "South American darter" is left in English. Add a local term such as "ikan darter Amerika Selatan", with italic or bracketed English if needed.
Item 5: "mustahil diidentifikasi" is too strong for "almost indeterminable" ("hampir" is already there). This is acceptable, but "di dunia akuarium" for "aquaristics" is fine.

characodon-lateralis.name: Rainbow Goodeid
notes: Item 5: "Arus yang tidak kuat ... juga wajib" is stiff. Consider "Arus air sebaiknya tidak kuat, dan ganti air sebagian perlu dilakukan rutin".
Item 10: "hamil" and "Masa kehamilan" for a fish are slightly odd. "bunting" or "masa kebuntingan" is also common among hobbyists.

charax-condei.name: Small-scale Glass Tetra
notes: Item 1: "mengancam teman setangki yang jauh lebih kecil" – 'jauh' is not in the English ('much smaller' is, actually, fine), but 'sejauh ini' for 'known only' adds a slight hedge ('so far') not in the source; use "hanya diketahui dari".
Items 1 and 2: "Sejauh ini hanya diketahui" adds 'so far' not in the English; drop "sejauh ini".

Item 3: "sungai kecil, kali, dan anak sungai ... juga sungai-sungai yang lebih kecil" is repetitive and ambiguous ('streams' and 'smaller rivers' both become 'sungai kecil'); rephrase, e.g. "sungai kecil, anak sungai, dan sungai yang lebih kecil".

Item 5: the 'alternatively ... well maintained, heavily planted tank' clause lost 'well maintained' nuance as 'terawat'; also "bisa hidup baik" is fine, but "setup yang lebih umum" should be "setup akuarium umum biasa" for clarity.
Item 8: "gerombolan" sounds like a gang of people/animals; use "kelompok" or "sekawanan" for shoal; "Loricariidae kecil" could be "ikan Loricariidae kecil (sapu-sapu)".
Item 1: "karasin" is a rare term for characin; Indonesian hobbyists typically write "characin" or "ikan characin"; add the English in brackets at first use.

charax-stenopterus.name: Rainbow Robber Tetra
notes: "punya warna yang cerah": the English says "especially colourful" (cerah/mencolok). This is fine in meaning but "tidak ada yang menyangka ... cerah" is slightly weaker. Consider "sangat berwarna-warni".
"nama dagangnya": the English says "common name". Use "nama umumnya" instead, because "nama dagang" means trade name.
"jadi berwarna": too weak for "became colourful". Use "menjadi berwarna cerah" or "warnanya muncul".
"saat ditangkap di alam": "when collected" does not mean "in the wild". Use "saat dikumpulkan/ditangkap". "di alam" is a small added detail.
The sentence structure is reordered: "pemasoknya mengklaim ... dan klaim itu sempat diragukan". It is acceptable but a little wordy. "memang" is repeated twice in the last sentence.

chela-cachius.name: Silver Hatchet Chela
notes: #6: '90 × 30 cm (about 81 litres)' — the converted volume is wrong for the tank. Use a listed tank size or a sensible whole-litre rounding (e.g. 'sekitar 80 liter'); do not keep the odd 81.

#15: 'sejumlah spesies yang dulu masuk genus ini' — the English says 'a number of former species' are now in related genera, so make it 'sejumlah spesies yang dulunya termasuk di sini' and keep the sense clear. The wording is acceptable but can be more precise.
#2: 'ikan cyprinid' and 'hatchet fish' are left in English. Use 'ikan sepat/cyprinid (suku Cyprinidae)' and add a local name, or keep the trade name consistently.
#1/#19: 'ikan barb terbang' is a literal rendering of 'flying barb'. Use the name hobbyists use ('flying barb' or 'chela'). Also, 'yang berenang' after a comma reads clumsily; drop the comma.

cherax-boesemani.name: Lobster Blue Moon
notes: Item 4: "Irian Jaya (Papua Barat)" – the English says West New Guinea; "Papua Barat" is a wrong gloss, so use "Irian Jaya (Nugini Barat)".

Item 2: "tidak dilarang di wilayah Anda" – the English says "state"; "negara bagian/wilayah" is acceptable, but "Florida ... ported" was rendered as "dibawa masuk"; check that this matches the intended "imported/transported" meaning.

Item 1: "Blue Papuan crayfish, Rainbow crayfish, Supernova crayfish, Blue Marble crayfish" – the other names were left in English with no Indonesian equivalent, so add "lobster" forms or italic marking for consistency.
Item 6: "Jangan buang kulit bekas molting" – it is fine, but add that the crayfish eat it to recover calcium. This is a minor omission only if the context requires it.
Item 8: "tempat yang sempit dan pas dengan tubuhnya" – 'tight-fitting' is rendered with extra wording; 'hanya filter gantung ... yang cocok' is fine.
Item 7: "Suhu: 24–31 °C" – fine, but "jadi makin kurang aktif" is slightly awkward; use "semakin tidak aktif".
Item 12: "Anakan suka bersembunyi dan hampir selalu tersembunyi" is repetitive; use "Anakan pemalu dan sebagian besar waktunya bersembunyi".

Item 5: "20-gallon long" was converted to "sekitar 80 liter" and "akuarium memanjang" – the conversion is fine (~76 L), but the term 'long' as a tank format is dropped from the number context; check that this is consistent.
Item 4: "Nama spesiesnya diambil dari Dr. Marinus Boeseman" – fine, but 'first collected it' should be "yang pertama kali mengoleksinya"; the subject is ambiguous.

Item 10: "Meski ukurannya besar" – 'Despite their size' should be tied to the crayfish with "Meski berukuran besar"; also "teman setangki yang buruk" is a calque, so use "Tidak cocok dipelihara bersama".

cherax-holthuisi.name: Lobster Apricot
notes: Item 5: "(bisa sambil diaerasi)" is not in the English; delete it or keep to the source's "Diamkan air selama beberapa hari".
Item 3: "tersembunyi di bawah tanah" and the added sentence "hidup di dalam liang" expand "lives underground". Use something like "hidup di bawah tanah, bukan di tempat terbuka".

cherax-pulcher.name: Lobster Pulcher
notes: Item 12: "khawatir jika Lukhaup membawanya pergi" names the author/researcher where the English says "he"; fine to keep as a pronoun like "ia". Use "jika ia membawanya".
Item 12: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard/awkward for "pinkish". Use "merah muda keputihan" or "merah jambu pucat".
Item 1/12: "Pembiakan: sedang hingga sulit" conflicts with the text saying it is not difficult; this follows the source, but "Pembiakan" in the spec list is fine. No change needed beyond consistency.
Item 7: "tidak cocok dipelihara dengan tanaman" is a loose rendering of "not plant safe". Use "tidak aman bagi tanaman".
Item 9: "tidak hidup berkelompok" is slightly off for "not social". Use "tidak bersifat sosial".
Item 11: "sangat tertutup" is unnatural for "very secretive". Use "sangat pemalu/suka menyembunyikan diri".

Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya sudah matang" is fine, but "aklimatisasi" is okay; "pipa paralon (PVC)" is okay. Minor: "anggota tubuhnya" in item 11 is vague for appendages. Use "kaki renang (pleopoda)".

cherax-quadricarinatus.name: Lobster Red Claw
notes: Item 17: "individu yang baru molting rentan dimangsa" is fine, but "Anakan ... belum bisa hidup terpisah dari induknya selama 7–10 hari pertama, lalu meninggalkan induk dalam 1–3 hari" is OK; however "Tanpa pakan yang tepat, mereka menjadi kanibal" is fine. Main issue: item 17 'Kematangan ... berat badan sekitar 50–120 g' fine.

Item 3: "Lobster dewasa memiliki panjang 10–12 cm" contradicts the other items' 25–35 cm. This is faithful to the source, so no change is needed. Item 3 'penyiksaan hewan' for 'cruelty to animals' is acceptable.
Item 1: "sedangkan betina tetap sedikit lebih kecil" - 'tetap' is slightly awkward; use 'betina sedikit lebih kecil'.
Item 5: "Papua bagian selatan" for 'southern New Guinea' narrows it to Indonesian Papua only; use 'Nugini bagian selatan' (Papua Nugini/Papua).

Item 8: "siklus nitrogennya sudah matang" - 'properly cycled' is commonly rendered 'sudah cycling/matang'; acceptable, but 'Molting' being heading-like text and 'pra-molting/antar-molting' are awkward; consider 'pra-ganti kulit', 'antar-molting' -> 'masa istirahat antar-molting'.

Item 11: "Lobster dewasa tetap baik meski diberi pakan" is awkward; use 'tetap tumbuh baik'. 'Daphnia' rendered as 'kutu air' is fine, but 'brine shrimp' and 'artemia' are duplicated without distinction.
Item 10: "mereka aktif di malam hari" fine. 'mencuil' is non-standard; use 'menggerogoti/menyobek'.
Item 12: "benar-benar bisa akur" and 'butter soft' rendered 'sangat lunak' loses the imagery but is acceptable.
Item 16: 'Ini setara dengan panjang total sekitar 4,5–6 cm' fine; 'dimangsa' in item 17 for 'prone to cannibalism' is slightly changed meaning: use 'rentan menjadi korban kanibalisme'.
Item 15: 'jantan memiliki lubang gonopore pada salah satu kaki ke-5, betina pada kaki ke-3 yang berlawanan' faithful but awkward ('opposite' = sisi lainnya); clarify.

cherax-snowden.name: Cherax Orange Tip
notes: Item 1: "(Kepala Burung)" is not in the English; it is harmless, but it can be dropped to keep the text faithful.
Item 3: "datang tercampur sebagai tangkapan alam" is slightly literal; "umumnya tersedia/diperdagangkan dalam keadaan tercampur sebagai tangkapan alam" would read more naturally.

cherax-tenuimanus.name: Lobster Marron
notes: Item 12 Colour: 'Generally dark marron' translated as 'marun gelap' – fine, but item 1 'Colour: Brown' vs. this is ok; however 'Cherax tenuimanus ... managed as 'critically endangered'' rendered 'kritis' – should be 'sangat terancam punah/kritis (critically endangered)'; wording incomplete.
Item 12: 'Cherax ... "a kind of lobster" or "crayfish"' rendered 'udang karang' – udang karang means marine spiny lobster; use 'lobster air tawar'/'crayfish'.

Item 11 Hatching: 'cannot live separately from the mother for a further 2–4 weeks' is ambiguous/wrong: should say they cannot live apart from the mother for another 2–4 weeks ('belum bisa hidup terpisah dari induknya hingga 2–4 minggu berikutnya').
Item 11 Eggs: 'dari situ sekitar 150–250 anakan dilepaskan' – 'from which' (from the eggs), phrasing misleading; say 'dari telur-telur itu'.
Item 12 Description: 'Smooth marron ... compared with Smooth marron' fine, but 'dark marron' colour: 'marun gelap' ambiguous with the animal name; use 'cokelat kemerahan tua'.
Item 9: 'Terutama jantan, mereka berkelahi' awkward; 'Peaceful: No' ok. 'serasah' for 'debris' (item 3 'woody debris' = 'serasah kayu') – serasah means leaf litter; use 'puing kayu/kayu lapuk'.
Item 8: 'sayuran rebus (blansir)' – blanched is 'direbus sebentar', not plain boiled.
Item 12 Description: 'ada duri pada telsonnya' ok; 'Kini varian biru elektrik dibudidayakan' ok. Item 6 'mortality' -> 'terjadi kematian' ok.

chilatherina-bleheri.name: Rainbow Bleheri
notes: "Endangered" (Terancam): Indonesian IUCN term is "Terancam Punah"; use "Terancam Punah (Endangered)".
"Daftar Merah Spesies Terancam Internasional": standard name is "Daftar Merah IUCN" / "Daftar Merah Spesies Terancam IUCN"; phrasing is awkward.
"Penangkapan ... tidak berperan, apalagi semua ikan...": "apalagi" is slightly off; "terlebih lagi karena" is more natural.
"sudah dikoleksi pertama kali": use "pertama kali dikoleksi pada tahun 1982"; "sudah" is a slight mistranslation of "as early as"; use "sedini tahun 1982".
"Pakan: omnivora": fine, but "ikan damai yang hidup bergerombol" is okay; "Irian Jaya" is now Papua, which is optional to add.

chilodus-punctatus.name: Spotted Headstander
notes: Item 7: 'kutu air (daphnia, moina)' is loose; Daphnia and Moina are water fleas, and 'live Daphnia, Artemia, Moina' lists three separate foods. Keep the three items in the original order.
Item 7: 'sedikit buah-buahan dari daratan' adds 'sedikit' (a little) where the source says 'some'. Use 'buah darat' or 'buah-buahan terestrial'.
Item 1: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically-immature' is an interpretation. 'Akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis' is closer.
Item 4: '90 × 30 cm ... sekitar 81 liter' leaves out the tank height. Check that the 81 L figure matches the source.
Item 8: 'cekcok' for 'squabbling' is a bit informal. 'Perselisihan kecil' would suit a handbook better.

Item 1: 'Spotted headstander' is left as a trade name, which is fine. 'Danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is acceptable, but 'danau tapal kuda' is a less common term for hobbyists. 'Danau oxbow' is more usual.

chiloglanis-polypogon.name: African Suckermouth Catfish
notes: Item 2: "antarspesiesnya sangat sulit dibedakan" is awkward and unclear. Rephrase it, for example "antarspesiesnya" → "spesies-spesiesnya sangat sulit dibedakan satu sama lain".
Item 17: "kolam/kurungan alami" is vague for "natural enclosures". Use one clear term, for example "kandang/enklosur alami".

chitala-blanci.name: Royal Knifefish
notes: Item 4: 'Mekong hulu, Kamboja utara' is fine, but item 3 is not: the English lists 'Thailand, Laos, and Cambodia' and the ID matches, so no change needed there. The real problem is in item 5: 'perairan berarus kuat' is fine.

Item 12: 'Terhadap sesama jenis dan teman satu akuarium yang tidak bisa dimangsa, ikan belida sangat damai' is acceptable, but 'Chitala' is translated inconsistently as 'ikan belida' here and elsewhere. Use 'belida' consistently, and give the common name 'Asian featherback' where it is used.
Item 1: 'sirip punggung berkembang baik' is stiff; use 'sirip punggung yang berkembang baik'.
Item 8: 'kayu rendam' for driftwood is non-standard; use 'kayu apung' or 'driftwood'. 'aliran/sirkulasi' should be one term.
Item 11: 'ikan mas koki kecil' is fine, but 'kebanyakan bisa beradaptasi dengan baik dengan pakan mati' reads awkwardly (double 'dengan'). Rephrase it.
Item 11: 'predator sejati' for 'obligate predator' is acceptable, but 'obligate' means it must feed on animal prey. Consider 'predator obligat'.
Item 18: the 'Text & photos' byline is dropped, which is correct. No fix needed.
Item 16: 'memijah di atas batu' is OK. 'Pada musim kawin' should be 'musim pemijahan' for fish.

chitala-lopis.name: Ikan Belida
notes: Item 1/9: "Ikan remaja yang lebih besar" for "Older juveniles" is slightly off; "remaja yang lebih tua/besar" is acceptable, but "ikan remaja menjelang dewasa" is more natural.
Item 7: "ikan koki kecil" for "small goldfish" is fine; "ikan umpan (feeder)" is slightly awkward, "ikan pakan (feeder fish)" is more common among hobbyists.

Item 3: "alur sungai utama" for "main river channels" is slightly stiff; "badan sungai utama/aliran utama sungai" reads more naturally. "lower basins" is rendered as "bagian hilir", which is acceptable.
Item 1: "Giant featherback" is left in English with no Indonesian name or explanation. This is acceptable as a trade name but could be set in italics or given a gloss.

chitala-ornata.name: Clown Knife
notes: Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'small goldfish' as feeder; 'ikan mas koki' is redundant/awkward, use "ikan mas koki" or "koki kecil" consistently.
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder fish' is loose; prefer "ikan pakan (feeder)".
Items 1/11: "leucistic" left in English; use "leusistik" or add a local term.
Items 1/11: "dikembangkan lewat penangkaran selektif khusus untuk pasar ini" - 'line-bred for the purpose' is slightly over-interpreted; use "dikembangbiakkan secara line-breeding untuk tujuan itu".
Item 11: "populer tanpa alasan yang jelas" - 'inexplicably' fine, but "sirip anal ... menyatu dengan sirip ekor" OK; "Notopterid" could be glossed as "ikan famili Notopteridae".
Item 7: "Predator sejati" for 'obligate predator' is acceptable but "predator obligat" is more precise; sentence "mau menerima ... juga pelet kering" is slightly clumsy.
Item 6: Fahrenheit dropped, which is fine; no issue.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" - hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "bogwood"; "kayu apung" means floating wood and may mislead.

chlamydogobius-eremius.name: Desert Goby
notes: Item 4: 'Volume: sekitar 41 liter' keeps an awkward unrounded figure; 41 L should be rounded to about 40 liter.
Item 1: 'dipelihara tanpa campuran spesies lain' is awkward; use 'dipelihara sendiri/tanpa ikan lain'.
Item 3: 'cekungan endoreik' is a rare term; the bracket gloss helps, but 'cekungan tertutup' is more natural.
Item 3: 'tidak hidup di danaunya sendiri' is awkward; use 'di danau itu sendiri'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'Daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)' is clearer to hobbyists.
Item 9: 'sirip perut' is fine, but 'Jantan dewasa punya rahang yang relatif lebih besar' is slightly awkward; 'lebih besar' is fine, no real fix needed.

chonerhinos-naritus.name: Golden Puffer
notes: Item 5: "remah pakan di daunnya" – source says morsels of food on the leaves; 'remah' (crumbs) is acceptable, but "si buntal melihat" is fine. Main issue is elsewhere.
Items 1/5: Original gives sg of 1.005 (specific gravity); fine. But item 1 'butuh garam laut' lacks the 'marine salt' qualification; use 'garam akuarium laut'.

Item 7: "kerang-kerangan/moluska" is clumsy and wrong: 'shellfish' here includes crustaceans (crab legs, prawns). Use 'hewan bercangkang/kerang dan krustasea'; 'unshelled shellfish' should be 'tanpa cangkang/dikupas', but the translation says "yang masih bercangkang" – this reverses the meaning (unshelled = cangkang sudah dilepas).

Item 11: "ikan ini keliru disamakan dengan ikan-ikan yang mirip" – 'keliru' is repeated twice; and 'genus Chonerhinos' kept as in source, fine. Smooth: "benar-benar menjadi hewan peliharaan sejati" is redundant.
Item 11: "1000 kali lebih mematikan" – 'over 1000 times deadlier' ok. 'si buntal' / 'buntal' vs 'ikan buntal' inconsistent but minor.
Item 1: "mudah menggigit hingga sobek bagian tubuh ikan lain" is awkward; 'bite chunks from' = 'menggigit sebagian tubuh ikan lain hingga terkoyak'.

chromidotilapia-guntheri.name: Guenther's mouthbrooder
notes: Item 2: 'Kamerun barat daya' is fine, but 'Pantai Gading (Côte d'Ivoire) bagian tenggara' OK; however 'Guinea Khatulistiwa' placed between Pantai Gading and Ghana changes the English country order — minor, fine.
Item 5: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically immature aquarium' is acceptable, but 'pasir yang halus dan lembut' adds redundancy; minor.

Item 8: 'ikan karasin (characid)' – 'pelagic' rendered as 'berenang di kolom air' is OK, but 'karasin' is nonstandard; use 'characid' or 'tetra'. 'breeding' left in English; use 'pembiakan'/'pemijahan'.
Item 7: 'Di alam' added, whereas the English says 'by nature' – acceptable; but 'pipet yang tajam' is awkward: 'ujung pipet atau pisau kecil yang tajam' (sharp applies to the knife/pipette end).
Item 4: '108 liter' – the English gives about 108 litres; fine. Item 1: 'bentofag' for 'benthophagous' fine; 'Sungai Niger dan Benue' is acceptable.
Item 10: 'pengeram mulut ovofil yang bertelur di substrat' loses 'biparental, paternal' ordering but meaning kept; 'burayak' is correct but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
Item 3: 'Hampir selalu menghuni' slightly weaker than 'almost exclusively' — use 'Hampir secara eksklusif'/'Nyaris hanya menghuni'.
Item 11: 'klad chromidotilapiine' is hard to read for hobbyists; add 'kelompok (clade)'.

chrosomus-erythrogaster.name: Southern redbelly dace
notes: Latin name 'Chrosomus erythrogaster' should ideally be italicized/marked as a species name; not a real error.
'ikan minnow' is acceptable but could add a note, e.g. 'ikan minnow (sejenis ikan kecil karper)'; optional.

cichla-kelberi.name: Ikan Kelberi
notes: "baru dikenali sebagai spesies tersendiri" adds slight nuance ("as a distinct species") not in the English "only recognized"; consider "baru dikenali pada tahun 2006" (very minor).
"sirip perut" and "sirip anal" are fine, but "sirip anal" could be "sirip dubur" for consistency; optional.

cichla-monoculus.name: Peacock Bass
notes: Item 4: The English says '(length x height x width)', so it is a source oddity. The translation keeps '305 x 91 x 122 cm' with 'panjang x tinggi x lebar' faithfully. Still, 305 cm length with 122 cm width is implausible and the item 1 bullet says 'at least 2 m long'. The translation is faithful, so this is not an error.

Item 1: The tank size '305 x 91 x 122 cm' is kept as in the source, so no change is needed. 'Ikan ini sering dijual saat masih anakan kecil, padahal ukurannya bisa mencapai sekitar 80 cm' adds a contrastive 'padahal' that the English does not have. Use 'dan' or 'namun' with a neutral tone.

Item 7: 'whitebait (ikan-ikan kecil sejenis teri)' is an added explanation, and calling whitebait 'sejenis teri' is not exact. Keep 'whitebait' alone, or use a neutral gloss such as 'ikan kecil'. 'ikan lancefish' is also awkward. Use 'lancefish (sand eel)' or an established local name.

Item 8: 'pari air tawar' and 'catfish besar' are acceptable. 'Bisa dipelihara berkelompok dengan sesamanya' is fine. 'Untuk bisa berhasil' drops the link to keeping them with other large species. Say 'Agar pemeliharaan semacam ini berhasil, dibutuhkan akuarium yang sangat besar'.
Item 9: 'benjolan di kepala (nuchal hump)' is acceptable. 'Nuchal hump' is the hump on the nape, so 'benjolan di dahi/tengkuk' is more accurate than 'kepala'.

cichla-ocellaris.name: Cichla ocellaris
notes: Item 7: "whitebait (ikan teri kecil)" is a loose gloss. Whitebait are small juvenile fish, such as herring or sprat, and are not necessarily anchovies. Consider "whitebait (anakan ikan kecil)".

cichla-orinocensis.name: Orinoco Peacock Bass
notes: Item 4: "lembah Amazon" is an odd rendering of "Amazon basin"; use "daerah aliran Sungai Amazon" or "Amazon" for consistency with the other items.
