Item 10: "Bisa dipelihara dalam kelompok sesama spesies" is slightly awkward, and "catfish besar" could be "lele besar" or "ikan cat besar".
Item 12: "jenong" is a regional term for the nuchal hump (usually used for louhan or arowana); consider "benjolan di kepala/tengkuk (nuchal hump)".
Item 16: "ikan sport fishing" is awkward; use "ikan buruan untuk olahraga pancing (sport fishing)".
Item 6: "isi akuarium dibuat cukup minim" is vague; use "dekorasi dibuat secukupnya/jarang".
Item 5: "kalau realistis" is awkward; use "secara realistis".

cichla-temensis.name: Peacock Bass Temensis
notes: "dipancing sebagai ikan sport fishing" (items 1 and 10) is awkward. Use "dipancing untuk olahraga (sport fishing)" or "menjadi target pemancingan olahraga".
"Speckled pavon" and "peacock bass" are left in English. This is acceptable, but you could add a local name or gloss such as "bass merak" on first use.

cichlasoma-boliviense.name: Bolivia Cichlid
notes: Item 8: "agresinya terbagi ke banyak ikan" is slightly awkward; better "agresi tersebar ke banyak ikan" or "tidak terfokus pada satu ikan".
Items 1/8/11: "agresi" and "agresinya" are acceptable, but "keagresifan" or "sifat agresif" is more natural.
Item 5: "Tidak terlalu rewel" for "Not critical" is acceptable but could be "Tidak terlalu menuntut/tidak krusial".

cichlasoma-trimaculatum.name: Trimac
notes: Item 4: '48" x 15" x 15"' became '122 × 38 × 38 cm' — 15 in is ≈38 cm, so this is correct; but the 'US gal' figure was dropped, which is fine. No issue here.

Item 11: 'Bentuk aslinya yang alami lebih disukai' loses the point of 'We prefer it in its natural state' (preferring the fish over the flowerhorn hybrid); rephrase neutrally, e.g. 'Spesies alaminya lebih disukai daripada hibridanya'.
Item 11: 'cukup jorok saat makan' is awkward for 'fairly messy eaters'; use 'makannya cukup berantakan / banyak menghasilkan sisa'.
Item 6: 'sekitar 15 GH' should be 'dGH'/'gH' as in the source; 'GH' alone is acceptable, but 'sedang' plus 15 is fine—keep unit consistent (15 dGH).
Item 9: 'mungkin lebih berwarna' is awkward; use 'mungkin warnanya lebih cerah/mencolok'.
Item 5: 'bogwood' in brackets after 'kayu' is imprecise; use 'kayu apung/driftwood (bogwood)' or 'akar kayu'.
Item 2: 'populasi liar' for 'feral populations' loses the introduced/escaped sense; use 'populasi liar introduksi' (e.g. 'populasi yang berkembang liar hasil introduksi').

cincelichthys-bocourti.name: Bocourti
notes: Item 3: "mancing sport" is informal and mixed; use "memancing (game fishing)" or "pemancingan olahraga". "perch" and "tarpon" are left in English; consider "ikan perch (kakap/baronang)" or add a short gloss.
Item 8: "gerombolan characin" sounds negative (like a gang). Use "kelompok" or "sekumpulan" for shoals.
Item 11: "Chisel-toothed" in quotes is left untranslated. Consider adding the local form, e.g. "cichlid gigi pahat".

cincelichthys-pearsei.name: Pearsei Cichlid
notes: Item 1: "tanaman apa pun pasti akan dimakan" – "pasti" is added certainty; English just says "will be eaten". Remove "pasti".
Item 1: "hampir sepenuhnya herbivora" for "vegetarian" is acceptable, but "air sadah dan basa" drops the nuance; fine.

Item 5: "Obviously a large biological filter is required" – "Tentu saja" okay, but sentence reorders to "ikan sebesar ini membutuhkan filter biologis yang besar"; fine. "sangat ideal" is redundant; use "ideal".
Item 6: "Lebih menyukai air netral hingga basa" is fine, but pH range wording okay.

Item 8: "ikan lele/catfish" and "cyprinid besar" — use "ikan lele (catfish)" and "cyprinid (suku ikan mas)" consistently; "Loricariidae (pleco)" changes the source term Loricariids to a family name plus trade name, minor.

Item 10: "memijah di substrat dan kedua induk ikut menjaga" for "bi-parental substrate spawner" is slightly loose; use "pemijah substrat dengan kedua induk menjaga telur dan anakan" – the source does not say 'menjaga' explicitly, avoid adding.
Item 10: "hal ini memungkinkan" is awkward; use "hal ini mungkin dilakukan".
Item 3: "withstand these conditions long term" – "ia" for fish is stiff; use "ikan ini".

Item 11: "garis vertikal pendek" for "short vertical bars" – "bar" is better rendered "pita/strip vertikal"; "garis" (lines) changes the pattern meaning slightly. Also "spesies anggota" is awkward; use "spesies yang menjadi anggotanya".

cirrhinus-caudimaculatus.name: Cirrhinus caudimaculatus
notes: Item 2: the source quote is truncated, with an unclosed bracket. The translation matches it, which is fine. 'Lokasi tipenya' could be 'Lokalitas tipe' or 'Lokasi tipe (type locality)'. This is minor.
Item 1: 'sawah atau lahan yang tergenang' adds 'sawah' (rice paddies) for 'inundated fields'. Use 'lahan yang tergenang' or 'padang banjir' instead. Item 3 uses 'lahan yang tergenang' and is fine.
Item 4: 'garis lateral' for 'lateral stripes' can be confused with the lateral line (gurat sisi). Use 'garis memanjang di sisi tubuh' instead.
Item 4: 'tinggi badan 3,5–3,8 kali dalam panjang standar' is slightly awkward. Use 'tinggi badan 3,5–3,8 kali lebih pendek dari panjang standar' or 'termuat 3,5–3,8 kali dalam SL'.
Item 4: 'ditangkap' for 'collected' is acceptable, but 'dijumpai' or 'dikoleksi' fits better in a scientific context.

cirrhinus-molitorella.name: Mud Carp
notes: Item 4: "larger growing fish" rendered as "ikan yang ukurannya bisa jadi besar" is slightly awkward; better "ikan yang tumbuh besar".
Item 4: "Ikan ini memang ditujukan untuk..." adds "memang" and changes the sense of "This is aimed at" a little. Consider "Ini ditujukan bagi...".
Item 4: "ikan yang melawan kuat saat dipancing" is a clumsy rendering of "strong fighter". Better "petarung tangguh saat dipancing".
Item 1: "Omnivora" is fine, but "pemakan segala" is the more common term for hobbyists.

citharinus-citharus.name: Moonfish
notes: Item 4: "ikan tambakan atau kissing gourami (Helostoma)" is wrong: ikan tambakan is Helostoma temminckii, so it is fine, but "night tetra (Semaprochilodus)" is left in English. Prochilodontids are not tetras, but the source says so, so keep it and consider "night tetra" in italics or brackets.
Item 4: "Yang paling menonjol" for "Most worth mentioning" is a bit off. Use "Yang paling patut disebutkan".
Item 4: "aufwuchs" is German and unfamiliar to Indonesian hobbyists. Use "aufwuchs (alga dan organisme penempel)" or "alga dan mikroorganisme yang menempel pada permukaan".
Item 1: "Spesies berukuran besar ini" is fine, but the original "The large species" is generic. Consider "Spesies yang besar ini" so it does not read as a bigger version of a smaller one.
Item 3: The repeated sentence "Cocok untuk akuarium yang sangat besar" mirrors the source, but it is redundant. Merge or vary it, e.g. "Hanya cocok untuk akuarium berukuran sangat besar".
Item 6: "Ikan berbentuk cakram perak yang tenang" is a fairly loose rendering of "silver discs". Use "cakram perak yang tenang ini" to keep the metaphor and avoid implying a disc-shaped fish.

clarias-anfractus.name: Clarias anfractus
notes: "Daftar Merah IUCN: Risiko Rendah (Least Concern...)" is acceptable, but "Clarias comes from Greek chlaros, lively" fine; main issue below.

"Kalimantan (Borneo)" / "perairan Kalimantan": the English says Borneo, and the type locality is in Sabah (Malaysian Borneo). Calling it Kalimantan implies Indonesian Borneo and is misleading; use "Borneo" for Sabah and the Malaysian part.
"Lokasi tipe" is non-standard; use "Lokalitas tipe" or "Lokasi tipe (type locality)".
"sedikit naungan" and "mudah diterima ikan ini" are okay, but "Pipa tanah liat" would read more naturally as "pipa tanah liat (clay pipe)" — minor.
"balashark" for silver shark is fine, but "spanner barb" and "tinfoil barb" are left in English without Indonesian equivalents (e.g. "barb tinfoil", "ikan lampam") — minor.
"pp18" in the reference is untranslated, which is fine.

clarias-angolensis.name: Lele Angola
notes: Item 8: "Belum ada laporan pemijahan di akuarium" adds "di akuarium"; the English only says "There is no breeding report". Remove "di akuarium" or use "Belum ada laporan pemijahan".
Item 6: "silver shark/bala shark" adds an alternative name. Keep it simple with one established name, e.g. "silver shark".

clarias-batrachus.name: Lele kampung
notes: Items 2 and 12: "leucistic" is left in English. Give an Indonesian term or gloss, for example "leusistik (albino parsial)".
Items 2 and 6: "jago sekali kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use something like "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 3: "Yang sudah pasti, ikan ini hanya diketahui dari..." is awkward. Use "Hanya diketahui dengan pasti dari daerah aliran sungai di Jawa".
Item 2: "sangat predator" is a little unnatural. Use "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa yang ganas".

clarias-buettikoferi.name: Clarias buettikoferi
notes: Item 1: "Silver Sharks" is rendered "bala shark" – fine, but "Nama spesiesnya diambil dari J. Büttikofer" is okay; however "Clarias... Yunani chlaros" fine. Main issue: "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is acceptable, but 'Etimologi' sentence 'Nama ini merujuk' adds nothing wrong.

Item 6: "Must be housed with lively, robust large fish" – "ikan besar yang lincah dan kuat" OK, but "Silver Sharks" → "bala shark" is a different common name usage; verify. "cyprinid" left untranslated; prefer "ikan suku Cyprinidae/cyprinid (karper-karperan)".
Item 9: "sungut panjang seperti cambuk" for "flagellate barbels" is loose; "epibrankial" and "superbrankial" are non-standard; consider "epibranchial" kept in Latin form or "lengkung insang".
Item 9: "Jari-jari sirip anal" and "sirip dada" fine; "depressed head" as "kepala pipih" is acceptable (dorsoventrally flattened).

clarias-camerunensis.name: Lele Kamerun
notes: Item 6: Added Latin names not in the source ("Balantiocheilos melanopterus", "Barbonymus schwanenfeldii", "Barbodes lateristriga"). The English gives only common names, so these are added facts, and the species identifications are unverified. Remove them or keep only the common names.
Item 6: "Silver Sharks" is rendered "balashark". That is fine, but "Teman satu akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Tankmate" is usually "teman sekolam/penghuni akuarium lain".
Item 1: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is a non-standard rendering. The IUCN Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah"; keeping the English in brackets is fine, but check the wording.

Item 9: "epibranchial" and "superbranchial" are left untranslated, and "suprabranchial" later in the same item is a different spelling of the same term. Use consistent wording, e.g. "organ suprabranchial" throughout.
Item 3: "20–27 °C" drops the decimal precision of 20.0-27.0. This is acceptable, so no change is needed unless exact consistency is wanted.

clarias-gariepinus.name: Lele dumbo
notes: #1: "Lele bernapas udara" fine, but "tidak rewel soal kualitas air" is OK; the added sentence break "Karena itu lele sangat cocok untuk budidaya" is fine. Real issue: last sentence "di seluruh dunia selama suhunya memungkinkan" is misplaced and ambiguous; rephrase: "...dibudidayakan di seluruh dunia di tempat yang suhunya memungkinkan".
#4: "Initially ... originates from Africa" -> "aslinya berasal dari" is redundant; use "Lele ini berasal dari Afrika".

#5: "Asia Minor" translated as "Asia Kecil" is okay, but "nearly Pan-African" -> "hampir di seluruh Afrika" fine; "di hulu pertemuan dengan Sungai Riet" for "above the confluence" is acceptable. "Asia: Jordan..." ok.
#7: "sangat predator" is unnatural; use "sangat bersifat predator / sangat buas (pemangsa)". "teman setangki" -> "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" / "tank mate" is more usual.
#9: "deformed bred fishes" rendered "anakan yang cacat" is acceptable; "peternak" -> "pembudidaya" is more standard for fish breeders.

#10: "Sungut rahang atas ... pangkal sirip perut" - "insertion of the pelvic fins" is okay. "Tinggi badan 6–8 kali dalam panjang standar" is awkward; use "tinggi badan 6–8 kali lebih kecil dari panjang standar". "Bangau marabou" ok.
#11: Reference list left untranslated – acceptable.

clarias-insolitus.name: Clarias insolitus
notes: Item 1: "Etimologi... chlaros ... lincah atau penuh semangat" is fine, but "Pengucapan: klar ee ass" is left as an English phonetic respelling. Consider giving an Indonesian-friendly pronunciation, or mark it as an English-style guide.
Item 1: "Data Deficient atau kekurangan data" is clumsy. The standard Indonesian term is "Kekurangan Data", with (Data Deficient) in brackets.

Item 3: "balashark" for silver shark is acceptable, but "tinfoil barb atau spanner barb" leaves the English trade names as is. Consider "ikan cyprinid" in a more common form such as "cyprinid besar" and check that the local names are consistent.

Item 6: Anatomical terms such as "epibranchial ke-2 dan ke-4", "superbranchial" and "fontanel anterior" are left untranslated. Consider adding Indonesian terms, or put the English in brackets after the Indonesian.

Item 6: Restructuring the text into bullet lists with the added lead-in "Ini ciri-ciri spesies Clarias:" and "Ciri lainnya:" changes the original's single-paragraph format. The content is intact, but this is a format change.
Item 6: "sirip dubur" is acceptable, but hobbyists often say "sirip anal". "Pori-pori saluran sensorik ... membesar" is slightly off for "Hypertrophied" (it means 'hypertrophied/enlarged').

clarias-leiacanthus.name: Lele hutan
notes: Item 3: "mengoleksi spesies ini" is slightly awkward; "mengumpulkan/menangkap spesies ini" is more natural.
Item 3: unit "mg/l" and "mg/L" are inconsistent, as in the source; make them uniform (mg/L).
Item 7: "Teman satu akuarium" is clumsy; "ikan penghuni bersama" or "tankmate" is more usual. "balashark" is a common name, which is fine.
Item 10: "lincah atau hidup" for Greek chlaros ("lively") adds "atau hidup"; use "lincah" only.
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable but redundant; the English is not needed in brackets.
Item 5: "mudah diterima ikan ini" is slightly stiff; "mudah diterima/dipakai ikan" would be better.

clarias-meladerma.name: Lele hitam
notes: Item 7: "silver sharks" translated as "bala shark" — the English says silver sharks; "tinfoil barb" and "spanner barb" fine, but keep to the source name or use "hiu perak/balashark" consistently. Minor, but "bala shark" differs from the source wording.

Item 1: "Least Concern" rendered as "Risiko Rendah" — IUCN's standard Indonesian term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kurang Perhatian"; "Risiko Rendah" is the old LR category. Use "Resiko Rendah/Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" accordingly.
Item 1: "chlaros, artinya lincah atau hidup" — the source says only "lively"; remove the added "atau hidup" (added fact).
Item 10: "kadang berbelang bintik-bintik hitam pekat" — "variegated with ... spots" means mottled with spots, not striped; use "kadang bercorak/berbintik-bintik hitam pekat yang tidak beraturan".
Item 3: leftover English anatomical terms "epibranchial" and "superbranchial" are left untranslated; consider "epibrankial" and "ruang suprabrankial" in Indonesian spelling.

Item 6: "Menghuni habitat berair tenang (tidak mengalir)" is fine, but "peats" -> "lahan gambut" and "bogs" -> "rawa" lose the distinction between swamps and bogs ("rawa" is used for both bogs and swamps); use "rawa gambut/payau" distinction e.g. "bog" = "rawa asam".

clarias-pachynema.name: Clarias pachynema
notes: Item 1: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern...)' is acceptable, but 'Fontanel frontalnya' and untranslated 'epibranchial ke-2 dan ke-4 ... superbranchial' mix English/Latin anatomical terms; consider 'epibrankial' and 'superbrankial' for consistency.
Item 1: 'Maximum size: 356 mm (14 in) SL' fine; but the paragraph drops nothing. 'tapis insang' fine. 'Tulang dermosphenotic' left in English form; consider 'dermosfenotik'.

Item 6: 'balashark' is an incorrect/non-standard spelling; use 'hiu balashark' or 'balá shark'. 'Silver Sharks' is Bala shark, but tinfoil/spanner barb should be consistent (e.g. 'barb tinfoil', 'barb spanner').
Item 8: 'Pemijahan: belum pernah dilaporkan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan.' is redundant (mirrors English, but could be merged); minor.
Item 11: Journal citation 'pp 438' left untranslated — acceptable as a reference, but treat as fine if reference list; no change needed unless it is not a reference.

clarotes-laticeps.name: Widehead Catfish
notes: Item 5: "Batu besar yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu sungai besar" (batu kali) instead.
Item 5: "menggeser-geser benda ... dengan tubuhnya yang besar" is slightly awkward; "dengan bobot tubuhnya" is more natural.
Items 1, 5, 8: "catfish" left in English; consider "ikan patin/lele" or "(catfish)" after the local term. "teman satu akuarium" is clunky; "penghuni akuarium lain" is more usual.
Item 8: "cyprinid" is left untranslated; use "ikan cyprinid (suku Cyprinidae)" or a common local term such as "ikan karper besar".
Item 4: "belum dewasa penuh" is fine, but "Minimal" has moved to the front of the sentence; this is acceptable but unnatural. Prefer "ikan sub-dewasa".

clavularia-viridis.name: Clove Polyp
notes: Section 6: "Tempatkan ... di bagian bawah atau tengah akuarium reef, tempat ia mendapat cahaya terang" is fine, but "tempelkan koral ini di batu terpisah" is OK; the real issue is "menyengatnya hingga mundur" for "sting it away" — fine; however "hal ini bisa membuat koral stres hingga meleleh (melt) dan hilang" is OK. The real problem: "perilaku masing-masing tidak pernah pasti" is stiff; use "perilakunya sulit diprediksi".
Section 9: "pakan berprotein" for "meaty foods" — better "pakan berdaging" or "pakan hewani"; "Jenis pakan: mikroplankton" fine.

Section 9: "Koral ini juga menyaring makanan" — keep "filter-feeds" meaning, but "memberi tempat berlindung serta perlindungan" is redundant (shelter and protection); use "tempat berlindung dan perlindungan" → "tempat tinggal dan perlindungan".
Section 12: "Koral merambat" for "encrusting" is imprecise; use "koral yang menyelimuti/mengerak". "tumbuh pada sejumlah polip" is awkward for "borne on".
Section 12: "Kondisi ... 'menguncup'" for retracted — better "menutup/menarik polip"; "ketelitian penting untuk mencegah kerugian" — better "agar koral tidak rusak/mati".
Section 12: "Disinfeksi dalam larutan iodin" is stilted; use "Desinfeksi dengan mencelupkannya ke larutan iodin".
Section 7: duplicate Salinity entry kept from source (fine), but "Stronsium" is better "Stronsium/Strontium" as hobbyists write "strontium".
Section 1: "Temper" rendered as "Sifat" — better "Temperamen".

cleithracara-maronii.name: Keyhole Cichlid
notes: Item 14: the source spells it 'Nannancara', but the translation says 'Nannacara'. This is the correct genus name, so it is only a silent change from the source. Keep it only if it is intentional.
Item 10: 'berenang di kolom air tengah' for 'open water-dwelling' is slightly narrower than the source. 'ikan perenang di air terbuka' would be closer.

clibanarius-africanus.name: Kelomang air payau Afrika
notes: "euryhaline" left in English; use Indonesian term "eurihalin" (optionally with the English term in brackets).
"Detritus terdiri dari" is better as "terdiri atas/dari"; minor wording only, optional.
"mau langsung menyantap" is slightly awkward for "feed readily"; consider "dengan lahap memakan".

clupisoma-bastari.name: Bastar garua
notes: Item 6: "memicu aktivitas berkembang biak invertebrata" is fine, but "hormon pemijahan" for "breeding hormones" and "Ikan-ikan ini berevolusi menyelaraskan" read stiffly; use "telah berevolusi sehingga siklus pemijahannya selaras dengan...".
Item 5: "Di alam memakan" was added; the English only says "Feeds on". It is a reasonable clarification, but the subject is missing. Use "Ikan ini memakan...".
Item 5: "pakan berprotein/daging" is awkward; use "pakan hewani" or "pakan berdaging". "ulat hongkong" is the usual term for mealworms, which is fine.

Item 4: "Menangani lele ... itu tidak gampang" is colloquial for a handbook; use a more neutral register such as "tidaklah mudah". Also "Abhisek Mishra" is named, which is acceptable only inside the citation, so consider a neutral "seorang hobiis".

clupisoma-garua.name: Garua Catfish
notes: Item 2: "provinsi-provinsi Gangga" is a literal rendering of "Gangetic provinces"; more natural: "wilayah dataran Sungai Gangga".
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is slightly stiff; "Lokalitas tipe" is the usual taxonomic term.
Item 6: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is acceptable, but "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah" is the usual IUCN Indonesian form; check consistency.
Item 6: "lele" for this Ailiid catfish is a loose rendering; consider "ikan lele" or "ikan patin-patinan" as the general term for catfish.

clupisoma-longianale.name: Clupisoma longianale
notes: Item 1: "dari sembilan Clupisoma" is vague; better "dari sembilan spesies dalam genus Clupisoma yang tercatat".
Item 3: "induk berpasangan secara jelas" is awkward; better "induk membentuk pasangan yang jelas".

clupisoma-prateri.name: Clupisoma prateri
notes: "jari-jari lunak sirip anal: 41–46; ruas tulang belakang" – "vertebrae" is better as "tulang belakang (vertebra)"; "ruas" is acceptable but "vertebra" is more standard.
"sungut aksila" – use "sungut ketiak" or "sungut aksilar (axillary)" for naturalness; "sungut dagu bagian dalam" is ok.
"sejajar pangkal sirip dada" is awkward; better "mulai dari bagian di bawah pangkal sirip dada".

"Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" – the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah"; fine, but "pita kehijauan ... melewati garis tengah punggung ke arah bawah" is slightly unclear.

clypeobarbus-congicus.name: Congo Barb
notes: Item 1: 'Copper-red Congo barb' left in English; the English name appears only in the source and is used inconsistently with 'Congo barb' elsewhere. Give a consistent name, e.g. 'barb Kongo merah tembaga (Copper-red Congo barb)'.

Item 1: 'only in rare exceptions they become up to 7 cm' is translated as 'hanya sesekali bisa mencapai 7 cm'. 'Sesekali' (occasionally) is weaker than 'rare exceptions'. Use 'hanya dalam kasus langka'.
Item 1: 'Barb ini benar-benar ikan yang damai dan hidup bergerombol' is fine, but 'schooling fish' could be 'ikan gerombol (schooling)'. This is minor.

Item 5: 'tempat yang lebih sempit' is vague. Use 'akuarium yang lebih kecil'. 'Agresi antarsesama' is acceptable but 'agresi intraspesifik/antarsesama jenis' is clearer. Also 'about 81 litres' is inconsistent: 90×30 cm is given without height, so check that the volume was not invented or altered.

Item 9: 'Microsyndontis spp.' is kept as in the source, but the genus is Synodontis/Microsynodontis. Keep the Latin name unchanged but check it. 'Suka bersembunyi' for 'withdrawn' and 'gugup' for 'nervous' are fine.
Item 2: 'hierarki yang jelas' for 'pecking order' is acceptable, but 'shoaling' is glossed as 'bergerombol longgar' in some places and not in others, so be consistent.
Item 6: 'Daun beech dan oak' is left in English. Use 'daun beech (Fagus)' or 'daun bukit/ek', and use the local term 'daun ketapang' consistently.

Item 11: 'indukan' is introduced where the English says 'the fish'. 'pindahkan indukan' for 'remove them' is ambiguous because 'them' could mean the eggs or the fish. It most likely means the adults. Check that this is clear.

cnidoglanis-macrocephalus.name: Estuary Cobbler
notes: Item 3: "weeds" translated as "rumput laut" (seaweed) is acceptable, but "holes and on ledges in banks" became "di bawah tonjolan pada tebing dasar perairan"; "on ledges" (di atas/pada tonjolan) was changed to "di bawah" (under), which changes the meaning. Use "di atas tonjolan".
Item 8: Added fact "di akuarium" in "Belum ada laporan pemijahan di akuarium"; the English says only "There is no breeding report". Remove "di akuarium" or keep it neutral.
Item 8: "drift weeds" as "Rumput laut hanyut" is fine, but "Julukan spesiesnya" in item 1 is non-standard for "specific epithet"; use "epitet spesifik" / "nama spesies".

Item 2: "Kepulauan Melayu" for "Malay Archipelago" is better as "Kepulauan Melayu (Nusantara)"; also "Perluasan sebarannya" is slightly awkward for "range extension"; consider "Perluasan daerah sebaran hingga Duck River".
Item 1: "total 222-234 jari-jari sirip median" is slightly awkward; use "jumlah total 222–234 jari-jari sirip median".

cobitis-macrostigma.name: Largespotted Spiny Loach
notes: Item 5: "Largespotted Spiny Loach" is left untranslated and the sentence reads oddly. Consider "bisa dinamai 'Largespotted Spiny Loach'" and add a local gloss such as "(loach duri bintik besar)". The byline drop is correct.
Item 1: "Loach" is left in English. It is acceptable as a hobby term, but "ikan loach" would read more naturally.

colomesus-asellus.name: Buntal Amazon
notes: Item 22: "114 liter" is an unrounded conversion of 30 gallons. Round it to about 115 liter, in line with the 5-litre rounding rule.
Item 10: "aufwuchs" is left as a German term. Add a gloss such as "aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme pada permukaan)" so hobbyists understand it.
Item 25: "platy pedang (swordtail)" is a slightly odd local name for swordtail. Using "swordtail" alone is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.

colomesus-psittacus.name: Banded Puffer
notes: Item 7: 'cockles, mussels' rendered as 'kerang darah, kerang hijau' – specific species added; use generic 'kerang' for cockles and mussels (e.g., 'kerang dara, kerang hijau' is a stretch).

Item 7: 'Brachyuran crabs' became 'kepiting Brachyura' fine, but 'Tetraodontids lack true teeth' rendered 'Famili Tetraodontidae' ok; 'so such a diet is essential' -> 'pakan seperti ini mutlak diperlukan' loses the point that hard-shelled food wears the teeth down; clarify.
Item 11: 'Puffers are secondary freshwater fishes, with the majority ... marine' translated with 'karena' (because), creating a false causal link; use 'meski' / 'sementara' instead.
Item 11: 'Ekologinya ... sebagian besar di perairan payau pesisir' ok, but 'jari-jari sirip yang keras' for 'spinous fin rays' should be 'jari-jari sirip keras (duri sirip)'; 'ribs' fine.
Item 3: 'saline habitats' changed to 'berair asin atau payau' – 'atau payau' added; also 'sebagian besar populasinya' vs 'predominantly an inhabitant' slightly shifted.

Item 2: 'Guyanas' translated as 'wilayah Guyana' (singular); should refer to the Guianas (Guyana, Suriname, Guyane Prancis). Also 'misidentifications' sentence adds 'Ikan yang dimaksud kemungkinan adalah' – ok but 'Type locality ... tercatat secara keliru' fine.

Item 1: 'jadi inilah spesies terbesar' adds causal 'jadi' not in source; 'Kemungkinan besar ikan ini akan agresif' fine. Also 'Difficulty ... a very large tank and a well-established tank' – 'sudah matang' ok.
Item 4: 648 litres is not rounded; the conversion is given in the source so acceptable, but 180×60×60 cm = 648 L is correct.

Item 5: 'Moderate levels of dissolved oxygen' rendered 'Kadar oksigen terlarut ... yang sedang' – should be 'cukup tinggi/sedang' ok; 'Wild examples ... delicate' as 'rapuh' – better 'peka/lemah'; 'standard gravity' rendered 'berat jenis (SG)' ok.

colomesus-tocantinensis.name: Tocantins puffer
notes: "Saat ini hanya diketahui dari lokasi tipenya" is fine, but "Spesimen tipenya" for "type series" would be more precise as "seri tipe" (minor).
"kerabat satu genusnya" for "congeners" is a bit clumsy; "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama" reads better (minor).
"Larvanya yang hidup melayang di kolom air" is acceptable, but "larva pelagis" is the more standard term (minor).

colossoma-macropomum.name: Colossoma macropomum
notes: #5: "pemanas (heater) kaca dan termostat" splits the "glass heaterstats" into separate items. Better: "heater-termostat kaca", or "pemanas bertermostat dari kaca".
#8: "kurang aktif, suka diam di dasar, atau pemalu" adds "suka diam di dasar", which the source does not say. "sedentary" means inactive or slow-moving. Use "yang kurang aktif atau pemalu".
#5: "Bagaimanapun" for "At any rate" is slightly off. "Sebisa mungkin" or "Yang jelas" fits better.
#5: "dipasang/difiksasi" with a slash is clumsy. Use "atau difiksasi pada akuarium".
#4: "minimal 300 × 90 × 90 cm atau sekitar 2550 liter": the volume figure is copied from the source, but 300×90×90 cm is about 2430 L. Check the figure.

compsaraia-samueli.name: Pelicano Knifefish
notes: "paling unik" for "most remarkable" is slightly off; "paling luar biasa" or "paling menakjubkan" is closer.
"cukup tidak rewel" is awkward; use "tidak terlalu menuntut" or "cukup toleran".
"Ikan jantan memiliki moncong panjang yang bentuknya aneh" loses "develop" (it develops with maturity) and "grotesque"; use "mengembangkan moncong panjang yang tampak ganjil/aneh".
"Tempat pemeliharaan" for "fishhouse" is vague; use "di fasilitas penangkaran/penampungan".
"ikan kecil sebagai pakan hidup" adds "hidup" (live), which the source does not say; "feeder fish" is better as "ikan pakan kecil".
"nama persembahan" for "dedication name" is unnatural; use "nama yang diberikan untuk menghormati Samuel Albert" (eponym).
"Tidak bisa akur" is acceptable but "intolerant" is better as "tidak menoleransi sesamanya".

congochromis-dimidiatus.name: Congochromis dimidiatus
notes: Item 10: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is a bit awkward; "filter busa (sponge filter) yang digerakkan udara" is more natural.
Item 8: "dither fish" is left untranslated; add a local explanation such as "ikan pengalih perhatian (dither fish)".
Item 4: the first sentence, "ukuran minimalnya akuarium dengan alas...", is awkward. Use "ukuran minimalnya adalah akuarium...".
Item 11: "Gurat sisi bagian atasnya hanya punya..." is slightly ambiguous. Make it clear that this is the upper lateral line.
Item 1: "cichlid" is left in English while "burayak" is used elsewhere. Both are acceptable, but be consistent about hobby terms.

congochromis-sabinae.name: Congochromis sabinae
notes: Section 5: "jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium baru (belum matang/siklus nitrogennya belum selesai)" - fine meaning, but the parenthetical is added explanation; 'immature aquaria' could be simply 'akuarium yang belum matang'.
Section 8: "teman satu akuarium dicari tahu dengan baik" is awkward; use "tankmate diteliti dulu dengan saksama".
Section 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)" is clearer; "pipet yang tajam" is awkward (sharp pipette end).
Section 10: "kedua induknya terlibat dalam pengasuhan" is slightly clumsy for 'bi-parental'; "telur dan anak" for 'broodcare' fine. "diusir keluar" okay.
Section 11: "Group 1/Group 2" and "anggota yang lebih lama dikenal" are slightly awkward; use "anggota yang lebih dulu dikenal".
Section 1: "sungai-sungai kecil di hutan hujan" fine; "salah diberi label" is awkward, use "salah dilabeli".

copadichromis-azureus.name: Copadichromis azureus
notes: Item 4: "~304 liter" – 150×45×45 cm is about 304 L, so the number is fine, but the rounding is not sensible; use ~300 liter.
Item 8: "Haps" and "setup" are left as English jargon; consider "cichlid Haplochromine" and "tata letak/aquascape".
Item 8: "kawin silang (hibrida)" is fine, but "akan berkembang baik" for "won't do well" is slightly loose; use "tidak akan betah/tidak akan sehat".

Item 10: "ikan jantan akan membuat tempat memijah ... substrat yang sudah dibersihkan dari butiran kasar" is OK, but "mengeluarkan kumpulan telur berikutnya" is wrong: the female lays (bertelur) the next batch, not releases it from her mouth. Use "bertelur lagi".

Item 10: "Waiting as long as possible" and "for too long" are fine, but "peternak" for breeders should be "pembiak"; "sebaiknya ditata seperti yang disarankan di atas" adds a cross-reference that is acceptable.
Item 11: "Rahang atasnya bisa dijulurkan jauh dan langsung dijulurkan cepat" is redundant and awkward; rephrase as "sangat protraktil dan dijulurkan cepat".
Item 11: "kelompok khusus" for "exclusive group" is vague; use "kelompok tersendiri".
Item 11: "cichlid Danau Rift" is wrong for "Rift Lake cichlids"; use "cichlid danau-danau Rift".

copadichromis-borleyi.name: Borleyi
notes: #6: "sekitar 304 liter" is wrong; 150 × 45 × 45 cm is about 304 L, but the tank table sets named sizes, so it should be a rounded figure (about 300 liter), not the exact conversion.
#14: "ikan jantan akan menyiapkan lokasi pemijahan" loses the detail "construct"; this is minor.
#14: "tata letaknya dibuat seperti yang disarankan di atas" refers to text above that is not in this passage; it is acceptable, but "peternak" for breeders is a bit odd ("pembiak" is better).
#14: "Jantan bisa cukup agresif saat mengejar betina" is fine, but "mengurus urusannya sendiri" is a weak rendering of the "business" joke.
#2/#4/#10: Copadichromis borleyi is not italicised in the Indonesian here, but the Latin name is unchanged, so this is minor.
#16: "Rahang atasnya bisa dijulurkan jauh ke depan dan dengan cepat dijulurkan" repeats "dijulurkan" and is awkward.
#16: "mengerami" and "stripping" are acceptable; "dengan cara khas pengeram mulut Malawi" is fine.

copadichromis-chrysonotus.name: Copadichromis chrysonotus
notes: Item 10: 'Allow around 46 × 46 × 46 cm' is fine, but 'the male has egg spots ... on his anal fin' etc fine; main issue: 'Kalau betina tertarik' fine. Real problem: 'secara paksa' added in 'mengeluarkan burayak ... secara paksa' is okay; however 'Burayak bisa dibiarkan bersama ikan dewasa dan biasanya tidak diganggu' is fine.
Item 11: pronunciation 'ooh-taw-kuh' rendered as 'u-ta-ka' — changes the pronunciation guide; should reflect the original or be omitted.

Item 11: 'betina antarspesies hampir tidak bisa dibedakan' — original says females of the species are indistinguishable from one another (among species in the genus); 'antarspesies' is ambiguous; clarify as 'betina antarspesies dalam genus ini'.
Item 1: 'Bagian punggung ikan jantannya lebih pucat dibanding C. azureus' ok, but 'Ikan ini jarang ada di dunia ikan hias' is awkward; use 'jarang ditemui di dunia akuarium'.
Item 4: 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' acceptable; 'Panjang standar: 16 cm SL' redundant but fine.
Item 7: 'bayam yang sudah direbus sebentar (blansir)' ok; 'Burayak artemia' for Artemia nauplii is non-standard — use 'nauplii artemia'.
Item 10: 'Pembuahan terjadi dengan cara yang khas pengeram mulut Malawi' is awkward; use 'seperti pengeram mulut Malawi pada umumnya'.
Item 10: 'peternak' for breeders is slightly off; use 'penangkar' or 'pembudidaya'.
Item 5: 'Substrat pasir paling cocok' OK; 'Tambahkan ... sebagai variasi' ok.

copadichromis-ilesi.name: Copadichromis ilesi
notes: "Burayak artemia" for "Artemia nauplii" (items 7 and 10) is not the usual term. "Burayak" means fry. Use "nauplius artemia" or "naupli artemia" instead.
"Rahang atasnya sangat bisa dijulurkan" is awkward. Use "sangat protraktil" or "dapat dijulurkan jauh".
"Kelompok khusus cichlid Malawi" for "exclusive group" is slightly vague. "Kelompok tersendiri" would be clearer.
The pronunciation "u-ta-ka" does not match the English guide "ooh-taw-kuh". Keep the phonetic hint or write it as "u-to-ka".

copadichromis-virginalis.name: Copadichromis virginalis
notes: #7: "campuran pakan kecil yang baik, baik pakan hidup..." is awkward and repeats "baik". Write "campuran pakan hidup, beku, dan kering berukuran kecil yang bermutu".
#11: "Rahang atasnya bisa dijulurkan jauh dan langsung dijulurkan dengan cepat" repeats "dijulurkan". Write "sangat protraktil (bisa menjulur jauh) dan langsung dijulurkan dengan cepat".
#10: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for the aquarium hobby. "pembiak" or "penangkar" is more usual.

copeina-guttata.name: Red Spotted Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'biologically immature tank' rendered as 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' – acceptable but slightly interpretive; consider 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)'.
Item 1/6: 'Red spotted tetra' left in English without local rendering; consider adding 'tetra bintik merah' or similar.
Item 6: 'pelet butiran' – 'granules' with 'pelet' is slightly redundant; use 'granul'.
Item 6: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is common, but hobbyists often write 'daphnia'; consider 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.
Item 9: 'klad' is non-standard; 'klade' is more usual. 'pendekatan kawin' for courtship is awkward; use 'penjodohan/percumbuan'.
Item 2: type locality quote left in English; fine as quote but 'Lokasi tipe' is acceptable.

copella-arnoldi.name: Splash Tetra
notes: Item 10: "10–12 telur diletakkan dalam sekali lompatan" is fine, but "sampai telur betina habis" is OK; real issue: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is slightly off (should be 'digerakkan udara/aerator').

Item 11: "Pyrrhulina" genus comparison fine, but "sirip perut" for ventral fin and "sirip dubur" for anal fin are non-standard in hobby; use 'sirip anal'. 'Pita gelap horizontal' vs 'garis tengah tubuh' inconsistent for stripe/band.
Item 11: "kerabat satu genusnya" for 'congeners' is okay, but "pangkal sirip punggung" for 'dorsal-fin insertion' (origin) is imprecise; use 'awal sirip punggung'.
Item 10: "Tanaman emersed" leaves English untranslated; use 'tanaman emersa/yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air'.
Item 5: "Alder cone" left in English without explanation; add 'kerucut alder (alder cone)'. Also 'blackwater' untranslated though acceptable as hobby term.
Item 7: "burayak artemia" and "kutu air moina" are fine, but "Seperti ... Drosophila" okay; 'burayak' for fry is regional (Malay) — 'benih/anakan ikan' is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.

Item 2: "Lokasi tipe hanya disebut 'Amazon' oleh Regan" OK; but 'lokasi neotipe ... tidak disertai penetapan neotipe' fine. Item 8: 'lele callichthyid atau loricariid' — 'lele' misleading for these catfishes; use 'ikan lele-lelean/catfish'.
Item 10: "dalam sekali lompatan" for 'during a single event' adds a slight shift; use 'dalam satu kali pemijahan'.

copella-carsevennensis.name: Copella carsevennensis
notes: Item 3: '75 × 30 cm ... (sekitar 68 liter)' keeps an unrounded figure; the 68 L should be rounded sensibly (e.g. about 70 liter).
Item 4: 'buah atau kerucut alder (alder cone)' adds 'buah' as an alternative; the source says only 'Alder cones'. Use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)' alone.
Item 4: 'daun yang membusuk juga memicu tumbuhnya koloni mikroba' is fine, but 'Air harus kaya oksigen' is slightly stronger than 'well-oxygenated'; wording is acceptable.
Item 7: 'karasid, gasteropelecid, dan lebiasinid' leaves family names as Latin transliterations; 'lele callichthyid atau loricariid' could use common names (lele corydoras/sapu-sapu) for hobbyists.
Item 10: 'sirip perut' for 'ventral fin' and 'sirip dubur' for anal fin are stiff; hobbyists use 'sirip perut' and 'sirip anal'. 'penjodohan' is also odd for 'courtship'.
Item 10: 'tidak ada tanda segitiga hitam pada jari-jari bagian bawah' is OK, but 'pangkal sirip punggung' for 'insertion' is imprecise; 'awal sirip punggung' would be more accurate.
Item 1: 'Guyana Prancis' is acceptable, but 'Guiana Prancis' is the standard form and is inconsistent with 'kawasan Guiana' in the same sentence.

copella-eigenmanni.name: Copella eigenmanni
notes: Item 4: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is OK, but 'Menambahkan daun kering' drops 'leaf litter' sense; use 'serasah daun kering'.
Item 4: 'Alder cones' rendered 'buah alder'; 'kerucut alder' is more accurate (cones are not fruit in hobby usage).

Item 4: 'overhanging vegetation, roots or branches' became 'akar, atau ranting yang menaungi permukaan air'; 'overhanging' modifies all three but is awkward; check that it clearly means hanging over the water.
Item 6: 'burayak artemia' for Artemia nauplii is non-standard; use 'nauplii artemia' (burayak means fry). Same in item 9.
Item 6: 'diberi makan pakan serpihan atau sayuran' is clumsy; fix to 'diberi pakan serpihan atau sayuran'.
Item 7: 'kelompok campuran ... supaya mereka merasa aman' fine, but 'Hasilnya, tampilan akuarium akan terlihat' is wordy; 'karasin' is non-standard, use 'karakin (characid)'.
Item 1: 'Ada garis gelap lebar dari moncong sampai mata' fine; 'terbawa di antara ikan tangkapan alam' adds the idea of being carried along, not in the source ('among').
Item 8: 'sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' should be 'sedang bertelur/penuh telur' (bunting telur); acceptable but 'jauh lebih besar' ok. Minor.
Item 3: 'Volume: ~72 liter.' fine; no real problem.
Item 9: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' ok; 'matang kelamin' for 'sexually-active' slightly changes meaning (mature vs. actively ready to spawn); use 'siap memijah'.

copella-meinkeni.name: Spotted Splashing Tetra
notes: Item 5: 'overhanging vegetation, roots or branches important' was split wrongly: 'dengan sebagian tumbuhan yang menjuntai ke atas air. Akar atau ranting penting kalau...'. Roots and branches are now detached from 'overhanging'. The meaning changed a little. Rewrite so vegetation, roots or branches overhanging the water are all important for raising fry with the adults.
Item 5: 'biologically immature aquarium' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is narrower than the source and adds a fact. Use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 5: 'dried leaf litter' became just 'daun kering'. 'Alder cones' was left as 'Alder cone'. Use 'daun kering (serasah)' and 'kerucut alder'.

Item 1: 'lays its eggs among vegetation' was reworded in the passive. It is fine, but the ID drops the 'SL' explanation. 'lateral stripe' was written 'garis lateral'. Use 'garis samping' or 'garis sisi'.
Item 7: 'Artemia nauplii' became 'burayak artemia'. Nauplii are not fry. Use 'nauplii artemia'.
Item 10: 'Artemia nauplii' became 'burayak artemia' again. Use 'nauplius artemia'.

Item 8: 'include other schooling fishes to provide security ... rewarded with a more natural-looking spectacle' was changed to 'hasilnya akan berupa pemandangan yang lebih alami'. It is awkward. Also 'characid ... yang ukurannya serupa' attaches the size only to some groups.

Item 11: 'later identified by Zarske (2011)' became 'kemudian diidentifikasi oleh Zarske (2011)', which is fine. 'cheek well-covered' is fine. 'Faktor pembatas lainnya adalah dalam banyak kasus...' reads awkwardly and the logic is unclear.

Item 9: 'Males grows ... develop more-extended fins' became 'siripnya lebih panjang'. 'gravid' became 'sedang bertelur'. That means laying eggs, not carrying them. Use 'sedang membawa telur / bunting telur'.

copella-nattereri.name: Spotted tetra
notes: Item 1/11: 'garis gelap di sisi tubuh' / 'bagian samping tubuhnya' is fine, but 'Pyrrhulina... berdasarkan beberapa aspek morfologi kepala' is OK; main issue is below.

Item 2: 'lokasi yang kedua ini berada di negara bagian Pará' omits the 'corresponding to a locality' nuance (Obidos corresponds to a locality in Pará); phrase it as 'yang sesuai dengan sebuah lokasi di negara bagian Pará'.

Item 5: 'akar atau ranting juga penting' changes the structure: the English says overhanging vegetation, roots or branches are important; 'beberapa vegetasi yang menjuntai' is awkward. Rephrase as 'dengan vegetasi menjuntai, akar, atau ranting yang penting bila ingin membesarkan burayak bersama induk'.
Item 5: 'Menambahkan daun kering' loses 'leaf litter'; use 'serasah daun kering'.
Item 5: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is acceptable, but 'biologically immature' could be simply 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 9: 'saat sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' should be 'saat sedang penuh telur/bunting telur'; 'bertelur' implies laying.
Item 11: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is clumsy for 'congener'; use 'spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama'. 'bercumbu' for 'courtship' is unnatural; use 'pacaran/ritual pemijahan'.

Item 11: 'tanda segitiga hitam pada jari-jari bagian bawah lobus bawah sirip ekor' should specify 'jari-jari ventral'. 'Faktor pembatas lainnya adalah ... meneliti masing-masing secara menyeluruh' is awkward.

Item 10: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' fine; 'jantan juga sebaiknya dipindahkan karena ia bisa mulai memakan burayak' ok. Item 7: 'kutu air (moina)' is acceptable; Item 3 'sungai kecil... anak-anak sungai yang kecil' is redundant.

coreoperca-liui.name: Chinese Perch
notes: "absolutely peaceful towards conspecifics" was rendered as "sama sekali tidak agresif". That is fine in meaning, but "sangat damai" would be closer.

"Keduanya diduga berkerabat dekat" is ambiguous. It reads as if the two genera are related to each other, when the original says the fish are related to groupers. Use "Ikan-ikan ini diduga..." or "Kedua genus ini diduga...".
"baru pertama kali berhasil didatangkan" is a bit awkward. Try "untuk pertama kalinya berhasil diperoleh/diimpor".
"perch" is left untranslated. Add the local term "ikan perch" or "ikan bass Cina" for readability.
"suka diberi pakan ikan hidup" is slightly off. The original says they like living fish as food, so "menyukai ikan hidup sebagai mangsa/pakan" is better.

corydoras-acrensis.name: Corydoras acrensis
notes: "lele berlapis baja": Indonesian hobbyists usually say "corydoras" or "lele lapis baja"; consider "catfish" in brackets. Minor.
"daerah aliran sungai rio Juruá": "rio" is Portuguese for river, so this reads redundantly; use "DAS Sungai Juruá" or "rio Juruá" consistently. Item 2 also writes "Rio" and "rio" inconsistently.
"Spesies ini tampaknya dideskripsikan" (item 1) repeats "tampaknya" from the sentence before it; vary the wording.
"saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid": better "saat penuh telur" or "bunting telur", since "bertelur" means laying eggs, not carrying them.
"Betina terlihat jelas lebih bulat": the phrase is awkward; use "Betina tampak jelas lebih bulat".
"Idealnya gunakan substrat": add a subject or use "Sebaiknya gunakan" for more natural Indonesian. Minor.

corydoras-acutus.name: Corydoras blacktop
notes: Item 1: "C077 ... is only known to differ in growing smaller" is rendered fine, but item 7 "C. acutus tampaknya tumbuh lebih besar daripada C077, tetapi saat ini belum ada ciri pembeda lain" drops "diagnostic characters" nuance; use "belum ada ciri diagnostik tambahan".
Item 7: "kelenjar aksila" for axillary glands is an odd term; use "kelenjar aksilar" or "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada".

Item 7: "Orbit tiga kali dalam kepala" and "Duri adiposa tanpa sirip" are literal and hard to read; "orbit" should be "diameter mata" and "duri adiposa tanpa sirip" clarified (duri lemak tanpa sirip).
Item 7: "hidup simpatrik" is jargon; consider "hidup bersama (simpatrik)".
Item 7: "Cope ... attenuation of the muzzle" translated as "moncongnya yang meruncing" is OK, but "Jari-jari D. I. 7" should be "jari-jari sirip" for clarity.
Item 7: "lele 'berlapis baja'" - "lele" for catfish is acceptable, but "kelompok" plus "secara kolektif" is redundant.
Item 8: reference list untranslated is fine; no change needed.

corydoras-adolfoi.name: Corydoras adolfoi
notes: Item 14: "Mereka adalah penghirup udara fakultatif" is slightly stiff; "dapat bernapas langsung di udara (fakultatif)" reads more naturally.

Item 2: "karena keduanya tidak bisa dibedakan secara andal dari warnanya" adds a causal "karena" that the English does not have; the English says only that the two cannot be reliably separated by colour.
Item 1: "sangat keren" is informal for a handbook; "menarik" would be more suitable.
Item 13: "peternak" for breeders could be "penangkar" or "pembudidaya", which hobbyists use more often.
Item 13: "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" is a slight shift. The English says the species is not the easiest to raise, not only the fry.

corydoras-aeneus.name: Corydoras bronze
notes: "Corydoras bronze" / "cory": the common Indonesian hobby name is "corydoras perunggu" or "Bronze Corydoras"; consider keeping it consistent.
"Ikan ini dapat bernapas langsung dari udara (fakultatif)": "fakultatif" in brackets reads awkwardly; better "mampu bernapas dari udara secara fakultatif".
"keping tulang (armoured catfish)" and later "lele berlapis baja"/"berzirah": keep the wording consistent for armoured catfish.
"burayak" is correct but "benih" or "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.
"peternak" for breeders: "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more natural for fish.
"perkawinan sekerabat terseleksi" for line-bred is clumsy; "pembiakan garis keturunan (line breeding)" would be clearer.
"Ikan ini sangat langka" and "hanya tersedia dalam jumlah terbatas" are fine, but "Gold Shoulder" is left in English without explanation; this is acceptable.

corydoras-agassizii.name: Corydoras agassizii
notes: Item 2: 'Region Loreto' is awkward; use 'Wilayah Loreto' or 'Departemen Loreto'. Original 'Loreto Regio' is itself odd, but the Indonesian should read naturally.
Item 2: 'munisipalitas' is stiff; 'kotamadya' or 'kota' is more natural.
Item 2: 'tampaknya setidaknya sampai ke' is clumsy and repeats itself; rephrase as 'tampaknya mencakup setidaknya hingga kota Iquitos'.
Item 1/8: 'lele berlapis baja' for armoured catfish is a literal rendering; hobbyists usually say 'corydoras' or 'lele lapis baja'. The bracketed English term is fine.
Item 8: 'Mereka adalah penghirup udara fakultatif' is stiff. Consider 'Ikan ini dapat bernapas langsung dari udara (fakultatif)'.
Item 8: 'kelenjar aksila' (axillary glands) is an unusual term for fish; consider 'kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada (aksilar)'.
Item 7: 'dewasa kelamin' is awkward; 'matang kelamin' or 'dewasa' is more natural.

corydoras-albolineatus.name: Corydoras albolineatus
notes: Item 9: "caudal-fin with iii 6-6 ii rays" rendered as "jari-jari iii 6-6 ii" – fine, but "6-6 ii" uses a hyphen where en dash is used elsewhere; minor consistency.
Item 1/9: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering of 'armoured catfish'; hobbyists usually say "corydoras" or "lele berzirah"; consider 'lele lapis baja (armoured catfish)'.
Item 6: "cacing sutra (Tubifex)" is fine, but "pakan" for food is okay; 'omnivora yang mencari makan di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (not in the source: 'foraging'). Use 'omnivora pencari makan'.
Item 9: "kelenjar aksila" is an odd term; use "kelenjar aksilar" or 'kelenjar di pangkal sirip'.
Item 3: "kerabat segenusnya" is a bit stiff; 'congener' could be 'satu genus'.

corydoras-amandajanea.name: Corydoras amandajanea
notes: Item 12: "Mereka adalah penghirup udara fakultatif" is slightly awkward; better "Ikan ini bernapas dengan udara secara fakultatif" or "dapat menghirup udara atmosfer (fakultatif)".
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" is an unusual rendering of 'armoured catfish'. "Lele lapis baja" or "kucing berzirah" would be more natural. Keep it consistent with item 12 ("berzirah").
Item 2: "Moncongnya relatif runcing" is fine, but "comparably" is left slightly vague. Consider "cukup runcing".
Item 12: "kelenjar ketiak (axillary)" is an odd literal rendering. Use "kelenjar aksilar" instead.
Item 5: "simpatrik" is jargon with no gloss. Add "(hidup di wilayah yang sama)".

corydoras-ambiacus.name: Corydoras ambiacus
notes: "sirip perut" for "ventral fins" alongside "sirip pelvis" for "pelvic fins" is confusing, since in Indonesian both usually mean the same fins. Consider a note or consistent wording.
"saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid": gravid means carrying eggs, so "saat sedang membawa telur / bunting telur" is more accurate.
"kelenjar aksila" is an unusual term. Consider "kelenjar aksiler (axillary glands)".
"Mereka adalah penghirup udara fakultatif" is slightly stiff. Consider "Ikan ini mampu bernapas udara secara fakultatif".
"minimal 4-6 ekor" is fine in meaning, but use an en dash or "sedikitnya 4–6 ekor" for consistency with the decimal-comma style used elsewhere.

corydoras-arcuatus.name: Corydoras Arcuatus
notes: #2: "perairan whitewater" leaves the English term bare; add a gloss such as "air putih (whitewater)".
#18: "Dengan mudah menerima ... dengan mudah diterima" is stiff and repeats itself; use "Mau menerima semua pakan buatan...".
#8: "(skunk = sigung)" is an added gloss that is not in the source; it is harmless but can be removed.

corydoras-armatus.name: Corydoras armatus
notes: Item 11: "lele bersisik tulang" is inaccurate; the English says bony plates in place of scales. Use "lele berlapis baja/berpelat tulang".
Item 9: "saat sedang mengandung telur" for "gravid" is slightly awkward. "saat bertelur/penuh telur" is more natural.

Item 4: "negara bagian Alto Amazonas" and "provinsi kecil Huallaga" are not accurate. Alto Amazonas is a province, so use "provinsi" and "wilayah/region" consistently. "Xeberos and Huallaga" was left in English inside the quote, which is acceptable.
Item 10: "Nama spesies ... berarti 'berpersenjata, bersenjata'" is redundant. Use "bersenjata" alone. "Corydoras armatus termasuk spesies Corydoras..." is slightly clumsy.
Item 2: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering. Hobbyists say "corydoras" or "lele berlapis (armoured catfish)".

corydoras-atropersonatus.name: Corydoras atropersonatus
notes: #2: "lebih sering lagi dengan C097" changes meaning; "more closely" means it is more closely confused or resembles, not more often. Use "dan lebih mirip lagi dengan C097".
#14: "alder cone" is left in English without explanation; use "kerucut alder (alder cone)".
#7: "kayu" for driftwood is vague; use "kayu apung/driftwood" or "kayu rambat".
#9, #14: "Tubifex" is translated as "cacing sutra", while #8 handles it differently; keep the terms consistent across entries.
#14: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off; "pembiak" or "penangkar" is more natural.

corydoras-aurofrenatus.name: Corydoras aurofrenatus
notes: Item 7: "sisik lateral (scute)" – scutes are bony plates, not scales; use "lempeng tulang lateral (scute)".
Item 7: "kelenjar aksila" is awkward for axillary glands in fish; consider "kelenjar aksilar".
Item 6: "sedang mengandung telur" for "gravid" is slightly informal; "sedang bertelur/penuh telur" reads more naturally.
Item 1/5/7: "lele berlapis baja" is an unusual term; consider "lele berzirah" consistently or keep "armoured catfish" in brackets.
Item 5: "jangan mengandalkan" is repeated twice in one sentence; rephrase to avoid the repetition.
Item 2: the type locality 'Aguada near Arroyo Trementina' is left in English, which is acceptable as a proper name, but "Rio Aquido Canigi" may need a note that it refers to the Aquidabán.

corydoras-axelrodi.name: Corydoras axelrodi
notes: Item 2: "Sungai Meta mengalir melintasi Kolombia, menjadi perbatasan dengan Venezuela" is fine, but "daerah aliran sungai tersebut" is OK. Consider making "bukti yang mengarah bahwa" more natural: "bukti yang menunjukkan bahwa".
Item 8: "peternak" is better rendered as "pembiak" or "breeder"; "burayak" is correct but "anakan/benih" is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.
Item 9: "Rio Meta" vs "Río Meta" is kept from the English source, so it is fine. "C3" in the source stays unchanged.
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering; hobbyists often say "lele lapis baja" or just "corydoras"; minor.
Item 10: "nama karangan" for "fabricated names" is awkward; use "nama rekaan" or "nama yang dibuat-buat".

corydoras-boesemani.name: Corydoras boesemani
notes: Item 1: "Boeseman's catfish" left in English; add a local name or keep it as a trade name in brackets, e.g. "lele Boeseman".
Item 1/10: "dikoleksi dari alam" adds "dari alam" (from the wild), which the English does not say; use "dikoleksi" only.
Item 10: "dunia ikan hias" is acceptable, but "hobi akuarium" would be closer to the original.
Item 10: "kelenjar aksila" is too technical; consider "kelenjar aksilar (axillary gland)" or a short explanation.
Item 10: "berzirah" is an unusual word; "berlapis baja" alone is enough, or use "lele lapis baja" consistently.
Item 10: "Jadi berhati-hatilah" starts a sentence a bit informally; use "Karena itu, berhati-hatilah saat menanganinya".

corydoras-bondi.name: Corydoras bondi
notes: Item 2: "Río Yuruari, anak sungai Río Cuyuni" — mixed "Sungai"/"Río" naming; use consistent "Sungai Yuruari" and "Sungai Cuyuni".
Item 2: "affluent" and "tributaries" both rendered "anak sungai"; acceptable but repetitive.

Item 8: "kerabat segenus" for "congeners" is fine, but "jari-jari pertama sirip punggung" in item 1 vs "beberapa jari-jari pertama" in item 8 is inconsistent with "first dorsal-fin rays"; harmonize wording.
Item 8: "berzirah" for 'mailed' is unnatural; consider "bersisik keras/berlapis baja" only, or drop it.
Item 8: "kelenjar aksila" (axillary glands) is stilted; consider "kelenjar aksilar" or "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada".
Item 6: "minimal 4–6 ekor" is slightly awkward; better "setidaknya 4–6 ekor".

corydoras-brevirostris.name: Corydoras brevirostris
notes: Item 1/8: "dark bars in the caudal fin" translated as "garis-garis gelap"; "bars" is better rendered as "pita/balok gelap" or "garis vertikal gelap" (minor).
Item 8: "sinonim dari H. brevirostre" is fine, but "Spotted cory" in item 1 could use a hobby term such as "lele kaca/korido bintik"; consider italicising or keeping the English name in brackets.
Item 8: "kelenjar aksila" is a stiff term for axillary glands; consider "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada (kelenjar aksilar)".
Item 5: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "pakan" repeated; "cacing darah" is OK (minor).

corydoras-britskii.name: Corydoras britskii
notes: Item 7: '243 litres' for 120 × 45 cm base is unchanged from the source, so check; the figure is not a conversion error, but keep it consistent.

Item 17: the Vietnamese common names '(cá da trơn Britski)' and '(cá chuột ngọc lục bảo Mato Grosso)' were dropped; this is fine, but the English names 'Britski's catfish' and 'Mato-Grosso Emerald catfish' are left with no Indonesian equivalent. Add e.g. 'lele Britski' / 'lele zamrud Mato Grosso' in brackets.

Item 2/6: 'danau tapal kuda' for oxbow and 'genangan di tepi sungai' for backwaters are okay, but 'danau di tepi sungai' for marginal lakes is clumsy and nearly duplicates 'tepi sungai'; use 'danau tepian' or 'lagoa tepi'.
Item 5: the type locality is left in English, then 'Mato Grosso State, Brazil' is repeated in brackets. Keep the original name and drop the redundant bracket, or translate it consistently.
Item 2: 'lele berlapis baja' for armoured catfish is acceptable, but 'lele lapis baja' or 'lele berzirah' should be used consistently (item 18 uses both 'berlapis baja' and 'berzirah').

Item 11: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine; 'cacing darah' for bloodworm is fine. However 'Corydoras spp. adalah omnivora yang mencari makan di dasar' adds 'di dasar' (at the bottom), which the English 'foraging' does not say; remove it.
Item 7: the 120 × 45 cm base gives about 243 litres only at a depth of 45 cm, as in the source; fine.
Item 18: 'Ikan ini adalah penghirup udara fakultatif' is stiff; use 'Ikan ini mampu bernapas udara secara fakultatif'.

corydoras-burgessi.name: Corydoras burgessi
notes: Item 4: type locality 'Rio Unini, tributary of Rio Negro, Amazonas, Brazil' left in English; acceptable as a quote but consider 'anak sungai Rio Negro' for readability.
Item 14: 'bernapas dengan udara bila diperlukan (fakultatif)' is awkward; use 'pernapasan udara fakultatif' or 'bisa bernapas langsung dari udara'.
Item 14: 'detail kamuflase atau detail yang memecah bentuk tubuh' is clumsy for 'cryptic or otherwise disruptive details'; simplify.
Item 13: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is fine but 'pembiak' or 'breeder' is more common among hobbyists; 'alder cone' and 'microworm' left in English without gloss.
Item 7: 'akuarium dengan alas berukuran 80 × 30 cm' is slightly stiff; 'alas akuarium minimal 80 × 30 cm' is more natural.
Item 8: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is acceptable, but 'arus air yang tidak terlalu kuat masih bisa diterima' slightly changes 'a degree of water movement is acceptable'.

corydoras-carlae.name: Corydoras carlae
notes: Item 1: "Size: 42 mm SL" omits the English "(1.7")" but that is a fine imperial removal; no fix needed on that.
Item 10: "Mau menerima semua pakan buatan" is awkward; use "Dengan mudah menerima" or "Mudah menerima" instead of "Mau menerima".
Item 10: "diterima dengan lahap dan baik untuk mengondisikan" is awkward; rephrase as "diterima dengan lahap dan bagus untuk mengondisikan induk".
Item 9: "kayu bogwood" mixes terms; use "kayu bogwood" or "kayu apung (driftwood)" consistently. "mengais-ngais" is informal; prefer "menggali" for dig.
Item 6: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is acceptable but "biologically immature" is better as "belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 5: "loricariid" left untranslated; consider "lele Loricariidae (sapu-sapu)".
Item 12: "hidup bergerombol" is fine, but "shoaling" could be kept as "berkelompok"; minor.

corydoras-caudimaculatus.name: Corydoras caudimaculatus
notes: #10: "karena ikan ini sangat menggores tenggorokan" is awkward and unclear; use e.g. "karena duri-durinya sangat melukai/menggores tenggorokan pemangsa".
#14: "Sebagian besar pembiak" - "pembiak" is non-standard; use "peternak" or "pembudidaya".
#14: "spawning mop" and "microworm" are left in English; consider "spawning mop (kain/benang pemijahan)" and "cacing mikro".
#2/#15: "aksila" for axillary glands is stiff; use "kelenjar aksilar" or explain in simple terms.

#12: "betina yang sudah matang seksual" - the English says "individuals" (sexually mature fish) are rounder than males; the Indonesian narrows it to females, which is a slight change. Use "individu dewasa" or "ikan yang matang kelamin".

#1: "bertotol ekor" is OK, but "tidak berkerabat dekat" is fine; "batang ekor (pangkal ekor)" in #2 is fine. #15: "lele" for Callichthyidae is OK, but the 'mailed' alternative is dropped ("armoured" or "mailed" -> only 'lapis baja').
#5: "Lokasi tipe" is stiff; use "Lokalitas tipe".

corydoras-cochui.name: Corydoras cochui
notes: "lele berlapis baja": common hobby term is "lele lapis baja" or keep "armoured catfish"; minor.
"cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "cacing darah" is usually "jentik beku/cacing darah" - minor.
"kelenjar aksila" is a rare term; consider "kelenjar aksilar (axillary gland)".
"berzirah" is slightly unnatural; use "bersisik lempeng" or keep with English in brackets.
"Barredtail cory" left untranslated as a common name; acceptable but could add "(cory ekor bergaris)" if a local name exists.

corydoras-concolor.name: Corydoras concolor
notes: "ikan lele berzirah": 'zirah' is odd; the common hobby term is 'lele lapis baja' or 'lele berpelat/berbaju zirah' — consider "lele berlapis baja".
"saat sedang bertelur" for 'gravid': gravid means carrying eggs, not laying; use "saat sedang membawa telur / bunting telur".
"satu-dua buah alder (alder cone)": 'alder cone' should be translated as "kerucut/runjung alder", not just "buah alder".
"Slate cory" and "kerabat satu genusnya" are acceptable, but "kerabat satu genus" would read more naturally than "kerabat satu genusnya".
"Tubifex" rendered as "cacing sutra": fine, but 'foraging omnivores' as "mencari makan di dasar" adds 'di dasar' (bottom), which is not in the source.

corydoras-condiscipulus.name: Corydoras condiscipulus
notes: Item 10: 'loop' was translated as 'simpul' atau 'jerat' — 'jerat' (snare) is an added meaning; use 'lingkaran'/'lengkung' or just 'simpul'.
Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is fine, but 'pakan yang tenggelam' is slightly awkward; 'pakan kering tenggelam' is more natural.
Item 9: 'sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' is slightly imprecise; use 'sedang membawa telur / bunting telur'.
Item 10: 'SL' left abbreviated after 'panjang standar' was spelled out earlier; use 'panjang standar' consistently.
Item 1/10: 'lele berlapis baja' is a literal rendering; hobbyists commonly say 'corydoras' or 'lele lapis baja'. Add a note of the common name.

corydoras-copei.name: Corydoras copei
notes: In #2, the English type-locality quote is left in English, though a gloss is given in brackets; the gloss drops 'Peru' and the coordinates. Add 'Peru' to the gloss, or translate the whole locality.
In #2, 'Lago Rimachi' is rendered 'Danau Rimachi'; this is fine, but 'anak sungai di tepi kanannya' is slightly awkward. Consider 'anak sungai tepi kanan'.
In #9, 'peternak' (breeders) is better as 'pembiak' or 'penangkar'. 'Burayak' is acceptable, but 'benih' or 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
In #10, 'berzirah' is an odd term for 'mailed'. Consider 'bersisik lempeng' or drop it. 'kelenjar aksila' is stiff; 'kelenjar aksiler' is the more usual form.
In #1, 'kerabat satu genusnya' for 'congeners' is wordy. Consider 'spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama'.

corydoras-crimmeni.name: Corydoras crimmeni
notes: "Sungai Rio Negro" is redundant, since "rio" already means river in Portuguese. Use "daerah aliran Rio Negro" or "Sungai Negro"; this is minor.
"cahaya datang dari arah depan ikan" is a bit stiff. "cahaya menyinari ikan dari depan" would read more naturally; this is minor.

corydoras-cruziensis.name: Corydoras cruziensis
notes: Item 6: "Jangan sekali-kali mengandalkan ikan ini bertahan hidup ... atau mengandalkannya" repeats "mengandalkan"; better "Ikan ini tidak boleh dibiarkan bertahan hidup dari 'sisa' pakan ... atau diandalkan untuk 'membersihkan' akuarium".
Items 1/9: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering of "armoured catfish"; hobbyists commonly say "lele lapis baja" or just "Corydoras". "berzirah" for 'mailed' is rare; consider "berlapis zirah".

Item 1/2: "daerah aliran" for "basin" and "drainages" is acceptable, but "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine; "garis di tengah sisi tubuh" for "midlateral stripe" is slightly clumsy; consider "garis horizontal di sisi tengah tubuh".

corydoras-davidsandsi.name: Corydoras davidsandsi
notes: Item 1: "Bersama H. melini, garis tersebut terbelah dua" reads as if the bar splits together with H. melini; rephrase: "Seperti H. melini, garis tersebut terbelah dua di atas pangkal ekor" (shared feature).
Item 1: "Sand's cory (cory davidsandsi)" adds a redundant invented common name; also "adalah corydoras, ikan lele berbaju zirah" is awkward; use "sejenis ikan lele berbaju zirah".
Item 2: "endemik di sistem anak sungai tersebut, yang terletak di hilir Rio Negro" is acceptable but "lower rio Negro" should be "bagian hilir DAS Rio Negro" to stay consistent with item 1.
Item 3: "yang dimaksud pihak yang mendeskripsikan spesies ini" is wordy; "the author" can be rendered more neutrally as "deskripsi aslinya".

Item 3: "kesadahan nyaris tak terdeteksi, konduktivitas rendah" breaks the parallel with "warna gelap oleh senyawa organik"; the original refers to organic chemicals making water stained, phrasing is slightly awkward.

Item 9: "betina yang sudah matang kelamin ... dibanding jantan" changes the meaning slightly: the English says sexually mature individuals (females) are rounder than males; acceptable but "betina" repeated; low priority.

Item 10: "burayak" is correct but "Burayak tampaknya lebih jarang terserang penyakit" - the English "They" likely refers to the fish generally (not only fry); the translation narrows the meaning to fry only; use "Ikan ini".
Item 10: "pembiak" is non-standard; use "peternak/pembudidaya"; "microworm" and "alder cone" are left in English without glosses, e.g. "cacing mikro", "buah alder".

corydoras-delphax.name: Corydoras delphax
notes: Item 3: "Ukuran alas minimal 90 × 30 cm disarankan" is awkward passive word order; use "Disarankan ukuran alas minimal 90 × 30 cm".

Item 1/10: "lele berlapis baja (armoured catfish)" and "kelompok lele 'berlapis baja' atau 'berzirah'" are literal; "lele berperisai" or "lele lapis baja" is more common, though the meaning is intact.

Item 9: "burayak" is a less common word among hobbyists; "larva" or "anakan" is more natural. Also "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" is awkward, since the English subject is the fish/species; use "Ikan ini tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan".
Item 9: "naupli artemia" and "microworm" are mixed; use consistent forms such as "nauplii Artemia" and "cacing mikro".

Item 10: "kelenjar aksila" is a stiff term; "kelenjar aksilar" or a short explanation would be better. "Mereka adalah pernapas udara fakultatif" is stiff; "Ikan ini dapat bernapas udara secara fakultatif" is more natural.
Item 5: Using a space in "22–27 °C" is fine, but the decimal commas "5,5–7,5" are correct Indonesian, so no change is needed here.

corydoras-desana.name: Corydoras desana
notes: Item 4: "Mau menerima semua pakan buatan" is awkward for a fish; use "Mudah menerima semua pakan buatan yang tenggelam ke dasar akuarium".
Item 3: "kayu rendam" for "bogwood" is non-standard; use "kayu bogwood/driftwood" or "kayu apung" consistently with the earlier "kayu (driftwood)".
Item 3: "sungut ikan rusak saat ikan mengais dasar" is slightly clumsy; "merusak sungut ikan saat ikan menggali/mengais substrat" is more natural.
Item 1: "Data Deficient (kurang data; ...)" is fine, but "armour" bracket could be dropped; "lempeng pelindung" is slightly unusual, "lempeng tulang/sisik keras" is more common.
Item 5: "shoaling" translated as "suka hidup bergerombol" is fine, but "ikan komunitas" is acceptable; no real issue.
Item 7: "Unreported" and "no breeding report" repeated; acceptable but could use "Belum ada laporan".

corydoras-diphyes.name: Corydoras diphyes
notes: "hanya tersedia sesekali" is slightly stiff; "hanya sesekali tersedia" or "jarang tersedia" reads more naturally.
"Padahal, spesies tersebut berasal dari negara bagian Sao Paulo" adds a contrastive tone not in the source; "namun spesies tersebut berasal dari..." is closer to "however".

corydoras-duplicareus.name: Corydoras duplicareus
notes: Item 4: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is acceptable but "air-powered" is more naturally "digerakkan udara"; consider "filter spons yang digerakkan pompa udara".
Item 10: "gravid" in item 8 is "bertelur penuh"; more natural: "sedang penuh telur" or "bunting telur".
Item 1/10: "spesies satu genus" for "congeners" is slightly awkward; use "kerabat segenus".

Item 6: "Tubifex" translated as "cacing sutra" is fine, but "Corydoras spp." opening could be rephrased more naturally; "suka mengais makanan" is slightly loose for "foraging" (e.g. "pencari makan di dasar").
Item 3: "anak-anak sungai blackwater yang masih asri" fine, but "karasin" for characids is non-standard; hobbyists use "characin" or "karasin" inconsistently—consider "characid (karasin)".

corydoras-ehrhardti.name: Corydoras ehrhardti
notes: Item 2: 'Sao Paulo' lacks the tilde, unlike elsewhere in the text; write 'São Paulo' (it is a source typo, but it should be consistent).
Item 2: 'sungai Jaraguá, Iguaçu, ...' mixes 'sungai' with 'Rio' (Rio Paranapanema); use one form, e.g. 'rio' for all or 'Sungai' for all.
Item 9: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is wrong for a list that includes Brochis garbei, which is a different genus; use 'spesies sekerabat' or 'spesies mirip lainnya'. The same applies in item 1.
Item 9: 'kelompok lele ... berzirah' is a bit stiff; 'lele bersisik lempeng' or 'lele lapis baja' would be more natural. 'mailed' could be 'berperisai'.
Item 8: 'saat sedang bertelur' for 'gravid' should be 'saat sedang penuh telur/bunting telur'; 'bertelur' means laying eggs, not carrying them.
Item 5: 'Kesadahan (GH): 5–15 dGH' is fine, but 'Kesadahan' should be consistent with the GH terms used elsewhere. Minor.

corydoras-elegans.name: Corydoras elegans
notes: Item 17: "plus the 'CW' numbers ... respectively" – the translation drops the paired 'respectively' meaning; acceptable, but "berzirah" is an uncommon term for "mailed"; prefer "berlapis baja/bersisik tulang" or just keep 'armoured'.

Items 2, 17: "cukup sering berada jauh dari dasar, dan sering membentuk kelompok" repeats "sering"; rephrase, e.g. "cukup banyak menghabiskan waktu jauh dari dasar dan kerap membentuk kelompok di tengah kolom air".
Item 9: "kayu bogwood" is redundant/awkward; use "kayu apung (bogwood)" or "akar/kayu rambatan". "Kerikil bulat ... kurang sempurna" is stiff; "alternatif yang kurang ideal" is more natural.

Item 16: "peternak" for breeders is acceptable but "penangkar" is more common; "Burayak" for fry is fine. "wadah tanpa substrat" for bare-bottom is ok; "spawning mop yang halus" could be "spawning mop bertekstur halus".
Item 10: "juga lahap dimakan" is slightly stronger than "readily accepted"; "mudah diterima" is more faithful.
Item 15: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" should be "saat penuh telur / bunting telur" (they are not laying yet).

corydoras-ellisae.name: Corydoras ellisae
notes: "Corydoras paleatus (peppered cory)" adds a Latin name not in the English source (which only says "Peppered Corydoras"); render it as "Corydoras peppered" or "cory peppered" without introducing the Latin name, or confirm it is the intended species.
"paling banyak dipelihara di hobi ini" is slightly awkward and shifts "most widespread" to "most kept"; consider "paling umum/tersebar luas dalam hobi akuarium".

corydoras-ephippifer.name: Corydoras ephippifer
notes: Item 2: type locality quote is left in English; acceptable as a quoted locality name, but 'Lokasi tipenya' could be 'Lokalitas tipe' (the more standard term).
Item 1/8: 'kerabat satu kelompoknya' is awkward for 'congeners'; use 'spesies sekerabat dalam satu genus' or 'kongener'.
Item 8: 'kelenjar aksila' is stiff; consider 'kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada (aksila)'.
Item 5: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is fine, but 'pakan' vs 'makanan' usage is consistent; no change needed beyond optional keeping 'Tubifex' in brackets.

corydoras-flaveolus.name: Corydoras flaveolus
notes: Item 6: 'sungut dagu' is fine, but 'penghirup udara fakultatif' is slightly awkward; prefer 'bernapas udara fakultatif'.
Item 6: 'lele berlapis baja' is a calque; hobbyists use 'lele lapis baja' or just 'corydoras'. Consider 'corydoras' as the common name.
Item 6: 'kelenjar aksila' is an odd term; use 'kelenjar aksiler' (axillary glands).
Item 6: 'cekung secara tajam' is awkward; prefer 'cekung tajam' or 'tiba-tiba cekung'.
Item 6: 'iskiadik dorsal basipterygium' is stiff; use 'tonjolan iskiadik dorsal pada basipterigium', and keep the spelling consistent.
Item 2: type locality quote left in English; acceptable as a quoted citation, but it could be glossed.
Item 5: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine, but consider adding 'Tubifex' in brackets since the Latin name was dropped.

corydoras-fowleri.name: Cory fowleri
notes: Item 11: "volume sekitar 243 liter" – 120×45 cm base volume should be a rounded figure; verify the number against the source (it is unchanged, but the tank size should be stated as a sensible round figure, e.g. sekitar 240 liter).

Item 13: "Gunakan akuarium yang banyak tanaman airnya" is fine but "longer snouted ... well suited to most community tanks" contradicts items 2 and 20 in the source; the translation faithfully repeats it, so no fix, but the contradiction is a source issue.
Item 22: "sirip perutnya tampak jelas membulat" – 'ventral fins' = sirip perut is OK, but 'thickened anterior pectoral-fin rays' should say 'jari-jari keras depan' clearly; minor.
Item 27: 'C. semiquilus' typo kept; 'tidak bisa memastikannya' fine. 'milegros' vs 'Milagros' inconsistent with item 4 – source issue, leave.
Item 5: "pelat baja" for 'armour plates' is awkward; use "pelat tulang (lapis baja)".
Item 25: 'burayak' used for fry but 'mereka' mixing; also 'induk atau telurnya harus dipindahkan' fine. 'alder cone' left untranslated; add 'kerucut pohon alder'.
Item 19: 'white worm', 'grindal worm' left in English without Indonesian explanation; add 'cacing putih' etc.
Item 1: 'Corydoras ... yang paling cantik' omits 'at all' nuance; minor.

corydoras-fulleri.name: Corydoras C115
notes: Item 3: "kayu" for driftwood/bogwood is vague; use "kayu apung/kayu driftwood" for driftwood and "kayu akar" for bogwood consistently.
Item 3: "mengais-ngais substrat" is slightly colloquial; "mengorek substrat" is more natural.
Item 4: "white worm" is left untranslated while the other worms are glossed; consider "cacing putih (white worm)" for consistency.
Item 8: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is fine, but "jari-jari sirip punggung" could be "jari-jari sirip dorsal", the term hobbyists use.

corydoras-geryi.name: Corydoras geryi
notes: "Sungai Río Mamoré" is redundant because río means river. Use "Sungai Mamoré" or "Río Mamoré".
"jenis kelamin ... paling mudah dibedakan" is fine, but "penuh telur" could be "bertelur penuh" or "sarat telur". This is optional polish only.

corydoras-gladysae.name: Corydoras gladysae
notes: Item 2: "bagian hulu lembah Sungai Paraná" for "upper Río Paraná basin" — "basin" here means drainage basin; use "daerah aliran sungai (DAS) Paraná bagian hulu", not "lembah".
Item 1 and 8: "tinggi badan yang berkurang (tubuh lebih rendah)" is awkward; use "tubuh yang lebih pipih/ramping" or "tinggi tubuh yang lebih rendah".
Item 5: "batu yang halus terkikis arus (water-worn)" is clumsy; use "batu yang terkikis/halus karena arus air".
Item 3: "Onchorhyncus mykiss" repeats the source misspelling; the correct Latin name is Oncorhynchus mykiss (flag, or leave unchanged if the rule is to keep Latin names).
Item 8: "kerabat satu genusnya" for "congeners" is wordy; use "spesies lain dalam genus yang sama".
Item 8: "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; use "ikan yang dapat bernapas langsung dengan udara (fakultatif)".
Item 9: the reference is left untranslated, which is allowed. No change needed.

corydoras-gomezi.name: Corydoras gomezi
notes: Item 3: "Ukuran alas minimal 90 × 30 cm disarankan" is awkward passive word order; rephrase as "Disarankan ukuran alas minimal 90 × 30 cm".

Item 9: "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" changes the subject; the English says the species (not only the fry) is not the easiest to raise. Use "Ikan ini tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan".
Item 9: "spawning mop", "alder cone" and "breeder" are left in English; prefer "penangkar" for breeder and add a gloss for the other two (e.g. "kerucut alder").
Item 9: "wadah tanpa substrat" is fine, but "lebih tahan penyakit" is slightly stronger than "less susceptible to ailments"; this is minor.
Item 10: "kelenjar aksila" is a stiff term; consider "kelenjar aksilar" or "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada".
Item 6: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "Tubifex" is the name hobbyists commonly use; consider giving it in brackets.

corydoras-gossei.name: Corydoras gossei
notes: Item 3: '90 × 30 cm (about 81 litres)' kept as is. The tank volume is given without a depth, so it cannot be checked. Round the figure to a sensible value if it is converted (e.g. 'sekitar 80 liter').

Item 2: 'Mamoré adalah salah satu anak sungai utama di hulu rio Madeira' is fine. 'affluent' and 'tributary' are rendered the same way, which loses the nuance. 'dengan pertemuan alirannya' is awkward; use 'yang bermuara di sebelah timur Manaus'.

Item 2: the type locality quote is left in English. Keep the original place names but translate the descriptive words, e.g. 'anak sungai dekat Guajará Mirim ... sistem rio Mamoré, negara bagian Rondônia, Brasil'.
Item 1/2: 'daerah aliran sungai rio Mamoré' is redundant ('sungai rio'). In item 2 'Sungai Mamoré' is used alongside 'rio Mamoré'. Use one form consistently.
Item 9: 'burayak' is used for fry, which is acceptable. 'peternak' for breeders is odd for hobbyists; use 'penghobi' or 'pembiak'.
Item 9: 'spawning mop' and 'alder cone' are left in English with no gloss. Add 'kerucut alder' or a short explanation.
Item 10: 'detail kamuflase atau detail yang memecah bentuk tubuh' is clumsy for 'cryptic or otherwise disruptive details'. Rephrase, e.g. 'corak penyamaran atau pemecah siluet'.
Item 10: 'berzirah' for 'mailed' is unusual. Use 'lele lapis baja' or 'lele bersisik tulang'.

corydoras-gracilis.name: Corydoras gracilis
notes: Item 10: "peternak" is a bit off for hobby breeders; prefer "penangkar" or "pembiak".
