Item 10: "burayak" is fine, but "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" is slightly awkward; consider "Burayak tidak mudah dibesarkan".
Item 11: "lele berlapis baja" and "berzirah" are acceptable, but "pernapas udara fakultatif" could read more naturally as "dapat bernapas langsung dari udara (fakultatif)".
Item 11: "nomor 'C' C041, C088..." reads awkwardly; add a colon or a comma, e.g. "nomor 'C', yaitu C041, ...".
Item 11: "cairan yang dikeluarkan kelenjar aksila" is acceptable, but "sekresi" is closer to the source.
Item 2: "di hulu Juriti" loses the "rio" (the river name), so write "di hulu rio Juriti".

corydoras-granti.name: Corydoras granti
notes: Item 1: "corydoras bergaris lengkung" is fine, but "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable; no issue. Main fix: item 4 "kayu apung yang melengkung" for "arching bogwood" is okay, but "bogwood" and "driftwood" are merged into one term; consider "kayu bogwood" or "akar kayu" for variety.
Item 4: "membuat sekelompok ikan ini merasa tenang" is slightly loose for "settle"; consider "betah" or "merasa aman".
Item 5: "Mau menerima" sounds awkward for "Readily accepts"; use "Mudah menerima" or "Doyan".
Item 5: "kutu air (Daphnia)" is more commonly "kutu air" but "Daphnia" alone is also used; fine. "cacing sutra (Tubifex)" is fine.
Item 9: "tidak dinilai sebagai nomen nudum" is ambiguous; clarify as "tidak dianggap sebagai nomen nudum".
Item 2: "Kadang bagian cleithrum berwarna emas" is acceptable; "cleithrum" could be glossed as "tulang cleithrum".

corydoras-griseus.name: Corydoras griseus
notes: Item 3: "sekitar 81 liter" is the English figure kept as is; 90 × 30 cm base depth is unspecified, so it is acceptable, but "liter" vs "L" is fine. No real problem.
Item 9: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off; use "penangkar" or "pembudidaya".
Item 9: "burayak" is fine, but "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" is awkward; rephrase as "Burayak tidak tergolong mudah dibesarkan".
Item 10: "berzirah" is uncommon; use "berlapis baja" for both terms, or "bersungut berlapis" (mailed).
Item 10: "kelenjar aksila" is overly technical; consider "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada (aksila)".
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" is understandable, but hobbyists commonly say "corydoras" or "lele berlapis"; consider adding the term "armoured catfish" in brackets.

corydoras-guapore.name: Corydoras guapore
notes: Item 1/10/11: "kutu air" for Daphnia is ambiguous (in Indonesia it can also mean skin fungus/lice); use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".
Item 10: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for hobbyists; "breeder"/"pembudidaya" is more natural.
Item 1: "sirip ekor yang bercabang tegas" is awkward; "sirip ekor bercagak jelas" is more natural.
Item 11: "relung ekologi yang berbeda-beda" and "memanfaatkan keuntungan mencari makan" are slightly clumsy; simplify.
Item 11: "Ikan ini adalah pernapas udara fakultatif" could be phrased "ikan ini dapat bernapas dengan udara secara fakultatif".
Item 4: 90 × 30 cm base gives about 81 L only if the height is 30 cm; this is fine, but "akuarium" is slightly redundant in "ukuran dasar akuarium" (minor).

corydoras-habrosus.name: Cory habrosus
notes: Item 6: 'southwestern Venezuela' is translated as 'Venezuela barat daya' (should be southwest, which is correct)... but 'Río Meta bagian hilir' drops 'the latter a tributary of the lower Río Meta' structure: fine; however 'other left bank Orinoco affluents' → 'anak-anak sungai tepi kiri Orinoco' OK. Real issue: 'Sungai Cinaruco dan Capanaparo' - original 'ríos'; minor.
Item 9: '(about 54 litres)' is kept; fine. Item 10: 40-litre tank vs item 9 60×30 cm - source inconsistency, no fix needed.
Item 13: '26-30°C' contradicts items 14/15 (20–26 °C) in the source; check that it is faithful, translation is faithful but flag for editor.
Item 3: 'terbesar di antara tiga spesies' faithful; however item 4 'peppered cory ... 6,4 cm' OK.
Item 8: 'Ratusan ekor berkumpul ... sambil menyaring substrat' - add 'Cory habrosus' subject clarity: 'Hundreds of them' ok. 'sifting' fine.
Item 19: 'Meskipun mereka "penyedot debu" yang andal' lacks verb 'adalah'; fix: 'Meskipun mereka adalah "penyedot debu" yang andal'.
Item 21: 'ikan bergerombol' vs 'schooling fish' fine; 'Mereka bisa hidup bersama udang hias kerdil' ok.
Item 2: 'Max size: 35 mm SL' while item 4 says 4 cm in item 1 - source inconsistency; not a translation error.
Item 25: 'Mereka adalah penghirup udara fakultatif' - 'Mereka' shifts from 'Ikan ini'; minor consistency.
Item 7: 'dataran padang rumput tropis yang sangat luas yang dilintasi' - awkward double 'yang'; rephrase.

corydoras-haraldschultzi.name: Corydoras haraldschultzi
notes: Item 12: 'Corydoras adalah penghirup udara fakultatif' – the English says 'They' (the family/Callichthyidae), but the translation says Corydoras, which changes the subject. This species is now Brochis. Use 'Ikan-ikan ini' instead.

Item 12: the English sentence about 'armoured' or 'mailed' catfishes is shortened, and 'mailed' is omitted. The translation also drops the quotation marks around the term. Add the 'mailed' alternative back.
Item 12: 'diduga sedikit beracun' drops 'or venomous' from 'mildly toxic or venomous'. Add 'atau berbisa'.

Item 1: 'Corydoras cantik ... kembaran bermoncong panjang' – 'counterpart' is rendered as 'kembaran' (twin), which overstates it. Also, 'show size' is better as 'ukuran pamer' or 'ukuran dewasa/siap kontes'. Use 'padanan'.

Item 3: 'Brasil, Goiás' changes the quoted type-locality text 'Brazil-Goias'. The 'former is correct as per the image' is rendered as 'foto', which is acceptable. 'daerah aliran Sungai Amazon' should be 'Sungai Amazon bagian tengah'. 'affluent' is rendered as 'anak sungai utama', which is fine.

Item 11: 'alder cone' is rendered as 'buah alder', which is unnatural. Use 'kerucut alder' or 'cone alder'. 'Burayak' for fry is fine, but the last paragraph switches to 'akuarium tanpa substrat' for 'bare arrangement', which is acceptable.

Item 5: the volume 108 litres is not rounded to the nearest 5 litres (the English gives 108 litres already in metric, so it stays). The wording 'Panjang standar: 85 mm SL' is redundant. Use 'Panjang standar maksimal 85 mm'.

corydoras-hastatus.name: Corydoras hastatus
notes: Item 3: "Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Paraguay, dan Uruguay" matches the English, so no change is needed here.
Item 6: "sekitar 54 liter" is the English figure left unchanged and is fine; no change.
Item 14: "Ulangi setiap hari sampai ikan memijah" is fine; no change.
Item 11: "tidak terlalu terikat di dasar" is awkward. Use "tidak terlalu menghuni dasar" or "tidak selalu berada di dasar".
Item 15: "garis samping yang 'hitam pekat'" renders "lateral stripe" as "lateral line" (garis samping). Use "garis lateral" or "garis di sisi tubuh", as in the other items.
Item 1: the sentence "Sampai belum lama ini" is awkward. Use "Hingga baru-baru ini".
Item 4: "Sanatrém" is kept as in the source, but it is probably a typo for Santarém. Ideally correct or flag it.
Item 2: "Tail-spot pygmy cory" is left in English without a local name. It would be better to add a gloss such as "(lele kerdil bercak ekor)".

Item 14: "burayak" is used for the fry, but the next sentence switches to "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan", which makes it unclear whether the English means the species or the fry. The English refers to the species, so use "Ikan ini".

corydoras-imitator.name: Corydoras imitator
notes: Item 1/4: 'imitator cory' etc. fine, but item 1 omits nothing; however item 9 'minimal 4–6 ekor' is fine. Main issue is item 5: 'Volume: ~81 liter' should be rounded sensibly (e.g. ~80 liter); minor.

Item 7: 'ikan tangkapan alam' is okay, but 'mungkin paling cocok di bagian tengah hingga bawah' is slightly awkward; 'wild fish may do best towards the middle and lower ends' -> 'ikan tangkapan alam mungkin lebih baik di kisaran tengah dan bawah'.
Item 13: 'Kelompok dugaan ini' is awkward; use 'Kelompok yang diduga ini' / 'kelompok putatif ini'.
Item 13: 'penghirup udara fakultatif' is acceptable but 'Mereka' with no antecedent; use 'Ikan ini/Corydoras'.
Item 13: 'karena adanya pelat tulang sebagai pengganti sisik' fine; 'pola jala' for 'reticulations' could be 'pola jaring-jaring'.
Item 14: reference list left untranslated, correct.

Item 11: 'Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan' adds 'Burayak' as subject while English says the species (they) are not easiest to raise; minor, fine, rephrase to 'Ikan ini tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan'.
Item 11: 'indukan atau telurnya harus dipindahkan' ok; 'breeder' could be 'pembudidaya/penangkar'.

corydoras-incolicana.name: Corydoras incolicana
notes: Item 4: "sekitar 108 liter" – the figure is not rounded; round to a sensible figure such as "sekitar 110 liter" (or 105).
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" and "Ikan ini adalah yang pertama kali mendapat nomor 'C'" are slightly awkward; phrase more naturally, e.g. "lele lapis baja" and "Ikan pertama yang mendapat nomor 'C'".
Item 7: "Jangan sekali-kali mengharapkan ikan ini bisa bertahan hidup dari 'sisa makanan'" is stiff; "Ikan ini tidak boleh dibiarkan hanya hidup dari 'sisa makanan'" is more natural.
Item 10: "peternak" is not the usual hobby term; use "breeder" or "pembiak". The English terms "spawning mop" and "alder cone" are left unexplained; consider adding "(kerucut pohon alder)".
Item 11: "kelenjar aksila" is an odd anatomical term for the axillary glands; use "kelenjar ketiak" or "kelenjar aksilar". "diduga bahkan sedikit beracun" reads awkwardly.

corydoras-julii.name: Corydoras julii
notes: Item 3: "sekitar 81 liter" — 90×30 cm base volume is the source's figure, so fine; no change needed except check that it is not an altered number.
Item 2: "sungai Guamá ... rio Ararandeua" — inconsistent: use either "sungai" or "rio" for river names consistently (e.g., "rio Guamá" or "Sungai Ararandeua").
Item 9: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off; "pembudidaya" or "penangkar" is more usual in the hobby.
Item 9: "Telur ... digulirkan perlahan ke atas kaca" is awkward; use "digeser perlahan ke atas kaca dengan jari".
Item 10: "kelompok lele 'berlapis baja' atau 'berzirah'" — "berzirah" is unusual; use "berlapis baja" or "bersungut berbaju zirah" consistently.
Item 1/10: "Lokasi tipe" is fine, but "lele berlapis baja" for catfish is fine; consider "lembah Amazon" -> "daerah aliran sungai Amazon" for basin.

corydoras-kanei.name: Corydoras kanei
notes: #13: "untuk keperluan penataan" kurang tepat untuk "organisation"; lebih natural "untuk keperluan pengelompokan/pencatatan".

corydoras-lamberti.name: Corydoras lamberti
notes: Item 2: "Region Loreto" is awkward; use "Wilayah Loreto" or "Provinsi Loreto".
Item 2: "hulu lembah Amazon" for "upper Amazon basin"; "daerah aliran sungai (DAS) Amazon bagian hulu" is more natural.
Item 2: the type locality is kept in English and then translated in brackets; the translation omits the coordinates and "Lago Rimachi" detail in the bracket. This is minor.
Item 9: "peternak" for "breeders" is acceptable but "pembiak" or "penangkar" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 9: "burayak" is fine, but "Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan" shifts the subject. The English says the species ("They"), not only the fry, is not easy to raise.
Item 10: "kelenjar aksila" is overly technical; use "kelenjar aksilaris" or add the English term.
Item 6: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine, but "Tubifex" is also common among hobbyists.

corydoras-leopardus.name: Corydoras leopard
notes: Item 5: "batu-batu halus" for "smooth rocks" is slightly off; "batu bertepi halus/licin" or "batu yang permukaannya halus" reads more naturally.

Item 10: "Pada Osteogaster aenea telah dibuktikan bahwa betina meminum sperma" is stiff; "terbukti" or "diketahui" fits better. "Condition a group" as "Kondisikan satu kelompok" is also awkward; "Siapkan indukan dengan pakan hidup dan beku" is more usual.
Item 10: "move them out" is translated as "pindahkan induk"; this is fine in meaning but ambiguous; say "pindahkan induk dari akuarium pemijahan".
Item 1: "Leopard cory" is left untranslated, which is acceptable; "lele lapis baja" is a non-standard term, and hobbyists usually write "corydoras" or "cory".
Item 11: "Anda akan melihatnya" shifts register slightly; a neutral "sesekali terlihat melesat ke permukaan" would match the neutral style used elsewhere.
Item 3: "danau tapal kuda" for oxbow lake is a legitimate term, but "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" would be clearer for hobbyists. "perairan tenang" for backwaters is a loose rendering.

corydoras-leucomelas.name: Corydoras leucomelas
notes: Item 4: 'Alas akuarium' is a bit stiff; 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' is more natural.
Item 1: 'lele berzirah' is odd; 'lele berlapis/berperisai' is clearer, and it is inconsistent with 'lele berzirah/berperisai' in item 11.
Item 11: 'jari-jari depan sirip punggung' for 'leading ray' is acceptable but could read 'jari-jari sirip lunak terdepan'.
Item 10: 'burayak' is correct, but 'mereka' for the fry is a bit informal.
Item 10: 'Ikan ini tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan' is slightly awkward; 'tidak mudah dibesarkan' is more natural.
Item 2: 'danau tapal kuda' for 'cutoff lake' is acceptable; 'danau oxbow/tapal kuda' is fine.
Item 7: 'Jangan sekali-kali mengharapkan' is slightly stiff.

corydoras-longipinnis.name: Corydoras longipinnis
notes: Item 1: "Size: 61 mm SL" is fine, but "julukan spesiesnya" is non-standard for "specific epithet"; use "epitet spesifik" or "nama spesies".
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is redundant; keep just "Belum Dievaluasi".
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable, but "lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.
Item 3: "Belum dilaporkan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan." repeats itself, though this mirrors the source.

corydoras-loretoensis.name: Corydoras loretoensis
notes: Item 9: "musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference from the source, which is irrelevant for readers in Indonesia and could confuse them. Rephrase it neutrally, e.g. "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara", or note that it is the dry season in the species' home region.
Item 8 (English original): "Females are noticeably rounder... than females" is a source error. The Indonesian correctly says betina vs jantan, so this is fine. No change needed.
Item 6: "Mau menerima" sounds odd and anthropomorphic for "Will accept". Use "Menerima" or "Mau memakan".
Item 4: "bogwood" is left untranslated. Use "kayu bogwood (kayu rawa)" or "kayu driftwood", which is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.

Item 10: "Walaupun mau memakan apa saja yang muat di mulut" adds "apa saja". The original says "bite-sized items such as eggs or fry". Use "hal-hal berukuran sekecil gigitan" or "makanan berukuran kecil seperti telur atau burayak".
Item 10: "Keanekaragaman... yang sebagian membuat" is awkward. Smooth it, e.g. "Sebagian karena keragaman inilah ... corydoras menjadi salah satu ikan paling populer".
Item 10: "pemakan sisa" for "scavengers" is acceptable, but "cory" and "corydoras" are used inconsistently. Pick one term and use it throughout.
Item 10: "pakan jenis tenggelam" is stiff. Use "pakan tenggelam".

corydoras-loxozonus.name: Corydoras loxozonus
notes: Item 6: 'Volume: ~51 litres' kept; fine, but 'Panjang standar: 55 mm SL' fine. No issue.

Item 13: 'Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris' keeps the UK reference, which is meaningless for Indonesian readers (no winter); rephrase neutrally, e.g. 'di belahan bumi utara/Eropa' or explain.
Item 13: 'ganti air ... dengan air yang lebih dingin' is correct, but 'burayak' is used for both fry and 'anakan' inconsistently; use one term (burayak/anakan).

Item 8 contradicts item 9 (25 °C minimum vs 21–24 °C), and item 8 contradicts items 2/11 (prefers lower temperatures). The source is inconsistent, but the translation reproduces it without comment. Check against the source, as this is a care-advice conflict.
Item 10: 'Mau menerima' is awkward; use 'Menerima' or 'Ikan ini mau makan'.
Item 7: 'sungutnya bisa rusak/hilang' – use a single wording: 'sungutnya bisa terkikis/hilang'.
Item 13: 'jangan memakai filter bawah (undergravel)' fine, but 'fungussing' → 'berjamur' fine. 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' OK.
Item 3: 'anak-anak sungainya' for 'affluents' acceptable; 'anak sungai' is more natural.
Item 15: 'penghirup udara fakultatif' → 'pernapasan udara fakultatif' is more natural; 'sengatan' OK.
Item 15: 'agresi ... hampir tidak pernah terdengar' → 'hampir tidak pernah terjadi' is more natural.

corydoras-melanistius.name: Corydoras melanistius
notes: Item 10: "Udang red cherry, Neocardina heteropoda" – the English says "Cherry shrimp"; "red" was added. Use "Udang cherry".
Item 10: "Jika memilih memindahkan telur, ternyata telurnya cukup kuat" – "ternyata" (turns out) implies surprise that isn't in the source. Use "telurnya cukup kuat".
Item 11: "Meskipun mau memakan apa saja yang muat di mulut" overstates "bite-sized items such as eggs or fry". Use "sesuatu yang berukuran sekali telan".

Item 1/4: "lele berlapis baja" is a literal rendering of "armoured catfish". The terms "lele lapis baja" or "catfish" are more natural to hobbyists. Also "Spotted cory" is left untranslated without being a local name.
Item 10: "Saat memijahkan cory, selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak" is clumsy. Use "Sebaiknya jumlah jantan lebih banyak daripada betina".

Item 10: "Musim ini jatuh pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference, which is fine, but Indonesian readers lack a winter. Add a clarification such as "(sekitar Desember–Februari)" only if the source supports it.

Item 10: "dua pilihan" and "Pindahkan indukan dan besarkan anakan" – the source says "a couple of choices", so "dua" is fine, but "anakan" vs "burayak" are mixed for "brood/fry". Use one term consistently.
Item 4: "~41 litres" is converted to "sekitar 41 liter", but the source's own metric figure sits oddly with the 5-litre rounding. Round to "sekitar 40 liter".
Item 11: "Selalu gunakan pakan tenggelam" – "fish above" is rendered "ikan-ikan di atasnya", which is acceptable. "Kutu air" for Daphnia (item 7) is a hobby term, but "daphnia" is more precise.

corydoras-melanotaenia.name: Corydoras Green Gold
notes: "Udang red cherry": the English says only "Cherry shrimp". Drop "red", or use the usual "udang cherry".
"Musim dingin di Inggris": the UK reference is kept, which may confuse Indonesian readers. Consider "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara", or keep it as is.
"buah alder cone" is redundant, because "cone" already means "buah". Use "kerucut alder (alder cone)".
"Cory green gold" is awkward. Consider "Cory hijau-emas (green-gold cory)".

corydoras-melini.name: Corydoras melini
notes: #17: "Burayak membutuhkan kualitas air..." — the English "They" is ambiguous and could mean all the fish. Consider "Ikan ini/burayak" to keep the original scope.
#18: "pengacau bentuk" for "disruptive" is awkward. Consider "pola pemecah bentuk tubuh (disruptif)".
#18: "lele 'berzirah'" is an uncommon term. Consider "lele 'bersisik tulang'" or keep "mailed" in brackets.

corydoras-metae.name: Corydoras metae
notes: Item 9: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off; "penangkar" or "pembiak" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 1: the common names are left in English as "cory 'masked' atau 'Meta'". Consider "cory bertopeng" or "cory Meta", with the English in brackets.
Item 9: "digulirkan perlahan ke atas kaca" is awkward. "digeser/digulung perlahan di kaca dengan jari" reads more naturally.
Item 2: "sungai Humea" is mixed with "Río Humea" in the same passage. Use one form consistently.
Item 6: "Corydoras spp. adalah omnivora yang mencari makan di dasar" is acceptable but a little wordy.

corydoras-napoensis.name: Corydoras napoensis
notes: Item 1: "hidup bersama di alam" is fine, but "Ikan ini termasuk dalam ... bersama G. elegans" is OK; no change needed here.

Item 12: "Neocardina heteropoda" is a Latin name and was left unchanged, so it is fine. But "Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps a UK reference that is irrelevant to Indonesian readers. Rephrase it neutrally, e.g. "di belahan bumi utara".

Item 12: "sebaiknya selalu tambahkan ... methylene blue ... mencegah jamur" is OK. "kemungkinan besar sebagian telur tetap akan berjamur" slightly strengthens "probably", so use "kemungkinan sebagian".
Item 12: "Udang cherry" should be "udang cherry (cherry shrimp)" or the usual "cherry red". Minor.
Item 5: "Anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai kecil" renders "small tributaries, creeks" redundantly. Use "anak sungai kecil, kali/sungai kecil" and better distinguish "creeks" (e.g. "alur sungai").
Item 9: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)" is clearer, since Indonesian hobbyists often write it as "daphnia".

Item 13: "Kedua sistem ini diperkenalkan oleh ... tetapi terbukti menjadi alat yang sangat berharga" is fine. "agresi terhadap spesies lain hampir tidak pernah terdengar" is stiff. Use "nyaris tidak pernah ditemui".
Item 13: "mereka tidak akan sehat jika diharapkan bertahan hidup dari sisa pakan" is awkward. Use "mereka tidak akan sehat jika hanya mengandalkan sisa pakan".
Item 3: The original says "Fairly widespread", and the translation adds nothing. But Item 1 says "Peru dan Kolombia" while Item 3 says "Ekuador dan Peru". That mismatch is in the source, so keep it.

corydoras-narcissus.name: Corydoras narcissus
notes: Item 11: "Intraspecific hostility ... Provided space isn't an issue" fine, but "Selalu gunakan pakan jenis tenggelam agar cory mendapat jumlah makanan yang cukup" is OK; the real issue: "mereka tidak akan sehat bila diharapkan bertahan hidup hanya dari sisa makanan" is awkward; rephrase to "tidak akan berkembang baik jika hanya mengandalkan sisa makanan".
Item 3: "Anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai kecil" renders tributaries and creeks as near-duplicates; use "anak sungai, sungai kecil/kali".
Item 5/10/11: "kayu apung" for driftwood is misleading (means floating wood); use "kayu bogwood/kayu rendam" or "kayu driftwood".
Item 5: "sungutnya bisa rusak/hilang" - use one wording ("sungutnya bisa terkikis/hilang"); slash is awkward.

Item 10: "Neocardina heteropoda" Latin name should be unchanged - OK; but "Udang cherry" fine. "musim dingin di Inggris" keeps UK reference; acceptable but could be neutralised for Indonesian readers.
Item 10: "burayak" is okay but "jamur" for 'fungussing' fine; "kuning telur" for yolk sacs should be "kantung kuning telur".
Item 1: "lele berlapis baja" is a non-standard rendering of armoured catfish; use "lele lapis baja/ikan corydoras" or keep English only.
Item 11: "agresi terhadap spesies lain hampir tidak pernah terdengar" is a literal calque; use "hampir tidak pernah ditemukan".
Item 11: "Kedua sistem ini diterapkan oleh majalah" - "dibuat/diperkenalkan oleh" is more natural than "diterapkan" (implemented).
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is ambiguous; use "Daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

corydoras-nattereri.name: Blue Corydoras
notes: Item 10: "Musim ini jatuh pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference, which is odd for Indonesian readers. Make it neutral, e.g. "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara", or explain that it corresponds to the northern-hemisphere winter.

Item 10: "Menyaring air melalui gambut (peat) cukup membantu" is acceptable, but "Saat memijahkan cory ... lebih baik jika jumlah jantan lebih banyak" drops the English 'higher ratio of males'. It is fine, so no change is needed here.
Item 4: "Alas akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Ukuran alas" or "Dasar akuarium" is more natural.
Item 3: "Anak sungai kecil, sungai-sungai kecil" is redundant. Use "anak sungai, parit/sungai kecil".
Item 10: "Siapkan akuarium pemijahan ... dengan dasar kosong" is fine, but "kegelisahan" for 'excitement' is slightly off. Use "keaktifan/kegairahan".
Item 10: "Jika ikan memutuskan untuk memijah" is a literal rendering. "Jika ikan mulai memijah" is more natural.
Item 8: "cichlid kerdil" and "ikan cyprinid" are fine. "karasin" is a less common term, so consider "characin" in brackets.
Item 11: "Kedua sistem ini dibuat oleh majalah" is fine. "Dwarf" and "scavengers" are fine. "pemakan sisa" is acceptable.

corydoras-nijsseni.name: Corydoras nijsseni
notes: Item 6: "rusak/hilang" uses a slash; choose one wording, e.g. "sungutnya bisa rusak atau hilang".
Item 9: "terasa sangat menggores di tenggorokan" is stiff; "sangat menusuk/mengganjal di tenggorokan" would read more naturally.
Item 4: "cabang sungai" for tributaries is slightly unusual; "anak sungai" or "sungai cabang" is more standard, but it duplicates creeks, so differentiate them.

corydoras-oiapoquensis.name: Corydoras Flag Tail Panda
notes: Item 18: "Inggris" keeps the UK reference; fine, but "Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" is not helpful for Indonesian readers. Consider neutral wording (e.g. 'musim dingin di belahan bumi utara').
Item 10: "Hindari memelihara di atas kerikil bersudut tajam" is awkward. Rephrase, e.g. 'Hindari kerikil bersudut tajam (pecahan) atau pasir tajam'.
Item 11/12: "Mau menerima" is stiff and unnatural for 'will accept'. Use 'Menerima' or 'Mudah menerima'.
Item 7/10/18: "kayu bogwood" and "driftwood" are inconsistent. Use 'kayu bogwood' or 'kayu apung/akar kayu' consistently; in item 10 'kayu' alone is vague.
Item 1: 'Flag Tailed Panda Cory' is left as English in the common name. This is acceptable as a trade name, but 'Sungai kecil Cumuri' for 'Creek' could be 'Anak Sungai Cumuri'.
Item 18: 'diduga sperma ini melewati mulut dan insang betina' is fine, but 'burayak' for fry is less common among hobbyists than 'anakan'. Consider 'anakan ikan'.

corydoras-ornatus.name: Corydoras ornatus
notes: "di Inggris" / "musim dingin di Inggris": the source says "UK winter"; this is fine, but the text is not adapted for Indonesian readers (UK seasons are meaningless there). Consider clarifying that it means the Northern Hemisphere winter.
"Mau menerima sebagian besar pakan kering": "Mau" sounds awkward as a sentence opener. Use "Menerima" or "Ikan ini mau menerima...".
"Habitatnya belum tercatat" is acceptable, but "jangan pakai filter bawah" is informal for a handbook. Use "jangan menggunakan".
"Alas akuarium" and "Teman setangki" are slightly non-standard. "Luas alas" and "penghuni lain/ikan sekomunitas" are more common.
"Perilaku pemijahan ditandai dengan ... kegelisahan": "excitement" is better rendered as "keaktifan/kegairahan", since "kegelisahan" implies stress.
"bogwood" and "java moss" are left in English without explanation. The first use of "bogwood" could add "kayu bogwood (akar kayu)" or similar.

corydoras-ourastigma.name: Corydoras ourastigma
notes: Item 10: "Musim ini jatuh pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference, which is meaningless to Indonesian readers. Rephrase it neutrally, for example as the northern-hemisphere winter, or explain it for the Indonesian context.
Item 10: "Saat memijahkan cory, rasio jantan yang lebih tinggi daripada betina selalu lebih baik" is awkward. Say "lebih banyak jantan daripada betina".
Item 1: "Long-nosed smudge spot cory (cory moncong panjang berbercak kabur)" is a clumsy invented gloss. Keep the trade name, or use a simpler one.

Item 5: "sungutnya bisa terkikis hingga hilang bila dipelihara dalam kondisi yang buruk" is fine in meaning, but "substandard conditions" is softened. Also "Lele ini" is odd for corys, so use "Ikan ini" or "Cory".
Item 11: "kabur/berbayang" gives two alternatives in the quotation marks. Choose one term, "kabur", to match the other items.
Item 11: "bercak ekornya lebih kebiruan" is acceptable, but "relatif baru di dunia akuarium" should read "relatif baru di dunia hobi akuarium".
Item 10: "fungussing" is translated as "berjamur", which is fine. However, "burayak" is used for fry, so check it is used consistently, and "Indukan akan memakan telurnya sendiri" adds "sendiri".

corydoras-paleatus.name: Corydoras Paleatus
notes: Item 2: "Imports of this species did not appear for more than 10 years" is rendered "tidak pernah diimpor" (never imported). Use "tidak muncul/tidak ada impor" so the sense of a period without imports stays.
Item 6: "morsels of food" is rendered "sisa makanan" (leftovers). Use "serpihan/remah makanan", because the fish look for food, not scraps.
Item 11: "peternak" (livestock farmer) for breeders is non-standard. Use "pembudidaya" or "penghobi".
Item 1, 4: "kolam-kolam alami" adds "alami" (natural), which is not in the source "pools". Use "kolam" or "genangan".
Item 13: "menyerap oksigen melalui ususnya" and "menyambar udara" are a little loose. Use "menelan/menghirup udara" for "gulp of air".
Item 9: "Lele" for catfish is acceptable, but "cichlid kerdil" is awkward. Use "cichlid dwarf/cichlid kerdil (dwarf cichlid)" or "cichlid kecil".
Item 11: "Kelompok indukan" and "burayak" are fine, but "Corydoras tidak secenderung beberapa ikan lain" is clumsy. Use "Corydoras tidak sesering sebagian ikan lain memakan telurnya".
Item 12: "varian hasil budidaya" for "breeding forms" is fine, but "Ikan veteran" is a literal rendering. Use "ikan lawas/klasik" for naturalness.

corydoras-panda.name: Corydoras panda
notes: Item 10: "half-grown animals" translated as "Ikan yang masih setengah dewasa ini" is okay, but "swarm behaviour" -> "perilaku bergerombol" fine; no fix needed except the kind of fish refers to juveniles: use "ikan remaja" (minor).

Item 13: "burayak tidak akan tersedot" fine, but "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" OK; "Udang cherry ... cukup efektif" for "work well" fine. However "Menyaring air melalui gambut ... akan membantu" fine. Wording "meski bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan" is awkward; use "meski kadang sampai 4 butir sekaligus".

Item 13: "Musim ini terjadi bersamaan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" keeps UK reference, acceptable but for Indonesian readers clarify (e.g., 'musim dingin di belahan bumi utara'); also 'Dapat ... akuarium berdasar kosong' fine.

Item 14: "Ini adalah sistem penomoran yang sangat sederhana" fine; "Namun, asalkan ruangnya cukup, hal ini jarang sampai menimbulkan luka fisik" OK. "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; prefer "mampu bernapas dengan udara bebas bila perlu".
Item 14: "pemakan sisa" for scavengers; "agresi ... nyaris tidak pernah terdengar" is stiff; prefer "hampir tidak pernah terjadi".
Item 9: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable colloquial but "Daphnia" (kutu air) is clearer; "mikroworm" in item 13 should be "cacing mikro" or "microworm" in italics.
Item 2/5: "sungai kecil" for streams fine; "blackwater" left untranslated, consider "air hitam (blackwater)".

corydoras-pantanalensis.name: Corydoras pantanalensis
notes: Item 12: "musim dingin di Inggris" for "UK winter" is imprecise; "Britania Raya" or "Inggris/Britania" would be more exact, or say "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara".
Item 8: "Mau menerima" is stiff; "Mau memakan" or "Umumnya menerima" is more natural.
Item 1: "ikan lele berzirah" is an unusual rendering of "armoured catfish"; "lele lapis baja" or "lele berzirah (armoured catfish)" may be clearer.

corydoras-pastazensis.name: Cory pastazensis
notes: Item 1/9: "lele berlapis baja" – 'lele' for armoured catfish is acceptable but "lele lapis baja"/"lele berzirah" would be more natural; "berlapis baja" reads literally as steel-plated.
Item 1: "hulu DAS Río Pastaza" – 'DAS' (daerah aliran sungai) is jargon; prefer "daerah aliran sungai" or "cekungan" in a hobby handbook.
Item 9: "kelenjar ketiak" for axillary glands is an awkward literal rendering; use "kelenjar aksila" or "kelenjar di pangkal sirip dada".
Item 9: "Dias et al. (2024)" fine, but "penghirup udara fakultatif" is stiff; consider "bernapas udara fakultatif".
Item 8: "saat sedang bertelur" for 'gravid' – better "saat sedang membawa telur / bunting telur" (gravid is not spawning).
Item 6: "mencari makan di dasar" adds 'di dasar' not in the English 'foraging' (minor).

corydoras-petracinii.name: Corydoras petracinii
notes: Item 3: "kolam-kolam" for natural pools in a dry stream suggests ponds; "genangan" or "kolam alami" would be more natural.
Item 5: "batu sungai yang membulat dan halus terkikis air" is slightly clumsy for "water-worn rocks"; "batu sungai yang terkikis air" is simpler.

corydoras-pinheiroi.name: Corydoras pinheiroi
notes: Item 4: tank volume '~68 liter' is a calculated figure; fine, but 60 × 38 × 30 gives 68.4 L — OK. No issue.

Item 10: 'Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris' — UK reference is kept from source; for Indonesian readers, rephrase neutrally (e.g. 'bertepatan dengan musim dingin di belahan bumi utara'), since 'the UK winter' is irrelevant locally.
Item 10: 'selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak daripada betina' is awkward; rephrase as 'sebaiknya jumlah jantan lebih banyak daripada betina'.
Item 10: 'meskipun bisa sampai 4 butir yang dikeluarkan' is awkward; use 'meskipun kadang sampai 4 butir sekaligus'.
Item 10: 'Di mana pun telur akan ditetaskan' / 'penuh telur' phrasing is slightly stiff; consider 'berisi telur' and 'Di mana pun telur ditetaskan'.

Item 1: 'corydoras (lele lapis baja/armoured catfish)' — Brochis is not a Corydoras and 'armoured catfish' refers to the family; use 'lele berlapis baja (armoured catfish)' without calling it corydoras, to avoid confusion with the 'Corydoras pinheiroi' name just given.
Item 5: 'sungutnya bisa terkikis hingga hilang' is a bit of an over-translation; 'sungutnya bisa habis/rusak' is more faithful to 'lose their barbels'.

corydoras-polystictus.name: Corydoras polystictus
notes: Item 4: "Many-spotted Cory" is left in English as a suggested common name. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add a local rendering such as "Cory berbintik banyak".
Item 1/3: "bertubuh tinggi" for "deep-bodied" is slightly awkward. "Berbadan tinggi/tebal" or "bertubuh pipih tinggi" may read more naturally.

corydoras-pygmaeus.name: Corydoras Pygmy
notes: Item 9: "cukup lunak" for "moderately soft" is fine, but "sedikit lebih sejuk" with 22–26 °C is carried over from the source; no error there. The real issue is item 7: "minimal 8–12 ekor" turns "at least 8–12" into a vague range. Write "setidaknya 8–12 ekor" or "8–12 ekor atau lebih".

Item 12: "Cyclops beku, kutu air (daphnia) beku, dan pakan mikro beku" applies "beku" to every item. The English says "Frozen cyclops, daphnia, and microfoods", so it is acceptable, but "kutu air" for daphnia is a non-standard hobby term. Use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

Item 13: "cacing sutra kering beku (freeze-dried)" is wrong. Tubifex is not the same as Tubifex sutra worms, and "kering beku" is awkward. Use "tubifex freeze-dried" or "cacing tubifex yang dikeringbekukan".
Item 15: "neon tetra" is correct, but "udang hias kecil yang sudah dewasa" for "adult-sized dwarf shrimp" is a bit off. Write "udang kerdil dewasa".

Item 15: "mengedipkan mata" for "wink" is a literal rendering that is not clear to readers. It also drops "quickly looking down" as the way they do it. Rephrase, for example "seolah 'berkedip' dengan cepat menunduk".
Item 17: "Spesies penyebar telur" is fine, but "burayak" is correct. No fix needed here, so ignore it.

Item 18: "peternak" for "breeders" is fine, but "pita hitam di belakang kepala" and "pola belang-belang penuh" for "fully mottled pattern" are acceptable. The problem is "Dalam beberapa hari" for "Within a couple of days", which is fine too. The one real fault is "Cory pygmy" and "corydoras pygmy" being used inconsistently with "pygmy corys". Pick one term.
Item 4: "Corydoras pygmy" should keep the species form, so use "Corydoras pygmaeus" or "corydoras pygmy" consistently. "Originally discovered" is also rendered correctly.

corydoras-rabauti.name: Corydoras rabauti
notes: Item 4: '90 × 30 cm (sekitar 81 liter)' – the volume is left as the source's figure, but a tank with a 90 × 30 cm base would normally be named by a standard size; check the volume against the tank table (e.g., 90×30×30 ≈ 81 L is the source's own estimate, so confirm it isn't mis-stated).
Item 2: type locality quote left in English ('tributary of Amazon River, 7 days by river boat from Manaus...'); translate it into Indonesian, keeping the coordinates unchanged.
Item 1/2: 'luas sebaran lengkapnya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'belum sepenuhnya jelas'.
Item 1: 'Bentuk albinonya kadang-kadang tersedia' is stiff; use 'Varian albino kadang tersedia di pasaran'.

Item 10: 'burayak' is correct for fry, but 'Burayaknya tidak termasuk yang paling mudah dibesarkan' changes the subject. The English says the species is not the easiest to raise; keep the species as the subject.
Item 10: 'spawning mop' and 'alder cone' are left in English without a gloss; add a short Indonesian explanation (e.g., 'kone alder') at first mention.

corydoras-reticulatus.name: Corydoras reticulatus
notes: Item 6: "~68 liter (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" is a computed volume and not a US-gallon tank, so it's fine; but "Panjang standar: 60 mm SL" keeps mm and should read 6 cm SL for consistency.

Item 12: "musim dingin di Inggris" keeps the UK reference; the source's "UK winter" is shop-specific, so rephrase neutrally (e.g. 'musim kemarau/musim dingin belahan bumi utara') or make clear it is the Northern Hemisphere winter.

Item 12: "Jantan lalu melepaskan sperma yang diduga melewati mulut dan insang betina, lalu diarahkan" - 'lalu' is repeated; use 'yang diduga melewati mulut dan insang betina sebelum diarahkan ke sirip perutnya'.

Item 12: "Pindahkan induk dan besarkan anakan di akuarium yang sama" - the English says 'remove the adults and raise the brood'; it should be 'Angkat/pisahkan induk', and the ambiguous 'Pindahkan' is acceptable but 'anakan' vs 'burayak' is inconsistent.
Item 9: "Mau menerima" is awkward; use 'Menerima' or 'Mau makan'.
Item 2/14: "hilir lembah Amazon" is awkward; use 'Amazon bagian hilir' or 'DAS Amazon bagian hilir'.
Item 13: "gelas atau wadah besar" - 'large cup' was rendered with an added alternative; use 'gelas besar' only.
Item 1: "teman dari spesies yang sama" is acceptable but 'sesama spesies' is more natural; 'secara total' is stiff.

corydoras-reynoldsi.name: Corydoras reynoldsi
notes: "Ukurannya hampir tidak pernah mencapai 5 cm" is slightly off: "Hardly reaches 5 cm" means it barely reaches 5 cm. Use e.g. "Hampir tidak lebih dari 5 cm" or "Panjangnya nyaris hanya 5 cm".
"Dideskripsikan" and "dikoleksi" are stiff. Prefer "dideskripsikan/diperikan" and "ditangkap/dikumpulkan" for "was collected".
"Habitat alaminya adalah Rio Tique" is loose for "natural distribution". Use "Sebaran alaminya".

corydoras-robineae.name: Corydoras robineae
notes: Item 4: "Volume: ~68 litres (60 × 38 × 30 cm)" is preserved, fine; but "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is OK. No issue there.

Item 10: "Inggris" and "musim dingin di Inggris" – source says UK winter; keep but this is acceptable; however "musim dingin" in the Indonesian reader context could be clarified (Indonesia has no winter).
Item 10: "Perilaku pemijahan ditandai dengan meningkatnya aktivitas dan kegelisahan" – "excitement" is better as "keaktifan/kegairahan", not "kegelisahan" (restlessness).
Item 10: "sementara jantan menjepit sungut betina" – 'grasps' is fine, but "posisi-T" should be "posisi T" (minor).
Item 7: "Mau menerima" is awkward; use "Menerima" or "Mau makan".
Item 5: "lele berlapis baja" (item 1) is a literal rendering of 'armoured catfish'; hobbyists say "lele lapis baja" or simply "corydoras" – minor.
Item 10: "anakan" vs "burayak" is used inconsistently for fry ("besarkan anakan ... besarkan burayak"); use one term.
Item 10: "Jantan kemudian melepaskan sperma" fine; however "filter kotak bertenaga aerator" is clumsy – use "filter spons atau filter box dengan aerator".
Item 9: English source has an error ("females ... than females"); translation corrected it to males, which is reasonable.

corydoras-robustus.name: Corydoras robustus
notes: Items 2 and 6: "anak-anak sungai kecil, sungai kecil" is repetitive for "small tributaries, creeks". Use "anak sungai kecil, alur/parit air" or similar to separate the two.
Item 16: "gerombolan besar" for "large schools" sounds odd for fish. Use "kawanan besar" instead.

corydoras-sarareensis.name: Corydoras sarareensis
notes: Item 4: "Mau menerima semua pakan buatan" is awkward for a fish; use "Menerima dengan baik semua pakan buatan..." or "Mudah menerima...".
Item 3: "kayu apung" is used for both driftwood and bogwood; fine in meaning, but "kayu bogwood/akar" could differentiate. Minor.
Item 1: "Rio Sararé, anak sungai di sisi kanan Rio Guaporé" is acceptable, but "Negara Bagian" is fine; "zirah" for armour plates is unusual, so prefer "lempeng tulang (scute)".
Item 8: reference left untranslated; "(Germany)" is fine, so no change is needed unless the style guide requires it.

corydoras-schwartzi.name: Corydoras schwartzi
notes: Item 12: "This occurs at the same time of year as the UK winter" is rendered "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara". The meaning is shifted: the wet season in South America matches the northern-hemisphere winter, but Indonesian readers need it explained clearly. Better: "bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris/belahan bumi utara", or drop the UK reference.
Item 14: "Meski memakan benda kecil seperti telur atau burayak" lacks the "bite-sized" nuance. Use "benda berukuran kecil yang muat di mulut".
Item 14: "yang sebagian membuat cory" for "It's partly this ... that puts" is awkward. Rephrase as "sebagian alasan mengapa cory termasuk ikan paling populer".
Item 14: "Kory" vs source "cory": "kata Yunani kory" changes the spelling of the English source word. Use the Greek transliteration "korys" or keep "cory" consistently.
Items 1, 2, 7, 12: "burayak" is fine, but "anakan" is used for fry in item 12 ("besarkan anakan di akuarium yang sama"). Use one consistent term.
Item 12: "Neocardina heteropoda" is left as in the source. The correct spelling is Neocaridina heteropoda; a Latin name should stay unchanged, but flag it for checking.
Item 7: "kayu beech" and "daun oak" are left as English trade names, but Indonesian hobbyists may not know them. Add a gloss such as "kayu beech (bukan kayu lokal)", or use a local equivalent.
Item 12: "Sebagai pernapas udara fakultatif" is fine. But "Lele berlapis pelindung" for "armoured catfish" is a literal calque. Hobbyists use "lele berzirah" or "armoured catfish".

corydoras-semiaquilus.name: Corydoras semiaquilus
notes: Item 15: "Permusuhan antarsesama spesies" is ambiguous for "intraspecific hostility"; use "agresi antar individu sesama spesies".

corydoras-septentrionalis.name: Corydoras septentrionalis
notes: Item 13: "24–27 °C" changes the source range "24–26.5°C". Keep 26,5 °C, or note that it was rounded.
Item 9: "Mau menerima" sounds stilted. "Menerima" or "Mudah menerima" reads more naturally.

corydoras-serratus.name: Corydoras serratus
notes: "Least Concern/LC" rendered as "Berisiko Rendah": the usual Indonesian IUCN term is "Risiko Rendah" or "Berisiko Rendah (LC)"; minor wording.
"Lineage 1" and "Garis keturunan" are mixed; use one term consistently, e.g. "Garis keturunan 1 (Lineage 1)".
"pembiak ikan" and "memijahkan" are acceptable, but "Sudah ada beberapa pembiak" is slightly stiff; "Ikan ini sudah dibiakkan oleh beberapa peternak" reads more naturally.
"tempat dua aliran bertemu dan menyatu ke sebuah anak sungai kecil" adds the nuance "menyatu"; the English says only that the two streams join a small tributary. Simplify it.
"di hobi akuarium" is slightly awkward; "di kalangan penghobi akuarium" is more natural.

corydoras-seussi.name: Corydoras seussi
notes: "Lembah Rio Mamoré": "lembah" means valley. For a river basin, "daerah aliran sungai (DAS)" or "cekungan" is more accurate. This appears in items 1 and 2.
"lele berlapis baja": a literal rendering of "armoured catfish". Hobbyists would more naturally write "lele berzirah" or "lele lapis baja (armoured catfish)".
Item 6, "Mau menerima sebagian besar pakan kering...": the subject is missing and the wording is colloquial. Use something like "Ikan ini mau menerima..." or "Menerima...".

corydoras-similis.name: Corydoras similis
notes: Item 5: tank 45 × 30 × 30 cm (~41 litres) — 'Volume ~41 liter' is fine, but check consistency with the listing's tank-size convention; the text's 'Alas akuarium 45 × 30cm' is OK.

Item 14: 'Musim ini terjadi pada waktu yang sama dengan musim dingin di Inggris' — a UK-centric reference left in a text for Indonesian readers (no winter there); should be neutralised, e.g. 'saat musim dingin di belahan bumi utara', or explain that the rainy season in South America coincides with the northern-hemisphere winter.

Item 14: 'beberapa spesies tertentu bisa butuh beberapa tahun' — the source says 'several years for certain species'; fine, but 'Neocardina heteropoda' is rendered as 'Udang cherry' without the Latin spelling issue; keep as is.
Item 14: 'alder cone' left untranslated without explanation; add 'kerucut alder' or a short gloss.
Item 15: 'sebagai pengganti sisik' is fine, but 'ukurannya jauh lebih besar, yaitu 7 cm' — OK; 'Smudge spot cory' in item 1 is left in English; acceptable as a trade name.
Item 1: 'lele berlapis baja' for 'armoured catfish' is an awkward term; the usual hobby term is 'lele lapis baja' or just 'corydoras'.

Item 4: 'kubangan' (wallow/mud puddle) for 'pools' is wrong in tone; use 'kolam' or 'genangan'. Also 'sungai kecil' repeated for both 'tributaries' and 'creeks'; differentiate (e.g. 'anak sungai' and 'parit/alur sungai').
Item 2: 'violet cory catfish' left as English; fine, but 'Ini spesies ... sangat keren' is informal.

corydoras-simulatus.name: Corydoras simulatus
notes: Item 5: "Jangan sekali-kali mengandalkan mereka untuk bertahan hidup dari 'sisa-sisa'... atau mengandalkan mereka" is repetitive; rephrase, e.g. "Jangan berharap mereka bisa bertahan hidup dari 'sisa-sisa' pakan ... atau diandalkan untuk 'membersihkan' akuarium."
Item 7: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; use "saat penuh telur" or "saat bunting telur" (gravid = carrying eggs, not laying).
Item 6: "minimal 4–6 ekor" is awkward; use "setidaknya 4–6 ekor".
Item 1/8: "sungut rictal" is jargon; consider "sungut di sudut mulut (rictal)". The "dari sepasang sungut" phrasing is also slightly awkward; use "berdasarkan sepasang sungut".
Item 8: "Mereka adalah ikan yang bisa menghirup udara secara fakultatif" is awkward; use "Mereka bernapas udara secara fakultatif".

corydoras-sodalis.name: Corydoras sodalis
notes: Item 4: "Volume: ~41 liter" and "(~41 liter)" for a 45 × 30 × 30 cm tank. The volume is given in litres in the source, so it is not wrong, but the "~41" is odd. Check that it matches the stated dimensions (45×30×30 = 40.5 L).

Item 10: "UK winter" became "musim dingin di belahan bumi utara". This is acceptable, but the source's UK-specific point is lost. Say it falls in the northern-hemisphere winter, which is roughly the dry season in the Amazon, or keep the meaning clearly.
Item 10: "fry" is translated inconsistently, as "burayak" and "anakan". Also "dasar kosong" for "bare bottom" is vague. Use "dasar tanpa substrat" throughout.
Item 12: "peternak" for "breeders" is a bit off. Use "penangkar". Also "jadi hanya ada sedikit dorongan" is stiff.
Item 12: "C. agassizii ... juga kebanyakan keliru disebut C. punctatus" is ambiguous. Make clear it is mostly wrongly called C. punctatus.
Item 13: "air dengan kadar kuman rendah" (low-germ water) is understandable but awkward. Use "air rendah bakteri/kuman" or "air yang bersih secara higienis".
Item 14: "pH dan kesadahan tidak penting" for "irrelevant" could be misread as care advice. Use "tidak menjadi masalah" or "tidak berpengaruh".
Item 10: "Neocardina" in the source was corrected to "Neocaridina". This is fine, but check that the Latin name is otherwise unchanged. Also, "pemakan sisa" for "scavengers" is ok.

corydoras-spectabilis.name: Corydoras spectabilis
notes: Item 4: '~68 litres (60 × 38 × 30 cm)' is a measured volume, fine, but 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' is slightly awkward; consider 'Ukuran alas akuarium'.
Item 7: 'Mau menerima' is awkward for 'Will accept'; use 'Menerima' or 'Mau memakan'.
Item 10: 'musim dingin di Inggris' keeps the UK reference; this is faithful but odd for Indonesian readers. Consider adding a note such as 'di Inggris (belahan bumi utara)'.
Item 10: 'jangan ragu mencoba pendekatan yang berbeda' is fine, but 'anakan' for the brood and 'burayak' for fry are used inconsistently; use 'burayak' throughout.
Item 11: 'tidak tumbuh sebesar spectabilis' is clear, but 'luntur' for 'smudged' is a little off; 'kabur' or 'berbayang' is more natural.
Item 8: 'Sangat damai' should be 'Sangat jinak/tenang'; 'damai' is acceptable but the phrase is stiff.

corydoras-splendens.name: Corydoras emerald
notes: #17: "white worm" is left in English; use "cacing putih (white worm)".
#14: "driftwood" and "bogwood" are both rendered "kayu apung"; bogwood could be "kayu bog" or "akar/kayu rawa" so the two terms stay distinct.

corydoras-sterbai.name: Corydoras sterbai
notes: Item 13: "2 jantan untuk setiap betina" is fine, but "selalu lebih baik jumlah jantan lebih banyak" is awkward. Rephrase as "rasio jantan terhadap betina sebaiknya lebih tinggi".
Item 13: "burayak" is used for both eggs hatched and young ("anakan" and "burayak" are mixed). Use one consistent term, preferably "burayak" or "anakan".

Item 13: "Musim ini bertepatan dengan musim dingin di Inggris" is a locale-specific fact kept as is. For Indonesian readers, add a note such as "musim dingin belahan bumi utara (Inggris)", or say that the wet season falls in the northern winter.
Item 14: "Walaupun mereka akan memakan apa pun yang muat di mulut" is an overstatement of "bite-sized items such as eggs or fry". Say "hal-hal berukuran seukuran gigitan seperti telur atau burayak".

Item 14: "pakan yang lolos dari ikan-ikan di atasnya" and "hanya diharapkan bertahan dari sisa pakan" are stiff. Rephrase as "jika hanya mengandalkan sisa pakan yang lolos dari ikan lain di lapisan atas".
Item 14: "Kedua sistem ini diterapkan oleh" should read "diperkenalkan oleh". The word "Loricariidae" is fine.
Item 1: "toko ikan hias" is fine, but "diternakkan" and "hasil penangkaran" are inconsistent for a farmed or bred fish. Use one term consistently.
Item 8: "cabang kayu apung (driftwood) (kalau ..." has a double parenthesis, which is awkward and hard to read. Restructure it.
Item 6: "kali" for creeks is informal. Use "anak sungai kecil, sungai kecil/parit".
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is a loose term. Use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)".

corydoras-trilineatus.name: Corydoras trilineatus
notes: #2: "sấy khô" (dried) became "kering beku" (freeze-dried). Use "pakan kering" or "dikeringkan", or add "beku-kering" only if the source says so.
#1: "agak sadah" is stiff. Hobbyists more often write "agak keras" or "sadah sedang".
#3: "ditakut-takuti olehnya" is awkward. Use "mudah takut dan stres karena diganggu ikan-ikan tersebut" or similar.

corydoras-virginiae.name: Corydoras virginiae
notes: Item 1/8: "lele berzirah" is an unusual term; "lele berlapis baja/berperisai" or simply "corydoras (armoured catfish)" is more familiar to Indonesian hobbyists.
Item 8: "pernapas udara fakultatif" is stiff; "ikan yang dapat bernapas udara secara fakultatif" reads more naturally.
Item 8: "kelenjar aksila" is a rare term; consider "kelenjar aksilar (axillary glands)".
Item 7: "terlihat jelas lebih bulat" is slightly awkward; "tampak jelas lebih bulat" is more natural.

corydoras-vittatus.name: Corydoras vittatus
notes: Item 5: "cocok untuk sebagian besar akuarium komunitas" is fine, but "Karena termasuk spesies bermoncong panjang" is a slightly odd causal link; consider "Sebagai salah satu spesies bermoncong panjang".
Item 7: "obligate eyeband" translated as "pita mata yang selalu ada"; "garis mata" or "pita mata yang selalu ada pada semua individu" may read more naturally.
Item 2: "Lineage 1" left in English; consider "Garis Keturunan 1" consistently or keep it with a note.
Item 4: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern, LC)" is acceptable, but "Berisiko Rendah" or "Kekhawatiran Rendah" is the more standard IUCN Indonesian term.

corydoras-weitzmani.name: Corydoras weitzmani
notes: In #2, "Ternyata informasi lokasi ... keliru" adds "Ternyata" (it turned out), a slight shift in tone; acceptable, but "The information... was wrong" could be stated plainly.
In #3, "kimia air" is a literal rendering of "water chemistry"; use "parameter air" or "kualitas air" instead.
In #3, "Dugaan ini sepenuhnya keliru" is fine, but "tidak terlalu berpengaruh" understates "not of great importance" only slightly; consider "tidak terlalu penting".
In #1, "tangkapan alam" is acceptable, but hobbyists usually say "tangkapan liar" or "hasil tangkapan alam (wild caught)".

corydoras-xinguensis.name: Corydoras Xingu
notes: "lele berlapis baja kecil bertotol" is a literal rendering of "armoured catfish". Hobbyists in Indonesia usually say "corydoras" or "ikan cory". Consider "ikan lele lapis baja (armoured catfish)" or simply "cory kecil bertotol".
"Dikoleksi dari anak-anak sungai" is stiff. "Ditangkap/ditemukan di anak sungai" would read more naturally.

corydoras-zygatus.name: Corydoras zygatus
notes: "daerah aliran tengah Río Marañón" is awkward; "DAS Marañón bagian tengah" reads more naturally (also in #2).

"sexually mature individuals ... than males" was rendered as "betina yang sudah matang kelamin". This adds an assumption about sex that the English does not state; "individu yang sudah matang kelamin" is closer.
"alder cone" is left untranslated; add a gloss such as "kerucut alder (alder cone)".
"peternak" for "breeders" is better as "pembiak" or "penangkar".

corynopoma-riisei.name: Swordtail Characin
notes: Item 8: "lele Loricariidae yang lebih kecil" is a little stiff; "lele Loricariidae kecil" or "sapu-sapu kecil" is more natural. This is minor.

costasiella-kuroshimae.name: Domba laut
notes: Item 1: "salty ocean caterpillar" left in English with no Indonesian rendering; give a translation (e.g. ulat laut asin) with the English in brackets, or explain it.
Item 9: "coral banded shrimp" left in English; use the local name "udang karang berpita" or "udang pembersih bergaris" with the English in brackets.
Item 2: "harganya tidak diketahui" is fine, but "toko akuarium" for "local fish stores" could be "toko ikan hias" to match the hobby term used in the same paragraph.
Item 8: "pemakan alga obligat" is slightly stiff; "pemakan alga eksklusif/spesialis" is more natural.
Item 9: "mengeluarkan lendir sebagai penangkal" is vague; "untuk mengusir predator" is clearer.

cranoglanis-henrici.name: Helmet Catfish
notes: Item 1: "Least Concern" rendered as "Berisiko Rendah" is fine, but "290 mm SL" kept in mm is acceptable; consider "29 cm SL" for consistency with the metric conversion.
Item 1: "ikan lele" for Greek glanis ("a cat fish") is acceptable but could be "ikan patin/lele (catfish)"; minor.
Item 6: "Tonjolan humerus lebar" is awkward; "Humeral process" is better as "proses humeral" or "taju humeral".
Item 6: "British-born French aristocrat" rendered as "bangsawan ... Prancis yang lahir di Inggris" is fine; "mengoleksi holotipenya" is slightly awkward, use "mengumpulkan spesimen holotipe".
Item 2: "Jarang terlihat di dunia ikan hias" is OK; "ikan ini predator" would read more naturally as "ikan ini bersifat predator/pemangsa".

craterocephalus-stercusmuscarum.name: Fly-specked hardyhead
notes: "Kualitas air yang tinggi" is a little awkward; "kualitas air yang prima/baik" is more natural.
"minim tanaman dan benda lain" adds detail to "sparse habitats"; "habitat yang relatif miskin/jarang vegetasi" is closer.
"pemalu" for "skittish" in item 1 is inconsistent with "mudah kaget" in item 8; use "mudah kaget" in both.

crenicara-latruncularium.name: Checkerboard Cichlid
notes: #1: "sehingga bisa dipelihara" adds a causal link that the English lacks ("it can be kept with..."). Use "dan bisa dipelihara" or start a new sentence.
#10: "burayak" is correct but formal. "Anakan" or "benih" is more common among hobbyists, so consider one of those.

crenicichla-albopunctata.name: White-spotted Pike Cichlid
notes: Item 4: tank volume given as 'sekitar 137 liter' for 120 × 38 × 30 cm; the figure is unchanged from the source and is a calculated dimension-based volume, not a US-gallon conversion, so it is acceptable. Minor: 'Ukuran dasar akuarium' is fine, but 'Panjang standar: 200 mm (20 cm)' is redundant yet faithful.

Item 5: 'Sediakan tatanan batu yang membentuk gua' is slightly awkward; consider 'Sediakan tatanan batu yang membentuk gua-gua kecil'. 'kayu bogwood' mixes terms; 'kayu bogwood (driftwood)' or 'kayu apung/akar' is more natural.
Item 1: 'White-spotted pike cichlid' left in English; consider adding a local name or italics. 'sungai kecil di hutan' is OK.

crenicichla-compressiceps.name: Dwarf Pike Cichlid
notes: Item 5: "Alas akuarium: 90 × 38 cm" and "Volume: ~154 liter" are fine, but "Akuarium berukuran 90 cm × 45 cm × 37,5 cm – 160 liter" is faithful; no change needed. Main issue is elsewhere.
Item 10: "betinalah yang berkuasa" is a loose rendering of the idiom "wear the trousers"; consider "betinalah yang mendominasi" for clarity.

Item 8: "pakan hidup atau setidaknya pakan beku" is fine, but "ulat hongkong" for mealworms is OK; "Earth and mealworms" is rendered as "Cacing tanah dan ulat hongkong", which is acceptable. Consider "bisa terkena" -> "bisa tertular" for "caught" to be more natural.

Item 12: "Proses pacarannya berupa tarian menggoyang tubuh dengan posisi kepala menghadap ke bawah yang sangat menarik" is clumsy; reorder, e.g. "Pacarannya berupa tarian menggoyang tubuh dengan kepala menghadap ke bawah yang sangat menarik".
Item 12: "pemijah gua" is slightly non-standard; "penetas di gua / pemijah di gua (cave spawner)" is more usual.
Item 2: "hilir lembah Sungai Tocantins" is awkward; use "cekungan hilir Sungai Tocantins" or "DAS bagian hilir Sungai Tocantins" (items 3 and 4 too).

crenicichla-johanna.name: Crenicichla johanna
notes: #1/#3: "berarus cukup deras" for "faster moving" adds a hedge ("cukup"); "berarus lebih deras" or "berarus deras" is closer.
#7: "Pada dasarnya terutama pemakan ikan" is redundant for "Predominantly piscivorous by nature"; use "Pada dasarnya pemakan ikan (piscivora)" or "Terutama pemakan ikan".
#9: "Betina lebih berwarna" is awkward; "Betina lebih berwarna-warni" or "warnanya lebih cerah" reads more naturally.

crenicichla-lepidota.name: Pike cichlid lepidota
notes: "Ikan yang masuk" is a slightly literal rendering of "The fish received"; consider "Ikan yang kami terima" in a neutral form, e.g. "Ikan yang diterima".

crenicichla-notophthalmus.name: Crenicichla notophthalmus
notes: #5: "benar-benar bertemperamen galak dan berapi-api" adds a claim (aggressive temperament) not in the English, which only says "have fire in their bodies". Use something like "punya semangat/nyali yang besar" or a literal idiom without adding "galak".
#6: "merah cerah" for "cherry-red" loses the cherry shade. Use "merah ceri".
#4: "luas dasar minimal 80 x 50 cm" is fine, but "floor space" is better as "dasar akuarium dengan ukuran minimal 80 x 50 cm".

crenicichla-proteus.name: Proteus Pike Cichlid
notes: "agresivitasnya lebih dari cukup untuk menutupi hal itu" (items 1 and 11) is a stiff, literal rendering of "more than makes up for it". A more natural version is "namun soal keagresifan, ikan ini tidak kalah dari ikan yang jauh lebih besar".

crenicichla-regani.name: Crenicichla regani
notes: #1: "Pike cichlid (Crenicichla)" – fine, but "cichlid kerdil sejati" could be more natural as "dwarf cichlid sejati"; minor.
#3: "pemijah gua (cave brooder)" – more common hobby term is "cave spawner"/"pembiak di gua"; minor.
#1: "jumlahnya sudah pasti lebih dari 90" – original says number 'increases to over 90'; acceptable but could be "jumlahnya pasti mencapai lebih dari 90".

crenicichla-strigata.name: Striped Pike Cichlid
notes: Items 1 and 11: "di Inggris" for "in the UK" is slightly narrow. "di Inggris Raya/Britania Raya" would be more precise.
Item 5: "Sediakan susunan batu" is a bit stiff. "Sediakan batu-batuan/tatanan batu" reads more naturally.

crenicichla-zebrina.name: Crenicichla zebrina
notes: "bintik humeral (bintik di belakang tutup insang)": added explanation not in source; the humeral spot lies behind the operculum/above pectoral fin, so the gloss is slightly risky. Consider just "bintik humeral".
"warna merah di bagian tenggorokannya relatif lebih tua": "deeper red" is better rendered as "lebih pekat/lebih intens"; "lebih tua" is slightly awkward.
"Ikan langka ini pernah diimpor sebanyak dua ekor": fine in meaning, but "Dua ekor spesimen ikan langka ini yang panjangnya 15–20 cm telah diimpor" is closer to the source.

crenuchus-spilurus.name: Sailfin tetra
notes: Item 5: "Volume: ~68 litres" — 75×30 cm base volume is given as ~68 liter; kept as is, acceptable, but check against the source tank size convention.

Item 13: "yang statusnya masih bersifat dugaan" is placed after both subfamilies, so it reads as if the family's splitting is putative; "putative subfamilies" should be rendered as "yang diduga/subfamili putatif" before the names.
Item 6: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" — fine, but "Tambahan daun kering" drops "litter"; also the clause "(Daphnia, Moina)" labeled "kutu air" is acceptable.

Item 8: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" — added the term "kutu air" for Daphnia/Moina and "lalat sehari" for Ephemeroptera, which are additions not in the source; Moina is not a kutu air in common usage (it is often called kutu air too) — remove or limit to Daphnia.
Item 12: "memakan beberapa tetasan pertamanya" — "Inexperienced individuals" refers to the fish; "tetasan" is OK but "anakan" in first sentence vs "burayak" later is inconsistent for "brood".
Item 4: "Habitat favoritnya" — 'most-favoured' is rendered as casual 'favorit'; use "habitat yang paling disukainya".
Item 11: "mengembangkan sirip layar" — awkward; better "memiliki sirip layar yang indah".

crossocheilus-burmanicus.name: Crossocheilus burmanicus
notes: Item 4: Volume '304 liter' is wrong conversion of 80 US gal (≈ 303 L); use 'sekitar 300 liter' — more importantly check rounding; minor.

Items 1, 3: 'krikil halus' is an invented/odd term for 'gravel' since 'kerikil' already used for pebbles; use 'kerikil' for pebbles and 'kerikil halus/koral' consistently, or 'kerikil' and 'kerikil kecil'.
Item 1: 'sambil merumput biofilm' and 'dirumput' — 'merumput' is awkward for fish; use 'memakan/mengerik biofilm'.
Item 6: 'aufwuchs' left untranslated without explanation; add 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme pada permukaan)'.
Item 6: 'blanched courgette' → 'zukini yang direbus sebentar' fine, but 'Kacang polong yang sudah dikupas' for 'shelled peas' is OK; 'betah' is colloquial for 'settled in' — use 'sudah beradaptasi'.
Item 7: 'Sampai saat ini diagnosis ... belum bisa didapatkan' drops the 'We've been unable' subject nuance; rephrase as 'Belum diperoleh diagnosis...'.
Item 7: 'jari-jari bercabang' ok; 'lobus rostral' could be 'lobus rostral (rostral lobes)' for clarity.
Item 8: Reference list left untranslated, acceptable; no change needed.

crossocheilus-cobitis.name: Siamese Algae Eater
notes: Item 6: 'merumput alga' is awkward for 'grazers'; prefer 'pemakan/penggerus alga' or 'menggerogoti'.
Item 6: 'betah di akuarium' is colloquial; prefer 'sudah beradaptasi'.
Item 7: 'kerabat segenusnya' is slightly awkward; prefer 'anggota genus lain'.
Item 1: 'ikan cyprinid' could be 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' for consistency.
Item 6: 'pakan berprotein tinggi sebaiknya tidak diberikan di akuarium' is a bit stiff; prefer 'jangan diberikan'.

crossocheilus-elegans.name: Crossocheilus elegans
notes: Item 6: "setup" is left in English; use "tata letak akuarium" or "aquascape".
Item 6: "aufwuchs" is left unexplained; add a gloss such as "(aufwuchs, lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme pada permukaan)".

crossocheilus-latius.name: Tariqilabeo latius
notes: Item 4: tank volume 'sekitar 300 liter' – the English gives 304 L (80 US gal); per the table 80 US gal is not listed, so convert and round to whole litres (≈303/304 liter), not 300.
Item 8: 'SF member Andy Rushworth has kept T. latius' became 'Seorang penghobi' – fine as neutral, but the 'SF member' source detail is dropped; acceptable. No fix needed beyond this.
Item 1: 'Tariqilabeo latius adalah ikan cyprinid' – 'cyprinid' left in English; prefer 'ikan dari famili Cyprinidae' or 'ikan sebangsa sepat/mas (Cyprinidae)'.
Item 5: 'bongkahan batu besar yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'bongkahan batu besar yang halus karena terkikis arus air'.
Item 5: 'dirumput oleh ikan ini' is unnatural; use 'dimakan/digerogoti ikan ini'.
Item 3: 'kerikil besar/kerakal' is awkward; 'kerikil besar' suffices.
Item 7: 'zukini yang direbus sebentar (blanching)' is fine, but 'Pakan ... 'black brush' (BBA)' keep consistent with 'alga sikat hitam'.

crossocheilus-nigriloba.name: Penguin Flying Fox
notes: Item 1: 'endemic to Borneo' became 'endemik Kalimantan' – changes the facts (Borneo is the whole island, Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part). Use 'endemik Pulau Kalimantan/Borneo'.

Item 4: '(about 304 litres)' is kept as 'sekitar 304 liter' – this is acceptable only if the volume is right; 150×45 cm needs a stated height, so the volume cannot be checked from the text. Check the figure.
Item 11: 'in the latter study' became 'dalam studi terakhir itu' – ambiguous and refers to a study that is not in the text; keep the sense of 'the latter'.
Item 11: 'uniquely breaks up' became 'yang khas hanya pada spesies ini' – awkward; use 'secara unik' or 'khas'.
Item 8: 'sympatric species' became 'spesies yang hidup sehabitat dengannya' – use 'spesies simpatrik' or 'hidup bersama di habitat yang sama'.
Item 8: 'shoaling, rather than schooling' – the explanation 'berkelompok longgar' and 'berenang serempak' is clumsy; keep the terms 'shoaling' and 'schooling' with a simpler gloss.

Item 7: 'Division Rhodophyta ... red algae' – the translation drops 'higher plants' nuance: 'tanaman tingkat tinggi' is fine, but 'blanched courgette' became 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar', which is acceptable. 'cuping moncong' for rostral lobes is non-standard; use 'lobus rostral' or 'cuping rostral'.

Item 10: 'Not thought to have occured in the hobby' became 'belum pernah berhasil dipijahkan' – OK, but 'related species are induced to spawn' lost the contrast: the 'Meski begitu' is added and not in the source.

crossocheilus-reticulatus.name: Reticulated Flying Fox
notes: Item 2: the type locality 'Bua Yai, Nokorn-Rajsima, eastern Thailand' is left with English 'eastern Thailand'. Use 'Thailand timur' and keep only the place names as written.
Items 3, 5 and 7: 'dirumput'/'merumput' for 'graze/browse' is a slightly unusual hobby term. 'memakan/mengerik biofilm' or 'grazing' would read more naturally.

cryptarius-truncatus.name: Manyung
notes: Item 5: "sedangkan sebagian besar sisa tulang ini hanya bersentuhan langsung dengan tulang kuadrat" adds "langsung" (not in source); drop it.
Item 5: "tonjolan posterior epioksipital" - "epioccipital" is usually "epiotik/epioksipital"; "posterior process" is better as "prosesus posterior" (more standard anatomical term than "tonjolan").
Item 1: "Spoonsnouted catfish" is left in English with no local name; consider adding a local equivalent (e.g. "ikan keting/patin laut moncong sendok") or keep as a trade name.
Item 5: "Arius yang tersamar" for "a cryptic Arius" is fine, but "terpancung" for truncate is rare; use "terpotong/tumpul".

cryptoheros-cutteri.name: Cutter's Cichlid
notes: "Temperamennya sangat aktif dan galak": "vivid temper" means lively/spirited; "galak" (aggressive) is an added fact and "sangat aktif" is only approximate. Use e.g. "Temperamennya sangat lincah/hidup" without adding aggression.
"Cichlid berukuran agak kecil": the source says "smaller"; "agak kecil" is acceptable, but consider "relatif kecil" for consistency with sentence 2.
"kerabat Cichlasoma Amerika Tengah lainnya": "relationship" refers to a group/species complex. Use "kelompok Cichlasoma Amerika Tengah" for more precise wording.

ctenochromis-polli.name: Ctenochromis polli
notes: Item 6: "(100 cm)" is left as a bare parenthetical; the English likewise lacks the word but it needs clarifying, e.g. "(kurang dari 100 cm)" — as written it is ambiguous and may be read as the recommended size. Make explicit that the tank length is meant.
Item 8: "24–28.3°C" was changed to "24–28 °C"; the rounding drops the upper figure's precision, so use 24–28,3 °C or a sensible 24–28 °C consistently (minor).

Item 12: "pelagic characids" translated as "berenang di kolom air tengah" — pelagic means open-water/upper swimmers, so use "pelagis" or "berenang di kolom air atas/tengah"; the meaning is slightly narrowed.

Item 1: "Mostly benthic ... Sebagian besar hidupnya di dasar" is okay, but "Tingkat kesulitannya sedang" is fine; no change needed. The actual issue is item 7: "jantan yang kalah dominan" is awkward for "subdominant males"; use "jantan subdominan".
Item 7: "sebagian besar hidup spesies ini ada di dasar" is awkward; use "karena spesies ini sebagian besar hidup di dasar perairan".

Item 7: "Fairly dim lighting" is rendered as "cukup redup" and "immature aquaria" as "akuarium yang belum matang", which is acceptable, but "Kalau lebih suka" should be "Jika diinginkan" for naturalness.
Item 7: the genus is given as Congochromis while other items use Haplochromis/Ctenochromis; keep Latin names unchanged as in the source (no fix needed beyond consistency check).
Item 15: "burayak" is a good term, but "naupli artemia" should be written "nauplii Artemia" with Artemia as a Latin genus name.

ctenolucius-hujeta.name: Hujeta
notes: Item 2/9: "Ternyata" for "Surprisingly" reads as a discovery, not as a surprise; "Anehnya" or "Mengejutkannya" would be closer.
Item 2/9: "mencari makan di dasar" is fine, but "teman setangkinya" is slightly stiff; "penghuni akuarium lain" is more natural.

ctenopharyngodon-idella.name: Ikan koan
notes: Item 1: "Ikan koan" is the common Indonesian name for grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella), so this is fine. Item 7: "duckweed (mata lele)" is wrong, because mata lele is Lemna and is not the same as every duckweed. It is acceptable but borderline, so use "duckweed (Lemna)" or "mata lele" alone.

Item 8: "tidak akan memangsa apa pun yang panjangnya lebih dari beberapa sentimeter" is ambiguous but matches the English. Rephrase it for clarity: "tidak akan memangsa ikan yang panjangnya lebih dari beberapa sentimeter".

Item 2: "Lokasi tipenya hanya disebutkan sebagai 'China'" uses "China" while the rest of the text uses "Tiongkok". This is minor, but make the spelling consistent, or keep the quoted original and gloss it.

Item 5: "ganti air mingguan sebanyak 50–70% volume akuarium" is fine. Item 9: "gravid" is rendered as "yang sedang bertelur", which means spawning. Use "yang sedang bertelur/bunting telur" or "berisi telur". "bertubuh lebih tinggi" is also slightly awkward; "lebih tebal/gemuk" or "badan lebih tinggi" would be better.

Item 3: "Meski begitu" moves the contrast to the start of the second sentence. The English "however" is attached to the tolerance, so this is acceptable. Item 10: "matang kelamin" is fine. In item 11, "Xenocyprinidae" is kept as a subfamily as in the source, so there is no issue.

ctenopoma-kingsleyae.name: Tailspot Ctenopoma
notes: Item 5: tank sizes not converted per the tank table. 'standard 120cm x 30cm x 30cm, 108 litre' should be named by the usual size (about 120 litres), and 'about 304 litres' for 150x45x45 should be about 300 litres. Both are exact conversions, not the usual rounded size.
Item 15: 'yang sebaiknya dicoba pada musim dingin' (winter) is odd for Indonesia, which has no winter. Use 'musim dingin (di belahan bumi utara)' or rephrase as the dry/cool season.
Item 1: 'sulit dicampur' for 'incompatible' is unnatural. Use 'tidak cocok dicampur'.
Item 9: 'Ini adalah pakan paling favorit' is redundant. Use 'pakan favoritnya'. 'fat flies' should be 'lalat besar/gemuk'.
Item 12: 'Loricariid', 'ciprinid' and 'Mormyrid' are left in English or non-standard. Use 'lele armor/Loricariidae', 'Cyprinidae' and 'Mormyridae', or give the common names.
Item 13: 'sering memungkinkan jenis kelamin dikenali dengan mata telanjang' is awkward. Use 'sehingga jenis kelamin sering bisa dikenali dengan mata telanjang'.
Item 17: 'Kingsley's climbing perch' is left in English. 'betok' is used for Anabas, but betok usually means Anabas testudineus, so the term is used loosely here.

ctenops-nobilis.name: Frail Gourami
notes: Item 4: "sekitar 108 liter" — tank volume given as 29 US gal should be named "120 liter" per the tank size table, not the exact conversion.
Item 1: "sebenarnya cukup mudah beradaptasi" adds "sebenarnya" and "mudah"; the English says "quite adaptable". Use "cukup adaptif".
Item 3: "Sebagian besar wilayah ... beriklim sedang" for "temperate" is acceptable, but "di awal siang hari" is awkward; use "pada siang hari menjelang sore" or "awal siang".
Item 3: "sungai kecil" for "stream" is fine, but "Di lokasi tipe ikan lele Pseudolaguvia muricata" is ambiguous; use "lokasi tipe lele Pseudolaguvia muricata".
Item 8: "cyprinid" is left untranslated; use "ikan cyprinid (suku Cyprinidae)" or a local term such as "ikan karper-karperan".
Item 10: "Percumbuan" is unnatural; use "Perilaku pacaran". "sirip anusnya" should be "sirip anal".
Item 10: "burayak" is used for "fry" in some places and "anakan" for "juveniles" elsewhere. The "Telur/burayak" section is acceptable but should be consistent.
Item 11: "proprietary de-worming product" became "obat cacing komersial"; this is fine, but "guratan" for ridges is awkward; use "rigi" or "alur".

cualac-tessellatus.name: Checkered Pupfish
notes: Item 3: "mata air panas" for "thermal" springs overstates the heat. The water is 26–30 °C, so use "mata air hangat" or "mata air termal".
Item 11: the typo "vilifom" should be "villiform" ("berbentuk villiform").
Items 1 and 2: IUCN "Endangered" is usually rendered "Genting" or "Terancam Punah". "Terancam" alone is ambiguous and can be confused with the broader "Threatened".

cyathopharynx-furcifer.name: Featherfin Cichlid
notes: #11: "(yang paling umum, karena ikan dewasa sangat mahal)" shifts the meaning of "likely". Use something like "(kemungkinan besar, karena ikan dewasa sangat mahal)".
#10: "memuntahkan telur atau burayak sebelum waktunya atau memakannya" adds "burayak". The English only says the female may spit out or eat the brood. Use "memuntahkan atau memakan telurnya".
#10: "untuk menyebarkan agresi" for "dissipate this aggression" is a little unnatural. Consider "untuk meredam/membagi agresi".

cyclocheilichthys-heteronema.name: Cyclocheilichthys heteronema
notes: Item 8: "Mick Wright" is named, and "UK aquarist" is kept ("Akuaris asal Inggris, Mick Wright"). Rewrite it neutrally, e.g. "seorang akuaris pernah memelihara sekelompok ikan ini". Naming the person is the only objection here.
Item 5: "kayu beech (Fagus sylvatica)" adds a Latin name that is not in the English, which only says "common beech". Remove the added Latin name.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp." changes "Cryptocorynes spp.". This is minor and acceptable, but "jenis seperti ... beberapa Cryptocoryne spp." is slightly awkward.

Item 4: the volume "sekitar 243 liter" is the figure for 48×18 in. At 120×45 cm the base area gives about 243 L only for an unstated height of about 45 cm. Check that the figure is consistent with the metric size.
Item 8: "berhasil menggabungkannya" is vague. Say "berhasil memeliharanya bersama".
Item 8: "proyek yang menarik dengan beberapa pilihan alternatif yang menarik" repeats "menarik". Vary the wording.
Item 1: "teman setangki yang agresif dan aktif" renders "boisterous" as "agresif", which overstates it. Use "heboh/aktif".
Item 8: "agresif" for "boisterous" has the same problem and implies aggression. Use "lebih lincah/hiperaktif".
Item 10: "dipijahkan" is acceptable, but "Sejauh ini diperkirakan belum pernah" is awkward. Use "Sejauh ini belum diketahui pernah berhasil dibiakkan".
Item 11: "Cyclocheilos yang divalidasi kembali" is clumsy. Use "yang kembali diakui sebagai genus valid".

cyclocheilichthys-janthochir.name: Temperas
notes: Item 1: "Di toko ikan" for "fishhouse" is acceptable, but "shark" should be "hiu"/"sepat" style; better: sebut "(shark)" with local term e.g. "hiu". Minor.
Item 1: "tidak ribet dalam hal lain" is colloquial; use "tidak rewel dalam hal lain".
Item 8: "biologically immature aquarium" is rendered "siklus nitrogennya belum matang"; it is acceptable but add "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" for fidelity. Minor.
Item 8: "agar tumbuh sehat" for "to thrive" OK; but "jangan pernah dimasukkan" switches from descriptive to imperative; use "tidak boleh dimasukkan".
Item 15: "Spesimen yang tersedia saat ini" drops "at the fishhouse" (shop talk, allowed); "Setiap pertambahan panjang 1 cm" is ok.
Item 12: "tidak mudah stres" for "less nervous" is slightly off; use "tidak mudah gugup/takut".
Item 11: "Enrichment" rendered as "nilai tambah" loses meaning slightly; use "pengayaan/pemanis" or "tambahan yang menarik". Minor.
Item 4: type locality 'Kapuas River in Pontianak' left in English inside translated phrase; use "Sungai Kapuas di Pontianak" or keep entire quote consistent.
Item 10: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable; "Penghobi ... mendapati" fine. Item 13: "kurang berwarna" is awkward; use "warnanya sedikit lebih pudar".

cyclocheilichthys-lagleri.name: Cyclocheilichthys lagleri
notes: Item 4: "about 648 litres" was converted to "sekitar 650 liter". 180 × 60 cm is a base size, not a US-gallon tank, so the table does not apply. Rounding to whole litres gives 648, and the rounding to 650 is unnecessary. Keep "sekitar 648 liter".
Item 7: "pelet butiran" is awkward for "granules". Use "granul" or "pelet" instead.
Item 8: "lele/catfish" is a questionable rendering of "catfish". It suggests the fish are lele (Clarias), which is too narrow. Use "catfish" or "ikan berkumis" instead.
Item 5: the English "setup" is left in "setup akuarium". Use "tata akuarium" or "set-up" in italics.
Item 8: "tidak terlalu gugup" for "less nervous" is a bit unnatural. Use "lebih tenang" instead.
Item 11: "belum banyak tulisan" and "Seperti anggota lain dalam genusnya" are slightly loose. Say "seperti anggota genus lainnya".

cynodon-gibbus.name: Dogtooth Characin
notes: In item 9, "memiliki (bukan tidak memiliki)" and the other "(bukan …)" renderings of "vs." read a bit awkwardly. Use "dibandingkan" or "vs." consistently, as the Rhaphiodon sentence already does.
"gampang ditindas" (items 1 and 8) is too colloquial for a handbook. "mudah didominasi" or "mudah ditindas" would fit better.

cynops-cyanurus.name: Chuxiong Fire-bellied Newt
notes: "dikoleksi" is awkward; use "ditangkap dari alam" or "dikumpulkan dari" (collected in the wild).
"Newt" is left untranslated; consider "newt (salamander air)" at first mention, since many Indonesian hobbyists don't know the term. Minor.
"newt perut api" is acceptable, but "fire belly newt" or "newt perut api (fire bellied newt)" is more familiar to hobbyists.

cynops-orientalis.name: Chinese Fire Belly Newt
notes: #6: "karena ikan kecil dengan senang hati akan dimakan" is awkward and repetitive; use "karena ikan kecil mudah dimangsa" or "karena ikan-ikan tersebut akan dimakan dengan senang hati".
