#8: "Mereka bertelur di daun tanaman air" - the source says "spawn"; acceptable, but "menempelkan telur pada daun tanaman air" is more natural for newts.
#4: "dengan sebagian besar wadahnya berisi air" is wordy; use "dipelihara secara dominan akuatik (aquatic)" or "sebagian besar berupa perairan".
#7: "bisa mencapai panjang hingga 10 cm" is redundant; use "bisa mencapai panjang 10 cm".

cyphotilapia-frontosa.name: Frontosa
notes: "berjenong" / "jenong": the usual hobby term is "nonjol" (Frontosa berjidat nonjol/kepala benjol). "jenong" is a Louhan term and is awkward here. Consider "benjolan di dahi".
"tampak unik" for "look bizarre": "bizarre" means odd or strange. Use "tampak aneh/mencolok" instead.
"Hasil penangkaran enam garis dari Taiwan": this is missing a noun. Write "Ikan hasil penangkaran bergaris enam dari Taiwan".
"banteng" in quotes for "bulls among the cichlids": the idiom is unclear. Consider "tergolong cichlid bertubuh besar dan kekar".
"pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengerem mulut". This is fine but not ideal. "Pemijahannya" is also fine.

cyprichromis-leptosoma.name: Cyprichromis Leptosoma
notes: Item 4: "~243 liter" is the exact conversion; per the tank-size table, the volume should be rounded to a sensible figure (the source's ~243 L is metric, so keep it as given only if it was the original; check).
Item 10: "suhu 24–26 °C" changes the source's 24–25.5 °C; restore "24–25,5 °C".
Item 11: "Bentuk atau varian ini tidak boleh dipelihara bersama" weakens the source's "None of these forms or morphs"; use "Tidak satu pun dari bentuk atau varian ini boleh dipelihara bersama".

Item 11: "Di pasaran, Anda mungkin juga menemukan C. leptosoma sp. \"Jumbo\" yang dijual" is redundant; also "Meskipun kemungkinan ada dua spesies yang berbeda" is awkward; use "Meskipun kemungkinan besar ada dua spesies berbeda".
Item 13: the source says "Maximum length less than 10 cm", but item 4 gives 12.5 cm SL and item 11 says the size quoted above; this is a source inconsistency, so keep it as is.
Item 16: the source gives "around 28°C", which is kept, so there is no error here, but it conflicts with 24–27 °C in the other items; this is a source issue, not a translation error.
Item 5: "memamerkan diri ketika memijah" is clumsy; use "saat pamer dalam pemijahan".

cyprichromis-microlepidotus.name: Cyprichromis microlepidotus
notes: #2: "beberapa catatan penangkapan yang tersebar" is a bit loose for "sporadic collections"; "penangkapan sporadis" would be closer.
#8 and #1: genus names such as "Cyprichromis" are not italicised in places, while they are elsewhere. Make this consistent.

cyprinion-semiplotum.name: Assamese Kingfish
notes: Item 4: "large aquaria" is rendered as "akuarium besar", which is fine. The English gives no tank size, so nothing is missing here.
Item 8: "ikan mas atau karper biasa (Cyprinus)" adds "ikan mas", which is not in the source. Use "karper biasa (Cyprinus carpio)" or just "karper biasa".
Item 1: "Assamese kingfish" is left in English. If no local name exists, add a short gloss or keep it as the trade name; this is minor.
Item 7: "ikan Labeo" for "Labeo-kind fish" is acceptable. "ikan-ikan ini bisa menjadi agresif" is slightly redundant; use "ikan bisa menjadi agresif".
Item 3: "sama sekali tidak umum" for "anything but common" is slightly stiff; "sama sekali tidak mudah ditemukan" or "jarang" reads more naturally.

cyprinodon-brontotheroides.name: Durophage Pupfish
notes: Item 7: "120″" in the English is a typo for degrees. "sekitar 120°" is fine, so no fix is needed there.
Item 4: "durophage spesialis" leaves the English term untranslated. Consider "pemakan mangsa bercangkang keras (durophage)".
Item 3: "Cyprinodon spp." at the start of the third paragraph could be "spesies Cyprinodon". Minor.
Item 1: "pupfish" is left untranslated. Consider "ikan pupfish" on first use. Minor.
Item 3: "hamparan rumput air" for wigeongrass patches is acceptable, but "padang" or "rumpun" would be more natural. Minor.

cyprinodon-desquamator.name: Scale-eating Pupfish
notes: Item 3: "rumput laut wigeongrass (Ruppia maritima)" – Ruppia is not a seaweed (rumput laut = algae); use "rumput wigeongrass" or "lamun" instead.
Item 3: "Astyanax affinis" and "Oreochromis spp. (nila)" are fine, but "spesies yang menghuni San Salvador dan Danau Chichancanab" drops the Cyprinodon reference; use "Cyprinodon yang menghuni ...".
Item 1/7: "mengarah agak ke atas (supra-terminal)" is an added gloss; supra-terminal means the mouth is on top/upturned ("mulut menghadap ke atas"), so "agak" slightly weakens it.
Item 6: "menjaga area pemijahan" – the original says "guarding breeding"; "menjaga wilayah pemijahan" is more natural. "teramati" is also stiff; use "terlihat/diamati".
Item 5: "Jantan yang sedang dalam masa kawin" is wordy; use "Jantan saat musim kawin". "ocellus" is fine but the gloss "bintik mata" is OK.

cyprinodon-julimes.name: Julimes pupfish
notes: Item 4: '(sekitar 54 liter)' is kept from the source, but 60 × 30 cm base alone doesn't give 54 L (needs 30 cm height); fine. No real issue there.
Item 7: 'dorsal-fin origin' translated as 'pangkal sirip punggung' while 'base' as 'dasar'; 'pelvic-fin' as 'sirip perut' is OK. 'caudal peduncle short, 4.5 to 6.5' fine.
Item 5: 'wool mops' kept in English italic; add the local term, e.g. 'pel benang wol (wool mop)'.
Item 2: 'munisipalitas Julimes' is non-standard; use 'kota praja/kotamadya Julimes' or 'munisipalitas (municipio) Julimes'.
Item 6: 'teramati memakan' is awkward; use 'diamati memakan' or 'terpantau memakan'.
Item 1: 'Julimes pupfish' left untranslated without a local name; acceptable but consider 'ikan pupfish Julimes'.
Item 8: reference left untranslated, fine.

cyprinodon-pachycephalus.name: Bighead pupfish
notes: Item 3: "nila yang merupakan ikan introduksi" is ambiguous; the English says only Lepomis megalotis and Tilapia are introduced. Rephrase as "ditambah ikan introduksi Lepomis megalotis dan nila".
Item 5: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" is slightly awkward. "Filter spons bertenaga udara (air-powered)" or "filter spons dengan aerator" is more natural.
Item 5: "mop wol (spawning mop)" is a non-standard rendering. Use "spawning mop dari wol" or "mop benang wol".
Item 6: "ikan mas/karper" is imprecise for 'carp'. Use "karper" alone.
Item 3: "waduk kecil buatan manusia" for 'impoundment' is a bit off. "Kolam penampungan" or "bendungan kecil" would be better, and "kolam waduk" is redundant.

cyrtocara-moorii.name: Blue Dolphin
notes: Item 10: "spitting out the brood early" was translated as "memuntahkan telur atau burayaknya lebih awal". This adds "telur atau" (eggs or), which the source doesn't say. Use "memuntahkan erami lebih awal" or just "burayak".

Item 10: "Sebagian peternak mengeluarkan burayak ... pada umur 2 minggu" says the fry are stripped at 2 weeks. The source says "at the 2 week stage" of brooding. Say "pada minggu ke-2 pengeraman" so it isn't read as the fry's age.
Item 10: "Selama masa ini betina tidak makan" is fine, but "warna mengeram berupa pola gelap" is awkward. Use "warna khas induk mengerami dengan pola gelap".
Item 10: "Ikan ini adalah mouthbrooder induk betina (betina mengerami telur di mulut) yang poligami" is clumsy. Use "mouthbrooder maternal poligami (betina mengerami telur di dalam mulut)".

Item 8: "Damai dan sebaiknya tidak dipelihara bersama spesies yang agresif ... tetapi ... akan mengintimidasi" is a muddled sentence. "Boisterous" is better as "hiperaktif/kasar" than "agresif" (items 1 and 8). "spesies Synodontis dari danau Rift" should be "Danau-danau Rift" and capitalised.
Item 8: "Teman satu akuarium" is OK, but "tankmates" is more naturally "penghuni bersama" or "tankmate" as hobbyists say it.
Item 4: The US gallon figure was dropped and the bracket removed. This is acceptable, but the volume is reported as "sekitar 257 liter" with false precision. Round to about 260 L.
Item 9: "jenong (nuchal hump)" is fine, but "Sulit dibedakan jenis kelaminnya" could use "sulit disexing" as hobbyists say it. This is minor.

danio-albolineatus.name: Pearl Danio
notes: Item 21: "Pemijahan bisa dipicu dengan menambahkan sedikit air yang lebih dingin" is fine, but "Induk ... diangkat setelah beberapa hari" is OK; however the original says "one or more smaller ... containers" and ID "satu atau beberapa wadah yang lebih kecil" is fine. The real error: "Incubation ... 24–36 jam" is correct, but item 20 and 21 conflict in the source, not the translation.
Item 12: the English gives pH 6.5–7.0 and "neutral (pH 7.0)"; fine. The omitted fact: "Pearl danios tolerate colder temperatures well" is OK. No error here.

Item 22: "Tinca tinca (tench)" is fine, but "Kottelat (2013) ... Danio ... separated" is OK. The problem: "Spesies yang dulu bernama D. erythromicron..." changes meaning; it should be "Spesies yang dulu dikenal sebagai ..." (minor).
Item 3/2: "Wild examples are rare" translated as "Ikan tangkapan alam jarang ada di pasaran" is OK, but "celestial pearl danio ... dark-colored danio" fine.

Item 20: "Place half as many females as males ... several days before introducing the males" is translated as "betina sebanyak setengah jumlah jantan", which matches the English, but the English itself is likely wrong. Keep as is.
Item 5: "Region Tanintharyi" and "negara bagian" for Myanmar states is awkward; use "Wilayah Tanintharyi" and "negara bagian/wilayah".
Item 17: "ikan catfish" is redundant; use "lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish". "gugup" for nervous is slightly odd; use "stres/mudah takut".
Item 11: "Akuarium yang banyak tanamannya atau aquascape" - "set-up" rendered as aquascape is a shift; use "tata letak".

danio-choprae.name: Glowlight Danio
notes: Item 18: "Spesies yang dulunya D. erythromicron, ..." is awkward; better "Spesies D. erythromicron, D. margaritatus, D. choprae, dan D. flagrans yang dulu dimasukkan ke Danio dikelompokkan bersama ...".
Item 17: "filter mesin" for "power filter" is non-standard; use "filter eksternal/power filter".
Item 9: "arus sederas air bah" is slightly exaggerated for "torrent-like"; "arus deras" is more natural.

danio-kyathit.name: Danio kyathit
notes: Item 12: "sirip anus" is used for the anal fin. "sirip dubur" is the more usual term in Indonesian ichthyology and hobby writing.
Item 11: "pada sore hari" for "in the evening". "malam hari" or "menjelang malam" would be closer for a water-change trigger.

danio-margaritatus.name: Rasbora Galaxy
notes: Item 8: 'deep forest' became 'hutan lebat' (dense forest); 'hutan yang dalam/hutan belantara' is closer to the original.
Item 26: 'revalidated the species' became 'mengkaji ulang status spesies ini'; 'memvalidasi kembali spesies ini' keeps the taxonomic meaning.
Item 9: '~41 litres' became '±41 liter'; 'sekitar/~41 liter' is more natural for an approximate value.

danio-rerio.name: Ikan Zebra
notes: #25: "pencahayaan yang redup dan menyebar" adds "redup" (dim), but the English only says "diffuse lighting". Use "pencahayaan yang menyebar/lembut".
#17: "akuarium memanjang berukuran 75 liter atau lebih panjang" mixes volume with length. Use "75 liter atau lebih besar", or keep "memanjang" separate.
#20: "gampang dan mudah dirawat" is redundant. Use just "mudah dirawat".
#1: "sawah yang sudah lama tergenang" for "mature rice paddies" is a loose paraphrase. The same wording recurs in #10, so use something like "sawah yang sudah mapan/matang".
#44: the source text is cut off mid-sentence and no Indonesian translation is given. Make sure it is translated in full.

danio-tinwini.name: Danio tinwini
notes: Item 4: "about 41 litres" for a 45 × 30 cm base is kept unchanged from the English. It is not tied to a tank size from the table, so please check it. This is not an error in the translation itself.

Item 10: "The adults ... are best removed after a couple of days" is translated as "setelah beberapa hari". "A couple of days" means about two days, so use "setelah dua hari atau lebih" or "setelah sekitar dua hari".

Item 10: "half-filled with water" is translated as "diisi air setengahnya". It is acceptable, but "setengah penuh" is more natural. "Pemijahan ... dipicu" with "cool water" is rendered as "air yang lebih dingin", which is fine.
Item 11: "Tinca tinca (ikan tench)" is fine, but "Danio spp." and "pigment stripe" are left in English without explanation. Consider "garis pigmen".

Item 2: the English "Ayeyarwaddy" in the type locality quote is kept, which is fine. "tempat D. choprae tampaknya juga endemik" is awkward. Rephrase it as "yang tampaknya juga menjadi wilayah endemik D. choprae".
Item 3: "minor rivers" is translated as "anak sungai" (tributaries). It is a slight shift in meaning. Use "sungai kecil" for "streams" and "sungai berukuran kecil" for "minor rivers".

datnioides-campbelli.name: Datz Papua
notes: Item 1: "tiger perch (datz)" – "datz" is not a clear, established Indonesian hobby term and is not in the source; use "datnoid" or just "tiger perch".
Item 1: "dari Papua bagian selatan" could be read as the Indonesian province only; use "Pulau Papua (New Guinea) bagian selatan", as in item 2.

datnioides-microlepis.name: Indo Datnoid
notes: "Saat taktik menyergap yang dipilih" is awkward; use "Saat memilih taktik menyergap" or "Jika taktik menyergap yang dipilih".
"corak terangnya" for "light blaze": a blaze is a light stripe or patch, so "corak/garis terang" is acceptable but slightly vague. Consider "tanda terang" or "blaze terang".
"tiger fish" is left in English. Consider adding "(ikan tiger)" or "ikan tigerfish", which is the usual hobby form.

datnioides-polota.name: Silver Datz
notes: Item 2: "Sungai Sarawak dan Rajang di Sarawak, Kalimantan" is wrong. The English says "Sarawak, Borneo". Sarawak is in Malaysian Borneo, not Kalimantan (Indonesia). Change it to "Sarawak, Borneo" (Pulau Kalimantan/Borneo).
Item 2: for the Indonesian records, "Kalimantan, Borneo" has lost "Borneo" in "Sungai Sambas, Kapuas, dan Barito, Kalimantan". Restore "Kalimantan, Borneo".

datnioides-pulcher.name: Siamese Tiger Fish
notes: Item 5: "meskipun pola ini juga muncul pada malam hari" is slightly ambiguous. Make clear that this stress-like pattern is also the normal nighttime pattern, e.g. "pola yang sama juga ditampilkan pada malam hari".
Item 11: "famili tripletail laut Lobotidae" leaves "tripletail" in English. Add a local term such as "ikan tripletail (Lobotes)" or a short gloss.

dermogenys-pusilla.name: Dermogenys pusilla
notes: Item 10: "Assuming they are healthy, the fry are best removed" is mistranslated as "Kalau anakannya lahir sehat". It should be about the fry being healthy and the advice to remove them (e.g. "Asalkan anakan sehat, sebaiknya dipisahkan"). The nuance is shifted.

Item 8: "Males will often spar... best to keep either a single male specimen or several" is fine. But "sparring" rendered as "bertarung" overstates it. Use "saling menyerang/beradu" or similar milder wording.
Item 1: "Lompatannya juga sangat jago" is awkward and colloquial. Use "Ikan ini juga pelompat ulung". Item 5 "jago melompat" is likewise informal.
Item 1: "Wrestling halfbeak atau julung-julung" leaves English untranslated and repeats "halfbeak". Use a consistent, established term such as "ikan julung-julung" throughout.
Item 1: the source says "tight lid" and then "tightly-fitting cover". The translation is fine, but "Butuh tutup" is terse. Use "Perlu tutup akuarium yang rapat".
Item 10: "Masa bunting" is used for a livebearer's gestation. "Masa kehamilan/mengandung" is more natural for fish. "Bunting" is mainly for mammals.
Item 10: "memancing ikan untuk kawin" is a literal rendering of "inducing the fish to breed". Use "merangsang ikan untuk berkembang biak".
Item 9: "Jantan dewasa ... ukurannya jauh lebih kecil daripada betina" is fine. But "organ kelamin" for "genital-type organ" drops the "type" nuance. Use "organ mirip alat kelamin".

desmopuntius-foerschi.name: Boomerang Barb
notes: Item 4: "sekitar 72 liter" is retained from the English. 80×30 cm gives 72 L only at a 30 cm depth, which the source does not state, so this is acceptable. No fix needed on the number itself.
Item 5: "Substrat pasir yang lembut kemungkinan pilihan terbaik" is missing "adalah". Use "kemungkinan adalah pilihan terbaik".
Item 5: "akar atau dahan kayu (driftwood) yang membuat cahaya ... jadi lebih redup" reads awkwardly. "Diffuse" means to scatter or soften the light, so use "menyebarkan/melembutkan cahaya".
Item 8: "teman setangki" is slightly informal. "Penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain dalam akuarium" is more natural.
Item 11: "keranjang sampah" is a literal rendering of "catch-all". "Kelompok serba-ada" or "kelompok penampung" is more natural.
Item 7: "pencari makan" for "foragers" is stiff. Use "pemakan yang mencari makan di dasar/sekitar", or reword.
Item 1: The first sentence is split in two, and "cyprinid" is left as is. "Ikan cyprinid (famili Cyprinidae)" would read better.

desmopuntius-gemellus.name: Desmopuntius gemellus
notes: Item 5: "setup bergaya sungai hutan" leaves "setup" as English. Something like "tata letak akuarium bergaya sungai hutan" would read more naturally.
Item 7: "pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran kering" is a bit clumsy. "pakan serpih (flake) dan granul kering" would be clearer.

desmopuntius-hexazona.name: Pentazona
notes: Item 4: English says the former locality ('Tuluk') is now Teluk Meranti, and that peat swamp forest was cleared 'to make space for oil palm plantations'. The Indonesian is fine on that. Still, 'Lokasi tipenya ... Tuluk dan Gunung Sahilan' is slightly altered: the original says 'of which the former is now known as'. This is a minor point.

Item 13: 'Hindari teman setangki yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan' adds 'saat makan'. The English says 'boisterous or very vigorous', not 'aggressive'. 'agresif' changes the meaning, so use 'sangat aktif/lincah'. 'bisa kalah bersaing dalam berebut pakan' is also redundant.

Item 17: 'D. pentazona ... terbatas di Kalimantan bagian barat laut, dan mungkin negara bagian Sarawak' is OK. But 'kelompok "tempat sampah" polifiletik' for 'catch-all' is a loose rendering; use 'wadah serba ada' or 'kelompok campuran'.

Item 17: 'pita ke-3 di pangkal awal sirip punggung' and 'pita ke-4 di pangkal awal sirip anal' render 'origin' as 'pangkal awal'. This is awkward; use 'awal pangkal sirip'. 'Pita pertama' also does not match 'anterior bar', which means the front bar.
Item 17: the sentence 'D. gemellus, D. johorensis ... pola pita hanya ada pada ikan muda' is fine. 'genus Desmopuntius dibentuk dan didiagnosis' is acceptable. 'Kesalahan penamaan' is fine.
Item 11: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' is acceptable. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is the common term, but 'Daphnia' is also used and readers may confuse it with other organisms.

Item 15: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' and 'diisi air matang' are ambiguous. 'air matang' usually means boiled water in Indonesian; use 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang/siklus' for 'mature water'.
Item 15: 'jangan' is missing nowhere, but 'tidak menunjukkan perawatan induk' is stiff; use 'tidak menjaga telur/anak'.
Item 1: 'sudah dewasa penuh' is stiff; use 'berukuran dewasa'. 'hasil tangkapan alam' is fine, but the hobby term 'tangkapan alam (wild)' is commoner.

desmopuntius-johorensis.name: Striped Barb
notes: Item 10: "air matang (dari akuarium yang sudah mapan)" – "air matang" means boiled water in Indonesian; use "air dari akuarium yang sudah mapan/matang (cycled)".
Item 11: ordinal inconsistency, "pita pertama" next to "pita ke-2", "ke-3"; use "pita ke-1" or consistent wording.
Item 11: "sungut rostral dan maksila ada" is awkward; use "terdapat sungut rostral dan maksila".
Item 2: "posisinya tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus" is awkward; use "tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus".

desmopuntius-rhomboocellatus.name: Snakeskin Barb
notes: Item 1: "Spesimen tangkapan alam dari Borneo yang sangat bagus." is a fragment with no verb. The source says specimens were received. Use a full sentence, e.g. "Kami menerima spesimen tangkapan alam yang bagus..." in neutral phrasing, such as "Diterima spesimen tangkapan alam yang sangat bagus dari Borneo."

Item 4: "Kahayan" differs from the English "Kahajan". It is the correct modern river name, so this is fine. The other place names keep the old spelling (Oelin, Bandjermasin), which matches the quoted type locality.
Item 13: "air akuarium yang sudah matang/siap (mature)" is clumsy. "mature water" means well-established, aged water. Use "air yang sudah matang" only.
Item 13: "keesokan paginya" is rendered with "biasanya", a hedge that is not in the source ("should take place"). Minor.
Item 14: "pangkal depan sirip punggung" for "dorsal-fin origin" is acceptable. "keranjang sampah" for "catch-all" is fine.
Item 10: "terlalu aktif/lincah" uses a slash. Choose one term, e.g. "terlalu aktif".
Item 3 was left out. The English is shop talk for customers, which the translator is told to drop, so this is not an error.

desmopuntius-trifasciatus.name: Three-line Barb
notes: Item 4: 'sekitar 243 liter' is the source's figure, but 120 × 45 cm has no stated height, so the number cannot be checked. If the source implied a different volume, round it sensibly (e.g. ~240 L).

Item 11: 'interaxial streak' is rendered 'garis interaksial'. The standard term is 'garis interaksial' only loosely, so use a clearer descriptor such as 'garis di antara garis-garis (interaxial streak)'.
Item 11: 'pangkal depan sirip punggung/anal' for 'origin' is fine, but 'sungut maksila' for 'maxillary barbel' should be 'sungut maksilar'. Also 'pita interaksial' is unclear.
Item 1: 'ikan cyprinid' is left untranslated. Use 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' or the common 'ikan mas-masan (cyprinid)'.
Item 7: 'mencari makan dengan mengais' adds 'mengais' (scraping), which the source's 'foragers' does not specify. Use 'mencari makan' with a plain list.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'pelet butiran' mistranslates 'granules'. Use 'granul'.
Item 8: 'jenis anabantoid tertentu' is fine, but 'kurang penakut' for 'less skittish' is awkward. Use 'tidak mudah takut/kaget'.

dichotomyctere-fluviatilis.name: Dichotomyctere fluviatilis
notes: Item 8: "Ketiga spesies ini adalah ikan air payau sejati" contradicts item 15 and item 2 where only fluviatilis is a true brackish species; this is a source inconsistency, but the translation keeps the claim as written. Fine, but check consistency.

Item 10: "kerang-kerangan yang cangkangnya tidak dikupas" is fine, but "unshelled shellfish (such as crab legs, mussels)" is contradictory in the source; the Indonesian is ambiguous, so clarify as "yang masih bercangkang".
Item 12: "Karena agak tidak toleran" is awkward; use "Ikan yang agak intoleran ini..." and "monos" should be "ikan kitang/monodaktilus (Monodactylus)" for clarity.
Item 12: "ikan ketang-ketang (scat)" is a non-standard name; "ikan ketang-ketang" is the usual Indonesian term for Scatophagus.

Item 15: "tetrodoxin" in the source was corrected to "tetrodotoksin"; fine, but "lebih mematikan daripada sianida" is okay. "Buntal adalah hidangan istimewa" adds "Buntal" as subject, which is acceptable.
Item 7: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "jadi pergantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 6: "Alas akuarium" is acceptable, but "Standard length" is better as "panjang standar (SL)".

dichotomyctere-nigroviridis.name: Buntal Hijau
notes: Item 8: "lele Arius" – Arius are sea/brackish catfish; consider "ikan manyung (Arius)" or "patin laut/sembilang Arius" for hobbyist clarity.
Item 8: "Terutama ikan jantan, akan terus-menerus berkelahi" is awkward; use "Terutama ikan jantan akan terus-menerus berkelahi" (no comma) or "Pejantan khususnya akan berkelahi terus-menerus".
Item 5: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "sehingga penggantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 8: "agresivitasnya agak terpecah" is slightly unnatural; use "agresi tersebar ke banyak ikan".

dichotomyctere-ocellatus.name: Buntal angka delapan
notes: Item 8: "ikan kakap perak (mono/Monodactylus)" is wrong/confusing: kakap perak is Lates calcarifer (barramundi); monos are Monodactylus argenteus, so use "mono (Monodactylus)" or "ikan bulan/kitiran" without "kakap perak".

Item 7: "hewan bercangkang (kerang dan udang-udangan)" mistranslates "shellfish"; the example in brackets is incomplete, and "unshelled shellfish" (crab legs, prawns) is rendered as "yang tidak dikupas", which is ambiguous. Use "moluska dan krustasea bercangkang", and clarify that the crustaceans are fed with the shell on.
Item 14: added "dan suka bertengkar" duplicates the meaning; the English only says "quarrelsome". Minor.
Item 13: "air sebaiknya sekeras mungkin (kesadahan setinggi mungkin)" is wordy; the bracket is an addition. Minor.

Item 11: "jika Anda tidak ingin memelihara ikan buntal Anda lagi" is wordy; "if you need to get rid of" would be better as "jika perlu melepas/menyingkirkan". Also "anyone ... lebih dari 1000 kali lebih mematikan" is fine, but "tidak perlu Anda khawatirkan" is a loose rendering of "This need not worry you"; ok.

Item 10: "Diperkirakan belum pernah dipijahkan" – "Not thought to have been bred" better as "Tampaknya belum pernah berhasil dikembangbiakkan di kalangan penghobi"; "dipijahkan" implies only spawning, not breeding success.
Item 15: "Sejak awal ikan ini sering tertukar" adds "sering" (often) not in the source ("Very early on it was confused").

discherodontus-ashmeadi.name: Discherodontus ashmeadi
notes: Item 8: 'Males will also display their best colours as they compete' is rendered in the wrong sense. 'Ikan jantan juga akan menampilkan warna terbaiknya saat bersaing satu sama lain' is acceptable, but 'Damai ... tempat ia akan menghabiskan ... dan akan tumbuh baik' is one long run-on sentence and hard to read. Split it.
Item 3: 'tanaman emersed' leaves English untranslated. Use 'tanaman emers' or 'tanaman yang tumbuh menyembul di atas air'.

Item 3: 'Collection is therefore much easier during the hours of darkness' is rendered as 'penangkapannya jauh lebih mudah saat gelap'. This is fine, but 'ia' used for the fish in several places is slightly stiff.
Item 5: 'arus sederas air bah' for 'torrent-like conditions' overstates the meaning, since a flood is not a torrent. Use 'arus sederas aliran deras/jeram'.
Item 5: 'Microsorum, Bolbitis, atau Anubias' are left without italics. Make them genus names in italics (<em>) as Latin names.
Item 1/11: 'mudah stres (shock)' is imprecise. 'Shock' is better rendered as 'syok'. 'Stres' alone does not convey it.

Item 4: The 'Volume ±243 liter' is correct, but the dropped bracketed imperial values are fine. No change is needed, though 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran minimum' is awkward. Use 'sebaiknya menjadi ukuran terkecil yang dipertimbangkan'.
Item 7: 'merumput biofilm' for 'browsing' is awkward. Use 'memakan/menggerogoti biofilm'. 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' is acceptable but loses the Latin name hobbyists use, so keep 'Daphnia'.
Item 12: The Kottelat reference contains the typo 'bibiography' and is left untranslated as instructed. This is fine, so no change is needed.

doryichthys-heterosoma.name: Longmouth Pipefish
notes: Item 7: "tankmate" is left in English; use "teman satu akuarium" or "ikan penghuni bersama".
Item 7: "ikan gobi kecil" is a little stiff; "ikan gobi (goby) kecil" or "ikan glodok kecil" would read more naturally.
Item 6: "saat baru dilepas" is slightly off for "lúc mới thả"; "saat baru dimasukkan ke akuarium" is clearer.

doryichthys-martensii.name: Pipefish air tawar
notes: "Ikan jarum ini" in item 5 is inconsistent with "Pipefish" elsewhere; "needles" is the English colloquial term, so use consistent terminology (e.g., "ikan pipa/pipefish").
"kutu air kecil" for small water fleas: "kutu air" is ambiguous; prefer "Daphnia kecil" or "kutu air (Daphnia) kecil".
"nauplii artemia" should be "nauplii Artemia" (genus name capitalised/italic) for consistency with Cyclops.
"Pipefish air tawar termasuk ikan yang cocok untuk aquarist yang sudah berpengalaman": "care objects for advanced aquarists" is slightly softened; "aquarist" could be "aquaris/penghobi", minor.
"sebisa mungkin pH sebaiknya di atas 7" is redundant ("sebisa mungkin" + "sebaiknya"); use one.
"perut yang tebal" is literal; "perut membuncit/gemuk" is more natural.

eirmotus-insignis.name: False Eight-banded Barb
notes: Item 1: 'Ia satu dari empat spesies' is clumsy and the English 'false eight-banded barb' is left in without a local rendering; consider 'barb delapan pita palsu' with the English trade name in brackets.
Item 1/2/11: 'DAS Kapuas' is fine, but 'Borneo' next to 'Kalimantan' is fine; no issue. However in item 2 the English 'upstrean' typo was silently fixed; OK.
Item 5: 'setup' is left as English; use 'penataan akuarium' or 'aquascape'. 'kimia air' is awkward; use 'parameter air' or 'kualitas air'.
Item 5: 'akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang' is OK, but 'biologically-immature' is more commonly 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is more commonly 'kutu air (Daphnia)'; 'siap kawin' should be 'siap memijah' for fish.

Item 8: 'Ikan jantan ... bersaing satu sama lain untuk menarik perhatian betina' is fine; 'teman satu akuarium' is awkward, use 'penghuni lain'. 'tertekan' for 'intimidated' shifts the meaning toward 'stressed'; use 'terintimidasi'.
Item 8: the English says 'among representatives available in the ornamental trade', and the Indonesian restructures; fine. 'gugup' for nervous is odd; use 'tidak mudah takut/stres'.
Item 9: 'bertubuh jelas lebih bulat' is awkward; use 'tampak jelas lebih membulat'.

Item 11: Terms like 'pita' for bars, 'predorsal' and 'interorbital' are left untranslated or are non-standard; use 'garis/belang' for bars and 'panjang predorsal' with explanation. 'SL', 'BL' and 'HL' are not defined.
Item 12: The reference list is left untranslated as the instructions allow; no fix.

entacmaea-quadricolor.name: Anemon bubble tip
notes: Item 6: "Some aquarists use this deliberately to induce splitting" is rendered as "Beberapa aquarist sengaja memanfaatkan hal ini untuk memicu pembelahan" and is fine. The real problem is in Item 6 "Roaming", where "Berpindah-pindah" is used for both 'roaming' and 'moving around'. This is minor.
Item 10: "Ikan badut clarkii / Clark's clownfish" is an awkward local name. Use "Ikan badut Clark".
Item 10: "sweeper tentacle" is left in English with no gloss. Add a local equivalent, for example "tentakel penyapu (sweeper tentacle)".

Item 10: "semi-agresif" is correct, but the English heading says the temper is 'aggressive' in the list (Item 1). The two descriptions differ in the source, so keep that discrepancy in mind. This is a minor point.

Item 6: "Bubble tip anemone is moderately difficult to care for" and "Removing it is easy to do damage" are rendered literally. "mudah sekali menimbulkan kerusakan" is stiff. Rephrase it as "mudah merusaknya".

Item 12: "bubbles kept when disturbed or stressed, or when relaxed" is rendered as "gelembung dipertahankan saat terganggu atau stres, atau saat rileks", which is hard to follow. Rephrase it as "gelembung tetap ada saat anemon terganggu...".
Item 12: "not enough algae in the water" and the phrase "anemon yang diberi pakan tidak lagi butuh gelembung" are accurate but stiff. Tidy the wording.
Item 9: "clam" is translated as "remis". Use "kerang" or "kima" for consistency, since "kerang" is already used for mussels.

epalzeorhynchos-bicolor.name: Red Tail Black Shark
notes: Item 3: "pembangunan manusia" is awkward and can read as human development. Use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan".
Item 5: "cukup tidak tahan terhadap penumpukan limbah organik" is clumsy. Use "kurang tahan" or "sensitif terhadap".

Item 7: "pakan kering berkualitas baik berupa pakan serpihan, granul, serta bahan nabati segar" lumps fresh plant material in with dried food. Separate them: dried flakes and granules, plus fresh plant material.
Item 2: "dianggap kritis" is vague for "considered critically endangered". Use "dianggap sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)".

Item 1: "ikan cyprinid" and "Red tail black shark" are acceptable, but the common name is more natural as "red tail black shark" (also "hiu bala/balashark ekor merah"). Use the form hobbyists use consistently.

epalzeorhynchos-frenatus.name: Rainbow Shark
notes: Items 7 and 11: "menggerogoti" (gnaw) for "browse/graze" on algae and biofilm is slightly off. "memakan/mengerik" or "merumput" would fit better.
Item 1: "anerythristic" is left untranslated, though item 11 glosses it. Consider "anerythristic (tanpa pigmen merah)" here too.

epalzeorhynchos-kalopterus.name: Flying Fox
notes: Item 2: "Fishes sold as ... are often confused with it, but it has white-edged..." Translation "Padahal flying fox punya..." is OK, but "Difficulty: Moderate" fine. No issue; ignore.
Item 6: "pembangunan manusia" is a mistranslation of "human development"; use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan" (it does not mean human development in the HDI sense).
Item 8: "Namun, ikan ini akan tumbuh paling baik" - "However it will thrive" fine, but "cukup tidak tahan" is awkward for "quite intolerant"; use "sangat sensitif terhadap penumpukan limbah organik".
Item 12: "hal ini jauh tidak terlalu jadi masalah" is ungrammatical; use "masalah ini jauh berkurang".
Item 12: "bisa suka bertengkar" is awkward; use "bisa suka berkelahi" / "cenderung bertengkar".
Item 1: "Hal ini karena ikan terus tumbuh" fine, but "Flying fox bisa dengan mudah hidup" drops "such a"; minor.

Item 11: "Daphnia" translated as "kutu air" - acceptable, but "zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar" for blanched is fine; "Pada dasarnya ikan ini perumput aufwuchs" misses a verb, use "Pada dasarnya ikan ini adalah perumput aufwuchs".
Item 16: "jenis kelamin gramatikal" should be "gender gramatikal"; "tersilangkan" unnatural, use "terjadi hibridisasi/persilangan".
Item 16: "Tertukar dengan ikan mirip ... bukan hal yang jarang, dan sebagian besar disebabkan" is a hard-to-read subjectless sentence; rewrite it.
Item 5: "peternakan komersial" for "commercial farms" should be "tempat budidaya/penangkaran komersial"; also "Kahajan" was changed to "Kahayan" (acceptable).

esomus-metallicus.name: Striped Flying Barb
notes: Item 12: "a dozen described Esomus species" is rendered "belasan spesies" (about 11–19). Use "selusin" or "sekitar 12 spesies" to stay close to the source.

Item 12: "tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is slightly weaker than "none are especially popular". "Tidak ada yang terlalu populer" is fine, but "sebagian besar umum dijumpai" would read more naturally as "sebagian besar tergolong umum".

eutropiichthys-burmannicus.name: Eutropiichthys burmannicus
notes: Item 1: size and temperature drop the original in brackets (14 in; 73-79°F). Dropping them is allowed because the metric conversion is given, so this is not an error.

Item 4: 'eutropheia = cukup makan' is fine, but 'jarang ditemukan di pasar ikan' is OK. 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is acceptable; the usual Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'.
Item 2: 'hilir Sungai Salween' reads slightly ambiguous. Consider 'bagian hilir Sungai Salween'.

farlowella-vittata.name: Farlowella
notes: #14: "more vigorous or larger species" is rendered "lebih agresif". Vigorous means energetic or fast at feeding, not aggressive. Use "lebih lincah/gesit" instead.
#17: "ikan catfish" is redundant. Use "ikan lele Amerika Selatan" or just "catfish Amerika Selatan".

garra-borneensis.name: Garra Borneo
notes: "Ikan ini mutlak hidup di sungai kecil" (obligate dweller): "mutlak hidup" is awkward and unclear; use "hanya hidup di" or "penghuni khas/eksklusif sungai berarus deras".
"dasar batuan induk" / "batuan induk" for bedrock: "batuan induk" is a geological term for parent rock (source rock), which is a different meaning; use "batuan dasar" or "dasar batu padat".

"Spesies ikan lain di sana" is fine, but "Tidak ada anggota genus ini lainnya yang diketahui berasal dari pulau tersebut" is stiff; rephrase as "Tidak ada anggota genus lain yang diketahui dari pulau tersebut".

"Spesies ini sudah tercatat" in 2: the English has no explicit subject and says "it has been recorded"; fine, but "negara bagian Sabah dan Sarawak" is correct, so no change needed there. Minor: "Malaysian provinces" rendered correctly.
"zat tanduk" for keratinised/horny is unnatural; use "mengeras seperti tanduk (berkeratin)".
"kecil kemungkinannya terwujud" and "kumpulan yang ada sekarang" for "current assemblage" are slightly awkward; prefer "pengelompokan saat ini".
"klad" is a rare spelling; use "klade".

garra-ceylonensis.name: Ceylon Logsucker
notes: Item 6: "pita yang lebih terang di bagian atasnya ke arah punggung" is slightly wordy and adds "di sisi tubuh"; simplify to "pita yang lebih terang di dekat punggung".
Item 2: "Ikan tangkapan alam" is acceptable, but "ikan liar/tangkapan alam" could be phrased more naturally; "Siamese algae eater" is fine, though "sucker/ikan sapu-sapu" confusion should be avoided.
Item 4: "suka bermain di dalamnya" is awkward; use "suka bermain di arus tersebut".

garra-flavatra.name: Garra panda
notes: Item 8: 'Memelihara Garra flavatra sangat mudah' — the English says 'very easy', but this contradicts the rest of the text, which says it needs stable water and a mature set-up. It is faithful to the source, so only flag it if the source is wrong. Not a translation error.
Item 10: 'Parameter air lainnya tidak berpengaruh baginya' is a little too absolute. Prefer 'tidak penting bagi mereka'. This is a minor point.
Item 13: 'Mereka sepenuhnya damai' — fine. No change needed.
Item 6: 'batu kerikil bulat' for 'pebbles' is awkward; use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali'. 'Anak sungai' for 'stream' is acceptable but slightly imprecise; 'sungai kecil' is better.
Item 6: 'Dasarnya didominasi batu besar dan batu kecil' — 'rocks and stones' is rendered with 'batu besar', which adds a size claim. Use 'batu dan batu kecil'.
Item 6: 'Pengambilan ikan' for 'collection' is vague; 'penangkapan/pengumpulan ikan' is clearer.
Item 12: 'Tubifex' is rendered as 'cacing sutra'. That is acceptable but not identical; keep Tubifex or add it in brackets.
Item 12: 'kerang/udang yang dihaluskan' for 'puréed shellfish' adds 'udang' and is imprecise. Use 'kerang-kerangan/hewan bercangkang yang dihaluskan'.
Item 16: 'Direktur pelaksananya' — 'Managing Director' is better as 'Direktur Utama'.
Item 3 is left out, which matches the instructions for shop talk. No issue.

garra-rufa.name: Ikan Dokter
notes: Item 3: "Lapisan biofilm" for "Growth" adds a term not in the source; the source says algae and the microorganisms in it. Use "Lapisan alga" or "Tumbuhan penempel (alga) beserta mikroorganisme di dalamnya" instead.
Item 4: "batu-batu berlumut alga" is slightly off for "algae-covered stones". "batu yang ditumbuhi alga", as used in item 3, is more consistent.
Item 4: "Terutama ikan-ikan muda sangat rajin" is awkward for "Young fish in particular are very fond of...". Use "Ikan muda khususnya sangat gemar membersihkan dan memakan alga".

Item 5: "Saat dicoba langsung" loses the "self-experiment" meaning, which is the author trying it on their own arm. Use "Dalam percobaan pada diri sendiri", or a neutral wording such as "Dalam uji coba pada lengan sendiri".
Item 5: "dengan sendirinya berenang menghampiri tangan" is fine, but "pemakan alga yang hebat" is a bit colloquial. "pemakan alga yang andal" is more natural.
Item 2: "Ikan dokter" is a common name, but it is not the same as "psoriasis fish". Consider "ikan dokter (ikan psoriasis) Kangal" for clarity.

gasteropelecus-maculatus.name: Spotted Hatchetfish
notes: "menampung otot-otot yang diperlukan" is slightly wordy; could be "menampung otot terbang yang diperlukan".

gastromyzon-ctenocephalus.name: Gastromyzon ctenocephalus
notes: Item 6: 'batu dan koral sungai' mistranslates 'water-worn rocks and pebbles'. 'Koral' means coral. Use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali dan kerikil'.
Item 6: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add an Indonesian gloss such as 'lapisan alga dan biofilm (aufwuchs)'.

Item 9: 'ikan lele penyuka arus' for 'rheophilic catfishes' is imprecise, because Glyptothorax, Akysis and Hara are not true lele. Use 'ikan catfish penyuka arus' or 'ikan berkumis penghuni arus deras'.
Item 8: 'gangguan pencernaan' for 'internal problems' narrows the meaning. Use 'gangguan kesehatan internal' or 'masalah organ dalam'.

gastromyzon-lepidogaster.name: Hillstream Loach Borneo
notes: "pilihan tankmate": English term left in; "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "teman satu akuarium" is more natural.
"aufwuchs": German term left as is; add a short Indonesian gloss such as "lapisan alga dan jasad renik (aufwuchs)".

gastromyzon-punctulatus.name: Borneo Sucker
notes: Item 6: "Karena bagaimanapun impor yang datang cukup sering berisi campuran..." changes the logic. The English says a mix of up to five species often arrives anyway, so the animals are simply still sold as G. punctulatus. Rephrase, e.g. "Karena toh cukup sering datang campuran hingga lima spesies...".

Item 6: "dulu dalam impor dimasukkan ke 3 spesies saja" is clumsy. The English says species that were assigned to 3 species in earlier imports. Rephrase, e.g. "yang pada impor terdahulu dimasukkan ke dalam 3 spesies".
Item 6: "tidak mau mengembangkan siripnya kalau dipanggil" is a literal, odd rendering of "when called". Rephrase, e.g. "tidak mengembangkan sirip sesuai perintah".
Item 6: "area tulang belakang" is stiff for "vertebral area". Use "daerah punggung sepanjang tulang belakang". "bentuk peralihannya banyak sekali" is awkward. Use "bentuk peralihan/perantara".

Item 6: "Di perdagangan ikan hias selalu ada" fits "There are always ... offered" only loosely. "Selalu" could be "senantiasa/biasanya". The "punctulated" point is also lost: "satu spesies berbintik".

Item 3: "perkelahiannya selalu tidak berbahaya" is awkward. Use "perkelahian di antara mereka selalu tidak berbahaya/tidak melukai". "tidak peduli" has a slightly negative tone for "not interested". Use "tidak mengganggu".

Item 1: "mungkin ada gunanya" is a bit colloquial. "Suhu di kisaran tengah lebih disarankan" is fine. In "sangat lunak dan sering juga asam", "lunak" is correct for soft water. "Acclimation" as "aklimatisasi" is fine.

Item 2: "Ikan ini sangat mudah diberi pakan, segala jenis pakan mau dimakan" is a comma splice. Merge into one sentence. "lumut" for algae is acceptable, but "alga" is more precise. The English says they are less concerned with algae than with micro life.

gastromyzon-zebrinus.name: Borneo Sucker Zebra
notes: Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air" is clumsy for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 6: "Kayu rendaman (driftwood) yang sudah lama" is a loose rendering of "aged driftwood". "Kayu apung/driftwood yang sudah lama dikeringkan/matang" is clearer.
Item 11: "dinaikkan secara bertahap sampai 28 °C selama 8 minggu" adds "secara bertahap", which the English does not say. It is minor and could be dropped.

geosesarma-hagen.name: Kepiting Red Devil
notes: Section 5 Molting: "memungkinkannya menumbuhkan kembali anggota tubuh yang hilang" is fine, but "Substrat ... Gunakan serat kelapa (cocopeat), tanah, dan gambut" is OK; the real problem: "Wadah harus punya beberapa tempat sembunyi" is fine, yet "Kelembapan bisa diatur dengan menambah kelembapan" is circular; say "menyemprotkan air/menambah sumber kelembapan".
Section 4: "Idealnya area darat mengambil minimal 70% ruang akuarium" is OK, but "Kepiting Red Devil sangat pandai kabur" is awkward; use "jago kabur" or "pandai meloloskan diri".
Section 8: EN "they are not vegetarians" translated as "bukan herbivora" — slightly changes meaning (vegetarian vs herbivore); better "bukan pemakan tumbuhan saja".
Section 8: "Pakan yang mereka sukai: ... pakan serpihan" fine; but "bugs" rendered as "serangga" duplicates the insect category; use "kepik/serangga kecil".

Section 8: "cuttlebones" as "tulang sotong" is fine, but "figs" as "buah tin" fine; "mereka bahkan bisa saling memangsa (kanibal)" OK. Minor: "Moss adalah tempat favorit untuk nongkrong" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "tempat favorit untuk bertengger dan bersembunyi".
Section 6: "pH: minimal 7,0–8,0" mirrors the English awkwardness; clearer "pH 7,0–8,0 (minimal 7,0)".

Section 11: "Betina melepaskan anakan" and "Anakan kepiting sebaiknya diberi pakan ... pakan yang sama seperti induknya" fine; "betina jadi lebih tertutup" is unnatural for "secretive"; use "lebih tertutup/pemalu" → "lebih menyembunyikan diri".
Section 12: "Umur ... tergantung penyakit" okay; "Hatchlings are almost dark" rendered "hampir gelap seluruhnya" slightly adds "seluruhnya"; use "hampir gelap".

glossolepis-dorityi.name: Rainbow Dorityi
notes: "rimbunan tanaman" for "plantation" is loose: the source term here likely means a planted thicket or spawning plants; consider "area tanaman" or "rumpun tanaman".
"peternak" for "breeder" is non-standard in the aquarium hobby; use "breeder" or "pembudidaya".
"memukau" for "splendid" slightly overstates the colour; "indah" or "cemerlang" would be more natural.
"pemijah berkelanjutan" is awkward for "continuous spawners"; consider "pemijah sepanjang waktu" or "memijah terus-menerus".
"kusam" is acceptable, but "kurang cerah" would read more naturally for "quite dull colours".

glossolepis-incisus.name: Rainbow merah
notes: Item 4: "western Papua New Guinea" translated as "bagian barat Papua Nugini". Lake Sentani is in Indonesian Papua, not Papua New Guinea, and item 2 says Indonesia. The translation copies the source's geographic error, which contradicts the other entries. Consider correcting it to "Papua" or flagging it.
Item 2: "far less colour" became "jauh lebih pucat" (much paler). This is a slight shift in meaning. Use "warnanya jauh lebih kurang mencolok" or "warnanya jauh kurang cerah".
Item 14: "Filter kecil bertenaga aerator" is awkward. Use "filter udara kecil" or "filter sponge dengan aerator".
Item 14: "air yang agak sadah dan basa" is acceptable, but "burayak" is a less common term for fry. "Anakan" or "larva" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 3: "seiring setiap sentimeter pertumbuhan ikan" is awkward. Use "seiring bertambahnya setiap sentimeter ukuran ikan".
Item 11: "lebih banyak lebih baik" is fine, but "ikan catfish" is redundant. Use "ikan lele-lelean (catfish)" or just "catfish".

Item 1: "Rainbow merah" is used for the red rainbowfish. The spelling "rainbow" is fine, but the sentence adds "dan keduanya relatif kurang mencolok", which restructures the source. The meaning is preserved, so this is minor.

glyptothorax-major.name: Glyptothorax major
notes: Item 1: "Berisiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is acceptable, but "pangkal ekor ... relatif tinggi" is fine; consider "tangkai ekor" as the more common hobby term for caudal peduncle.
Item 3: "Lele Sisoridae" is slightly odd; consider "Ikan lele sisorid" or keep "Sisoridae" as a family name without "Lele".
Item 3: "melawan arus kuat" reads a little awkwardly; "di tengah arus kuat" or "agar tidak terbawa arus kuat" is more natural.
Item 4: "mutlak diperlukan" is stronger than "necessary"; use "diperlukan" or "perlu".
Item 6: "pakan buatan" for "prepared foods" is acceptable, but "pakan olahan/pelet" may be closer to the source.

gnathonemus-petersii.name: Elephant Nose
notes: "saling keroyok, bahkan sampai ada yang mati" – "mob each other, even to death" is slightly softened; better "saling menyerang beramai-ramai, bahkan sampai mati". "keroyok" is colloquial.
"elephant nose" – the usual Indonesian hobby name is "ikan hidung gajah" (or "elephantnose"); consider using it.
"Padahal di alam" – "however" is better rendered as "Namun, di alam"; "padahal" implies contradiction/reproach and is slightly off.
"unik" for "bizarre" – "aneh" or "tidak biasa" is closer to the source.
"kawanan" and "bergerombol" for schools/schooling – "kawanan" is usually for land animals; "gerombolan" is more natural for fish shoals.

gymnarchus-niloticus.name: Aba Aba
notes: #5: "ditanam atau diberi pemberat" adds "ditanam" (planted), which the source doesn't say. Use "diberi pemberat dengan kuat" or "dikunci/ditahan dengan kokoh".
#3: "lahan basah" is a broad term for wetlands in general. For "marshes" use "paya" or "rawa-rawa".

#11: "Karena sirip punggungnya yang memanjang... padahal" in #1 and "pencinta ikan predator monster" in #11 are loose. "Tankbusting" means fish that outgrow and wreck tanks, so "ikan predator raksasa perusak akuarium" is closer.

gymnochanda-filamentosa.name: Gymnochanda filamentosa
notes: Item 1 and 11: "sulit dipelihara" is added; the English only says "delicate" (evidently delicate and recommended only to experienced aquarists). Remove "dan sulit dipelihara".
Item 5: "akuarium yang baru disiapkan" for "a new aquarium" is okay but slightly changes the meaning. The point is an uncycled, immature tank, so use "akuarium baru (belum matang/belum siklus)".

Item 9: "duri sirip" is kept for spines, but the filaments are elsewhere called "jari-jari" (rays). Keep "duri/jari-jari" consistent with the source. "seperti benang" is added to "filamen" and is redundant.
Item 11: "Betina tidak berpigmen (bening)" for "colourless" is a slight over-interpretation. Use "tidak berwarna".
Item 7: "kutu air (Daphnia)" is acceptable, but "kutu air" also names other organisms. Consider "Daphnia/kutu air" or the hobby term "cacing sutra/kutu air" as appropriate.
Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 54 liter" is fine but the volume figure was left out of context. The 60×30 cm base needs the height assumed, so keep this as in the source.

gymnochanda-ploegi.name: Gymnochanda ploegi
notes: Item 8: "ikan kuhli" is loosely phrased for "Kuhli loaches"; use "ikan kuhli (Kuhli loach)" or "lundu/loach kuhli".
Item 7: "kutu air" for daphnia is okay but "daphnia" is more precise; consider "daphnia (kutu air)".
Item 1: "ikan kaca (glass perch)" is fine, but "SL" is left unexplained in the sentence; write "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 7: "mungkin mau menerima" is slightly clumsy; use "dapat mau memakan".

gymnocorymbus-ternetzi.name: Black Widow
notes: #8: 'manfish' is wrong for 'angel fish'; use 'angelfish' (atau 'ikan manfish' hanya jika dikenal) — better 'angelfish/skalar'.
#4: '20g long' dropped; '(sekitar 70 liter)' fine, but 'standar' ok. Minor: ensure 70 L retained as stated (it is).
#1/#11: 'ikan karasin (Characidae)' – 'karasin' is non-standard for hobbyists; use 'characid' or 'famili Characidae'.
#11: 'cukup 'black tetra'' is awkward for 'simply black tetra'; use 'atau sekadar 'black tetra''.
#11: 'nama dagang' for 'common names' should be 'nama umum'.
#5: 'Cukup tidak rewel soal dekorasi' is awkward; use 'Tidak terlalu rewel soal dekorasi'.
#7: 'pelet butiran' adds 'pelet'; source says granules – use 'granul'. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok, but 'Daphnia' commonly used.
#10: 'java moss' and 'spawning mop (media pemijahan dari benang)' adds explanation; acceptable but 'lumut jawa' is the local term.
#10: 'Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu' fine; 'indukan harus segera dipindahkan' ok. 'burayak' is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
#3: 'kali' redundant with 'anak sungai'; 'creeks' ok but streamline.

gymnothorax-tile.name: Freshwater Moray
notes: "kerabatnya, G. polyuranodon" is vague for "congener"; say "satu genus" (e.g. "spesies segenus, G. polyuranodon").
"piscivora" is jargon; "pemakan ikan" alone (or "karnivora pemakan ikan") reads more naturally.
"Moray" is left untranslated; the common Indonesian "belut moa" or "mura" could be added once, e.g. "belut moray".

gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.name: Chinese Algae Eater
notes: Item 1: "Umurnya bisa lebih dari 15 tahun, dan sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk akuarium komunitas" – the subject is ambiguous; better "ikan ini sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk..." or "kurang cocok untuk...".
Item 3: "kerikil kecil, kerikil" for "pebbles, gravel" is a little repetitive; consider "kerikil besar/koral, kerikil".

hampala-bimaculata.name: Hampala
notes: "500 mm SL": "SL" (standard length) is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" and perhaps cm (50 cm).
"cyprinid": could use "ikan suku Cyprinidae", which is more natural.

"hidup di tempat yang sama" for sympatric is fine, but "biasanya mengalir melewati hutan tropis" is ambiguous: the subject is the river, not the fish. Rephrase as "sungai yang biasanya melewati hutan tropis".
"Terutama ikan sungai": "Predominantly" is better rendered as "Umumnya".
"bimaculata... Sarawak": the "bibiography" typo in the reference list is left as in the source, which is acceptable.

hampala-dispar.name: Spotted Hampala Barb
notes: Item 1: 'Needs a tank at least 2 m long' vs 'Aquarium size: 240 × 60 cm' is fine, but the ID 'Butuh arus kuat, dengan filter yang memutar air akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' is OK; no issue. Main problem is in item 8: 'ikan teri (whitebait)' is wrong; teri are anchovies, whitebait are juvenile herring/sprats. Use 'ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)'.
Item 8: 'ikan mas koki kecil' for 'small goldfish' is acceptable, but 'pack-style behaviour' became 'kawanan pemburu', which adds 'hunting'. Use 'perilaku berkelompok seperti kawanan'.

Item 8: 'Hampala spp. ... dalam jumlah lebih sedikit' in item 12 changes meaning: 'to a lesser extent, H. dispar' means H. dispar is seen less often, so it is OK; but item 8 'ditambah sebagian ikan kecil' is fine.
Item 12: 'di Kalimantan' placed after 'Malaysia' is garbled. Say 'negara bagian Sarawak di Kalimantan, Malaysia'.
Item 12: 'bentuk H. bimaculata ... sebaiknya dianggap berbeda' loses the 'ought to be considered distinct [species]' nuance. Say 'dianggap sebagai spesies tersendiri'.
Item 12: 'pada dua spesies lainnya terletak di bawah pangkal awal sirip punggung' is slightly redundant. Use 'di bawah pangkal sirip punggung'.

Item 5: the '~864 litres' volume is correct, but 'Spesies aktif yang hidup di kolom air terbuka (pelagis)' is a loose rendering of 'pelagic'. Use 'ikan pelagis aktif yang berenang di kolom air tengah-atas'.
Item 9: 'shoaling (berkumpul longgar)' and 'schooling (berenang serempak)' are acceptable, but 'ikan yang kalah dominan' is awkward. Use 'ikan subdominan'.
Item 6: 'setup' and 'mudah kaget' are fine, but 'skittish' as 'cukup mudah kaget' is OK; 'substrat batu dan kerikil berbagai ukuran' is fine. Item 1: the 'SL 35 cm' conversion is right.

hampala-macrolepidota.name: Hampal
notes: Item 2: "Needs a tank at least 2 m long" is fine, but item 3 'Needs a tight-fitting lid...' ok; main issue: item 15 "tidak semestinya dianggap sebagai ikan akuarium kecuali dalam kondisi yang sangat ekstrem" is acceptable, but "Salah satu pengecualian yang langka" (item 1) shifts meaning: 'rare exceptions' = pengecualian yang jarang, fine; no change needed.

Item 15: "di bawah pangkal awal sirip punggung" for "below the dorsal fin origin" is fine, but "H. dispar ... kurang tegas" ok; real issue: 'Hampala spp.' left in English style, use 'spesies Hampala'.
Item 12: "ikan catfish (ikan berkumis)" is redundant; use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish". Also "loach botiid" mixes terms; use "loach famili Botiidae".

Item 12: "shoaling ... schooling" rendered as "hidup berkelompok longgar ... berenang serempak" is acceptable, but "mudah gugup" for 'rather nervously' and "kalah dominan" for 'subdominant' are awkward; use "ikan yang berstatus lebih rendah".

Item 10: "ikan teri kecil (whitebait)" – whitebait is not teri exactly; use "ikan kecil utuh (whitebait)". Also 'feeder fish' translated as "pakan hidup" loses the 'feeder fish' meaning; use "ikan umpan/feeder".

Item 11: "sangat damai terhadap" – use "sangat damai terhadap" fine; 'schooling fish' as "hidup bergerombol" conflicts with item 12 where the species is explicitly shoaling, not schooling; use consistent term.
Item 3/7: 'cyprinid', 'characid' left as English; prefer "ikan Cyprinidae", "Characidae".
Item 15: "H. macrolepidota ... sisik gurat sisi" numeric ranges use hyphen while elsewhere en dash; minor consistency.

hampala-salweenensis.name: Hampala Salween
notes: Item 8: "ikan yang rewel makan" is fine, but "Hampala ... disarankan sebagai teman satu akuarium" changes the subject: the original says the fish is recommended as a tankmate for fussy/new fishes, which is kept, but "segerombolan" for "a shoal" is fine. The real error is "feeder" fish: "ikan mas koki kecil" is OK. Check "pakan hidup (feeder)": feeder fish are live fish, so say "ikan umpan (feeder fish)" rather than "pakan hidup", which wrongly suggests all live foods.
Item 6: the sentence "Ikan ini juga paling baik dipelihara ... " is fine. "mudah kaget" for skittish is okay, but "cabang kayu (driftwood)" should be "kayu apung/kayu rendam" or just driftwood.
Item 12: "dilewati gurat sisi" is awkward for "passing through lateral line"; use "tepat pada gurat sisi" or "menutupi gurat sisi".
Item 12: "ikan lele/catfish" and "Cyprinid, characid" are left as English-style terms; use "ikan lele" and consider "ikan karpet (cyprinid)" only if needed.
Item 12: "di Kalimantan (Borneo)" is awkward; Sarawak is in northern Borneo (Kalimantan is Indonesian), so write "di Pulau Borneo".
Item 12: "tanda di tubuh cenderung memudar pada ikan yang sangat besar pada semua Hampala spp." has double "pada"; rephrase.
Item 1: the "201 mm SL" figure is unchanged, which is correct, but SL is not explained anywhere; consider "panjang standar".
Item 3: the type locality is left in English with a translation in brackets, which is acceptable; "anak Sungai" is fine.

hasemania-nana.name: Silver tip tetra
notes: Item 1: 'All the fish in the trade are captive bred and unfussy... and it is sometimes sold as copper tetra' – fine, but 'sedikit genus characid' ok; no major issue.
Item 14: 'angel fish' translated as 'manfish' – wrong; use 'angelfish' / 'ikan manfish' is a different name (Indonesian hobbyists say 'manfish' for angelfish, acceptable) – minor.
Item 7: '208-litre tank' vs 20 fish and 75 L: fine. 'Keeping only a few may lead them to nip' translated OK.
Item 6: '~68 liter' kept; OK. Imperial dropped correctly.
Item 16: 'translucent' → 'transparan' and 'deepen into' → 'pekat' slightly off; use 'tembus cahaya' and 'semakin pekat'.
Item 8: 'daun ek dan beech' – 'beech' left untranslated; use 'daun ek dan bukit (beech)' or 'beech (Fagus)'. Also 'setup' is informal; use 'penataan'.
Item 15: 'Kelompok yang cukup besar akan mengikuti jari' fine; 'kribensis' ok.
Item 17: 'burayak' used for fry mostly, but 'Anakan' for young mixed; 'tanaman lebat' omits 'foliage' nuance—minor. 'kualitas air tetap tinggi' → 'tetap baik'.
Item 5: 'white water (air keruh keputihan)' explanation added; 'Kabarnya' ok but explanation is an added gloss—minor.
Item 2: 'peternakan ikan' for fish farms → 'penangkaran/budidaya ikan' more natural.

helostoma-temminckii.name: Tambakan
notes: Item 1: 'Tambakan atau kissing gourami' — adds a local name that is not in the source; also 'famili Helostomatidae' is added. 'Tambakan' is the established local name, but the added family name is not in this sentence.
Item 1: 'Bentuk putih kemerahan' for 'pinkish-white' is okay, but item 11 then says 'Bentuk pink' — use one term consistently.
Item 8: 'ikan lele/catfish' — the source says 'catfishes' (a broad group), and 'lele' is a specific catfish; use 'ikan berkumis/catfish' or just 'catfish'.

Item 5: 'Pencahayaan relatif tidak penting ... lumut/alga jangan dibasmi' — acceptable, but 'mengambil udara dari permukaan' is fine. 'saluran keluar' for 'outflows' is slightly clumsy. 'merumput biofilm' is odd; use 'memakan/menggerus biofilm'.
Item 7: 'Bibirnya yang tebal' — the source says 'fleshy lips'; 'berdaging' is closer. 'mengecap' for 'mouthing' is unnatural; use 'membuka-tutup mulut'.
Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' — fine, but 'Tapis insang' / 'lengkung insang' are not clearly rendered as 'gill rakers' and 'gill arches' to hobbyists.

hemibagrus-planiceps.name: Baung
notes: Item 6: "kelompok spesies dugaan" is awkward for "putative species groups"; use "kelompok spesies yang diduga/belum dipastikan".
Item 6: "sangat pipih" for "strongly-depressed head" could be clearer, e.g. "sangat pipih dorsoventral (gepeng dari atas ke bawah)".
Item 6: "Anggota kelompok ini yang saat ini diakui sah" is slightly wordy; "Anggota yang saat ini valid" is more natural.
Item 2: 'Java, Indonesia' is left in English because it is a quoted type-locality label; this is acceptable, but consider adding "Jawa, Indonesia" in brackets.

hemibagrus-wyckii.name: Crystal Eye Catfish
notes: Item 1: "mata birunya tidak disebut ... dalam diagnosis mana pun yang pernah ditemukan" is awkward and slightly changes the source ("seen" = consulted). Better: "dalam diagnosis mana pun yang dirujuk".
Item 4: "710 mm SL" is not converted or rounded to cm (about 71 cm SL). The imperial figure was dropped, which is fine. Consider "71 cm SL" and the Indonesian "panjang standar (SL)".
Item 1/10: "Anakannya" is non-standard. Use "Anakan ikan ini" or "Ikan muda".
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is a poor term. Hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendam".

Item 7: "cacing sutra" for Tubifex is fine. "daging mamalia seperti jantung sapi atau ayam" is wrong, because chicken is not a mammal. This follows the source, but clarify with "daging unggas" or "daging ayam".
Item 10: "Hemibagrus ... Etimologi" is fine. "kerabat segenus" is awkward. Use "spesies sekerabat dalam genus yang sama" or "anggota genus lain".
Item 10: "posttemporal", "interneural" and "mesetmoid" are left untranslated or misspelled. "mesetmoid" should be "mesetmoid/mesethmoid", and "sirip dada" for pectoral fin is fine.
Item 3: "hutan yang tergenang banjir" is OK. "musim hujan" for wet season is fine.

hemigrammus-bleheri.name: Rummy Nose Tetra
notes: Item 12: "Tulang frontal kiri dan kanan saling bersentuhan" adds "kiri dan kanan", which is not in the source ("Contact between frontals").

Item 12: "17 atau lebih sedikit jari-jari sirip anal bercabang" is fine, but "tepi posterodorsal ... tidak bersentuhan (berjarak)" reads awkwardly and the source is unclear. Check this against the source.
Item 12: "warna merahnya melewati tutup insang" is OK. However, "lobus sirip ekor yang dipisahkan oleh pita berwarna putih" is ambiguous. Specify that the bars are separated by white bands.
Item 12: "tidak dapat dideklinasikan" is a stiff, unnatural literal rendering. Use "tidak mengalami perubahan bentuk (indeclinable)".
Item 4: "kelompok 10 ekor, lebih baik lagi kalau lebih banyak" is fine. "Karena sifatnya yang aktif berenang" is acceptable.
Item 8: "Anabantoid" and "Loricariidae kecil" are inconsistent. Use "anabantid/labirin" and "loricariid kecil".
Item 10: "sekitar enam ekor dari masing-masing jenis kelamin" is OK. "Dengan jumlah yang baik" is awkward.
Item 11: "Uniknya" adds emphasis not in the source. "Precisely in a tetra" is rendered loosely.

hemigrammus-erythrozonus.name: Glowlight Tetra
notes: "sejauh ini hanya diketahui" (items 1 and 2) adds a hedge the English doesn't have. Use "hanya diketahui dari".
"manfish" for angel fish is acceptable. "angelfish" is the more common hobby spelling and could be added in brackets.
"ternakan massal" and "hasil ternakan" read slightly stiff. "hasil penangkaran massal" is more natural.

hemirhamphodon-phaiosoma.name: Hemirhamphodon phaiosoma
notes: Item 1: "betinanya tetap lebih kecil" – "tetap" is slightly off for "stay smaller"; "betinanya tetap berukuran lebih kecil" or "betina lebih kecil" is more natural.
Item 2: "ikan julung-julung" is fine, but "blackwater (air hitam)" is slightly redundant; acceptable but could use "perairan air hitam (blackwater)".

hemirhamphodon-pogonognathus.name: Julung-julung
notes: Item 5: "teman setanknya tidak boleh terlalu kasar" – "setank" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain dalam akuarium yang sama". "robust" is better rendered "terlalu bongsor/agresif/aktif" than "kasar".
Item 5: "Sesama jantan bisa cukup sering berkelahi" adds "sering" (frequency); the source says quite quarrelsome, so use "cukup suka berkelahi".

Item 2: "tidak tahan pengiriman" is stiff; use "tidak tahan terhadap pengangkutan/transportasi". "kondisi ... hampir tidak mendukung kehidupan" is fine but "miskin" for food supply could be "minim nutrisi".
Item 2: "aklimatisasi" is good, but "Terutama, ikan ini..." is awkward; use "Ikan ini terutama tidak tahan...".
Item 4: "dimakan dengan lahap" slightly strengthens "with pleasure"; "dimakan dengan senang hati/mau memakan" would be closer.

hemisilurus-heterorhynchus.name: Hemisilurus heterorhynchus
notes: Item 1: 'SL (panjang standar)' is acceptable; no issue.
Item 6: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is fine, but the official Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Risiko Rendah'; minor.
Item 4: 'bertubuh lebih tinggi' for 'deeper bodied' is slightly awkward; use 'tubuh lebih tinggi/membulat' or 'bertubuh lebih tebal'.
Item 5: 'Belum ada laporan. Belum ada catatan pemijahannya.' is repetitive; fine in meaning but could be merged, e.g. 'Belum dilaporkan; belum ada catatan pemijahan.'

hemisilurus-moolenburghi.name: Lais
notes: Item 1: "Maximum size: 500 mm (19.7 in) SL" – the conversion is fine, but "panjang standar" was added in brackets; this is acceptable, so check only that the abbreviation is used consistently.

Item 8: "Seperti ketiga spesies dalam genus ini" – the English says "all three species in this genus", which includes this species. Better: "Seperti ketiga spesies dalam genus ini" is slightly ambiguous; use "Seperti semua (ketiga) spesies dalam genus ini".
Item 8: "penggundulan hutan" is acceptable, but "deforestasi" or "pembukaan hutan" is more common in technical text.
Item 8: "para penulis deskripsinya" – the English says "the authors"; "para penulis (yang mendeskripsikan spesies)" is clearer, and "presumably" should be "diduga" rather than "kemungkinan".
Item 5: "tutup insang" for opercle is fine, but "bertubuh lebih tinggi" for "deeper bodied" could be "berbadan lebih tinggi/bongsor"; minor.
Item 9: the reference title is left untranslated, which is fine.

herichthys-carpintis.name: Green Texas
notes: Item 4: in "P 120 cm × T 45 cm × L 37,5 cm", "L" for lebar is easy to confuse with L for litre. Consider writing "Lebar" in full or using "P × L × T" with the words spelled out.
Item 10: "telur/larva" adds a word that is not in the source (it says only "they"). Use "telur" alone.

heros-severus.name: Severum
notes: "agak sadah" for "medium hard": use "sadah sedang" (or "kesadahan sedang"); "agak sadah" slightly shifts the meaning.
"Hal ini terutama karena perilaku berkembang biaknya": "berkembang biak" is awkward. Use "perilaku pemijahannya" or "cara berbiaknya".
"mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbreeding)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram mulut". Also, "bertelur di substrat" is vague; "memijah di substrat (substrate breeder)" is better.
"Amazon, Orinoco": add "Sungai" or "DAS" (e.g., "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Orinoco") so the reader knows these are river systems.
"warnanya mungkin jadi memudar": "jadi" is colloquial; use "menjadi" in the formal handbook register.
"Ikan juga bisa lebih rentan" and "tanda-tanda kondisi yang menurun": stiff and vague. Use "tanda-tanda penurunan kondisi" or "kesehatannya menurun".
"Pakan nabati perlu ditambahkan": the source says "vegetarian components". "Komponen nabati" or "pakan berbahan nabati" is closer. "pelet stik" for "sticks" is fine, but "stik" alone is enough.

homaloptera-orthogoniata.name: Saddleback Loach
notes: Item 5: "~108 liter" from a 120×30 cm tank is kept as-is, but the English gives litres, so no conversion issue; fine. Real issue is elsewhere.
Item 12: "sirip dubur" for anal fin and "sirip perut" for pelvic fin are fine, but "isthmus" is left untranslated; use "tenggorokan/isthmus" or a proper Indonesian term.
Item 12: "corak ... permukaan punggung selalu dengan 3 corak besar" is awkward; rephrase as "permukaan punggung selalu memiliki 3 corak besar".

Item 6: "batu dan koral sungai yang halus terkikis air" - "pebbles" is mistranslated as "koral" (coral); use "kerikil bulat/batu kali" instead. This could mislead the reader into thinking coral is added to a freshwater tank.

Item 6: "Anubias sangat berguna" - the English says "The latter" (Anubias), which is fine, but "filter berkapasitas lebih besar dari ukuran akuarium" for "over-sized filter" is wordy; use "filter berkapasitas besar".
Item 8: "merumput biofilm" is awkward for "grazers feeding on biofilm"; use "pemakan biofilm yang merumput/pengerik".

Item 9: "ikan lele dari genus Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp." mixes "genus" with "spp."; drop "spp.". "berbaris berdekatan" for "arrange themselves close to one another" is slightly off; use "berkumpul berdekatan".

Item 2: "endemik Kalimantan (Borneo), yang diketahui berasal dari sungai-sungai di Sarawak dan Kalimantan" is ambiguous because Kalimantan is used for both the island and the Indonesian part; use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo)" as in item 3.

homaloptera-parclitella.name: Lizard Loach
notes: Item 3: 'Jadi spesies yang layak dipelihara' for 'recommendable species' is awkward; also the 'we were able' import claim is rendered passively, which is acceptable, but 'Loach cantik ini mutlak' is fine. Main issue is only minor wording.
Item 12: 'pertarungan pamer' for 'comment fights' (Komment fights, ritualised display fights) is unnatural; use 'perkelahian ritual/adu pamer' with a clearer explanation.
Item 9: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' → 'batu dan kerikil bulat berbagai ukuran yang terkikis arus'.
Item 9: 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)' is a German term left in place in items 9 and 11; use 'aufwuchs' with a gloss consistently, or 'lapisan alga/biofilm'.
Item 9: 'Turnover ... 10–15 times' conflicts with item 2 (8–12) in the source itself; this is not a translation error, but 'jadi bila perlu' adds a slightly different logic to 'so ... as necessary'.
Item 16: the translation is missing entirely (left out). The stock code and wholesale note were dropped; if the shop talk is intentionally dropped this is fine, but confirm it.
Item 13: 'lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp.' calls the catfishes 'lele', which usually means Clarias; use 'ikan lele-lelean' or 'catfish'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'merumput biofilm' is awkward; use 'memakan biofilm dengan cara merumput'.

homalopteroides-nebulosus.name: Homalopteroides nebulosus
notes: Item 3: the English says 'H. nebulosa' and the translation writes 'H. nebulosus'. That quietly changes a Latin name, so keep it as in the source or flag it as the name used there.

Item 2: 'negara bagian Kelantan' and 'negara bagian Terengganu' are fine, but 'wilayah Kalimantan bagian Malaysia' is wrong. Kalimantan is the Indonesian part of Borneo, so the Malaysian part should be called 'Borneo bagian Malaysia'. Say 'Borneo' for the island, e.g. 'Borneo bagian Malaysia maupun Indonesia'.

Items 1 and 5: 'menyaring volume akuarium 8–12 kali per jam' and the 10–15 version are acceptable, but 'turning the tank over' is rendered inconsistently with the 'Turnover' wording. Also, item 1 says 'tercatat di Kalimantan' where the English says Borneo, so change it to 'Borneo'.
Item 5: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air' is awkward. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat karena terkikis arus'.
Item 5: the English says 'oxygenated' and the translation says 'kaya oksigen'. 'Kaya oksigen' is acceptable, but 'beroksigen baik' is closer to 'well-oxygenated'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but hobbyists commonly write 'daphnia'. 'Ikan dari famili Balitoridae' is fine, though the English 'Balitorids' is more generic.
Item 11: 'Homalopteroides ... sungut rostral' and 'bantalan dagu (mental pad)' are acceptable. 'Genus ... divalidasi ulang' is stiff, so use 'diakui kembali sebagai genus yang sah'.

homalopteroides-stephensoni.name: Homalopteroides stephensoni
notes: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use something like "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis arus", or "batu kali yang membulat".
"gobi" is not the usual hobby spelling. Use "goby".

homalopteroides-tweediei.name: Gecko Loach
notes: Item 5: "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but item 2 omits nothing; however item 6 "filter yang kapasitasnya berlebih" fine. Real problem: item 6 "jangan pernah dimasukkan ke akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is OK; but item 6 turnover "10–15 kali per jam" differs from item 2 "8–12 kali per jam" (source inconsistency, check consistency).
Item 12: "sangat bersahabat" for "very thankful" (dankbar = tolerant/undemanding) is a mistranslation; use "tahan banting" / "mudah beradaptasi dan tidak rewel".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat terkikis air" (water-worn).

Item 6: "Anubias sangat berguna" - source says 'the latter' (Anubias/ the plants generally); acceptable but "Anubias spp." should be consistent. Also "Microsorum, Crinum, dan Anubias spp." mixes genus/spp.
Item 1: "Homaloptera tweediei" and "gecko loach" left untranslated; consider "loach gecko" and note the name differs from Homalopteroides in item 2.
Item 8: "predator mikro" for micropredators is OK, but "kutu air" for Daphnia is usually "kutu air (Daphnia)"; "cacing darah" fine. "pakan kering yang tenggelam" better "pakan kering tenggelam".
Item 9: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax..." fine; "teman setangki" better "penghuni akuarium lain / tankmate".

homalopterula-ripleyi.name: Homalopterula ripleyi
notes: "batu dan koral sungai yang halus terkikis air": "koral" suggests coral and the phrasing is clumsy. Use "batu dan kerikil bulat sungai (water-worn) berbagai ukuran".
"lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis": these hillstream catfishes are not usually called "lele". Use "ikan lele (catfish)" or "catfish" with the genus names.
"perumput spesialis" for "specialised grazers" is awkward. Use "pemakan lumut/biofilm yang menggerogoti permukaan (grazer)".
"hillstream loach" is left in English in item 1 with no gloss. Add a local term such as "loach sungai berarus deras".

hyalobagrus-flavus.name: Shadow Catfish
notes: Item 4: "Volume: ~41 liter (45 × 30 × 30 cm)" is fine as the source gives metric, but "Ukuran dasar akuarium" is slightly awkward; consider "Ukuran alas akuarium".
Item 3: "Ini adalah spesies sungai" is stiff; "Spesies ini hidup di sungai" is more natural.
Item 8: "teman setangki" is non-standard; hobbyists more often say "tankmate" or "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama".
Item 1/11: "catfish" is left in English throughout; consider "ikan lele/baung" or "(catfish)" after the local term on first use.
Item 11: "(dan masih diimpor)" is fine, but "dimasukkan ke dalam genus baru ... dan diketahui" is slightly stiff; "sempat" in "sempat dianggap" adds a nuance not in the source.

hypergastromyzon-humilis.name: Hypergastromyzon humilis
notes: Item 9: "cukup rapuh" for "quite delicate" is a literal rendering. "sensitif" or "mudah stres" is more natural for a fish's care needs.
Item 6: "aufwuchs" is left as a German term with no gloss. Use "aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)" or "lapisan biofilm/alga" so hobbyists understand it.
Item 8: "masalah kesehatan internal/pencernaan" uses an awkward slash. "masalah pencernaan/organ dalam" would read better.
Item 10: "bertubuh lebih besar dan berat" overstates "heavy-framed". "berperawakan lebih kekar" is closer.
Item 8: "alga rhodophyta 'black brush'" is clumsy. Use "alga merah (rhodophyta) jenis 'black brush' (BBA)".

hyphessobrycon-amandae.name: Ember Tetra
notes: "Mudah diberi makan; mau menerima pelet" is slightly stiff; more natural: "Mudah diberi pakan; mau makan pelet."
"Paling baik dipelihara" is slightly awkward; "Sebaiknya dipelihara" is more natural.
"cukup sadah" is non-standard for "moderately hard"; use "agak sadah" or "sedang".

hyphessobrycon-eques.name: Serpae Tetra
notes: Item 11: "Disarankan kelompok 12–15 ekor ... tanpa spesies lain penghuni lapisan air atas" is fine, but "mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik, tetapi pilihan lain yang mungkin termasuk" is clumsy and repeats "mungkin". Rephrase, e.g. "barangkali pilihan terbaik, sedangkan opsi lain meliputi...".
Item 11: "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor sebaiknya dianggap sebagai syarat minimum" is redundant. Use "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor dianggap sebagai syarat minimum".
Item 11: "ikan rainbow" should be "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)", the usual hobby term.
Item 11: "ikan beranak (livebearer)" is acceptable, but "lele callichthyid atau loricariid" should be clearer, e.g. "lele/ikan sapu-sapu" for loricariid.
Item 14: "Bagaimanapun, ikan ini memang indah" renders "after all" poorly. "Bagaimanapun" means "anyway/however". Use "Lagi pula, ikan ini memang indah".
Item 14: "warna merah bening seperti kristal" and "merah tembus pandang" are fine, but "Brillant" is kept with the German spelling. This is a trade name, so it is fine.
Item 10: "saling merusak sirip" loses the sense of ruffling/nipping. Use "saling menggigiti sirip".
Item 13: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" should be "filter spons berpenggerak udara". "pengasuhan induk" should be "tidak menjaga anakan".
Item 2: "Varian hias hasil penangkaran" says "captive-bred", but the source says "ornamental strains". Use "galur hias" to match item 15.
Item 7: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu krusial, meskipun warnanya cenderung..." leaves the subject unclear (the fish). Say "ikan ini cenderung menampilkan warna lebih bagus".

hyphessobrycon-flammeus.name: Flame Tetra
notes: Item 11: "volume sekitar 54 liter" — the figure is given in the source, so fine, but item 8 etc. OK; main issue is elsewhere.

Item 9: "paling banyak hanya tersisa segelintir populasi" — "at best" means at most/at best; acceptable, but "Hanya terdapat di... sebarannya saat ini agak belum pasti" is awkward; use "masih belum jelas".

Item 18: "Penulis lain mengajukan pandangan yang saling bertentangan dan biasanya lebih sempit" is stiff; "monofilinya" and "Hyphessobrycon adalah garis keturunan polifiletik" are awkward, use "kelompok polifiletik".
Item 18: "Hyphessobrycon diajukan oleh Durbin ... sebagai subgenus" is awkward; use "diusulkan"/"dinyatakan".

Item 6: "Hyphessobrycon flammeus yang dipelihara sendirian atau berpasangan" — "jenis kelamin" fine; but item 15 "Usahakan membeli kelompok campuran" fine; item 2 "Sudah puluhan tahun tidak ada impor dari alam" is OK.

Item 14: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" — Daphnia/Moina are not exactly "kutu air" in the source sense; "larva chironomid (cacing darah) hidup maupun beku" fine. Keep Daphnia, Moina as written; "kutu air" is an addition.
Item 12: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting" lacks the sense of "not especially critical"; "daun kering" omits "leaf litter" (serasah daun).

hyphessobrycon-herbertaxelrodi.name: Black Neon Tetra
notes: Item 7: 'Volume: sekitar 72 liter' is fine, but item 4: 'Sungai Sepotuba bermuara ... 500 kilometer di hulu Taquari' keeps the source typo-free; however 'Lokasi tipenya ada di daerah aliran sungai hulu rio Taquari' is OK. Real issue below.

Item 19: 'Lima et al. (2014)' — the English says 'Lima et al.'; fine, but 'tinggi badan kurang dari 3,6 kali dalam SL' is awkward; use 'tinggi badan kurang dari 1/3,6 SL' or 'SL lebih dari 3,6 kali tinggi badan'.
