rasbora-elegans.name: Rasbora elegans
notes: Item 4: '~243 litres' for 120 × 45 × 45 cm is correct (243 L), fine. Item 10: '120 × 30 × 30 cm (113 litres)' is wrong; the actual volume is 108 L, so correct the figure. The English figure of 113 is itself questionable, but the translation should note this.
Item 1/4/8/10: 'bisa bersikap gelisah' is unnatural. Use 'mudah gugup/stres' or 'menjadi tegang'.
Item 10: 'rapat tanamannya' is awkward. Use 'ditanami lebat'.
Item 10: 'Filter internal bertenaga' for 'internal power filter' is awkward. Use 'filter internal (power filter)'.
Item 10: 'telur betina habis' is awkward. Use 'betina kehabisan telur'.
Item 10: 'sedikit air yang lebih dingin' loses 'cool'. Fine, but 'sehingga wadah perlahan-lahan terisi penuh' is okay.
Item 7: 'pakan serpihan dan pelet butiran kering' is redundant for 'dried flakes and granules'. Use 'flake dan granul kering'.
Item 5: 'Java fern' and 'Java moss' are left in English without Indonesian equivalents. Add 'pakis java' and 'lumut java'.
Item 11: 'Kepekatan tanda' is an awkward choice for 'intensity'. Use 'Intensitas/ketajaman tanda'.
Item 1: 'adalah ikan cyprinid' is fine, but 'jago melompat' is colloquial for a handbook.

rasbora-kalochroma.name: Clown Rasbora
notes: Item 7: "kayu common beech (Fagus sylvatica)" adds a Latin name that is not in the source. Remove it, or use "kayu beech" only.
Item 7: "setup" and "common beech" are left in English. Consider "penataan" and "kayu beech".

rasbora-patrickyapi.name: Rasbora patrickyapi
notes: Item 3: "pH air di rawa gambut sangat rendah" is fine, but the English says only "The pH"; this is acceptable, no change needed beyond optionally "Nilai pH".
Item 4: "jumlah bakteri dalam air harus ditekan" is a bit loose for "bacterial pressure"; consider "tekanan bakteri (kepadatan bakteri) serendah mungkin".

rasbora-sarawakensis.name: Rasbora sarawakensis
notes: Item 13: "45 × 20 × 20 cm (29,5 liter)" – the English figure is 29.5 L for a half-filled container? Volume 45×20×20 = 18 L; the original figure is inconsistent, but the translation keeps it unchanged. Consider checking it.

Item 13: "The adults ... are best removed after a couple of days" became "jadi sebaiknya dipindahkan setelah beberapa hari" – 'a couple of days' is closer to 'beberapa hari' but 'dua hari' is more faithful; also the 'jadi' adds a causal link not in the source.
Item 13: "diisi air setengahnya" is slightly awkward; use "diisi setengah penuh dengan air".
Item 13: "Pemijahan bisa dipicu...sehingga akuarium perlahan-lahan terisi penuh" – 'topped up' is a gradual refill to the original level, not necessarily 'penuh'; use "terisi kembali".
Item 1: "sangat kaya spesies" is fine, but "Ikan ini cantik, hidup bergerombol" – 'completely undemanding' rendered as "tidak rewel" is OK; no real issue.

Item 7: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat" – 'tends to hail from' is fine; but "akar atau cabang kayu (driftwood)" fine. 'diffuse the light' translated as "meredam cahaya"; "menyebarkan/menyaring cahaya" would be more exact.
Item 11: "Trichogaster trichopterus" – the Latin name is retained, good; "Rasbora lain yang ukurannya serupa" leaves Rasbora/Puntius in capital genus form, fine.
Item 9: "seperti anggota genus lain yang serupa" is ambiguous; use "seperti anggota genus ini lainnya yang mirip".

rasbora-tornieri.name: Yellowtail rasbora
notes: Item 1: "Di kondisi mana pun, penutup yang rapat..." has no preceding context in the ID and repeats the lid sentence. It follows the EN, but "In either situation" refers to nothing. This is an awkward duplicate; fix or drop the redundancy.

Item 3: "anak sungai yang tenang (backwater)" mistranslates backwaters. Backwaters are genangan/perairan tepi yang tenang, not tributaries (anak sungai). Use "perairan tepi/rawa banjiran yang tenang".

Item 11: "batang ekor yang lebih tinggi" is ambiguous. Deeper caudal peduncle means "batang ekor yang lebih tinggi/tebal", so this is acceptable, but "fitting 7.9-8.8 times in SL" is stiff: "7,9–8,8 kali dalam SL" should read "7,9–8,8 kali panjang standar".

Item 11: "Menurut pengertian saat ini, spesies ini terdapat di Jawa" - "As currently recognised it occurs" refers to R. argyrotaenia. Make the subject explicit as "R. argyrotaenia" to avoid confusion with R. tornieri.
Item 11: "Klad" is the clade term; it is fine but "clade" in brackets would help hobbyists. "monofili" and "genus baru" are fine.
Item 3: "kolam" for "pools" is OK, but "khas berwarna cokelat" reads awkwardly. Rephrase as "biasanya berwarna cokelat".
Item 4: "luas permukaan minimal 120 × 30 cm" - OK. Item 10: "burayak" is regional (Malay); "anakan" or "larva/benih" is more common among Indonesian hobbyists. "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable.

rasbora-trilineata.name: Rasbora ekor gunting
notes: #9: "ikan cyprinid lain" adds "lain" (other), which the English does not have. Use "cyprinid" or "ikan cyprinid" only.
#11: "setelah dua hari" turns "a couple of days" into an exact number. "beberapa hari" or "sekitar dua hari" is closer.

rasbora-vulcanus.name: Rasbora Vulcanus
notes: "biologically immature tank" → "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" adds a specific claim (nitrogen cycle) not in the English; use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis" (or "belum matang" only).
"Dissolved 'filter listrik'" for "power filter": use the term hobbyists use, e.g. "filter eksternal/power filter" or "filter hang-on"; "filter listrik" is unnatural.
"setengah" water fill: "half-filled with water" is fine, but "Rasbora ... lele/catfish": "lele" is a different fish (Clarias); use "ikan lele-lelean/catfish" or just "catfish".
"Pemijahan ... telur betina habis" and "burayak": "burayak" is a Malay term; Indonesian hobbyists use "burayak" less often, so prefer "anakan" or "larva ikan".

"Saat itu" ... "Induk akan memakan telur apa pun": fine; but "hanya itu informasi yang tersedia" in #5 omits nothing. In #1, "anterior centers of the scales" → "bagian tengah depan sisik" is ambiguous; use "bagian tengah sisik yang menghadap ke depan (anterior)".

"sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine; but "predator mikro" for "micropredator" is acceptable. Fix #1: "Nama spesiesnya yang 'panas'" – the English refers to the species epithet "vulcanus", so say "nama spesiesnya (vulcanus) yang 'panas'".

#14 "dimasukkan oleh Liao et al. ke dalam spesies yang belum terklasifikasi, yang mungkin bukan Rasbora": "possibly not Rasboras" is plural/general; render as "kelompok spesies yang belum terklasifikasi (incertae sedis), yang mungkin bukan Rasbora".

rocio-octofasciata.name: Jack Dempsey
notes: #11: 'have been received' became 'Tersedia spesimen...'. Say that the specimens were received or obtained, not that they are generally available.
#4: 'sekitar 243 liter' is a very precise figure for the volume. Round it, for example to 'sekitar 240 liter'.

sahyadria-denisonii.name: Denisoni
notes: Item 1: "ikan ini hanya boleh ditangkap" - the English passive is more general (only small quantities may be caught); consider "hanya sejumlah kecil yang boleh ditangkap dan diekspor sebagai ikan hias" (minor).
Item 4: "Pemberian pakan beku dan pakan serpihan tidak bermasalah" is slightly stiff; consider "Pakan beku dan pakan serpih (flake) mudah diberikan/diterima dengan baik" (minor).

scatophagus-argus.name: Ikan kiper
notes: #4: "tidak perlu diberi pakan kotoran" is weaker than the English "should not feed them feces". Use "jangan diberi pakan kotoran" or "sebaiknya tidak diberi".
#4: "Tentu saja" is added and not in the source. Use a neutral connector such as "Namun".
#6: "dahinya yang sangat curam" is slightly awkward. "dahinya yang sangat landai/miring tajam" or "dahi yang sangat membulat/tegak" may read more naturally for a steep forehead profile.

scleropages-formosus.name: Arwana Asia
notes: Item 1/2/3: 'extirpated' is rendered 'punah'; 'punah' means extinct. Use 'hilang dari / tidak lagi ditemukan di sebagian besar wilayah sebarannya' (or 'punah secara lokal').
Item 5: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)' is closer to the source.
Item 5: 'completely bare set-ups' is rendered 'kosong tanpa dekorasi'. 'Tanpa substrat dan dekorasi' would be more precise.
Item 7: 'small goldfish' is rendered 'ikan mas koki kecil'. Mas koki is the fancy goldfish. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish kecil' to be safe.
Item 7: 'feeder fish' is rendered 'ikan umpan'. 'Ikan pakan (feeder)' is the term hobbyists use.
Item 8: 'Termasuk pengeram mulut, dan yang mengerami adalah jantannya' is wordy. Use 'Pengeram mulut oleh induk jantan'.
Item 9: 'dikoleksi dari Pegunungan Schwaner' should read 'ditangkap/diambil dari'. Also, 'masing-masing' is ambiguous about which variant belongs to which province pair.
Item 9: 'Varian green' mixes English and Indonesian. Keep the form names consistent, e.g. 'varian green' in quotes like the others.
Item 6: The °F values are dropped, which is fine because the metric conversion was requested.

scleropages-jardinii.name: Arwana Irian
notes: Item 1: "Ikan lidah tulang" is a literal rendering; hobbyists more commonly use "arwana/ikan lidah tulang (bony tongue)"; consider adding the English term in brackets.
Item 1: "lempeng-lempeng benua yang bergeser" adds the idea of shifting plates; the source says "continental floes" (bongkahan/pecahan benua). Minor.
Item 2: "Keduanya paling jarang diimpor dibandingkan semua jenis arwana lainnya" is awkward; better "Keduanya adalah arwana yang paling jarang diimpor".
Item 2: "akuaris" is non-standard; "aquascaper" or "penghobi akuarium" is more natural. "tempat penangkaran" is fine, but "breeding facilities" could also be "fasilitas penangkaran".
Item 4: "peternakan di Australia" for "breeding farms" is slightly off; use "tempat/penangkaran budidaya" or "farm pembenihan".
Item 3: "agak suka bertengkar" is a bit colloquial; "agak agresif terhadap sesamanya" is more natural for hobby text.

sewellia-breviventralis.name: Sewellia
notes: Item 1: "warnanya berbeda dibandingkan ikan impor yang masih hidup" is slightly awkward; better "ada perbedaan warna dibandingkan ikan impor hidup".
Item 1: "bentuk warna" for "colour form" is awkward; use "varian warna" or "morf warna".
Item 1: "ditangkap di provinsi Hue" is fine, but "Karena itu ... tetap digunakan" is slightly clumsy; consider "tetap dipertahankan".
Item 4: "mau makan" is colloquial; "memakan" or "menerima" is more natural in a handbook.
Item 4: "pelet butiran" is redundant; use "granul" or "pelet".
Item 4: "dirangsang" for "promoted" is slightly off; "didorong" or "dipicu" fits better for algae growth.
Item 3: "hanya sedikit tercemar bahan organik" is acceptable but wordy; "rendah polutan organik" is more natural.

sewellia-lineolata.name: Reticulated Hillstream Loach
notes: Item 13: 'goldfish' translated as 'ikan mas koki'. Use 'ikan mas koki' only if that is meant; fine, but 'river manifold tank' is left as 'akuarium model river manifold'. Explain it in Indonesian or give a proper term.

Item 16: 'Pseudogastromyzon pun bisa kesulitan menunjukkan dominasinya' follows 'jika wilayah terbatas'. The English says 'if the latter resources are limited', meaning food and territory. Write 'jika pakan dan wilayah terbatas'.
Item 20: 'mencucup-cucup permukaan punggungnya' for 'mouthing of the dorsal surface' is awkward. Use 'menyentuh/mengisap-isap dengan mulut'.
Item 20: 'to dislodge her into open water' is rendered as 'terlepas ke kolom air'. Say 'perairan terbuka'.

Item 20: 'Pacaran ... mengepak-ngepakkan sirip' is fine, but 'fry' appears as 'burayak' in 'Initial reports ... recovering fry'. That is fine. 'woollen mops' became 'spawning mop dari benang wol'. Acceptable.
Item 6: 'arus deras sekali' for 'torrential' is awkward. Also 'air terjun kecil' for 'cascades' is okay. Rephrase the torrential part as 'arus sangat deras'.
Item 22: 'tuberkel' and 'balitorid' are fine. 'pipih ke bawah (depressed)' is OK. 'sirip dubur' for 'anal fin' is stiff. Use 'sirip anal'.
Item 22: 'one simple and 19–26 branched pectoral-fin rays' is rendered 'satu jari-jari sirip dada tunggal dan 19–26 bercabang'. Use 'satu jari-jari tak bercabang (simple)'.
Item 15: 'frozen spirulina brine shrimp' is rendered 'artemia beku yang diperkaya spirulina'. This is fine, but 'sayuran yang direbus sebentar (blanching)' is okay.
Item 3: 'Spesies Sewellia bisa dibilang yang paling mudah dipijahkan ... di antara semua loach' is fine. The 'tutup yang rapat mutlak diperlukan' repetition mirrors the source.

sicyopus-exallisquamulus.name: Lipstick Goby
notes: Item 6: "turnover of 10-15 times" is rendered correctly, but item 1 says 8–12 times; fine. Real issue in item 12: "putative subfamily Sicydiinae" became "subfamili Sicydiinae yang masih diperdebatkan" – OK; but "between the fifth pair of fin rays" / "between all five rays" is rendered as "di antara pasangan jari-jari sirip kelima" and "kelima jari-jarinya", which is ambiguous/possibly altered; check the meaning.

Item 11: "the initially pelagic post-hatch larvae are washed downstream" – "burayak pasca-larva" for post-larval fry is fine, but "hidup melayang di kolom air" adds detail; acceptable. The "Hal ini tidak diragukan lagi" is OK.
Item 3: "Moluccas" left in English; use "Maluku" or "Kepulauan Maluku" and "Kepulauan Rempah-rempah" – the sentence is circular as written.
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang membulat".
Item 9: "pelagic" translated as "berenang di kolom air" – acceptable; "Hindari ikan yang makannya agresif" fine. "Ikan yang lebih besar sebaiknya tidak dimasukkan sama sekali" fine.
Item 1: "Hardiness: needs a well-established tank" translated as "Ketahanan" is slightly odd; a clearer rendering would be "Daya tahan".
Item 10: "posteroventral portion of the body" rendered "bagian belakang bawah tubuh" – fine; "genital papilla" fine.
Item 4: "bedrock" as "batuan induk" is a geological term meaning parent rock; use "batuan dasar".

sicyopus-zosterophorus.name: Flaming Arrow Goby
notes: Item 11: 'strategi ini hanya di famili Gobiidae saja pun dipakai oleh berbagai genus kerabat' is garbled and unnatural; rewrite as 'strategi ini dipakai oleh berbagai genus kerabat, hanya dalam famili Gobiidae saja'.

Item 12: 'cakram ... menempel ke perut hanya di antara jari-jari sirip pasangan kelima' is wrong. The English says the disc is attached only between the fifth pair of rays, and then 'between all five rays' in other sicydiines. Fix the wording so it reads 'hanya di antara pasangan jari-jari kelima' and 'di antara kelima jari-jari'.
Item 12: 'subfamili Sicydiinae yang masih bersifat dugaan' puts 'putative' on the wrong noun. Better 'subfamili Sicydiinae (yang diajukan/dugaan)'.
Item 12: 'goby bibir bergigi' and 'spesies Sicyopus ... bersifat omnivora' are fine, but 'Banyak yang diimpor' is ambiguous. Specify 'Banyak spesies/ikan ini'.

Item 12: 'Lidahnya juga menyatu ... beberapa goby lain' is acceptable, but 'Juxtastiphodon ... tidak ada yang melengkung ke belakang' is fine. Check 'jari-jari yang menebal' against the original, which says 'strong spine and thickened, highly-branched rays'.
Item 9: 'Caridinia' in the English was corrected to 'Caridina'. This is fine, but check that 'teman setangkinya' is natural; 'penghuni akuarium yang sama' is better.

Item 6 and item 1: the turnover figures conflict, but both are faithful to the English, so they are not errors. 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn'; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus karena terkikis air'.
Item 8: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'kutu air' can be read as a parasite. Use 'daphnia' or 'kutu air (Daphnia)'.
Item 11: 'Hal ini tidak diragukan lagi disebabkan oleh' is fine, but 'burayak' for post-larval fry is a poor fit. Use 'anakan' or 'larva'.

silurichthys-hasseltii.name: Hassel's Leaf Catfish
notes: #1: "Dibedakan dari kerabatnya" adds "from its relatives", which is not in the English; use "Dibedakan oleh ...".
#2: "Least Concern/Risiko Rendah" is a non-standard mix; use "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" or "Berisiko Rendah".
#2: "Diketahui terdapat di DAS Mekong" is slightly awkward; "Diketahui dari DAS Mekong" is closer to the source.
#4: "kayu (driftwood)" is vague; use "kayu apung" or "kayu driftwood", which hobbyists use.
#6: "gurami" for gouramies is fine, but "hidup bergerombol" for shoaling would more naturally be "berkelompok".

sphaerichthys-acrostoma.name: Giant Chocolate Gourami
notes: Item 14: 'Sphaerichthys memiliki struktur telur yang unik ... bersama tiga genus terakhir' – English says 'They share with the latter trio'; the sentence is garbled/ambiguous. Rephrase: 'Genus ini memiliki struktur telur yang sama dengan ketiga genus terakhir, yang unik di antara teleostei'.

Item 14: 'garis-garis vertikal terang' for 'light vertical bars' fine, but 'garis lateral' for 'lateral stripe' and 'gurat sisi' for 'lateral line' are inconsistent; use 'garis samping/gurat sisi' consistently.
Item 2: the bracketed explanation '(yang mengerami telur di mulut adalah si jantan)' is an added gloss, redundant; delete. Also 'jauh dari kata umum' is awkward; use 'tidak umum/jarang ditemukan'.
Item 11: 'bercumbu' for courtship sounds odd; use 'saat berkencan/dalam masa penjodohan (courtship)'. Same in item 12 'Perilaku bercumbu'.
Item 9: 'predator mikro' for 'micropredator' acceptable, but 'kutu air' for Daphnia and 'mikro worm' are inconsistent; use 'Daphnia' and 'cacing mikro (microworm)'.

Item 7: 'tanaman air' with 'Taxiphyllum' etc fine, but 'beech, oak' left untranslated; add 'daun beech/oak' with explanation or local equivalent. 'burayak' used for 'fry' while 'anakan' for 'juveniles' – okay.
Item 12: 'betina yang terbalik' omits 'diputar/dibalik' sense of the pair; fine. 'Telur/burayak disimpan di dalam mulut' OK. 'peternak' for breeders better 'pembudidaya/breeder'.

sphaerichthys-selatanensis.name: Crossband Chocolate Gourami
notes: Item 11: 'Volume: ~54 litres' for a 60×30 cm base is kept as is. It is not a gallon conversion, so it is fine; no change needed unless the source figure differs.
Item 26: 'subfamili Osphronemidae Luciocephalinae' is wrong. Use 'subfamili Luciocephalinae dalam famili Osphronemidae'.
Item 24: 'pembuat sarang busa' is fine, but 'burayak' is used for eggs/fry. 'Telur dan burayak disimpan di dalam mulut' is acceptable. For 'free-swimming juveniles', 'anakan' is fine.

Item 6: 'Kalimantan Tengah' is kept, but 'several hundred kilometres east' is placed in the wrong clause. In Indonesian it reads as if Sampit is east of Central Kalimantan; reword to 'di sebelah timur Banjarmasin'.
Item 7: 'tenggara' (southeast) is kept, but the English says 'Kalimantan' is the region name. Fine.
Item 21: 'Untuk ikan komunitas' is stiff. Phrase it as 'Sebagai teman satu akuarium'.
Item 1: 'Not Evaluated' is correctly kept in brackets. No change needed.
Item 20: 'Danionella, Microdevario' etc. are fine, but 'cyprinid damai yang berenang di kolom air' translates 'pelagic' loosely. Use 'cyprinid pelagis'.
Item 18: 'Pada dasarnya merupakan mikropredator' mistranslates 'Primarily'. Use 'Terutama'.
Item 12: 'Ketapang almond leaves' is rendered as 'daun ketapang', which is fine.

sphaerichthys-vaillanti.name: Samurai Gourami
notes: Item 8: English says '75 litres (20 gallons)'; the translation keeps 75 liter. 20 gallons is about 75 L, so this is fine. No fix needed here, but item 17 has a real error.

Item 17: 'Red mosquito larvae' was translated as 'Cacing darah'. Use 'jentik nyamuk merah' or 'larva cacing darah (bloodworm)'. 'Tubifex' was translated as 'cacing sutra'. This is acceptable, but keep the name consistent.
Item 17: 'mosquito larvae' appears as 'jentik nyamuk' and the red variety is rendered differently. Make the two terms consistent so the advice is not confusing.

Item 18: 'Avoid big, fast-moving fish like tetras and rasboras' was translated 'Hindari ikan besar dan gesit seperti tetra dan rasbora'. This is fine. However, item 19 recommends small Rasbora, so check that the two items do not contradict each other.
Item 4: 'sistem danau Danau Sentarum' is redundant. Use 'sistem Danau Sentarum'.

Item 21: 'females ... red and green patterning which intensifies further during courtship' was translated as 'semakin pekat saat masa kawin'. The word 'further' is dropped, which is minor. Also 'rahang bawah yang lurus rata' is awkward.
Item 24: 'subfamili Osphronemidae Luciocephalinae' is wrong. Osphronemidae is a family, so write 'subfamili Luciocephalinae dalam famili Osphronemidae'.
Item 24: 'kulit elastis' and 'pengeram mulut betina' are fine. 'Terdapat dua tanda merah yang masing-masing memanjang ke belakang dan ke bawah mata' is acceptable.
Item 1: the translation 'Tingkat kesulitan: Menengah sampai ahli' is fine. The 75-82°F figure was correctly dropped.
Item 11: 'daun beech, oak' is left in English. Add Indonesian glosses, such as 'daun beech/oak (jika tersedia)', since these leaves are not common in Indonesia.

stigmatogobius-sadanundio.name: Knight Goby
notes: "Monos" is left in English and capitalised. Write it lowercase as "mono", or give the genus Monodactylus, as in "ikan mono (Monodactylus)".

"S. sadanundio sejauh ini yang paling umum di antaranya di dunia akuarium" reads awkwardly because it has no verb. Use "S. sadanundio adalah yang paling umum di antara spesies tersebut di dunia akuarium".

stiphodon-atratus.name: Stiphodon atratus
notes: Item 12: 'between the fifth pair of fin rays' vs 'between all five rays' – 'attached between the fifth pair' is garbled; should read 'hanya menempel pada perut di antara jari-jari kelima (sepasang)', versus semua lima jari-jari; clarify meaning.
Item 6: 'Anubias sangat berguna' – English says 'The latter' (Anubias), OK, but 'kaca depan' for 'viewing pane' fine; however 'Goby ini' replaces 'These gobies' (plural/genus) – minor.
Item 6: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn'; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat'.
Item 6: 'dasar kaca akuarium' fine, but 'Aged driftwood' → 'sudah lama terendam' changes meaning slightly; use 'kayu apung yang sudah matang/lama dikeringkan-direndam'.
Item 8: 'alga rhodophyta 'black brush' (BBA)' – 'BBA' abbreviation added; use 'alga merah (rhodophyta) jenis black brush'.
Item 9: 'Males tend to be loosely territorial' rendered 'agak teritorial' acceptable; 'Mereka... Annamia, Homaloptera' fine. 'caridina' ok.
Item 11: 'Pemijahan' used twice for 'courtship' and 'Perilaku kawin' inconsistent; 'cichlid' untranslated-ish minor (use 'sikklid').

Item 4: 'riam atau aliran' for 'riffles or runs' – 'riam' means rapids; use 'arus dangkal berbatu (riffle) atau aliran tenang (run)'. Also 'jeram' used for both 'cataracts' and 'cascades'; 'Sicydiine' unitalicised fine.
Item 11: 'Irian Jaya/Papua' fine; 'bertakik (emarginate)' acceptable but 'sirip ekor bertakik' ok.

stiphodon-birdsong.name: Stiphodon birdsong
notes: Item 1: the English says nothing about 'matang' tank only... fine; but no issue. Focus on item 6: 'Meskipun tidak terdapat di habitat aslinya' drops 'a feature of this species' natural habitat'; the sentence is ambiguous and could read as the plants being absent in the aquarium. Rewrite: 'Meskipun bukan bagian dari habitat alami spesies ini'.
Item 6: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus karena terkikis air' - 'water-worn' means rounded by water; 'halus' is added. Use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang membulat'.

Item 6: 'Aged driftwood' is translated as 'Kayu yang sudah lama terendam', which changes the meaning (aged/seasoned wood). Use 'kayu apung yang sudah matang/lama dikeringkan' or 'driftwood yang sudah tua'.
Item 6: 'diletakkan langsung di dasar kaca akuarium' - the English says tank base, so use 'dasar akuarium'. Avoid adding 'kaca'.

Item 4: 'Sebaliknya... jeram' - 'riffles' translated as 'riam dangkal' and 'cataracts' as 'jeram'; 'riam' and 'jeram' are both rapids, so the terms are confused. Use 'riam/jeram dangkal' for riffles and 'air terjun bertingkat' for cataracts.

Item 4: 'Kelompok sicydiine begitu berhasil menghuni... memanfaatkan biofilm' - 'this' is clarified as biofilm, which is acceptable. 'hampir secara eksklusif menghuni' is fine, but 'Habitat yang paling ideal' for 'most favourable' is OK.
Item 11: 'Selama musim dingin tahunan' - the English says 'annual cool spell', not winter, in a tropical setting. Use 'periode dingin tahunan'.
Item 11: 'sirip ekor berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)' - 'emarginate' means notched; the phrase is acceptable but 'larva pelagis... lebih besar' is fine. 'mata yang berfungsi' is fine.
Item 12: 'tangkai ekor yang lebih panjang (17–23 vs. 10–16...)' - fine. 'burayak' for fry is used consistently. 'Peran cakram... melahirkan nama umum' is fine.
Item 3: 'yang terletak di lepas ujung timur Papua Nugini' - English 'off the latter's eastern tip' refers to Fergusson Island's tip, not PNG. Change to 'di lepas ujung timur pulau tersebut'.

stiphodon-maculidorsalis.name: Stiphodon Orange Fin
notes: Item 5: 'Volume: ~72 litres' kept as-is; fine, but check consistency. Not an error.
Item 11: 'Selama musim dingin tahunan' for 'annual cool spell' adds a 'winter' notion; Sumatra/Okinawa context better as 'periode dingin/sejuk tahunan'.
Item 11: 'Amfidromi pada goby sicydiine bukan hanya milik anggota Stiphodon' is okay, but 'Pemijahan' is repeated; 'Spawning is initiated' wording is fine.
Item 12: 'Peran cakram ini ... melahirkan nama umum' is stiff; use 'menjadi asal nama umum'.

Item 12: 'Pada Sicyopus dan Stiphodon ... menempel ke perut hanya di antara pasangan jari-jari sirip kelima' is ambiguous/awkward; the English 'fifth pair of fin rays' vs 'between all five rays' should be rendered clearly (e.g., 'hanya pada jari-jari kelima', 'pada kelima jari-jari').

Item 12: 'rahang bawah dengan gigi simfisis' - 'dentary' is the lower jaw bone; acceptable, but 'sirip dada' is fine. 'Lokasi tipe' in item 3 leaves 'South Painan, West Sumatra Province, Sumatra' in English; use 'Painan Selatan, Provinsi Sumatra Barat, Sumatra'.
Item 6: 'kaca depan' for 'viewing pane' is fine; but 'dasar kaca' for 'tank base' is odd; use 'dasar akuarium'.
Item 6: 'kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward for 'water-worn'; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus/bulat' .

Item 9: 'Spesies ini juga pernah terlihat dipelihara bersama' changes subject from 'we've also seen it' (this species); sentence now attaches awkwardly to the previous list of tankmates, so 'it' (Stiphodon) is ambiguous; rephrase to 'Stiphodon juga pernah terlihat dipelihara bersama...'.
Item 8: 'Cakram perut (sirip perut yang menyatu)' adds a gloss not in the source; minor.

stiphodon-ornatus.name: Rainbow Stiphodon
notes: Item 18: "Selama musim dingin tahunan antara Desember dan April" – English says "annual cool spell" (periode sejuk), not winter; Indonesia has no winter, so rephrase as "periode bersuhu lebih dingin".
Item 19: "subfamili Sicydiinae yang diusulkan" – "putative" means presumed/dugaan, which is ambiguous. Use "yang diduga/dianggap" instead.

Item 3: "sangat sulit diidentifikasi" is fine, but the clause "sehingga spesies-spesiesnya memiliki sebaran yang sangat luas" is a weak causal link; "determine" and the "so" logic should be smoothed. Also use a comma, not a semicolon, before "sehingga".
Item 6: "dasar kaca akuarium" – English says "tank base"; "kaca" is added, so use "dasar akuarium". "kaca depan untuk melihat" is clumsy; use "kaca depan (sisi pandang)".
Item 6: "Kayu apung yang sudah lama" for "aged driftwood" is unclear; use "kayu apung yang sudah matang/lama direndam". "tetapi hindari kayu baru" is OK.
Item 18: "burayak" is used for larvae/fry throughout. It is acceptable, but "larva yang baru menetas" and "burayak" are mixed for the same stage; use "larva" and "anakan" consistently.
Item 18: "Durasi larva pelagis (PLD)" should be "lama fase larva pelagis (PLD)". "zona ombak yang dangkal" is better as "zona pecah ombak yang dangkal".
Item 19: "Ikan yang paling umum diperdagangkan jelas tampaknya adalah" is awkward; use "tampaknya memang".

stiphodon-semoni.name: Blue Neon Goby
notes: Item 6: "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy; use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis arus" or "batu kali dan kerikil".
Item 12: "hampir setengah abad kedua puluh" is awkward; "hampir separuh abad ke-20" is more natural.
Item 8: "'alga' hijau-biru" is fine, but "alga rhodophyta 'black brush algae' (BBA)" would read better as "alga merah (rhodophyta) 'black brush algae' (BBA)".

striuntius-lineatus.name: Lined Barb
notes: Item 1: "ikan suku Cyprinidae bergaris memanjang di sisi tubuh" is fine, but "punya paling banyak satu pasang sungut" is awkward; use "paling banyak satu pasang sungut" or "tidak lebih dari satu pasang sungut".
Item 2: Sarawak is a Malaysian state and the translation is right. However, "Kalimantan Barat/West Kalimantan" lost the English form; this is minor.

Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "pelet/flake kering" is wrong: the English says flakes and granules, so use "serpih dan butiran kering" or "flake dan granul". The slash form is awkward.
Item 8: "cobitids" was rendered as "ikan loach". Use "ikan loach (Cobitidae)" for accuracy; the term is also loose.
Item 5: "setup" is left in English; "tata letak" or "rancangan akuarium" reads more naturally.
Item 3: "Kandungan mineral terlarutnya umumnya nyaris tidak ada" overstates the English "negligible"; use "sangat rendah".
Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the volume of an 80 × 30 cm base depends on height. The figure is carried over from the source and is fine.

Item 11: "0–1 pasang sungut ... ketiga spesies lainnya punya 2 pasang" conflicts with item 1's "paling banyak satu pasang". The meaning is the same, but wording should be consistent. Also "Puntius spp. lain" is fine.
Item 1: "Namun" was added to join the sentences. The English says "but it has no more than one pair", so the contrast is preserved; this is fine.

sulcospira-testudinaria.name: Keong Susuh Kura
notes: Item 9: "Burrowers: Yes" is listed as "Penggali: Ya", which contradicts the preceding statement in the same item that they are not obligate diggers and generally do not move under the substrate. This is faithful to the source, so only check whether it should be clarified. The text itself is fine.

Item 6: "does not tolerate salinity well" became "kurang tahan terhadap air payau/asin". This adds the idea of brackish water, which the source does not mention. Use "tidak tahan terhadap salinitas tinggi" or stay closer to the source wording.

Item 6: "regain activity immediately" was rendered as "segera aktif kembali". This is acceptable. However, "When moved to freshwater" is untouched, so the source's logic stays confusing. No fix is needed beyond checking the sentence.

Item 7: "do not burrow much or too deep" was rendered as "tidak banyak menggali dan tidak terlalu dalam". This reads awkwardly. Use "tidak banyak menggali dan tidak terlalu dalam" only if the subject is made clear, e.g. "tidak banyak menggali, dan galiannya pun tidak dalam".
Item 1: the original "Optimal tank size: 10 gallons (about 40 litres)" is correct at 40 L. Item 1 leaves "Javanese snail" untranslated in "Nama lain". Give the Indonesian form, e.g. "keong Jawa".
Item 9: "Danio rerio" and "Endlers" are fine. "Least Killifish", "Pygmy Swordtail" and "Ghost Glass Catfish" are left in English with no local name. Add Indonesian names or brackets for readability.
Item 5: "Cycle the tank" became "Selesaikan siklus nitrogen di akuarium". This is fine. "tidak ribet" is colloquial for a handbook; use "tidak rumit".
Item 11: "embryonic shells" became "cangkang embrio". It is literal but unclear. Say "embrio bercangkang".

sundadanio-axelrodi.name: Rasbora Axelrodi
notes: Item 7: 'akuarium 29,5 liter' – the English gives both; the metric figure is correct, so this is fine. But the 3-gallon/12.5 L and 8-gallon/29.5 L figures are correctly kept, so no change is needed there.
Item 9: 'biologically immature tank' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This adds a specific claim. Use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis' (or 'belum cycling').

Item 9: 'hails from sluggish waters' is rendered 'sebagian besar berasal dari perairan yang tenang'. The word 'mostly' qualifies the origin, not the habitat. Use 'berasal dari perairan yang berarus lambat'.
Item 18: 'Beri ikan banyak pakan hidup dan beku, maka ikan seharusnya akan siap memijah' is slightly awkward. Rephrase it as a condition ('Jika diberi ... ikan seharusnya siap memijah').
Item 12: 'filter mesin' is a non-standard term for power filter. Use 'filter eksternal/power filter' or 'filter bertenaga'.
Item 1: 'Blue Axelrodi Rasbora' and 'Neon Blue Danio' are left in English. This is acceptable as trade names, but 'memukau' for 'stunning' is fine.
Item 14: 'Corydoras' is rendered 'Corydoras' only. The English says 'Corydoras catfish', so add 'lele kecil' or 'ikan kucing' for the reader.
Item 16: 'dengkingan/cicitan' is an odd rendering of croaking/chirruping. Use 'suara berkuruk/mencicit'. 'Gelang sirip dada' for pectoral girdle is also stiff.
Item 19: 'monotipe' and 'danionin' are used loosely. 'Ikan bertulang sejati' for 'bony fishes' is OK, but 'subfamili ... kelompok saudara' needs consistent terminology.
Item 13: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'cacing grindal' and 'cacing mikro' should keep 'grindal' and 'micro worm' as hobbyists know them.

sundasalanx-microps.name: Sundasalanx microps
notes: Item 6: "burayak artemia (nauplii)" is non-standard. "Burayak" means fry. Hobbyists say "nauplius artemia" or "naupli artemia".
Item 6: "pakan plankton berukuran kecil" is slightly loose for "small planktivorous food". Something like "pakan hidup berukuran kecil" would be clearer.

symphysodon-discus.name: Discus
notes: Item 6: "burayak" for fry is regional/less common among Indonesian hobbyists; "benih" or "anakan" is more common, and the text mixes "burayak" with "anakan" (item 9). Use one term consistently.
Items 2 and 9: "manfish" for Angelfish (Pterophyllum) is a common name, but "angelfish" is the more widely understood term; consider "ikan angelfish (manfish)".
Item 8: "yang sudah ahli" is awkward; use "hanya oleh ahli" or "hanya dapat dibedakan oleh orang yang berpengalaman".
Item 8: "musim kawin" for "breeding time" is inconsistent with "memijah" elsewhere; use "saat musim pemijahan".
Item 9: "mencabik 'makanan'" is too strong for "breaking off"; use "mengerat/menyobek sedikit 'makanan'".
Item 1: "dipopulerkan ke seluruh dunia" and "akuaris" are acceptable but "penghobi akuarium" is more natural.

syncrossus-hymenophysa.name: Langli
notes: Item 4: 'structural components of housing' was translated as 'bagian dari struktur rumah', which is misleading. Use something like 'bagian struktur bangunan/permukiman (mis. tiang rumah)'.
Item 12: 'Syncrossus ... the former alteration ... the latter' is fine, but 'meskipun studi yang kedua' is ambiguous. Name Šlechtová et al. (2006) explicitly.
Item 12: 'Yasuhikotakia ... berkerabat lebih dekat dengan Sinibotia maupun Syncrossus' should read 'baik dengan Sinibotia maupun Syncrossus'.
Item 6: 'kerikil halus' is used for both 'fine gravel' and 'pebbles', which is repetitive. Use 'kerikil' for pebbles.

Item 6: 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang' for 'biologically immature set-ups' is acceptable, but 'disukai' is better than 'seperti yang disukai' for 'favoured'. Also 'ruang depan gelembung renang' should be 'ruang anterior'. Minor.
Item 10: 'seharusnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk' turns 'should be' (expected) into a prescriptive 'seharusnya'. Use 'umumnya tampak jelas lebih gemuk'.
Item 12: 'ikan alfa' and 'ikan yang bertarung' are fine, but 'dengan Botia tampaknya sebagai garis keturunan paling basal' is awkward. Rephrase.

Item 8: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine, but 'zukini' for courgette is fine too. 'kalau ada pilihan makanan lain, ikan ini akan memilih yang lain itu' misreads the English 'if other options are available they will take them'. It should say that the fish will still eat snails even when other food is available, so they should not be relied on to clear an infestation. As translated, it has the fish avoiding snails, which reverses the meaning.

synodontis-eupterus.name: Synodontis Featherfin
notes: Item 13: 'udang besar, udang kecil' for 'prawns, shrimps' adds an invented size distinction; use 'udang' / 'udang kecil'.
Item 20: 'kurus atau sangat kurus' is redundant for 'thin or emaciated'; use 'kurus atau sangat kurus kering' or just 'kurus kering'.
Item 16: 'quarrelsome' rendered as 'agresif' is slightly too strong; use 'suka berselisih' or 'galak'.
Item 12: 'bekas luka yang buruk' is awkward; use 'bekas luka yang jelek/permanen'. 'kayu bogwood/akar' is redundant.
Item 17: 'cichlid yang kekar' is odd; use 'cichlid bertubuh tangguh'.
Item 4: 'di farm' is awkward; use 'hasil budidaya (farm bred)'. Items 1 and 22 'farm budidaya ikan' could be 'tempat budidaya ikan'.

systomus-endecanalis.name: Desmopuntius endecanalis
notes: Item 2: 'Danau Sentarum lake system' became 'sistem danau Sentarum'; use 'sistem Danau Sentarum' (proper name, capital D) to match item 1.
Item 9: 'saat sedang mengandung telur' for 'gravid' is slightly awkward for an egg-bearing fish; use 'saat sedang bertelur/penuh telur'.
Item 7: 'mendorong ikan masuk ke kondisi siap memijah' is stiff; use 'merangsang ikan siap memijah'.
Item 5: 'berasal dari perairan yang arusnya lambat' is fine, but 'Ikan ini seharusnya tumbuh baik' is awkward; use 'Ikan ini akan tumbuh baik'.
Item 11: 'pita pertama' for 'anterior bar' is an inference, and the English didn't number it; 'pangkal depan' for 'origin' adds 'depan' not in the source (use 'pangkal sirip punggung').

Item 11: 'serasah' in item 5 and 'jari-jari sirip punggung tidak bercabang' for 'simple ray' are acceptable, but the English 'rostral and maxillary barbels' is rendered 'sungut maksila'; 'sungut maksilar' is the usual term.
Item 8: 'ribut atau sangat lincah' for 'boisterous or very vigorous' is OK, but 'tidak terlalu mudah kaget' for 'less skittish' is awkward; use 'tidak mudah takut/stres'.
Item 1: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is awkward for 'congeners'; use 'spesies segenus'.

systomus-orphoides.name: Mata merah
notes: Item 1/5/8: 'cukup heboh' for 'boisterous' is colloquial; use 'cukup aktif dan gaduh' / 'bertingkah kasar'.
Item 4: 'Volume: ~720 liter' is fine, but 'dibutuhkan akuarium berukuran minimal' is OK; no real issue beyond the ones below.
Item 5: 'batu-batu sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu sungai berbagai ukuran yang telah halus terkikis air'.
Item 5: 'Arus sederas air terjun' overstates 'torrent-like'; use 'arus deras seperti torrent/jeram'.
Item 11: 'ukuran dewasa lebih dari 80 mm SL' is fine, but 'sungut moncong' for rostral barbel is acceptable; consider 'sungut rostral'.
Item 11: 'keranjang sampah' for 'catch-all' is overly literal; use 'kelompok penampung'.
Item 10: 'Kemungkinan belum pernah tercatat berhasil dipijahkan' adds 'berhasil dipijahkan'; the source says possibly unrecorded in aquaria.

taenioides-cirratus.name: Bearded Worm Goby
notes: "Bearded worm goby" left in English as the name; consider adding a local/descriptive name (e.g., goby cacing berjenggot) with the English in brackets.
"Matanya sangat mengecil" is slightly awkward; better "matanya sangat tereduksi/mengecil sekali".
"ia bisa menghirup udara" - "bernapas dengan udara" is more natural; "ruang bronkial" could be "ruang insang".
"Kemungkinan besar ikan ini cukup pasif" is slightly stronger than "Likely to be quite inactive"; "Kemungkinan ikan ini cukup pasif" is closer.
"Jelas jangan dicampur" is awkward; use "Sama sekali tidak boleh dipelihara bersama...".
"mangsa" for "food" is acceptable but "pakan" is closer.
"berat jenis" for sg is fine, but add "(sg)" for hobby familiarity.

tanichthys-albonubes.name: White Cloud
notes: Item 20: "hide most of the time" is rendered "lebih sering bersembunyi"; this is weaker than the source, so use "hampir sepanjang waktu bersembunyi".
Item 28: "musim semi hingga musim gugur" is awkward for Indonesian readers, who have no such seasons; consider "sepanjang musim kawin (musim semi hingga musim gugur di habitat asalnya)".
Item 12: "African dwarf frog" is left in English; add a local term such as "katak kerdil Afrika" with the English name in brackets.
Item 27: "betina tampak bunting telur" is odd for fish; "betina tampak penuh telur" is more natural.

telmatherina-bonti.name: Bonti-bonti
notes: #4 "pakan kering maupun pakan beku apa saja" is slightly awkward; better "Ikan ini mau memakan semua jenis pakan kering maupun beku."
#6 "hidup bercampur dalam warna-warni" is awkward; better "hidup bercampur dengan berbagai warna".
#6 "saling kawin" for interbreed; "kawin silang" or "berbiak satu sama lain" is more natural.
#6 "ras" for breeds; "varian" or "strain" is more usual in the hobby.
#8 "Asal nama" for Lexicon is fine, but "silverside" is left in English; consider the local term "ikan perak" or "silverside" with a short gloss.

thayeria-boehlkei.name: Penguin Tetra
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very boisterous" shifts the meaning. Boisterous means rowdy or very active, not aggressive. Use "sangat aktif/heboh".
Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "atau malam". The source says only "in the evening", so use "pada sore hari".
Item 10: "sperma" for "milt" is acceptable, but "cairan sperma" or "air mani ikan" would read more naturally for fish.
Item 8: "Selalu beli dalam kelompok" leaves out the object, so it reads abruptly. Use "Selalu beli ikan ini dalam kelompok...".

thorichthys-meeki.name: Firemouth
notes: Item 7: "(dipakai seperti cetakan)" is added to the pipette instruction and isn't in the source. Remove it.
Item 11: "subopercle" and "preorbital" are left untranslated. Consider "suboperkulum" and "praorbital", or add a gloss.
Item 2: "Sungai Río Tonalá" says "river" twice (Sungai and Río). Use "Río Tonalá" or "Sungai Tonalá".

toxotes-chatareus.name: Toxotes chatareus
notes: Item 4: "~432 liter" — 120×60×60 cm = 432 L, so the figure is correct; no change needed. Real problem: the source says "Standard length: 40 cm SL"; keep it, but "Alas akuarium" is odd — use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Panjang × lebar dasar".

Item 7: "The archer fish ... paludarium setup described above" — the earlier text (item 5) calls it a "biotope setup", not a paludarium, so "seperti dijelaskan di atas" is fine. Fix "pakan apung seperti pakan serpihan dan pelet" to avoid repetition: "pakan apung seperti serpihan dan pelet".

Item 11: "Largescale archerfish termasuk dalam kelompok ikan menarik yang mengembangkan cara makan ini" — "mengembangkan" reads as if the fish deliberately developed it; use "yang berevolusi memiliki cara makan yang sangat khas ini".
Item 11: "Toxotes chatareus juga dijual di Inggris" — "juga" is added; the source says "is offered for sale in the UK". Remove "juga".

Item 8: "scat (ikan kiper)" — "ikan kiper" is a different fish (Scatophagus is called ikan scat/kiper in some usage but "kiper" is also used for Datnioides/Monodactylus confusion); prefer "scat" alone or "ikan kiper (scat)", and give "mono" as "monodactylus (mono)". "green chromide" should be rendered as the local trade name "chromide hijau" or "Etroplus suratensis".

toxotes-jaculatrix.name: Ikan sumpit
notes: Item 1: "archerfish" is left in English in "jenis archerfish" and "di antara archerfish lainnya". Use "ikan sumpit" consistently.
Item 11: "dijual di Inggris" keeps the UK context, which is fine. "setup" could be "penataan" or "tata akuarium", but this is optional.

trichogaster-lalius.name: Colisa
notes: Item 3: 'Minimum tank size: 15 gallons (~60 litres)' is fine, but the 'Nitrate: less than 60' line is left without a unit (mg/L). Add the unit or keep as in the source.

Item 28: 'Nests ... reaching several inches across (roughly 7–15 cm)' is fine, but 'Mencabut tanaman karpet' etc. are OK. The real problem: 'Sirip perut' vs 'ventral' is mixed up, so 'touches her ventral side' became 'bagian perut betina'. This is acceptable, but 'menyentuh punggung atau ekor jantan' is fine too.
Item 10: 'sudah pas-pasan cukup' is awkward. Use 'cukup untuk sepasang, asalkan ditata dengan benar'.

Item 14: 'manfish' for angelfish is non-standard. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish/angel'. 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is acceptable. 'corydoras pygmy' and 'rasbora harlequin' use inverted English order. Use 'rasbora harlequin' or 'Rasbora hengeli' consistently.
Item 9: 'sirip ekornya membulat hingga tegak lurus di ujungnya' is a poor rendering of 'rounded to truncate'. Use 'membulat hingga tumpul/terpancung'.
Item 17: 'pantulan cahaya dari dasar kaca' adds 'kaca' (glass) that is not in the source. Also 'Anacharis' and 'Elodea' are listed as two plants, as in the source.
Item 27: 'Jantan sama sekali tidak bisa lagi menerima keberadaan pasangannya' is stiff. Use 'tidak lagi menoleransi pasangannya'. 'Anakan gurami' mixes terms with 'burayak'. Keep one term.

Item 16: 'Suhu yang mematikan 50% populasi' is fine, but 'kematian hanya 1%' at 20 and 25 °C is faithfully kept. The listed range 20–26 °C against the 22–27 °C elsewhere is a source inconsistency, not a translation error.
Item 1: the 'Max size: 88 mm SL' line dropped '(3.5 in)', which is permitted. 'Pembiakan massal juga mungkin telah menyebarkan' is fine, so no change is needed here.

trichopodus-leerii.name: Sepat mutiara
notes: Item 8: 'Minimum tank size: 20 gallons (about 76 litres)' – 20 US gal is ~76 L, fine, but '40-gallon (about 150 litres)' is fine too; no issue here. Real issue: item 2 'Life expectancy: 4 to 5 years' vs item 1/21 '8 years' is a source inconsistency, translation faithful – ignore.

Item 6: 'sepat mutiara tumbuh baik, dan begitu pula di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa' is awkward and slightly changes meaning; rephrase to 'Di habitat aslinya yang penuh vegetasi... sepat mutiara berkembang baik di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa'.
Item 14: 'pakan kering beku (freeze-dried)' is a clumsy term; use 'pakan freeze-dried' or 'pakan beku-kering'. 'jentik kaca' for glass worms is okay but 'cacing kaca' is more common.
Item 15: 'it will become withdrawn' translated as 'menjadi pemalu' – better 'menarik diri/stres dan bersembunyi'.
Item 17/18: 'blander' translated as 'lebih pucat' is acceptable; 'Jantan dewasa jauh lebih berwarna' is awkward, use 'warnanya jauh lebih cerah'.

Item 19: 'air-powered filters' rendered 'filter bertenaga aerator' – use 'filter udara (filter busa/sponge berpenggerak udara)'. 'gaya berpelukan khas anabantoid' is stilted; use 'pelukan pemijahan khas anabantoid'. Also '6-8"' converted to 15–20 cm and '10"' to 25 cm are correct.
Item 20: 'sirip perut ... berbentuk seperti antena peraba' – 'antena' is odd for fish; use 'sungut/filamen peraba'. Also 'after four days' ambiguity fine.
Item 22: 'efek seperti kerang mutiara' for mother-of-pearl should be 'kilau mutiara/induk mutiara', not 'kerang mutiara'. 'Bagian bawah kepala' fine.
Item 4: 'Pulau Sumatra serta Kalimantan' acceptable; 'Hampir Terancam' good.
Item 7: 'Panjang standar: 120 mm SL' – 'SL' redundant; fine otherwise.

trichopodus-trichopterus.name: Sepat rawa
notes: Item 7: "omnivora yang cukup umum" is a loose rendering of "fairly generalised omnivores". Use "omnivora generalis" or "pemakan segala yang tidak spesialis".
Item 8: "loricariid" is left in English. Consider "ikan lorikarid (suckermouth catfish)" or "ikan sapu-sapu dan kerabatnya" so readers recognise it.

trigonopoma-gracile.name: Rasbora Gracilis
notes: Item 6: "Volume: ~68 liter" with base 75 × 30 cm: fine; no issue. (ignore)

Item 2: "Asal: Singapura" — OK; but item 1 says "Kalimantan" while the English says "Borneo"; the translation changes the island to the Indonesian part only (also in item 3 "Di Kalimantan", "Kepulauan Sunda Besar, yaitu Kalimantan dan Sumatra"). Use "Borneo" (the island) to avoid excluding Sarawak/Malaysian Borneo.
Item 3: "Di Kalimantan, sebagian besar penangkapan..." then "Sarawak" is said to be in Kalimantan; use "Di Borneo".

Item 11: "Hindari teman satu akuarium yang ribut atau sangat agresif saat makan" adds "saat makan"/"agresif"; English says boisterous or very vigorous tankmates that may outcompete it for food. Also "mereka bisa kalah bersaing" drops the subject "it"; rephrase.

Item 15: "empat genus baru dari Liao et al., ... disinonimkan" fine; but "Klad keempat/kelima" statement "begitu pula anggota klad kelima" is OK. "Sinonim junior" ok. Item 14: "pemijahan biasanya terjadi" turns "should take place" into a stronger claim; use "seharusnya terjadi".
Item 4: "harlequin rasbora" and "glowlight rasbora" left in English; use local names (e.g. rasbora harlequin/ rasbora glowlight) consistently; "gurami coklat" should be "cokelat".
Item 12: "Rasbora ini adalah ikan komunitas yang sempurna" is fine.

trigonopoma-pauciperforatum.name: Rasbora redline
notes: Item 6: 'Volume: sekitar 81 liter' is fine, but the 90 × 30 cm base with 81 L is retained; OK. No issue.

Item 14: 'dideskripsikan ulang sebagai R. gracilis oleh Kottelat' — wording ok; but 'Ikan tersebut ... Ikan ini pernah ditampilkan' ambiguity: second 'Ikan ini' should be 'Ikan tersebut' to avoid confusing it with T. pauciperforatum.
Item 10: 'Beberapa spesies dari Kalimantan yang lebih umum diekspor' — fine; but 'bisa kalah bersaing dengan mereka' is ambiguous; say 'ikan ini bisa kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan'.
Item 1: 'tetra glowlight' — Latin/common name fine; 'sirip lemak (adiposa)' is awkward, use 'sirip adiposa'.
Item 3: 'perairan hitam (blackwater)' is awkward; use 'perairan blackwater' or 'air hitam'.
Item 7: 'ketapang' leaf given as 'daun ... ketapang' — fine; 'untuk lebih meredupkan cahaya' better 'untuk menyebarkan/meredam cahaya lebih jauh' (diffuse, not dim).
Item 7: 'tampak sangat menarik' — 'look particularly effective' okay; 'Substrat pasir yang lembut mungkin merupakan' fine.
Item 12: 'jumlah yang baik sekitar enam ekor jantan dan enam ekor betina' — 'half a dozen of each sex' correct.
Item 11: 'polanya lebih tegas' — 'more-intensely patterned' better 'pola lebih intens/mencolok'.
Item 13: 'perairan hitam Sundaland' OK; 'ini hanyalah yang paling terkenal' is stilted; use 'itu hanyalah yang paling dikenal'.

trigonostigma-espei.name: Rasbora Lambchop
notes: Item 10: 'sebaiknya pada sore atau malam hari' – English says only 'preferably in the evening'; 'atau malam hari' is added.
Item 10: 'kesadahan 1–5°H' – use 'dGH' for consistency; '°H' is ambiguous.
Item 10: 'ganti air besar ... dengan air yang lebih dingin' – fine in meaning, but 'peternak' for breeders is odd; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi'.
Item 10: "sejumlah 'latihan'" for 'dry runs' is unclear; use something like 'percobaan/gerakan pemijahan palsu tanpa telur'.
Item 10: 'Alas plastik jenis rumput' fine, but 'Rupanya perilaku memijah' is stiff; 'jumlah telurnya juga lebih sedikit' fine.
Item 3: 'dasarnya dipenuhi daun gugur' – the English says the substrate is scattered with leaves; 'dipenuhi' overstates it; use 'bertebaran'.
Item 1: 'cyprinid' left untranslated; Indonesian hobby usage is 'ikan cyprinid/suku Cyprinidae' – acceptable but 'lambchop' in quotes is not explained.
Item 5: 'Daun boleh dibiarkan ... atau diangkat dan diganti' is fine; 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan' is awkward; use 'tidak terlalu krusial'.

Item 8: 'ikan hias paling populer' – 'in the hobby' is rendered loosely; and 'catfish, loach' are untranslated trade terms where 'lele-lelean/ikan sapu-sapu' type terms are not intended; 'gugup' for nervous is odd, use 'stres/penakut'.

trigonostigma-hengeli.name: Rasbora hengeli
notes: Item 4: "in the current post" is dropped. Add something like "dalam artikel ini" or "yang dibahas di sini" before the Trigonopoma example.
Item 2: "buah alder (alder cone)" is slightly odd. "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder" is more accurate than "buah", because alder cones are catkin-like cones.

Item 1: "tubuh bagian depan T. espei berwarna (pada T. hengeli terang/transparan)" is clumsy and hard to parse. Rephrase it, for example "bagian depan tubuh T. espei berwarna, sedangkan pada T. hengeli terang/transparan".

trigonostigma-heteromorpha.name: Rasbora Harlequin
notes: Item 25: 'boisterous' is translated as 'berisik' (noisy). It means rowdy or boisterous, so use 'beringas/hiperaktif/kasar' instead, in both places.
Item 22: 'blanched vegetables' is rendered 'sayuran rebus'. 'Sayuran yang diblansir/direbus sebentar' is more precise.
Items 29 and 30: 'in the evening' is expanded to 'sore atau malam hari'. This slightly adds to the source; 'pada sore hari' or 'menjelang malam' is closer.
Item 31: 'Mating: one female per male' contradicts the '2 males and 3–4 females' in the list. This is faithful to the English, but the translator could flag it.

urocaridella-antonbruunii.name: Clear cleaner shrimp
notes: Item 8: the Vietnamese 'thức ăn đông lạnh' was left in the English list; the Indonesian should be 'pakan beku' (the translator wrote 'pakan beku' in the ID, so check the source), but flag that the EN source contains Vietnamese text that the ID rendered silently.
Item 8: 'No direct feeding is necessary' is rendered 'Tidak perlu diberi makan secara langsung', which is ambiguous. Clarify it as 'tidak perlu diberi pakan langsung ke udang (target feeding)'.
Item 5: 'temperature-acclimate' is translated as 'aklimatisasi suhu' only. Consider 'aklimatisasi suhu (dan salinitas) secara perlahan', but do not add facts. The wording is acceptable.
Item 4: '"tenggelam" (jarang terlihat)' is an odd rendering of 'get lost'. Use 'tidak terlihat / hilang di antara dekorasi'.
Item 9: 'kemampuan bertahannya yang terbatas' for 'limited defensive capability' is wrong. Use 'kemampuan pertahanan diri yang terbatas'.
Item 3: 'terumbu berdasar keras' is clumsy. Use 'terumbu dasar keras'.

vaillantella-maassi.name: Dragon Loach
notes: Item 6: "yang bisa saja atau tidak sedikit berwarna kecokelatan karena tanin" is awkward and unclear; use "yang mungkin berwarna kecokelatan karena tanin, mungkin juga tidak".

Item 14: "Unreported in aquaria" became "Belum pernah dilaporkan berkembang biak di akuarium". This adds "berkembang biak" (breeding) which the English does not say. Keep it literal, e.g. "Belum ada laporan pemeliharaannya di akuarium", unless the section heading makes the breeding sense clear.
Item 6: "di lingkungan dataran yang lebih tinggi" is clumsy for "higher altitude environments"; use "di daerah dataran tinggi" or "di habitat berketinggian lebih tinggi".

vittina-waigiensis.name: Nerite Waigiensis
notes: Item 3: "Semua hal yang umumnya berlaku untuk siput nerite juga berlaku untuk perawatan spesies ini" is slightly redundant; simplify to "Perawatannya sama seperti siput nerite pada umumnya".
Item 5: "ahli yang kompeten" is a bit stiff; "ahli yang berkualifikasi" or just "ahli" is more natural.

Item 5: "Spesimen tipe yang ditampilkan di basis data ilmiah WoRMS warna dan bentuknya lebih mirip..." has awkward syntax; add "yang" or "dalam hal", e.g. "...dari segi warna dan bentuk lebih mirip...".
Item 5: "Semua V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang" should read "Semua siput V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang (puncak cangkangnya hilang)" for clarity.

wallago-attu.name: Ikan Tapah
notes: Item 15: "terhadap pemancing yang menanganinya dengan kasar saat ikan ini dipegang" – 'nasty anglers' is rendered as handling roughly and is redundant; use e.g. "terhadap pemancing yang menangkapnya/memegangnya" without inventing 'dengan kasar'.
Item 10: "lancefish (sejenis ikan sand eel)" adds an explanation not in the source and is questionable; use "ikan lancefish/sand eel" or a plain local term, and drop the added gloss.
Item 3: "profilnya menggolongkannya" is a literal rendering of 'the profile treats it as'; use neutral wording, e.g. "ikan ini dianggap sebagai ikan yang benar-benar berbahaya".

Item 2/3/15: "lele" for Wallago catfish is acceptable, but "Helicopter catfish" is better given as a trade name with a local gloss, e.g. "lele helikopter (helicopter catfish)"; in Indonesia the fish is also known as tapah/ikan tapa.

wallago-leerii.name: Tapah
notes: #8 "ikan teman yang lebih besar" is awkward; use "ikan penghuni lain yang lebih besar" or "ikan sekandang".
#7 "daging mamalia atau unggas" adds "unggas" to the source's "mammals" (chicken is a bird). The meaning is fine, but it departs slightly from the original.
#7 "predator sejati" is a bit stronger than "highly predatory"; "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa agresif" is closer.
#11 "(yaitu ukuran yang laku dijual)": "ie." is better rendered "yakni" or "artinya". The phrasing is slightly clumsy.

xenentodon-canciloides.name: Ikan Todak
notes: Item 12: "Volume: ~648 litres" was kept as in the English. 180 × 60 × 30 cm is only about 324 L, so the figure is wrong in the source. Check or flag it rather than copying it.
Item 13: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is narrower than "biologically immature set-ups". Use "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)".
Item 19: "Kebanyakan spesies masuk ke genus Tylosurus dan Strongylura yang relatif beragam" is ambiguous. Say that most species belong to the relatively diverse genera Tylosurus and Strongylura.
Item 8: "dengan gigi yang membingungkan" is a stiff rendering of "disconcerting teeth". Consider "bergigi aneh/mengherankan".
Item 9 and item 16: "ternyata cukup damai" does not convey "surprisingly peaceful" well. Use "mengejutkan damainya" or "anehnya damai".
Item 16: "kalah bersaing saat berebut makan" adds "saat berebut makan", which the English does not say. Use "pesaing yang lemah".
Item 15: "sulit diajari makan pakan mati" is acceptable, but "sulit dibiasakan" is more natural for "wean".
Item 5: "ikan todak" for needlefish is fine. Item 3: "gerombolan" is less common than "kelompok" or "sekawanan" for a school of fish.

xiphophorus-hellerii.name: Ikan Pedang
notes: Item 1: 'bentuk ikan hias yang membingungkan saking beragamnya' is awkward and over-translates 'bewildering array'; use 'beragam bentuk ikan hias yang sulit dihitung'.
Item 3: 'garis tengah lateral' for 'mid-lateral stripe' is confusing; 'dusky' rendered as 'gelap' is fine, but write 'garis lateral tengah' and 'garis kemerahan di atas dan di bawah garis tersebut'.

Item 19: 'posisi sirip dada lebih ke atas' for 'dorsal position of the pectoral fin' is okay, but 'tubuhnya berbentuk torpedo (fusiform)' adds 'torpedo' not in source; use 'berbentuk fusiform (ramping memanjang)'.

Item 26: 'Watak' for 'Temper' and 'Pilihan yang disarankan: platy' lose 'southern platyfish' (Xiphophorus maculatus); 'cupang (Betta)' is fine but 'Kekurangan pakan' fine. Name 'southern platy' rather than plain 'platy'.

Item 27: 'jantan "bongsor"' for 'real bulls' and 'peternak' for breeders; 'early/late males' rendered as 'jantan cepat/lambat' is non-standard; use 'jantan dewasa dini (early) dan lambat (late)' consistently and 'pembiak' instead of 'peternak'.
Item 31: source text is truncated ('sneakers',' and 'for months,'); the Indonesian mirrors it, but ensure the sentence is completed/ consistent with the source.

Item 33: 'memijahkan' is used for livebearers, which do not spawn; use 'mengawinkan' or 'membiakkan'. Also 'melahirkan sampai 9 kali berturut-turut' for 9 broods is fine, but 'mikroworm' and 'blackworm' should be 'cacing mikro' and 'cacing hitam'.
Item 36: 'Sumber aslinya menyebutkan' still references the source page, contrary to the neutral-writing rule; rephrase to 'Ada keterangan yang menyebut ... namun itu keliru'.
Item 2/13: 'Harapan hidup' for 'Life expectancy' is acceptable, but 'Area berenang' is nonstandard; use 'Lapisan air' or 'Zona berenang'.
Item 12: 'ukuran alas' conveys 'surface dimensions' ok; but 'kutu air' for Daphnia (item 21, 23) is better as 'daphnia' to avoid confusion with other pests.

xiphophorus-maculatus.name: Platy
notes: Item 3: 'Nitrat: kurang dari 60' — unit (mg/L) missing in the source too, but the Indonesian gives no unit; add 'mg/L' only if the source had it, otherwise fine.
Item 25 Mating: 'Bila betina kawin dengan lebih dari satu jantan, biasanya kedua jantan sama-sama menjadi ayah' — 'kedua jantan' presumes exactly two males; use 'semua jantan tersebut'.
Item 25 Mating: 'saat ada jantan lain maupun saat tidak ada predator' — fine in meaning, but 'Pendekatan jantan (rayuan)' is awkward; use 'pacaran/rayuan jantan'.
Item 25 Incubation: 'para ilmuwan belum memiliki penjelasannya' is OK; but the heading 'Masa kehamilan' for 'Incubation' is acceptable. 'Betina tidak selalu mau kawin' is OK.
Item 20: 'Clown killifish', 'Garra panda' and 'Corydoras pygmy' are left or half-translated inconsistently; use 'Corydoras pygmy/kerdil' and a consistent common name for each.
Item 20: 'Lobster air tawar' for crayfish is acceptable, but 'Sebagian besar lobster air tawar' should say 'crayfish (lobster air tawar)' to avoid confusion.
Item 20: 'Perilaku teritorial baru dilaporkan pada satu poeciliid saja' — 'baru' adds a temporal nuance ('only so far'); use 'hanya dilaporkan pada satu poeciliid'.
Item 20: 'membutuhkan parameter air yang sama' — source says 'the same water parameters' (tank mates having); use 'memiliki kebutuhan parameter air yang sama'.
Item 15: 'Ikan ini lebih suka air sadah' repeated 'Ikan ini' — minor; also 'Ikan ini bisa hidup di air apa pun' is a loose rendering but meaning is intact.
Item 8: 'sungai kecil dan sungai' is clumsy; use 'anak sungai dan sungai'.

yasuhikotakia-modesta.name: Botia Modesta
notes: Item 10: 'all botias are somewhat sensitive to the spot disease ... but tolerate medication against it only poorly' is rendered 'namun kurang tahan terhadap obat'. This is acceptable, but 'Ichthyophtirius' and the inserted '(white spot, ...)' are fine, so no change is needed here.

Item 17: 'Ambastaia ... dua spesies yang dulu pernah menjadi anggota Botia maupun Yasuhikotakia' is fine, but 'Ada varian ... The former name' is mistranslated. The English 'The former name' refers to 'blue fin', but the English text itself is ambiguous. The translation adds 'Nama 'blue fin''. This is acceptable.
Item 17: 'ikan ... juga membayangi'. 'Shadowing' is left in English, with 'membayangi' used inconsistently. Add a Indonesian gloss or keep the term consistent.
Item 17: 'Pertunjukan seperti ini' for 'Such displays' is awkward. Use 'Perilaku unjuk diri seperti ini'.
Item 13: 'Beberapa loach dari famili Cobitidae dan Nemacheilidae' alters 'cobitid and nemacheilid loaches'. This is acceptable.
Item 13: 'That said they seemingly require regular contact' is rendered 'Bagaimanapun'. This is minor, but 'Selain itu' fits the flow better.
Item 3: The first sentence is duplicated in the source, and the translation keeps both. This is faithful.

Item 16: 'Anakan memiliki serangkaian garis vertikal gelap' changes 'They have' to 'Anakan'. This is an addition that is not in the source, since the English says 'They' and implies juveniles. It is plausible, but flag it.
Item 11: 'cacing sutra' for Tubifex is fine. 'moluska obligat' for 'obligate molluscivores' loses the meaning 'pemakan moluska obligat'. Use 'pemakan moluska obligat'.
Item 8: 'kerikil halus yang licin' for 'pebbles' repeats 'kerikil halus' (fine gravel) from the preceding clause. Use 'kerikil' or 'batu kali kecil' for pebbles.
